dance.q: Shambhu Maharaj was the famous guru of which of the following Kathak gharana?
dance.solution: Pandit Shambhu Maharaj, Lucknow Gharana ke 'Kalka-Bindadin' khandaan se talluk rakhte the. Inhe 1956 me Sangeet Natak Akademi Award aur 1958 me Padma Shri se nawaza gaya tha. Ye Thumri gayaki aur bhav batane me mahir the. Yaad rakho: Maharaj surname wale zyadatar kalakar (Birju, Shambhu, Lachhu) Lucknow gharana se jude hote hain.
why: GALAT ✗ – Banaras Gharana (Janakiprasad Gharana) apni 'Natwari' aur 'Tatkar' (footwork) ki shuddhata ke liye jana jata hai, jisme Sitara Devi ek pramukh naam hain. Shambhu Maharaj isse nahi jude the.

GALAT ✗ – Jaipur Gharana apne tez chakkar aur kathin layakari (rhythm) ke liye mashhur hai, jiske pramukh kalakar Gopi Krishna aur Durga Lal hain. Is gharane ka focus nritya ke 'tandav' paksh par zyada hota hai.
SAHI ✓ – Shambhu Maharaj Lucknow gharane ke diggaj kalakar the. Ye gharana apne nazakat, 'Abhinaya' aur 'Bhava' (expressions) ke liye vishwa-prasiddha hai.
GALAT ✗ – Raigarh Gharana Chhattisgarh ke Raja Chakradhar Singh dwara sthapit kiya gaya tha. Ye gharana Lucknow aur Jaipur shailiyon ka ek sundar mishran hai, par Shambhu Maharaj yahan ke nahi the.

dance.q: Natwari dance belongs to which dance style?
dance.solution: Kathak ko 'Natwari Nritya' isliye kaha jata hai kyunki ye Lord Krishna (Natwar) ki kahaniyon par adharit hai. Kathak Uttar Pradesh ka classical dance hai jisme footwork aur spins (chakkar) ka mahatva hota hai. Yaad rakho: 'Katha kahe so Kathak kahave' - jo kahani sunaye wahi Kathak hai.
why: GALAT ✗ – Kathakali Kerala ka ek dance-drama hai jisme chehre ke makeup aur 'mudras' ka prayog hota hai. Ye Natwari nahi, balki puranik kathaon (Mahabharata/Ramayana) ke yuddh aur veerta dikhane ke liye jana jata hai.
SAHI ✓ – Natwari shaili Kathak se judi hai kyunki aisa mana jata hai ki Krishna ne Kaliya naag par jo nritya kiya tha, wahi Kathak ka mool hai.
GALAT ✗ – Kuchipudi Andhra Pradesh ka dance hai jo Bhagvat Mela parampara se nikla hai. Isme 'Tarangam' (peetal ki thali par nritya) ek khaas visheshtha hai, par ise Natwari nahi kehte.
GALAT ✗ – Odissi Odisha ka nritya hai jo 'Tribhanga' posture aur 'Maharis' (temple dancers) ke liye jana jata hai. Ye Lord Jagannath ko samarpit hai, Natwari shaili ko nahi.

dance.q: Roshan kumari, Shovana Narayan, Maya Rao and kumudini Lakhia are famous _____ artists.
dance.solution: Ye sabhi mahila kalakar Kathak ko aadhunik pehchan dilane ke liye jani jati hain. Kumudini Lakhia ne 'Kadamb' school banaya, wahi Shovana Narayan ek IAS officer hone ke saath-saath Padmashri Kathak dancer bhi hain. Maya Rao ko Kathak me choreography ke liye jana jata hai. Yaad rakho: In sabhi ne Kathak ko traditional se hatkar contemporary touch diya hai.
why: SAHI ✓ – Roshan Kumari, Shovana Narayan, Maya Rao aur Kumudini Lakhia sabhi Kathak ki diggaj nartakiyaan hain jinhone is art form ko global stage par pahunchaya.
GALAT ✗ – Manipuri dance me Jhaveri behne (Darshana, Nayana, Suverna, Ranjana) aur Guru Bipin Singh mashhur hain. Isme 'Raslila' ki pradhanta hoti hai.
GALAT ✗ – Kuchipudi me Raja-Radha Reddy aur Yamini Krishnamurthy jaise naam aate hain. In kalakaron ka style Kathak se bilkul bhinn hota hai.
GALAT ✗ – Odissi me Kelucharan Mohapatra, Madhavi Mudgal aur Sonal Mansingh ka naam pramukh hai. Roshan Kumari aur Shovana Narayan isse sambandhit nahi hain.

dance.q: The sangeet Natak Akademi of India has recognized 8 dance forms of Indian classical dance. Which of the following is not included in these?
dance.solution: Sangeet Natak Akademi (SNA) ne 8 classical dances ko recognition di hai: Bharatnatyam (TN), Kathak (UP), Kuchipudi (AP), Odissi (Odisha), Kathakali (Kerala), Sattriya (Assam), Manipuri (Manipur), aur Mohiniyattam (Kerala). Halaki, Ministry of Culture 'Chhau' ko bhi 9th classical dance maanti hai, par SNA ki list me ye abhi shamil nahi hai. Yaad rakho: SNA list me sirf 8 hi hain.
why: GALAT ✗ – Sattriya Assam ka ek bhakti nritya hai jise 15th century me Mahapurush Srimanta Sankardev ne shuru kiya tha. Ye SNA ki 8 classical list me shamil hai.
GALAT ✗ – Bharatnatyam Tamil Nadu ka sabse purana classical dance hai jo 'Sadir' nritya se viksit hua hai. Ye SNA list ka hissa hai.
GALAT ✗ – Kuchipudi Andhra Pradesh ka nritya hai jo 'Vachika Abhinaya' (bolna aur naachna) ke liye jana jata hai. Ye bhi SNA ki 8 classical list me shamil hai.
SAHI ✓ – Chhau ek tribal/folk martial dance hai jo Odisha, WB aur Jharkhand me hota hai. SNA ise 'Semi-Classical' maanti hai, par ye 8 main classical dances ki list me nahi hai.

dance.q: Select the correct combination of Indian classical dances and their respective dancers.
dance.solution: Elam Endira Devi Manipur ki ek mashhur classical dancer hain jinhone Manipuri dance ko desh-videsh me failaya. Inhe 2014 me Padma Shri mila tha. Classical dance me artist aur unke state/dance ka sahi mel pehchanna exam point of view se bahut zaruri hai. Yaad rakho: Jhaveri sisters aur Elam Endira Devi Manipuri ke liye fix yaad kar lo.
why: GALAT ✗ – Guru Bipin Singh ko 'Father of Manipuri Dance' kaha jata hai, unhone Mohiniyattam nahi balki Manipuri ko punarjeevit kiya tha.
GALAT ✗ – Pandit Birju Maharaj Lucknow gharane ke Kathak ke sabse bade naam the, na ki Sattriya ke. Sattriya Assam ka dance hai jiske liye Srimanta Sankardev jane jate hain.
GALAT ✗ – Surendra Nath Jena Odissi nritya ke ek bahut bade guru aur kalakar the, unka Kuchipudi se sambandh nahi tha.
SAHI ✓ – Elam Endira Devi Manipuri dance ki ek prasiddh nartaki aur teacher hain. Ye option bilkul sahi match hai.

dance.q: Manipuri, a recognized classical dance of Manipur, is a religious and spiritual dance in which ____ god is included?
dance.solution: Manipuri dance, jise 'Jagoi' bhi kaha jata hai, Northeast India ka ek pramukh classical dance hai. Ye dance form Vaishnavism par adharit hai, jismein Raslila ki prastuti di jati hai. Isme laasya (soft movements) par zyada zor diya jata hai aur Pung (drum) ek mukhya vadya yantra hai. Yaad rakho: Jhaveri Sisters is dance ki sabse mashhoor kalakar hain.
why: SAHI ✓ – Lord Krishna aur Radha ki prem katha (Raslila) Manipuri dance ka mukhya vishay (theme) hai. Isliye ye bilkul sahi uttar hai.

GALAT ✗ – Sun God (Surya Dev) ki upasana mukhya roop se Chhath Puja ya Odissi dance ke 'Surya Upasana' bhag mein dikhti hai. Is prashn ke liye ye galat hai kyunki Manipuri Vaishnav bhakti par focus karta hai.
GALAT ✗ – Lord Nataraja (Shiva) mukhya roop se Bharatanatyam aur Kuchipudi ke aarambh mein pooje jate hain. Manipuri mein Shiv-Parvati ke 'Lai Haraoba' ka zikr hai par main theme Krishna-Radha hai.
GALAT ✗ – Goddess Lakshmi ki puja diwali ya dhanteras par hoti hai, lekin Manipuri dance ka core spiritual focus Radha-Krishna ki bhakti par kendrit hota hai.

dance.q: In Bihar, which of the following dances is performed to please Indra, the rain god, for good rainfall and good harvest?
dance.solution: Bihar ke Mithila kshetra mein 'Jhijhiya' dance ka bahut mahatva hai. Ye dance mukhya roop se Navratri/Durga Puja ke samay kiya jata hai. Isme mahilayein apne sir par ek chhidrit matka (perforated pot) rakhti hain jiske andar ek diya jalta rehta hai. Iska uddeshya bhagwan Indra ko prasann karna hota hai taaki acchi baarish aur fasal ho.
why: GALAT ✗ – Jat-Jatin Bihar ka ek lok nritya hai jo pati-patni ke beech ke nok-jhonk aur prem ko darshata hai. Ye baarish ke liye nahi balki samajik rishton par adharit hai.
SAHI ✓ – Jhijhiya hi wo dance hai jo Indra Dev ko khush karne ke liye baarish ki kamna ke sath Mithila region mein kiya jata hai.
GALAT ✗ – Jhumri Bihar ka ek lok nritya hai jo mukhya roop se विवाहित (married) mahilayon dwara kiya jata hai, ye Jharkhand mein bhi popular hai par Indra se sambandhit nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Fagua Bihar aur UP ka ek energetic dance hai jo Holi ke tyohar par mard aur auratein milkar karte hain, iska sambandh kheti ya baarish se nahi balki phalgun maas se hai.

dance.q: Select the correct match of Indian classical dance and their respective dancer :
dance.solution: Classical dancers aur unke dance forms ko yaad rakhne ke liye gharana aur unke gurus ka naam zaroori hai. Anita Ratnam Bharatnatyam ke sath-sath apne modern dance styles ke liye jaani jati hain. Pallavi Krishnan Mohiniyattam ki diggaj hain, Sharodi Saikia Sattriya ki, aur Kelucharan Mohapatra Odissi ke punaruddharak (revivalist) maane jate hain.
why: SAHI ✓ – Anita Ratnam ek prasiddh Bharatnatyam dancer hain jo Chennai se hain, unhone 'Neo-Classical' style mein bhi kaam kiya hai.
GALAT ✗ – Pallavi Krishnan Mohiniyattam ke liye jaani jati hain, na ki Manipuri ke liye. Unka yogdan Mohiniyattam ko globally popular banane mein raha hai.
GALAT ✗ – Sharodi Saikia Assam ke 'Sattriya' nritya se judi hain, na ki Kathakali se. Kathakali Kerala ka mask dance hai jabki Sattriya Assam ka classical dance hai.
GALAT ✗ – Guru Kelucharan Mohapatra 'Odissi' dance ke sabse bade naam hain, unhone hi is dance ko 20th century mein dubara zinda kiya tha, unka Mohiniyattam se lena-dena nahi hai.

dance.q: Sangeet Natak Akademi gives fellowship to eminent artists. Gopika Varma received it for Mohiniyattam, a dance form the state of ____.
dance.solution: Mohiniyattam 'Dance of the Enchantress' (jaadu karne wali ka nritya) ke naam se jana jata hai. Ye ek solo female dance hai jismein 'white and gold' border wali saree pehni jati hai. Gopika Varma ek mashhoor Mohiniyattam exponent hain jo Travancore royal family se taluq rakhti hain. Is dance mein 'Atavakul' steps aur nazuk movements mukhya hote hain.
why: GALAT ✗ – Tamil Nadu Bharatnatyam ka ghar hai, jo Bharat ka sabse purana classical dance mana jata hai. Mohiniyattam yahan ka nahi hai.
SAHI ✓ – Mohiniyattam Kerala ka ek shastriya nritya (classical dance) hai, isliye Gopika Varma ka sambandh isi rajya se hai.
GALAT ✗ – Karnataka mein Yakshagana jaisa prasiddh folk/theatre dance hai, lekin Mohiniyattam ka udgam sthal ye nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Andhra Pradesh 'Kuchipudi' dance ke liye jana jata hai, jo Siddhendra Yogi dwara shuru kiya gaya tha. Mohiniyattam Andhra ka nahi hai.

dance.q: Pandit Shambhu Maharaj is a famous dancer of _____.
dance.solution: Pandit Shambhu Maharaj Kathak ke 'Lucknow Kalka-Bindadin Gharana' ke ek mahan kalakar the. Unhe 'Abhinaya' (expressions) ka raja mana jata tha. Kathak Uttar Pradesh ka classical dance hai jismein ghungroo aur tatkar (footwork) ki bahut importance hoti hai. Shambhu Maharaj, Birju Maharaj ke chacha (uncle) the. Yaad rakho: Maharaj surname aksar Lucknow Kathak gharane se juda hota hai.
why: GALAT ✗ – Odissi Odisha ka classical dance hai jiske liye Kelucharan Mohapatra mashhoor hain. Shambhu Maharaj ka isse koi sambandh nahi hai.
SAHI ✓ – Shambhu Maharaj Kathak ke Lucknow gharana ke ek stambh (pillar) the, unhe Sangeet Natak Akademi aur Padma Shri se sammanit kiya gaya tha.
GALAT ✗ – Kuchipudi Andhra Pradesh ka dance hai. Shambhu Maharaj ne kabhi is style mein kaam nahi kiya, wo pure Kathak exponent the.
GALAT ✗ – Sattriya Assam ka dance hai jo Mahapurush Sankaradev ne shuru kiya tha. Shambhu Maharaj North India ke Kathak parampara se belong karte hain.

dance.q: Select the correct pair of Indian classical dancers of odissi style.
options: Meenazhi sundaram Pillai and Savita Shastri
dance.solution: Odissi dance Odisha ka classical dance hai jo 'Tribhanga' posture ke liye jana jata hai. Sujata Mahapatra, legendary Guru Kelucharan Mohapatra ki bahu hain aur unki legacy ko aage badha rahi hain. Madhavi Mudgal ne is dance ko international level par pehchan dilayi hai. Dono hi Sangeet Natak Akademi awardee hain. Yaad rakho: 'Mahapatra' surname aksar Odissi se juda hota hai.
why: GALAT ✗ – Meenazhi Sundaram Pillai Bharatnatyam ke Pandanallur gharane ke mahan guru the aur Savita Shastri bhi Bharatnatyam se judi hain. Isliye ye Odissi pair nahi hai.
SAHI ✓ – Sujata Mahapatra aur Madhavi Mudgal dono hi Odissi ki prasiddh nartaki hain, jinhone is art form ko global stage par promote kiya hai.
GALAT ✗ – Mallika Sarabhai Bharatnatyam aur Kuchipudi ki expert hain, wahi Shobha Naidu Kuchipudi ki mahan kalakar thi. Inka sambandh Odissi se nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Amala Shankar Uday Shankar style (fusion) ki dancer thi aur Singhjit Singh Manipuri dance ke mahan guru hain. Ye pair Odissi se mel nahi khata.

dance.q: Darshana Jhavere and Devjani Chaliha are most famous for their contribution to which style of Indian dance?
dance.solution: Manipuri dance (Jagoi) Vaishnavism par adharit hai, jisme Radha-Krishna ki 'Raasleela' dikhayi jati hai. Jhaveri Sisters (Darshana, Nayana, Suverna, aur Ranjana) ne is dance ko revive kiya tha. Devjani Chaliha bhi iski prasiddh exponent hain. Isme 'Pung' (drum) ka prayog hota hai. Yaad rakho: Jhaveri Sisters ka naam aate hi Manipuri tick kar dena.
why: GALAT ✗ – Kuchipudi Andhra Pradesh ka dance hai jisme 'Tarangam' (thali par dance) hota hai. Darshana aur Devjani is style se nahi judi hain.
SAHI ✓ – Darshana Jhaveri aur Devjani Chaliha Manipuri dance ki diggaj kalakar hain, jinhone is soft aur graceful dance form ko duniya bhar me sikhaya hai.
GALAT ✗ – Kathak Uttar Pradesh ka shastriya nritya hai jo 'Tatkar' (footwork) ke liye jana jata hai. In kalakaro ka sambandh Kathak se nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Bharatnatyam Tamil Nadu ka hai jo 'Abhinaya Darpana' par adharit hai. Devjani aur Darshana isse talluq nahi rakhti.

dance.q: Which of the following classical dance styles is depicted on the Gopuram of chidambaram Temple?
dance.solution: Chidambaram Temple (Tamil Nadu) Lord Shiva (Nataraja) ko samarpit hai. Iske Gopuram (entrance tower) par Bharatnatyam ki 108 'Karanas' (mudras) ko pathar par utara gaya hai. Ye dikhata hai ki ye nritya kitna prachin hai. Yaad rakho: Chidambaram ya Thanjavur temple ka naam aye to Bharatnatyam hi answer hoga.
why: SAHI ✓ – Bharatnatyam ki vibhinn mudrayen Chidambaram mandir ke gopuram par bani hui hain, jo is dance form ke shastriya hone ka praman deti hain.
GALAT ✗ – Mohiniyattam Kerala ka 'Dance of the Enchantress' hai. Iska varnan Tamil Nadu ke Chidambaram mandir ki nakashi me mukhya roop se nahi milta.
GALAT ✗ – Kathak North India ka dance hai aur iski vikas yatra mandiro se darbaron tak hui, par Chidambaram gopuram par iska depiction nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Kuchipudi Andhra ka hai. Halanki ye Bharatnatyam se milta-julta hai, par Chidambaram ki murtiyan mukhya roop se Bharatnatyam postures dikhati hain.

dance.q: Bagurumba is the folk dance of which tribe of Assam?
dance.solution: Bagurumba Assam ka ek behad sundar folk dance hai jo 'Butterfly dance' ke naam se bhi jana jata hai kyunki isme dancers titliyo ki tarah hath hilate hain. Ye Bodo samaj ki mahilayein spring season (Bwisagu festival) ke waqt karti hain. Yaad rakho: 'B' se Bagurumba aur 'B' se Bodo tribe.
why: GALAT ✗ – Miri (Mishing) tribe Assam ki hai jo 'Ali-Aye-Ligang' festival manati hai, par Bagurumba inka mukhya nritya nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Kachari ek bada ethnic group hai, par specific 'Bagurumba' identity Bodo tribe ke sath hi judi hui hai.
GALAT ✗ – Rabha tribe ka apna 'Baikho' festival hota hai. Bagurumba unka traditional folk dance nahi hai.
SAHI ✓ – Bagurumba mukhya roop se Bodo tribe dwara kiya jane wala prakriti-centric dance hai, jo Assam ki sanskritik pehchan hai.

dance.q: Guru Vempati ChinnaSatyam, awarded with Padma Bhushan award, is known for his efforts to give classical status to which of the following dance style?
dance.solution: Vempati Chinna Satyam ne Kuchipudi ko ek naya jeevan diya. Unhone Chennai me 'Kuchipudi Art Academy' kholi aur is dance form ko systematize kiya takki ise 'Classical Status' mil sake. Unhe Padma Bhushan se sammanit kiya gaya tha. Yaad rakho: Kuchipudi ko modern pehchan dilane ka credit 'Vempati' sir ko jata hai.
why: GALAT ✗ – Odissi ko revive karne me Guru Kelucharan Mohapatra aur Pankaj Charan Das ka hath tha, Vempati Chinna Satyam ka nahi.
SAHI ✓ – Guru Vempati Chinna Satyam ne Kuchipudi ko uske raw village form se nikal kar ek sophisticated classical dance banaya aur duniya bhar me failaya.
GALAT ✗ – Kathakali Kerala ka mask dance hai. Iske punaruddhar ke liye Vallathol Narayana Menon aur Guru Kunchu Kurup jane jate hain.
GALAT ✗ – Manipuri dance ke liye Jhaveri sisters aur Guru Bipin Singh mashhoor hain. Vempati Chinna Satyam isse nahi jude hain.

dance.q: The Rathwas, who are the inhabitants of _____ state, perform the Rathwa dance on the occasion of Holi (festival of colours).
dance.solution: Rathwa ni Gher dance Gujarat ki Rathwa tribe dwara Holi ke mauke par kiya jata hai. Ye log 'Pithora' painting ke liye bhi mashhoor hain. Is dance mein male dancers colorful kapde aur ghungroo bandhte hain. Yaad rakho: Gujarat ke Chhota Udepur aur Panchmahal districts mein ye sabse zyada popular hai. Rathwa tribe 'Baba Dev' ko apna bhagwan manti hai.
why: GALAT ✗ – Andhra Pradesh apne Kuchipudi aur Lambadi dance ke liye jana jata hai, naaki Rathwa dance ke liye. Is prashn ke context mein ye galat hai kyunki Rathwa tribe yahan ki mool niwasi nahi hai.
SAHI ✓ – Gujarat ki Rathwa tribe Holi (Kwant mela) ke samay ye shandaar dance karti hai. Isme 'Gher' ghumne ki parampara hai isliye ise Rathwa ni Gher kehte hain.
GALAT ✗ – Telangana mein Perini Shivatandavam aur Bonalu jaise festivals/dances hote hain. Rathwas ka sambandh is state se nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Maharashtra mein Lavani aur Dhangari Gaja mashhoor hain. Rathwa tribe specifically Gujarat ke eastern belt se belong karti hai.

dance.q: was a great figure of the Kathak dance form, described by Rabindranath Tagore as 'Nritya Samragini' (Empress of Dance)
dance.solution: Sitara Devi Kathak ki ek mahan kalakar thi jinhone 16 saal ki umra mein Rabindranath Tagore ke saamne perform kiya tha. Tagore unke dance se itne prabhavit huye ki unhe 'Nritya Samragini' ki upadhi di. Wo Banaras aur Raigarh Gharana se talluk rakhti thi. Yaad rakho: Unhe 'Sangeet Natak Akademi Award' aur 'Padma Shree' se bhi nawaza gaya hai.
why: SAHI ✓ – Sitara Devi hi wo Kathak dancer hain jinhe Rabindranath Tagore ne 'Nritya Samragini' yaani Empress of Dance kaha tha.
GALAT ✗ – Mallika Sarabhai ek mahan Bharatanatyam aur Kuchipudi dancer hain aur Vikram Sarabhai ki beti hain. Unhe Tagore ne ye title nahi diya tha.
GALAT ✗ – Rukmini Devi Arundale ne Bharatanatyam ko punarjeevit (revive) kiya tha aur wo Rajya Sabha mein nominate hone wali pehli dancer thi.
GALAT ✗ – Mrinalini Sarabhai Bharatanatyam aur Kathakali ki expert thi aur Darpana Academy ki founder thi. Inka Kathak se mukhya nata nahi tha.

dance.q: As of August 2021, how many classical dance styles in India were officially recognized by the sangeet Natak Akademi?
dance.solution: Sangeet Natak Akademi (SNA) ke anusar Bharat mein 8 Classical Dances hain. Halanki, Ministry of Culture 'Chhau' ko bhi classical manti hai (jis se total 9 ho jate hain), lekin SNA sirf 8 ko hi recognize karta hai. Ye 8 hain: Bharatnatyam, Kathak, Kathakali, Kuchipudi, Manipuri, Mohiniyattam, Odissi, aur Sattriya. Yaad rakho: Sattriya (Assam) sabse naya (2000 mein) add kiya gaya classical dance hai.
why: SAHI ✓ – Sangeet Natak Akademi sirf 8 dance forms ko classical maanti hai. Exam mein agar SNA pucha jaye toh 8 hi sahi answer hoga.
GALAT ✗ – 6 ki sankhya kisi bhi official recognition se mel nahi khati. Pehle dances kam the par ab 8 ho chuke hain.
GALAT ✗ – 9 classical dances Ministry of Culture ke hisaab se hain (Chhau ko milakar), lekin Sangeet Natak Akademi ke hisaab se ye galat hai.
GALAT ✗ – 7 ki sankhya galat hai kyunki Sattriya ke judne ke baad ye count 8 ho gaya tha.

dance.q: Songi Mukhawate dance of _____ celebrates the victory of truth over falsehood. The dance kates its name from the two lion masks worm by the two dances representing Narsimha, a progency of Lord Vishnu.
dance.solution: Songi Mukhawate Maharashtra ke Nashik aur aas-paas ke ilakon ka lok nritya (folk dance) hai. Ye Chaitra Purnima par kiya jata hai. Isme do dancers Lord Vishnu ke 'Narsimha' avatar ke sher wale mukhote (masks) pehenkar dance karte hain, jo burayi par acchayi ki jeet dikhata hai. Yaad rakho: Sambal aur Dhol is dance ke mukhya vadya yantra (instruments) hain.
why: GALAT ✗ – Gujarat mein Garba aur Tippani mashhoor hain, lekin Songi Mukhawate wahan ka paramparik dance nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Madhya Pradesh mein Matki aur Jawara dances hote hain. Narsimha mask wala ye specific 'Songi' dance yahan nahi hota.
SAHI ✓ – Maharashtra mein hi ye mukhote wala dance 'Songi Mukhawate' perform kiya jata hai, jo Lord Narsimha ko dedicate hai.
GALAT ✗ – Jharkhand mein Chhau aur Seraikella dances hote hain jisme masks use hote hain, par Songi Mukhawate Maharashtra ka hai.

dance.q: Mukteshwar dance festival is organized from 14 to 16 January at Mukteshwar temple in the state of _____.
dance.solution: Mukteshwar Dance Festival Odisha ke Bhubaneswar mein sthit 10th-century ke 'Mukteshwar Temple' ke aangan mein hota hai. Ye festival Odissi dance ki khubsurti ko dikhane ke liye har saal January mein manaya jata hai. Is temple ko 'Gem of Odisha Architecture' bhi kaha jata hai. Yaad rakho: Odisha mein Konark Dance Festival aur Raja Parba bhi bahut famous hain.
why: GALAT ✗ – Himachal Pradesh mein Kullu Dussehra aur Nati dance famous hai. Mukteshwar mandir Odisha mein hai, Himachal mein nahi.
SAHI ✓ – Odisha ke Bhubaneswar mein hi Mukteshwar temple hai jahan har saal ye classical dance festival organize hota hai.
GALAT ✗ – Uttarakhand mein Mukteshwar naam ki jagah zaroor hai, lekin ye specific 'Dance Festival' Odisha ke mandir mein hota hai.
GALAT ✗ – Madhya Pradesh mein Khajuraho Dance Festival hota hai, jo kafi famous hai, par Mukteshwar festival yahan nahi hota.

dance.q: Identify the wrong pair of dance and related dance style among the following. <table> <tr><th></th><th></th></tr> <tr><td>
dance.solution: Kumkum Dhar Kathak ki ek bahut famous exponent hain jo Lucknow Gharana se belong karti hain. Unhe 2022 mein Sangeet Natak Akademi Award se sammanit kiya gaya tha. Shruti Bandopadhyay Manipuri ki scholar aur performer hain, Trilochan Mohanta Mayurbhanj Chhau ke bade naam hain, aur Meenakshi Chitharanjan Pandanallur style Bharatnatyam ki expert hain. Yaad rakho: 'Kumkum' naam aksar Kathak se juda hota hai (Jaise Kumkum Mohanty Odissi ki hain, par Kumkum Dhar Kathak ki).
why: GALAT ✗ – Kumkum Dhar Lucknow se hain aur Kathak ki mahir kalakar hain, unka sambandh Kuchipudi se nahi hai. Isliye ye pair galat match kiya gaya hai.
GALAT ✗ – Shruti Bandopadhyay ek prashisht Manipuri nritya ki kalakar aur Professor hain. Ye pair bilkul sahi match hai, isliye answer nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Trilochan Mohanta Chhau (visheshkar Mayurbhanj style) ke ek pratishthit guru hain. Ye pair sahi hai, isliye answer nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Meenakshi Chitharanjan Bharatnatyam ki ek mashhoor nartaki aur guru hain. Ye pair bhi sahi match hai, isliye answer nahi hai.

dance.q: Lebang Boomani dance is a harvest dance of ____ state.
dance.solution: Lebang Boomani Tripura ka ek lok nritya (folk dance) hai jo 'Harvest Season' (fasal ki katai) ke baad kiya jata hai. Isme log bamboos ka use karke 'Lebang' naam ke insects ko pakadne ka acting karte hain, jo fasalo ko nuksan pahunchate hain. Isme Goria dance ke instruments jaise Khamb aur flute ka prayog hota hai. Yaad rakho: Tripura = Lebang (Bamboo/Insect dance).
why: GALAT ✗ – Mizoram apne 'Cheraw' (Bamboo dance) aur 'Khuallam' ke liye jana jata hai. Lebang Boomani yahan ka nritya nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Meghalaya mein 'Wangala' (100 drums festival) aur 'Nongkrem' jaise harvest festivals hote hain. Lebang Boomani yahan se nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Assam mein Bihu aur Bagurumba jaise harvest dances hote hain jo pure desh mein prashidh hain. Lebang Boomani yahan ka nahi hai.
SAHI ✓ – Lebang Boomani Tripura ki Tripuri tribe dwara kiya jane wala harvest dance hai. Isme bamboo sticks ka use insects ko bhagane ke liye kiya jata hai.

dance.q: Mahari Dance and Gotipua dance are related to which of the following states?
dance.solution: Mahari aur Gotipua dono hi Odissi dance ke purvaj (ancestors) mane jate hain. Mahari nritya Puri ke Jagannath temple mein 'Devdasis' (Maharis) dwara kiya jata tha. Gotipua mein chhote ladke ladkiyon ki tarah sajkar acrobatic postures banate hain. Inhi dono styles ko mila kar modern Odissi ka punarudhaar (revival) hua. Yaad rakho: Jagannath Puri = Odisha = Mahari & Gotipua.
why: GALAT ✗ – Bihar mein Jat-Jatin aur Bideshiya jaise lok nritya mashhoor hain. Mahari aur Gotipua ka sambandh Bihar se nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Uttar Pradesh Kathak aur Nautanki ke liye jana jata hai. Mahari aur Gotipua yahan ke mandiro se sambandhit nahi hain.
GALAT ✗ – Haryana mein Phag aur Loor jaise folk dances hote hain. Yahan Odissi style ke Mahari/Gotipua ka koi chalan nahi hai.
SAHI ✓ – Mahari (Temple dance) aur Gotipua (Boys performing as girls) dono Odisha ke sanskritik virasat ka hissa hain aur Odissi dance ki buniyad hain.

dance.q: Which of the following dance styles is not related to Chattisgarh?
dance.solution: Chhattisgarh ke folk dances mein Panthi (Satnami community), Raut Nacha (Yadav community), aur Gedi (Stilt dance) bahut pramukh hain. Kajari asal mein ek monsoon song aur dance form hai jo Uttar Pradesh (Visheshkar Mirzapur aur Varanasi) mein 'Sawan' ke mahine mein kiya jata hai. Yaad rakho: Kajari = UP/Bihar ki baarish (Sawan).
why: GALAT ✗ – Panthi Chhattisgarh ke Satnami samuday ka sabse mahatvapurn nritya hai jo Guru Ghasidas ki jayanti par kiya jata hai. Ye Chhattisgarh se related hai.
GALAT ✗ – Raut Nacha Chhattisgarh ke Yaduvanshiyon dwara Deepawali par kiya jane wala shaurya nritya hai. Ye bhi wahan ka mukhya nritya hai.
GALAT ✗ – Gedi Chhattisgarh ka ek unique dance hai jisme nartak bamboo ke dande (stilts) par chadkar nritya karte hain. Ye Chhattisgarh se hi hai.
SAHI ✓ – Kajari Chhattisgarh ka nahi, balki Uttar Pradesh ka lok nritya/geet hai. Isliye ye Chhattisgarh se related nahi hai.

dance.q: Kalamandalam Kalyanikutty Amma is known for creating the morphological structure and ornamentation of the _____ dance form.
dance.solution: Kalamandalam Kalyanikutty Amma ko 'Mother of Mohiniyattam' kaha jata hai. Unhone hi is dance form ko ek systematic structure diya aur ise vilupt hone se bachaya. Mohiniyattam Kerala ka classical dance hai jo sirf mahilayon dwara kiya jata hai (Lasya aspect). Isme 'White and Gold' saree pehni jati hai. Yaad rakho: Kalyanikutty Amma = Mohiniyattam ki Maa.
why: GALAT ✗ – Kathakali Kerala ka hi dance hai par ye 'Male-dominated' aur mask/heavy makeup wala dance hai. Kalyanikutty Amma isse nahi judi hain.
GALAT ✗ – Bharatnatyam Tamil Nadu ka classical dance hai. Halaki iska base 'Natyashastra' hai, par Amma ka yogdan Mohiniyattam mein hai.
SAHI ✓ – Kalamandalam Kalyanikutty Amma ne Mohiniyattam ko uska vartaman swaroop, ornamentation aur morphological structure pradan kiya hai.
GALAT ✗ – Kuchipudi Andhra Pradesh ka classical dance hai. Kalyanikutty Amma ka karyakshetra Kerala aur Mohiniyattam hi raha hai.

dance.q: Panthi dance form is associated with _________ state of India.
dance.solution: Panthi Chhattisgarh ka ek bahut hi pavitra folk dance hai, jo Satnami community dwara Guru Ghasidas ki jayanti par kiya jata hai. Is dance mein dancers 'Aughi' aur 'Mridang' jaise instruments ka use karte hain aur acrobatic stunts dikhate hain. Guru Ghasidas ne 18th/19th century mein Satnami sect ki sthapna ki thi. Yaad rakho: 'Panthi' se 'Path' (rasta) aur Guru Ghasidas ka satya ka rasta.
why: GALAT ✗ – Maharashtra apne Lavani, Lezim aur Koli dances ke liye prasiddh hai, jo Ganesh Chaturthi aur harvesting ke waqt hote hain. Is prashn ke liye ye sahi nahi hai kyunki Panthi yahan ka nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Kerala Kathakali aur Mohiniyattam jaise classical dances ke liye jana jata hai, wahan Kaikottikali jaise folk dances hote hain. Is prashn ke liye ye galat hai.
SAHI ✓ – Chhattisgarh mein Satnami samaj ke log Panthi dance karte hain. Ye dance Guru Ghasidas ki shikshao aur spiritual devotion par based hota hai, isliye ye sahi uttar hai.
GALAT ✗ – Punjab apne energetic Bhangra aur Giddha ke liye world famous hai, jo Baisakhi jaise tyoharo par kiye jate hain. Is prashn ke context mein ye match nahi karta.

dance.q: Which of the following dances is a folk dance of Jammu and kashmir, India?
dance.solution: Rouf (ya Rauf) Jammu & Kashmir ki Muslim women dwara Eid aur spring season (Ramzan ke baad) mein kiya jane wala sunder dance hai. Isme mahilayein do katar (rows) mein khadi hokar ek dusre ke kandhe par hath rakhkar chalti hain. J&K ke dusre dances 'Damhal' (Watal tribe) aur 'Hikat' hain. Yaad rakho: 'Rauf' mein 'Roof' (chhat) jaisi feeling aati hai jo pahadon (Kashmir) se connect karti hai.
why: SAHI ✓ – Rouf Jammu & Kashmir ka sabse popular folk dance hai jo wahan ki mahilayon dwara kiya jata hai, isliye ye sahi option hai.
GALAT ✗ – Bihu Assam ka sabse pramukh festival aur dance hai jo saal mein teen baar (Rongali, Kongali, Bhogali) manaya jata hai. Iska J&K se koi lena dena nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Bhangra Punjab ke purusho (men) dwara kiya jane wala high-energy harvest dance hai, jo Dhol ki thaap par hota hai. Isliye ye galat hai.
GALAT ✗ – Kathak Uttar Pradesh (North India) ka classical dance hai jisme 'Tatkars' aur 'Chakkars' ka mahatva hota hai. Ye folk dance nahi, classical dance hai.

dance.q: Which folk dance of Punjab is mainly performed by women?
dance.solution: Giddha Punjab ki ladies ka 'Bhangra' hai. Ye kafi energetic hota hai lekin isme graceful movements aur 'Boliyaan' (traditional songs) ka use hota hai. Isme mahilayein ek ghere mein khadi hokar taali (clapping) bajati hain aur ek-do mahilayein beech mein aakar perform karti hain. Yaad rakho: Giddha = Girls/Women of Punjab.
why: GALAT ✗ – Jawara Madhya Pradesh (Bundelkhand) ka harvest dance hai jisme mahilayein sar par jowar se bhari tokri rakhkar balance karti hain. Ye Punjab ka nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Dadra Uttar Pradesh ka ek semi-classical music aur dance form hai jo Lucknow ke courtesans mein kafi popular tha. Punjab se iska sambandh nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Fugdi Goa aur Maharashtra ki mahilayon dwara Konkan region mein kiya jane wala dance hai, jo aksar Ganesh Chaturthi par hota hai. Ye Punjab ka nahi hai.
SAHI ✓ – Giddha Punjab ka wo lok nritya hai jo vishesh roop se mahilayon dwara khushi ke mauko par kiya jata hai, isliye ye bilkul sahi hai.

dance.q: Janaki Prasad to which gharana of Kathak?
dance.solution: Janaki Prasad Kathak ke Banaras Gharana ke sansthapak (founder) mane jate hain. Banaras Gharana apne shuddh (pure) Kathak movements aur 'Natwari Nritya' ke liye jana jata hai, jisme Table ke bajaye Pakhawaj ke bol par zyada dhyan diya jata hai. Janaki Prasad Varanasi ke rehne wale the. Yaad rakho: Janaki (Sita ji) ka rishta Banaras/UP ke pavitra shehron se hai.
why: SAHI ✓ – Janaki Prasad ne Banaras Gharana ki neev rakhi thi, jo Kathak ka ek pramukh school hai. Isliye ye sahi uttar hai.
GALAT ✗ – Lucknow Gharana Nawab Wajid Ali Shah ke sanrakshan mein phala-phoola aur iske sabse bade kalakar Pt. Birju Maharaj rahe hain. Janaki Prasad isse nahi jude the.
GALAT ✗ – Raigarh Gharana Chhattisgarh ke Raja Chakradhar Singh ne develop kiya tha, jo Kathak ke vibhinn gharano ka mishran hai. Ye Janaki Prasad se sambandhit nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Jaipur Gharana apne fast footwork (tatkar) aur chakkars ke liye jana jata hai aur iske pravartak Bhanu Ji the. Ye Janaki Prasad ka gharana nahi hai.

dance.q: Which folk dance of Rajasthan is also called 'Sapera dance'?
dance.solution: Kalbelia Rajasthan ki 'Kalbelia' tribe (jo pehle saanp pakadne ka kaam karti thi) dwara kiya jata hai. Is dance mein dancers kale rang ke poshak pehente hain aur unki movements saanp (snake) ki tarah lachili hoti hain. Ise 2010 mein UNESCO ki Representative List of Intangible Cultural Heritage mein shamil kiya gaya tha. Yaad rakho: Kalbelia = Kaala (Black dress) + Belia (Snake charmers).
why: SAHI ✓ – Kalbelia ko hi 'Sapera Dance' kaha jata hai kyunki ye snake-charmer community ka dance hai aur isme Been instrument ka prayog hota hai.
GALAT ✗ – Chari dance Rajasthan ki Gujjar community karti hai, jisme sar par jalti hui chhari (pot) rakhkar balance kiya jata hai. Ise sapera dance nahi kehte.
GALAT ✗ – Gair dance Rajasthan ki Bhil community dwara kiya jata hai, jisme purush dande (sticks) lekar ek ghere mein naachte hain. Ye sapera dance nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Ghoomer Rajasthan ka sabse famous state dance hai jo Bhil tribe ne shuru kiya tha aur baad mein Rajput queens ne apnaya. Isme 'Ghoomna' main hota hai, saanp ki mudrayein nahi.

dance.q: Who among the following has been honoured as ''Queen of Thumri''.
dance.solution: Girija Devi Banaras Gharana ki ek mahan shastriya gayika thi. Unhone Thumri ko puri duniya me pehchan dilayi, isliye unhe 'Appa Ji' aur 'Queen of Thumri' kaha jata hai. Unhe 2016 me Padma Vibhushan se nawaza gaya tha. Yaad rakho: Girija = Banaras = Thumri Queen.
why: GALAT ✗ – Siddheswari Devi bhi Banaras Gharana ki ek bahut badi Thumri gayika thi, unhe 'Maji' kaha jata tha. Par 'Queen of Thumri' ka khitab mukhya roop se Girija Devi ke liye prayog hota hai.
GALAT ✗ – Annapurna Devi ek mahan Surbahar (bass sitar) vadak thi aur Baba Allauddin Khan ki beti thi. Unka sambandh gayan (singing) se zyada vadan (instrumental) se tha.
GALAT ✗ – Naina Devi ek prasiddh Thumri aur Dadra gayika thi jo apni sufiyana gayaki ke liye jani jati thi. Unhe 'Queen' ka title nahi mila tha.
SAHI ✓ – Girija Devi ko hi unke asadharan yogdan ke liye 'Queen of Thumri' kaha jata hai. Wo Thumri ke saath-saath Khayal aur Dadra me bhi nipun thi.

dance.q: Gair dance is performed by ____ community of Rajasthan.
dance.solution: Gair dance Rajasthan ka ek lok nritya hai jo mukhya roop se Holi aur Janmashtami ke mauke par kiya jata hai. Isme purush dande (sticks) lekar ek ghere (circle) me nritya karte hain. Ye Bheel aur Meena dono samudayo dwara kiya jata hai. Yaad rakho: Gair = Ghera (Circle) = Bheel Tribal Dance.
why: GALAT ✗ – Gujjar samuday Rajasthan me 'Chari' nritya ke liye jana jata hai, jisme sir par jalta hua deepak rakha jata hai. Gair unka mukhya nritya nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Jat samuday mukhya roop se kheti se juda hai; halaki wo lok sangeet me ruchi rakhte hain, par Gair unka vishisht samudayik nritya nahi hai.
SAHI ✓ – Bheel samuday Rajasthan ke Mewar aur Marwar kshetra me Gair nritya ka ayojan karta hai. Isme 'Khanda' (talwar jaisa danda) ka prayog hota hai.
GALAT ✗ – Gond mukhya roop se Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh aur Telangana ki jan-jati hai. Inka mukhya nritya Karma aur Saila hai, Gair nahi.

dance.q: Kargam folk dance is related with ____ state.
dance.solution: Kargam (ya Karagattam) Tamil Nadu ka ek prachin lok nritya hai jo varsha ki devi 'Mariamman' ki pooja me kiya jata hai. Isme nartak apne sir par ek bartan (pot) ko santulit (balance) karte hain. Isme 'Naiyandi Melam' vadhya yantra ka upyog hota hai. Yaad rakho: Karagam = Kudam (Pot) = Tamil Nadu.
why: GALAT ✗ – Haryana me Jhumar, Phag aur Daph jaise nritya hote hain. Yahan sir par bartan balance karne wala Kargam nritya nahi hota.
GALAT ✗ – Rajasthan me Ghoomar aur Kalbelia jaise nritya prasiddh hain. Halaki wahan Chari me bartan hota hai, par Kargam vishisht roop se South India ka hai.
SAHI ✓ – Tamil Nadu me Kargam nritya do tarah ka hota hai: Aatta Karagam (manoranjan) aur Sakthi Karagam (dharmik).
GALAT ✗ – Assam Bihu, Bagurumba aur Sattriya nritya ke liye jana jata hai. Kargam ka Assam ki sanskriti se koi lena-dena nahi hai.

dance.q: Tanjar Balasaraswati was awarded the title of Sangeeta Kalanidhi by the Madras Music Academy in 1973 for contribution to ____ dance.
dance.solution: Tanjore Balasaraswati Bharatnatyam ki ek aisi mahan kalakar thi jinhone is dance form ko global level par pehchan dilayi. 1973 me unhe Madras Music Academy se 'Sangeeta Kalanidhi' mila, jo mukhya roop se sangeetkaro ko milta hai, par unki nritya-sangeet samajh ke liye unhe ye samman diya gaya. Yaad rakho: T. Balasaraswati = Bharatnatyam Legend.
why: GALAT ✗ – Kathak Uttar Pradesh ka nritya hai aur iske mukhya kalakar Birju Maharaj hain. Balasaraswati ka isse koi sambandh nahi tha.
GALAT ✗ – Kathakali Kerala ka ek mukhya classical dance hai jisme mukhote (masks) ka prayog hota hai. Ye purush-pradhan nritya hai.
SAHI ✓ – Balasaraswati Bharatnatyam ki 'Abhinaya' queen mani jati thi. Unhe 1977 me Padma Vibhushan se bhi sammanit kiya gaya tha.
GALAT ✗ – Mohiniyattam Kerala ka ek shaant aur laasya (feminine) nritya hai. Balasaraswati iski nahi, balki Bharatnatyam ki pratinidhi thi.

dance.q: Raja and Radha Reddy were honored with sangeet Natak Akademi Award for their contribution in ____ dance.
dance.solution: Raja Reddy aur Radha Reddy ek famous 'Dancing Couple' hain jinhone Andhra Pradesh ke Kuchipudi nritya ko antarrashtriya star par pahunchaya. Inhe 'Kuchipudi ke mukhya stambh' mana jata hai. Dono ko Padma Bhushan se bhi sammanit kiya gaya hai. Yaad rakho: Reddy Surname = Kuchipudi (Andhra Pradesh).
why: GALAT ✗ – Kathak ke liye Lucknow ya Jaipur Gharana ke kalakar (jaise Lacchu Maharaj) jane jate hain. Reddy parivar isse nahi juda hai.
GALAT ✗ – Sattriya Assam ka ek dharmik nritya hai jiske mukhya guru Srimanta Sankardev mane jate hain. Reddy parivar is shaili se nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Kathakali Kerala ka natya-nritya hai jisme mukhya roop se Kalamandalam ke kalakar prasiddh hain, Reddy parivar nahi.
SAHI ✓ – Raja-Radha Reddy ne Kuchipudi ke liye Delhi me 'Natya Tarangini' school ki sthapna ki aur is shaili me maharat hasil ki.

dance.q: Kumudini Lakhia is the exponent of ____ classical dance style?
dance.solution: Kumudini Lakhia Kathak ki ek mahan kalakar hain jinhone 'Kadamb Centre for Dance' ki sthapna Ahmedabad mein ki thi. Unhe Kathak mein modern choreography aur group coordination ke liye jaana jata hai. Unhe Padma Bhushan aur Sangeet Natak Akademi Award se sammanit kiya gaya hai. Yaad rakho: Kumudini = Kathak (K to K connection).
why: GALAT ✗ – Odissi Odisha ka classical dance hai jo Mahari aur Gotipua parampara se nikla hai. Kelucharan Mohapatra iske pramukh kalakar hain. Is prashn ke liye ye sahi nahi hai kyunki Kumudini Lakhia ka sambandh isse nahi hai.

GALAT ✗ – Sattriya Assam ka classical dance hai jise Mahapurush Srimanta Sankardev ne 15th century mein shuru kiya tha. Ye Vaishnavite monasteries (Sattras) mein hota hai. Kumudini ji isse judi nahi hain.
GALAT ✗ – Kuchipudi Andhra Pradesh ka dance hai jo 'Kuchelapuram' gaon se aaya hai. Isme 'Tarangam' (plate par dance) mashhoor hai. Kumudini ji is style ki exponent nahi hain.
SAHI ✓ – Kathak UP ka classical dance hai jo 'Kathakars' (storytellers) se bana hai. Kumudini Lakhia is gharane ki ek pioneer hain jinhone Kathak ko naye perspective diye hain.

dance.q: Sattriya dance style originated in which of the following Indian states?
dance.solution: Sattriya ko 15th century mein bhakti sant Srimanta Sankardev ne Assam mein shuru kiya tha. Ye pehle keval purushon (Bhokots) dwara Sattras mein kiya jata tha, lekin ab sab karte hain. Ise saal 2000 mein Sangeet Natak Akademi ne 'Classical Dance' ka darja diya. Yaad rakho: Assam = Sattriya (A-S connection).
why: SAHI ✓ – Sattriya Assam ke Vaishnavite maths (monasteries) se originate hua hai. Ye Bhakti movement ka ek hissa tha aur isme Borgeet ka prayog hota hai.
GALAT ✗ – Tamil Nadu Bharatnatyam ka birthplace hai jo Bharat Muni ke Natya Shastra par based hai. Sattriya ka yahan se koi lena-dena nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Uttar Pradesh Kathak ka janmasthan hai jahan Lucknow, Jaipur aur Banaras gharane phale-phoole hain. Sattriya yahan ka nahi, Assam ka hai.
GALAT ✗ – Manipur se Manipuri (Jagoi) dance aata hai jo Radha-Krishna ki Raasleela ke liye jana jata hai. Sattriya Assam ka ek alag dance form hai.

dance.q: Which dance is performed by the women of Maharastra?
dance.solution: Lavani Maharashtra ka sabse popular folk dance hai jo Dholki ki thaap par kiya jata hai. Isme mahilaye 9-yard (Nauvari) saree pehenti hain. Ye 'Tamasha' folk theatre ka ek anmol hissa hai. Yaad rakho: Maharashtra ki 'Lavanya' (beauty) = Lavani.
why: GALAT ✗ – Ghoomar Rajasthan ka folk dance hai jo Bhil tribe ne shuru kiya tha aur Rajput mahilaye ghoonghat odh kar karti hain. Isliye ye Maharashtra ka nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Bihu Assam ka harvest festival aur dance hai jo saal mein teen baar (Bhogali, Rongali, Kongali) manaya jata hai. Iska Maharashtra se sambandh nahi hai.
SAHI ✓ – Lavani Maharashtra ka traditional dance hai jo apni energetic beats aur mahilayon ki graceful movements ke liye poore India mein mashhoor hai.
GALAT ✗ – Bhangra Punjab ka ek joshila lok nritya hai jo mukhya roop se Baisakhi ke mauke par purushon dwara kiya jata hai. Iska origin Maharashtra nahi hai.

dance.q: Aditi Mangaldas is a leading dancer and dance instructor of the classical Indian dance style of _____.
dance.solution: Aditi Mangaldas Kathak ki ek modern face hain jinhone Pt. Birju Maharaj aur Kumudini Lakhia se shiksha li hai. Wo apne 'Drishtikon Dance Foundation' ke liye jani jati hain. Unka kaam tradition aur contemporary style ka mixture hai. Yaad rakho: Aditi ne 'Kathak' ko global banaya.
why: GALAT ✗ – Bharatnatyam Tamil Nadu ka hai jisme Rukmini Devi Arundale aur Padma Subrahmanyam jaise naam jude hain. Aditi ji iski dancer nahi hain.
GALAT ✗ – Kuchipudi Andhra Pradesh ka hai jo Yamini Krishnamurthy aur Raja-Radha Reddy ke liye jana jata hai. Aditi Mangaldas Kathak ki kalakar hain.
SAHI ✓ – Aditi Mangaldas Kathak ki leading dancer hain. Unhone Birju Maharaj se iski barikiya seekhi hain aur wo apni fast footwork (tatkar) ke liye jani jati hain.
GALAT ✗ – Kathakali Kerala ka dance-drama hai jisme bhari makeup aur costumes hote hain. Aditi ji Kathak (UP style) ki dancer hain, Kathakali ki nahi.

dance.q: dance is introverted and restrained compared to most other dances of India, with the performer never making direct eye contact with the audience.
dance.solution: Manipuri dance (Jagoi) apni shaant bhavnaon aur 'restrained movements' ke liye jana jata hai. Isme ghunghroo nahi pehne jate aur facial expressions bahut halkey hote hain (subdued). Dancer hamesha neeche dekhta hai aur audience se direct eye contact avoid karta hai. Yaad rakho: Manipuri = Maryada aur Shanti.
why: GALAT ✗ – Kathakali mein expressions (Rasa) bahut 'loud' aur intense hote hain. Isme aankhon ki movements (Netra Abhinaya) sabse zaroori hoti hai, isliye ye 'restrained' nahi hai.
SAHI ✓ – Manipuri dance mein 'bhakti' bhav hota hai jisme dancer sharm aur vinamrata (modesty) dikhate hue audience se aankhen nahi milata. Isme Pung (drum) ka use hota hai.
GALAT ✗ – Kuchipudi ek vivacious dance hai jisme expression aur eye contact bahut strong hote hain. Isme 'Vachika Abhinaya' (bolna) bhi shamil hota hai.
GALAT ✗ – Bharatnatyam mein 'Abhinaya' (expressions) aur 'Drishti Bheda' (eye movements) bahut clear aur direct hote hain. Ye 'introverted' style nahi hai.

dance.q: Birju Maharaj is a well known dancer of ____.
dance.solution: Birju Maharaj Kathak ke sabse bade naam the. Inka asli naam 'Brijmohan Nath Mishra' tha aur ye Lucknow ke 'Kalka-Bindadin' gharane se taluq rakhte the. Inhe 1986 mein Padma Vibhushan mila tha. Yaad rakho: Maharaj surname wale zyadatar artist Kathak (Lucknow gharana) se hote hain.
why: GALAT ✗ – Bharatnatyam Tamil Nadu ka classical dance hai, jisme Rukmini Devi Arundale aur Balasaraswati jaise naam mashhoor hain. Birju Maharaj isse jude nahi hain.
GALAT ✗ – Manipuri Manipur ka bhakti-pradhan dance hai jo Radha-Krishna ki 'Raasleela' par adharit hai. Birju Maharaj ka isse koi sambandh nahi hai.
SAHI ✓ – Kathak North India (UP) ka dance hai. Birju Maharaj iske sarvashresth kalakar aur guru rahe hain, jo apni 'Bhav Batana' aur 'Tatkar' (footwork) ke liye duniya bhar mein prasiddh the.
GALAT ✗ – Sattriya Assam ka classical dance hai jise Mahapurush Srimanta Sankardev ne shuru kiya tha. Birju Maharaj is dance form se nahi jude hain.

dance.q: Which of the following dancers is associated with odissi dance?
dance.solution: Sujata Mohapatra Odissi ki ek Diggaj nartaki hain. Ye 'Guru Kelucharan Mohapatra' ki bahu aur shishya hain. Odissi dance Odisha state ka hai aur ye 'Tribhanga' mudra ke liye jana jata hai. 2017 mein inhe Sangeet Natak Akademi Award mila tha.
why: GALAT ✗ – Shovana Narayan ek bahut prasiddh 'Kathak' dancer hain aur wo IAS officer bhi rahi hain. Unka talluq Odissi se nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Birju Maharaj Kathak ke parampitama mane jate hain (Lucknow Gharana). Unka Odissi se koi lena-dena nahi hai.
SAHI ✓ – Sujata Mohapatra Odissi ki shreshth kalakar hain. Inhone 'Srjan' dance institute ke madhyam se is kala ko aage badhaya hai.
GALAT ✗ – Rukmini Devi Arundale 'Bharatnatyam' ki punaroddharak (reviver) mani jati hain. Unhone Kalakshetra Foundation ki sthapna ki thi, Odissi ki nahi.

dance.q: The 19th century saw the golden age of Kathak under the patronage of ____ the last Nawab of Awadh.
dance.solution: Wajid Ali Shah Awadh ke aakhri Nawab the aur wo khud 'Akhtar Piya' ke naam se thumri likhte the. Unke darbar mein Kathak ko sanrakshan mila aur Lucknow Gharana apne shikhar par pahuncha. Unhone 'Rahas' (dance drama) ko bhi badhava diya.
why: GALAT ✗ – Asaf-ud-Daula ne Lucknow ka bada Imambara banwaya tha. Unke samay kala badhi par Kathak ka 'Golden Age' Wajid Ali Shah ke samay aaya.
GALAT ✗ – Siraj-ud-Daula Bengal ke Nawab the jo Battle of Plassey (1757) ke liye jane jate hain. Unka Awadh ke Kathak se sambandh nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Saadat Khan Burhan-ul-Mulk Awadh dynasty ke founder (sthapna karne wale) the. Ye shuruati daur tha, Kathak ka golden age nahi.
SAHI ✓ – Wajid Ali Shah ne Kathak ko darbar mein samman dilaya aur Thakur Prasad jaise gurus ko ashray diya, jiske karan ye 'Golden Age' ban gaya.

dance.q: Deepika Reddy is related to which of the following classical dance style?
dance.solution: Deepika Reddy Telangana se taluq rakhti hain aur Kuchipudi ki ek mashhoor nartaki hain. Kuchipudi Andhra Pradesh ka classical dance hai jisme 'Tarangam' (peetal ki thali par naachna) hota hai. Inhe 2017 mein Sangeet Natak Akademi award se nawaza gaya tha.
why: GALAT ✗ – Manipuri dance ke liye Jhaveri sisters prasiddh hain. Deepika Reddy is dance form se sambandhit nahi hain.
SAHI ✓ – Deepika Reddy ne Kuchipudi mein maharat hasil ki hai aur wo 'Deepanjali' namak dance school chalati hain.
GALAT ✗ – Kathak North India ka dance hai. Deepika Reddy South Indian classical dance (Kuchipudi) ki kalakar hain.
GALAT ✗ – Sattriya Assam ka Vaishnav dharam se juda dance hai. Deepika Reddy ka isse koi nata nahi hai.

dance.q: Which of the following dance styles is related to Assam.
dance.solution: Bihu Assam ka sabse lokpriya folk dance (lok nritya) hai jo saal mein teen baar (Rongali, Kongali, Bhogali) manaya jata hai. Ismein 'Dhol', 'Pepa' (horn instrument) aur 'Toka' ka istemal hota hai. Yaad rakho: Sattriya Assam ka classical hai aur Bihu wahan ka folk hai.
why: SAHI ✓ – Bihu Assam ka mukhya tyohar aur dance dono hai. Ye kheti (agriculture) aur ritu parivartan se juda hua hai.
GALAT ✗ – Bhangra Punjab ka ek joshila lok nritya hai jo mukhya roop se purushon dwara Baisakhi ke mauke par kiya jata hai.
GALAT ✗ – Kalbeliya Rajasthan ki ek 'Snake Charmer' community ka dance hai, jise UNESCO ki Intangible Heritage list mein shamil kiya gaya hai.
GALAT ✗ – Kathak Uttar Pradesh ka classical dance hai. Ye Assam se nahi balki North India ke mandiron aur darbaron se nikla hai.

dance.q: Gopika Verma is a classical dancer of ____.
dance.solution: Gopika Verma Mohiniyattam ki ek bahut badi dancer hain, unhe 2018 me Sangeet Natak Akademi Award mila tha. Mohiniyattam Kerala ka ek female solo dance hai jo 'Vishnu ke Mohini roop' par based hai. Isme 'Lasya' (grace) element bahut dominant hota hai aur dancers white & gold sari pehenti hain. Yaad rakho: Mohiniyattam ke main kalakar hain - Kanak Rele, Sunanda Nair, aur Gopika Verma.
why: SAHI ✓ – Gopika Verma Kerala ke Mohiniyattam dance ki prasiddh nartaki hain aur unhe 'Kerala Sangeetha Nataka Akademi Award' bhi mil chuka hai.
GALAT ✗ – Kathak North India (UP) ka dance hai, jisme footwork aur chakkars par zor hota hai. Isse Birju Maharaj aur Sitara Devi jude hain, Gopika Verma nahi.
GALAT ✗ – Manipuri Manipur ka bhakti dance hai, jo Radha-Krishna ki Raasleela par based hai. Isme Jhaveri behne (Darshana, Nayana etc.) famous hain.
GALAT ✗ – Kuchipudi Andhra Pradesh ka dance hai jisme brass plate par dance (Tarangam) hota hai. Iske pramukh kalakar Yamini Krishnamurthy aur Raja-Radha Reddy hain.

dance.q: Which of the following classical dances begins with a drumming performance called ''Kelikottu''?
dance.solution: Kathakali (Kerala) ek 'Dance Drama' hai jisme Kelikottu se shuruat hoti hai taaki audience ka dhyan khincha ja sake. Isme 'Mudrayan' aur 'Navarasas' ka prayog karke puranik kathayein (Ramayana/Mahabharata) dikhayi jati hain. Isme facial makeup (Vesham) ka bahut mahatva hai, jaise Green (Pacha) noble characters ke liye hota hai. Yaad rakho: Kelikottu = Drumming call for Kathakali.
why: GALAT ✗ – Odissi Odisha ka dance hai, jiska aarambh 'Mangalacharan' se hota hai na ki Kelikottu se. Ye Lord Jagannath ki upasana se juda hai.
GALAT ✗ – Kuchipudi Andhra ka dance hai, isme 'Soothradhara' shuruat karta hai. Kelikottu iska part nahi hai.
SAHI ✓ – Kathakali me performance se pehle 'Kelikottu' (drum beating) ki jati hai takki gaon walo ko pata chale ki natak shuru hone wala hai.
GALAT ✗ – Bharatnatyam (Tamil Nadu) ka shuruati bhag 'Alarippu' kehlata hai. Ye sabse purana classical dance hai.

dance.q: Dance couple Kamalini and Nalini Asthana have been awarded the Padma shree in 2022. They are famous for which of the following dance styles?
dance.solution: Kamalini aur Nalini Asthana 'Banaras Gharana' ki behtareen Kathak dancers hain. Inhe 2022 me Padma Shri se nawaza gaya tha. Kathak ka arth hota hai 'Katha Kahe So Kathak Kahaye'. Isme tatkar (footwork) aur padhant (bol bolna) bahut zaroori hota hai. Yaad rakho: Asthana sisters Banaras gharane se hain aur ye Lucknow gharane ke Birju Maharaj se alag style follow karti hain.
why: GALAT ✗ – Kuchipudi Andhra Pradesh ka hai. Kamalini-Nalini isse nahi balki North Indian classical dance se judi hain.
GALAT ✗ – Manipuri Manipur ka soft dance hai, jisme Pung Cholom jaisa music hota hai. Asthana sisters is style ki expert nahi hain.
SAHI ✓ – Nalini aur Kamalini Asthana Kathak ki vishwasniya jodidar hain aur unhe Kathak ko duniya bhar me promote karne ke liye Padma Shri mila hai.
GALAT ✗ – Bharatnatyam Tamil Nadu ka hai jo Sadir Attam se nikla hai. Ye dono behne is traditional dance se sambandhit nahi hain.

dance.q: Which of the following classical dance forms is related to the worship of lord Jagannath?
dance.solution: Odissi dance Odisha ke mandiro (Visheshkar Puri ka Jagannath Mandir) me 'Maharis' (devdasis) dwara shuru kiya gaya tha. Is dance me 'Tribhanga' posture (teen jagah se sharir ka mudna) sabse iconic hai. Jayadeva ki 'Gita Govinda' par ye dance sabse zyada perform hota hai. Yaad rakho: Jagannath = Odissi ka mool (base).
why: GALAT ✗ – Sattriya Assam ka dance hai jo Mahapurush Sankaradev ne Vaishnavism ke prachar ke liye banaya tha, ye Jagannath worship se direct nahi juda.
GALAT ✗ – Bharatanatyam Tamil Nadu ke mandiro (Shiva/Vishnu) se juda hai, lekin iska main deity Lord Nataraja hain.
SAHI ✓ – Odissi ki shuruat hi Lord Jagannath ki seva me hui thi, isme dancer hamesha pranam karke Jagannath ji ka aashirwad leta hai.
GALAT ✗ – Kathak North India ka hai, jisme Krishna ki leelayein dikhayi jati hain, par ye Lord Jagannath ki specific worship se origin nahi hua.

dance.q: Honored with ''Sangeet Natak Akademi Award'' Ratikant Mahapatra is known for which of the following classical dances of India?
dance.solution: Ratikant Mahapatra legendary Guru Kelucharan Mohapatra ke bete hain, jinhone Odissi ko modern time me revive kiya. Ratikant ji 'Srjan' naam ki dance academy chalate hain aur unhe Odissi me unke contribution ke liye Sangeet Natak Akademi award mila hai. Yaad rakho: Mahapatra surname aksar Odissi dance se juda hota hai (Jaise Kelucharan, Ratikant, Sujata).
why: SAHI ✓ – Ratikant Mahapatra Odissi ke ek mahan nartak, guru aur percussionist (Mardala vadak) hain.
GALAT ✗ – Manipuri dance me Singh aur Devi surnames zyada milte hain. Mahapatra gharana Odissi se talluq rakhta hai.
GALAT ✗ – Kathak Lucknow, Jaipur aur Banaras gharano me banta hai. Ratikant ji is style se nahi jude hain.
GALAT ✗ – Kathakali Kerala ka mask dance hai. Ratikant Mahapatra ka naam Odisha ki parampara se juda hai.

dance.q: Surupa sen is famous dancer.
dance.solution: Surupa Sen Odissi ki ek bahut badi dancer hain aur Bangalore ke 'Nrityagram' gurukul ki artistic director rahi hain. Odissi dance Odisha ka classical dance hai jo 'Tribhanga' posture ke liye jaana jata hai. Inhe 2018 me Sangeet Natak Akademi Award mila tha. Yaad rakho: Surupa Sen, Madhavi Mudgal aur Kelucharan Mohapatra sab Odissi se jude hain.
why: GALAT ✗ – Kathakali Kerala ka classical dance drama hai jisme bhari make-up (Vesham) aur facial expressions (Navarasas) ka prayog hota hai. Surupa Sen is style ki dancer nahi hain.
GALAT ✗ – Kathak Uttar Pradesh ka dance hai jo Lucknow aur Jaipur gharana ke liye famous hai. Isme footwork aur chakkar par focus hota hai, Surupa Sen isse judi nahi hain.
GALAT ✗ – Bharatanatyam Tamil Nadu ka sabse purana classical dance hai. Surupa Sen ne shuruat me isse seekha tha par wo pehchan Odissi ke liye rakhti hain.
SAHI ✓ – Surupa Sen Odissi ki ek internationally acclaimed dancer aur choreographer hain. Unhone is dance form ko modern twist ke sath global stage par pahuchaya hai.

dance.q: Which of the following ritual dances is performed by the kamad tribe of Madhya Pradesh?
dance.solution: Teratali dance Madhya Pradesh aur Rajasthan ki 'Kamad' tribe karti hai. Isme mahilayein sharir ke 13 alag-alag hisson par 'Manjira' (cymbals) baandhkar baithkar dance karti hain aur haathon se unhe bajati hain. Ye ek ritualistic dance hai jo aksar Baba Ramdev ji ke samman me kiya jata hai. Yaad rakho: 13 Manjira = Tera-tali.
why: GALAT ✗ – Ghapal Rajasthan ka ek folk dance hai. Ye Kamad tribe ka ritual dance nahi hai, balki general community celebrations ka hissa hai.
GALAT ✗ – Painka ya Paika Odisha aur Jharkhand ka martial folk dance hai jise munda aur dusri tribes karti hain. Isme dhal aur talwar ka prayog hota hai, ye MP ki Kamad tribe se nahi hai.
SAHI ✓ – Teratali hi wo anokha dance hai jisme Kamad tribe ki mahilayein manjiron ke saath baithkar hairat-angez movements dikhati hain.
GALAT ✗ – Munari Odisha ke Santhal tribe dwara kiya jane wala ek folk dance hai jo harvest season ke baad khushi manane ke liye hota hai. Iska MP se talluk nahi hai.

dance.q: Famous dancer yamini krishnamurthy opened Yamini school of Dance in the year 1990 in ____?
dance.solution: Munger (Bihar) me janmi Yamini Krishnamurthy Bharatanatyam aur Kuchipudi dono ki mahir dancer hain. Unhone 1990 me Delhi me 'Yamini School of Dance' khola taaki naye bachon ko ye kala sikhayi ja sake. Inhe 2016 me Padma Vibhushan se nawaza gaya hai. Yaad rakho: Yamini Krishnamurthy = Delhi school + 2 dance forms (B + K).
why: GALAT ✗ – Chennai Bharatanatyam ka gadh hai aur yahan Kalakshetra Foundation hai, lekin Yamini ji ne apna main school 1990 me yahan nahi khola tha.
GALAT ✗ – Mumbai film aur art industry ka center hai, par Yamini ji ki educational activity aur unka dance school Delhi me sthapit hai.
GALAT ✗ – Hyderabad Kuchipudi ka main center hai, par Yamini ji ne apne school ki sthapna desh ki rajdhani ko chuna tha.
SAHI ✓ – Delhi me Yamini Krishnamurthy ne 1990 me apna dance school shuru kiya tha aur tab se wo wahin rehkar classical dance ko promote kar rahi hain.

dance.q: Which of the following traditional dances is mainly performed during Navratri?
dance.solution: Garba Gujarat ka sabse popular folk dance hai jo Navratri ke 9 dinon me Maa Durga ki pooja ke roop me kiya jata hai. Isme 'Garbo' (ek mitti ka diya) bich me rakha jata hai aur uske charo taraf circular motion me dance hota hai. 2023 me UNESCO ne ise 'Intangible Cultural Heritage' ka darja diya hai. Yaad rakho: Garba = Gujarat + UNESCO list.
why: GALAT ✗ – Dumhal Jammu & Kashmir ke Wattal tribe ka dance hai jo khas moka par purushon dwara kiya jata hai. Iska Navratri se seedha sambandh nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Ras Leela UP (Mathura/Vrindavan) aur Manipur me Krishna bhakti me ki jati hai. Ye holi ya janmashtami par zyada hoti hai, sirf Navratri ka main dance nahi hai.
SAHI ✓ – Garba hi wo dance hai jo Navratri ka synonyms ban chuka hai, jise pura Gujarat aur ab pura Bharat dhoom-dhaam se manata hai.
GALAT ✗ – Nati Himachal Pradesh ka famous folk dance hai jo festivals aur mela (jaise Kullu Dussehra) par hota hai. Ye Navratri ka specific dance nahi hai.

dance.q: Which of the following dances is performed by the Santhal tribe of Jharkhand?
dance.solution: Jhinka Dasai Jharkhand aur West Bengal ki Santhal tribe ka ek parampariyak dance hai jo aksar Durga Puja ke dauran 'Dasai' festival par hota hai. Santhal tribe apne community dances jaise Paika, Golwari aur Jhinka ke liye jaani jati hai. Yaad rakho: Santhal = Jharkhand + Dasai/Paika.
why: GALAT ✗ – Kolkali Kerala aur Lakshadweep ka folk dance hai jisme dandon (sticks) ka istemal hota hai. Iska Santhal tribe se koi lena-dena nahi hai.
SAHI ✓ – Jhinka Dasai Santhal mard (men) dwara kiya jane wala ek dukh aur bhakti ka dance hai jo wo gaon-gaon jakar karte hain.
GALAT ✗ – Coli ya Koli Maharashtra ke machuaro (fishermen) ka dance hai jo samudra ki leharon ki tarah movement dikhata hai. Ye Jharkhand ka nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Ghoomar Rajasthan ka sabse famous folk dance hai jo Bhil tribe shuru kiya tha aur ab Rajput mahilayein karti hain. Santhal tribe se iska naata nahi hai.

dance.q: Mati-Akhora is related to which of the following classical dances of India?
dance.solution: Mati-Akhora Sattriya dance ki buniyad (foundation) hai. Iska shabdik arth hai 'Ground Exercises'. Isme total 64 prakar ki exercises hoti hain jo dancers ki body ko flexibility aur balance deti hain. Sattriya ko 15th century me Mahapurush Srimanta Sankardev ne shuru kiya tha aur ise 2000 me classical status mila. Yaad rakho: Sattriya = Assam + Bhakti Movement + Mati-Akhora.
why: SAHI ✓ – Sattriya Assam ka classical dance hai aur iski training 'Mati-Akhora' se hi shuru hoti hai, jo sharir ko taiyar karne ke liye zameen par ki gayi exercises hain.
GALAT ✗ – Kathakali Kerala ka dance-drama hai jo apne bhari makeup aur 'Navarasas' (facial expressions) ke liye jana jata hai. Isme Mati-Akhora jaisa term use nahi hota.
GALAT ✗ – Kathak Uttar Pradesh ka dance hai jo 'Tatkar' (footwork) aur chakkars ke liye mashhoor hai. Iska base 'Gharana' system par adharit hai.
GALAT ✗ – Odissi Odisha ka dance hai jisme 'Tribhanga' posture aur 'Chauka' position main hoti hai, Mati-Akhora iska hissa nahi hai.

dance.q: The Guru Kelucharan Mahapatra Award festival celebrated every year is named after the famous classical dancer of which of the following dance styles?
dance.solution: Guru Kelucharan Mahapatra wo shakhsiyat hain jinhone 20th century me Odissi dance ko punarjeevit (revive) kiya tha. Unhe 1999 me Padma Vibhushan mila tha. Srjan (Bhubaneswar) naam ka dance school unhi ke dwara sthapit kiya gaya hai. Exam point: Kelucharan Mahapatra 'Pakhawaj' vadya yantra bajane me bhi mahir the.
why: GALAT ✗ – Mohiniyattam Kerala ka 'Dance of the Enchantress' hai, jisme Kanak Rele aur Sunanda Nair jaise bade naam jude hain, na ki Mahapatra.
GALAT ✗ – Kuchipudi Andhra Pradesh ka dance hai jiske pramukh kalakar Vempati Chinna Satyam hain. Iska is award se seedha sambandh nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Kathak ke sabse bade naam Pandit Birju Maharaj hain. Kelucharan ji ka sambandh is North Indian classical style se nahi raha.
SAHI ✓ – Guru Kelucharan Mahapatra Odissi ke bhishma pitamah maane jaate hain. Unke samman me hi har saal ye prestigious award festival organize kiya jata hai.

dance.exam: SSC CGL (Tier-1) – 26/07/2023 (Shift-III) SSC Selection Posts XI– 28/06/2023 (Shift-I)
dance.q: Lai Haroba is the early form of which of the following classical dances of India?
dance.solution: Lai Haraoba Manipur ka ek prachin festival hai jiska matlab hai 'Merry making of the Gods'. Ye Manipuri classical dance ka adhaar (root) maana jata hai kyunki isme 'Umang Lai' (Forest Deities) ki puja aur nritya hota hai. Manipuri dance me Radha-Krishna ki 'Raaslila' aur 'Pung Cholom' sabse zyada famous hain. Yaad rakho: Lai Haraoba = Meitei community of Manipur.
why: GALAT ✗ – Mohiniyattam ki shuruaat Kerala ke mandiro me 'Devadasi' parampara se hui, iska Lai Haraoba festival se koi lena-dena nahi hai.
SAHI ✓ – Lai Haraoba hi wo purani form hai jisse viksit hokar aaj ka Manipuri classical dance bana hai, ye Meitei logo ka sabse bada tyohar hai.
GALAT ✗ – Sattriya ki shuruaat Assam ke 'Sattras' (Monasteries) me hui thi, iska Manipuri culture se direct link nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Kathakali ek temple theatre form hai jo Kerala ki hai, jabki Lai Haraoba Northeast India (Manipur) se belong karta hai.

dance.q: Guru Bipin Singh is related to which of the following dance styles?
dance.solution: Guru Bipin Singh ko 'Father of Manipuri Dance' ke roop me jana jata hai. Unhone Manipuri dance ko traditional temples se nikaal kar stage performance ke layak banaya. Unhe 1966 me Sangeet Natak Akademi Award mila tha. Unke saath 'Jhaveri Sisters' ka naam hamesha yaad rakhna, kyunki unhone unhi se training li thi. Trick: Bipin = Manipuri.
why: GALAT ✗ – Kathak me Maharaj khandaan (Birju Maharaj, Lachhu Maharaj) ka bolbala hai, Guru Bipin Singh is shaili se nahi jude hain.
GALAT ✗ – Kathakali ke liye Guru Kunchu Kurup jaise naam famous hain, Bipin Singh ka contribution yahan nahi raha.
SAHI ✓ – Guru Bipin Singh Manipuri dance ke director aur guru the. Unhone hi is dance form ko modern structure aur worldwide pehchan di.
GALAT ✗ – Odissi me Kelucharan Mahapatra aur Pankaj Charan Das ke naam aate hain, Bipin Singh ka sambandh Odissi se nahi hai.

dance.q: Khemraj received the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award for his contribution in folk music and 'kud' dance. This folk dance belongs to which state?
dance.solution: Kud dance Jammu & Kashmir ka ek lok nritya (folk dance) hai jo aksar raat ke samay khule aasmaan ke niche kiya jata hai. Isme log 'Gram Devta' ka shukriya ada karte hain achhi fasal ke liye. Isme 'Flute' aur 'Drum' ka upyog hota hai. Khemraj ko isme unke yogdan ke liye Sangeet Natak Akademi se sammanit kiya gaya hai. Yaad rakho: Kud = J&K + Night dance.
why: GALAT ✗ – Punjab ke pramukh dance Bhangra aur Giddha hain. Kud yahan ka dance nahi hai, isliye ye option sahi nahi hai.
SAHI ✓ – Kud Jammu & Kashmir ke pahadi ilako ka ek ritualistic folk dance hai, aur Khemraj isi art form ke liye jane jate hain.
GALAT ✗ – Haryana me Phag, Loor aur Gugga dance famous hain, Kud ka sambandh Haryana ki sanskriti se nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Himachal Pradesh me Nati aur Dangi dance ki pradhanata hai, Kud specifically J&K ka regional dance hai.

dance.q: Ramkrishna Talukadar received the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award in 2018 for his contribution to the sattriya dance form. This dance style belongs to which state?
dance.solution: Sattriya dance Assam ka ek classical dance hai jise 15th century me Vaishnava saint Srimanta Sankardev ne shuru kiya tha. Ramkrishna Talukdar iske ek mahatvapurn kalakar hain. Is dance ko pehle 'Sattras' (monasteries) me male monks (Bhokots) karte the, lekin ab ise stage par perform kiya jata hai. Isme 'Khol' aur 'Cymbals' ka prayog hota hai. Yaad Rakho: Sattriya ko 2000 me Sangeet Natak Akademi dwara 8th Classical dance ka darja mila.
why: GALAT ✗ – Meghalaya apne 'Laho' aur 'Nongkrem' dances ke liye jana jata hai jo yahan ki Jaintia aur Khasi tribes karti hain. Is prashn ke context me ye galat hai kyunki Sattriya wahan ka nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – West Bengal me 'Chhau' aur 'Gambhira' jaise folk dances famous hain, jabki yahan ka koi classical dance form Sangeet Natak Akademi ki list me nahi hai.
SAHI ✓ – Sattriya Assam ka shastriya nritya (classical dance) hai. Srimanta Sankardev ne ise Bhakti movement ke prachar ke liye shuru kiya tha.
GALAT ✗ – Jharkhand apne 'Seraikella Chhau' ke liye prasiddh hai. Sattriya ka Jharkhand ke culture se koi seedha sambandh nahi hai.

dance.q: Nati is the folk dance of which of the following states of India?
dance.solution: Nati Himachal Pradesh ka sabse lokpriya folk dance hai, jo khaas karke Kullu aur Shimla regions me kiya jata hai. Ye dance 'Guinness World Record' me bhi naam darj kara chuka hai sabse bade folk dance ke roop me. Isme log ek dusre ka haath pakad kar ek lamba chain banate hain aur 'Dhol-Nagada' ki thaap par nritya karte hain. Yaad Rakho: Kullu Nati sabse zyada famous hai.
why: SAHI ✓ – Nati Himachal Pradesh ka ek community dance hai jo tyoharon aur shadiyon ke mauke par kiya jata hai.
GALAT ✗ – Andhra Pradesh ka sabse bada dance identity 'Kuchipudi' (classical) aur 'Dhimsa' (folk) hai. Nati yahan ka dance nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Kerala 'Kathakali' aur 'Mohiniyattam' ke liye jana jata hai. Nati North India ka pahadi dance hai na ki South India ka.
GALAT ✗ – Nagaland apne 'Hornbill Festival' aur 'War Dances' (jaise Bamboo dance) ke liye famous hai. Nati ka yahan se koi lena dena nahi hai.

dance.q: The play ''Nal Charitam'' is related to which Indian dance style?
dance.solution: Nala Charitam ek bahut hi prasiddh 'Attakatha' (dance drama script) hai jise Unnayi Variyar ne likha tha. Ye Raja Nala aur Damayanti ki prem kahani par aadharit hai. Kathakali me chehre ke haav-bhaav (Navarasas) aur haath ki mudraon se puri kahani sunayi jati hai. Yaad Rakho: Kathakali hamesha 'Good vs Evil' ki ladayi dikhata hai aur iske costumes bahut bhari hote hain.
why: GALAT ✗ – Odissi Odisha ka dance hai jo 'Jayadeva' ke Gita Govinda par aadharit hota hai. Nal Charitam specifically Kerala ki Kathakali parampara ka hissa hai.
GALAT ✗ – Kathak UP ka dance hai jo 'Kathavachaks' dwara shuru hua tha. Isme Radha-Krishna ki lilaen dikhayi jati hain na ki Nal Charitam ka drama.
GALAT ✗ – Sattriya Assam ka hai aur ye Sankardev ke 'Ankiya Nat' par aadharit hota hai. Nal Charitam iske repertoire ka part nahi hai.
SAHI ✓ – Kathakali me Mahabharata aur Puranon ki kahaniyan dikhayi jati hain, jisme Nal Charitam ek pramukh play hai.

dance.q: Who was the founder Banaras Gharana of Kathak?
dance.solution: Kathak ke teen pramukh gharane hain - Lucknow, Jaipur aur Banaras. Janaki Prasad ji ne Banaras Gharana ki sthapna ki thi. Is gharane ki khasiyat ye hai ki isme 'Natwari Nritya' par zor diya jata hai aur pakhawaj ki thaap ka zyada upyog hota hai. Lucknow gharana Ishwari Prasad se shuru hua tha aur Nawab Wajid Ali Shah ke samay peak par pahuncha. Yaad Rakho: Banaras gharane me 'Chakkars' par bahut dhyaan diya jata hai.
why: GALAT ✗ – Shambhu Maharaj Lucknow gharane ke ek diggaj kalakar the, founder nahi. Wo Birju Maharaj ke chacha the.
GALAT ✗ – Ishwari Prasad ko pure Kathak dance form ka aadi-guru mana jata hai, jinse Lucknow gharane ki neev padi thi.
GALAT ✗ – Raja Chakradhar Singh Raigarh Gharana (Chhattisgarh) ke sanrakshak the, unhone Kathak ko bahut badhava diya tha.
SAHI ✓ – Janaki Prasad ne Banaras Gharana shuru kiya tha, jise 'Janaki Prasad Gharana' ke naam se bhi jana jata hai.

dance.q: Bhortaal dance is famous in _____
dance.solution: Bhortaal dance Assam ke Barpeta kshetra ka ek bahut hi energetic dance hai. Isse Narahari Burha Bhakat ne develop kiya tha. Is dance ki sabse badi visheshtha 'Cymbals' (bade manjire) hain. Kalakar in manjiron ko haath me lekar bahut tezi se beats par bajate hain aur complex formations banate hain. Yaad Rakho: Ye Sankardev ke Sattriya culture se hi nikla ek lok nritya hai.
why: SAHI ✓ – Bhortaal Assam ka ek lok nritya hai jo cymbals (manjiron) ke saath kiya jata hai.
GALAT ✗ – Odisha me 'Gotipua' aur 'Chhau' jaise dances popular hain. Bhortaal ka wahan koi prachalan nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Punjab apne 'Bhangra' aur 'Giddha' ke liye jana jata hai jo dhol ki thaap par hote hain, manjiron par nahi.
GALAT ✗ – Madhya Pradesh me 'Matki' aur 'Grida' dances hote hain. Bhortaal North-East India ki sanskriti ka hissa hai.

dance.q: Which of the following group of classical dancers belongs to Kathak?
options: Sitara devi, Shashwati Sen and Urmila Nagar
Yamini Krishnamurthy, Shobha Naidu and Swapana sundari
Kumkum Mohanty, Sonal Mansingh and Kiran Sehgal
Alarmel Valli, Malvika Sarokkai and Sucheta chapekar
dance.answer: Sitara devi, Shashwati Sen and Urmila Nagar
dance.solution: Kathak North India ka ekmatra classical dance hai jisme 'Gharana' system hota hai. Sitara Devi ko 'Kathak Queen' kaha jata hai (Rabindranath Tagore ne ye title diya tha). Shashwati Sen Birju Maharaj ki pramukh shishya hain aur Urmila Nagar Jaipur gharane se talluq rakhti hain. Yaad rakho: Kathak me 'Tatkar' (footwork) aur 'Chakkars' ka bahut mahatva hota hai.
why: SAHI ✓ – Sitara Devi (Lucknow/Varanasi), Shashwati Sen aur Urmila Nagar teeno Kathak ki mahan kalakar hain. Isliye ye sahi group hai.
GALAT ✗ – Yamini Krishnamurthy aur Shobha Naidu Kuchipudi aur Bharatanatyam ke liye jani jati hain. Is prashn ke liye ye galat hai kyunki ye Kathak se jude nahi hain.
GALAT ✗ – Kumkum Mohanty aur Sonal Mansingh Odissi dance ki diggaj hain. Is prashn ke liye ye galat hai kyunki ye Odissi ke exponent hain.
GALAT ✗ – Alarmel Valli aur Malvika Sarukkai Bharatanatyam ki 'Pandanallur' style ke liye mashhoor hain. Is prashn ke liye ye galat hai kyunki inka sambandh Kathak se nahi hai.

dance.q: Padma Bhushan awardee, Alarmel valli, who is famous for Bharatanatyam, is also an exponent of which of the following dance styles?
dance.solution: Alarmel Valli Bharatanatyam ki 'Pandanallur' style ki ek world-famous dancer hain. Unhone 'Dipashikha' naam ka apna dance centre bhi khola hai. Wo Bharatanatyam ke saath-saath Odissi me bhi maharat rakhti hain. Odissi dance me 'Tribhanga' posture (body ka 3 jagah se bend hona) sabse mahatvapurn hota hai. Yaad rakho: Sonal Mansingh bhi Bharatanatyam aur Odissi dono karti hain.
why: SAHI ✓ – Alarmel Valli ne Odissi ki training Kelucharan Mohapatra jaise gurus se li hai, isliye wo Odissi ki bhi exponent hain.
GALAT ✗ – Kathakali Kerala ka dance-drama hai jisme bhari makeup aur costumes hote hain. Is prashn ke liye ye galat hai kyunki Alarmel Valli isse nahi judi hain.
GALAT ✗ – Kuchipudi Andhra Pradesh ka dance hai jo 'Laya' aur 'Abhinaya' ka mishran hai. Is prashn ke liye ye galat hai kyunki Valli ka main focus Odissi raha hai.
GALAT ✗ – Kathak UP ka classical dance hai jisme ghungroo aur spins (chakkar) main hote hain. Is prashn ke liye ye galat hai kyunki Valli ka background south Indian aur Odissi styles me hai.

dance.q: Kathak is found in three different forms, called 'Gharana's', which are named after the cities where the kathak dance tradition developed. Name those three cities.
dance.solution: Kathak 'Katha' shabd se bana hai jiska arth hai 'kahani sunane wala'. Iske teen main gharane hain: 1. Lucknow (Nawab Wajid Ali Shah ke samay develop hua, bhava pe focus), 2. Jaipur (Kachwaha rajputo ke yahan, footwork/speed pe focus), 3. Banaras (Spiritual aur Natwari nritya pe focus). Raigarh gharana (Chhattisgarh) ko bhi chautha gharana mana jata hai. Yaad rakho: L-B-J trick (Lucknow, Banaras, Jaipur).
why: SAHI ✓ – Jaipur, Banaras aur Lucknow hi Kathak के teen mool stambh ya gharane hain jahan ye kala phali-phuli.
GALAT ✗ – Thiruvananthapuram Mohiniyattam/Kathakali ke liye hai aur Surat ka Kathak gharane se koi historic link nahi hai. Isliye ye option galat hai.
GALAT ✗ – Ayodhya aur Prayagraj cultural centres hain, par Kathak ke 'Gharana' system me inka naam nahi aata. Isliye ye galat hai.
GALAT ✗ – Banaras aur Lucknow sahi hain par Ayodhya Kathak ka koi alag se sthapit gharana nahi hai. Isliye ye option galat hai.

dance.q: Guru Shashadhar Acharya was awarded the Padma Shri in 2020 for his contribution in which of the following fields?
dance.solution: Guru Shashadhar Acharya 'Chhau' nritya ke mahan guru hain, jo Seraikella (Jharkhand) style ke liye jane jate hain. Chhau ek semi-classical/folk dance hai jo UNESCO ki intangible heritage list me bhi shamil hai. Inhe 2020 me Padma Shri mila tha. Yaad rakho: Chhau teen tarah ka hota hai - Seraikella (Jharkhand), Mayurbhanj (Odisha) aur Purulia (West Bengal).
why: GALAT ✗ – Classical dance ki list me sirf 8 dances (Kathak, Bharatnatyam, etc.) aate hain. Chhau ko semi-classical mana jata hai par officially wo folk category me award hua tha.
SAHI ✓ – Chhau ko aksar folk/tribal dance ki category me rakha jata hai, aur Shashadhar Acharya ne isi me yogdaan diya hai.
GALAT ✗ – Hindustani Classical Singing me gharane (Gwalior, Kirana) hote hain aur ye vocal music hai. Shashadhar Acharya ek dancer/choreographer hain.
GALAT ✗ – Musical instruments jaise Sitar ya Tabla bajane wale ko instrumentalist kehte hain. Acharya ji nritya se jude hain, isliye ye galat hai.

dance.q: Raut Nacha is famous in which of the following states?
dance.solution: Raut Nacha Chhattisgarh ki 'Yadav/Ahir' community dwara kiya jata hai. Ye dance 'Dev Uthani Ekadashi' (Diwali ke baad) par Lord Krishna ki puja ke roop me hota hai. Isme dancers colorful kapde pehente hain aur lathi (sticks) ka use karte hain. Yaad rakho: Chhattisgarh ke baaki dances hain - Panthi, Pandwani aur Karma.
why: GALAT ✗ – Punjab ke famous dances Bhangra aur Giddha hain. Raut Nacha ka Punjab se koi connection nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Assam me Bihu aur Sattriya (classical) kiya jata hai. Isliye ye option Chhattisgarh ke context me galat hai.
GALAT ✗ – Gujarat me Garba aur Dandiya Raas mashhoor hain. Raut Nacha wahan ka local dance nahi hai.
SAHI ✓ – Raut Nacha Chhattisgarh ka ek pramukh lok nritya hai jo Yadav vansh dwara shaurya aur bhakti dikhane ke liye kiya jata hai.

dance.q: Joravsingh Jadhav was awarded the Padma shri 2019 for his contribution to which the following dance forms?
dance.solution: Joravsingh Jadhav ek veteran folklorist hain jinhe Gujarat ke folk arts aur 'Bhavai' ko promote karne ke liye 2019 mein Padma Shri mila. Bhavai ek 700 saal purana ritualistic folk theatre hai jo Gujarat ke 'Asaita Thakar' dwara shuru kiya gaya tha. Isme male artists (Nayaks) female roles karte hain aur sar par 7-9 matke (pots) balance karke dance karte hain. Yaad rakho: Bhavai = Gujarat ka emotional aur social drama.
why: GALAT ✗ – Tamasha Maharashtra ka ek traditional folk theatre hai jo Kolhati community karti hai aur 'Dholki' iska mukhya vadya yantra hai. Iska sambandh Joravsingh Jadhav se nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Ghoomar Rajasthan ka sabse famous folk dance hai jo Bhil tribe ne shuru kiya tha aur Rajput women veil (ghunghat) mein karti hain. Iska Jadhav ji se link nahi hai.

GALAT ✗ – Yakshagana Karnataka ka traditional theatre form hai jisme mythological stories (Ramayana/Mahabharata) dikhayi jati hain aur bhari-bharkam costumes pehne jate hain. Ye Gujarat ka dance nahi hai.

SAHI ✓ – Bhavai Gujarat ka ek lok-nritya (folk dance) aur natak hai. Joravsingh Jadhav ne Gujarat Folk Art Council ke zariye is kala ko bachane aur duniya tak pahunchane ke liye kaam kiya, isiliye unhe Padma Shri mila.

dance.q: Raigarh Gharana is related to which of the following dance styles?
dance.solution: Raigarh Gharana Kathak ke char mukhya gharano (Lucknow, Jaipur, Banaras, Raigarh) mein se ek hai. Is gharane ki shuruaat Chhattisgarh ke Raigarh riyasat ke Raja Chakradhar Singh ne ki thi. Unhone Kathak aur Tabla ke liye 'Nartan Sarwaswa' jaisi kitaabein bhi likhin. Ye gharana Kathak ke laya (rhythm) aur footwork ke liye jaana jata hai. Yaad rakho: Raigarh = Raja Chakradhar Singh + Kathak.
why: GALAT ✗ – Kathakali Kerala ka classical dance hai jo apne 'story-play' aur bhaari facial makeup/costumes ke liye jana jata hai. Isme gharana system nahi balki 'Kalari' training schools hote hain.
GALAT ✗ – Odissi Odisha ka classical dance hai jo 'Tribhanga' mudra ke liye prasiddh hai. Isme Kelucharan Mohapatra jaise gurus ka yogdaan hai, lekin Raigarh iska gharana nahi hai.
SAHI ✓ – Raigarh Gharana Kathak ka sabse naya (youngest) gharana hai. Chhattisgarh ke Raja Chakradhar Singh ne ise develop kiya aur Kathak ko ek shastriya pehchan di.
GALAT ✗ – Manipuri Manipur ka classical dance hai jo Vaishnavism par adharit hai aur isme 'Raasleela' dikhayi jati hai. Iska Chhattisgarh ke Raigarh se koi sambandh nahi hai.

dance.q: Dancer Natraj, who was honored with the Padma Shri Award in 2019, was given this award for which of the following contributions?
options: To overcome social exclusion through Bharatanatyam dance performance.
For speciality in Indian knowledge system Nayaya Shastra.
To popularize Indian cuisine in the world.
To bring women empowerment through anyone.
dance.answer: To overcome social exclusion through Bharatanatyam dance performance.
dance.solution: Nartaki Natraj ek mashhoor Bharatanatyam dancer hain aur wo Padma Shri samman pane wali pehli Trans-woman (Kinnar) hain. Unhone Thanjavur Nayaki Bhava tradition ko aage badhaya. Unhe ye award unke art ke zariye social barriers todne aur transgender community ko respect dilane ke liye mila. Yaad rakho: Nartaki Natraj = First Trans-woman Padma Shri + Bharatanatyam.
why: SAHI ✓ – Nartaki Natraj ne transgender hone ke naate samajik bahishkar (social exclusion) ka samna kiya aur apne dance performance se samaj mein badlav laya aur samman hasil kiya.
GALAT ✗ – Nyaya Shastra Indian philosophy ka ek tarka-sangata (logic) system hai. Natraj ji ka field Indian philosophy ya logic research nahi, balki classical dance hai.
GALAT ✗ – Indian cuisine (khana) ko popular karne ke liye Vikas Khanna ya Sanjeev Kapoor jaise chefs ko jana jata hai, dancer Nartaki Natraj ka yogdaan isme nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Halanki unka kaam women empowerment ki disha mein hai, par unka primary contribution Bharatnatyam ke zariye trans-community aur social exclusion ke liye hai.

dance.q: Alarippu Dance is which of the following classical dance forms of India?
dance.solution: Alarippu Bharatanatyam dance recital ka sabse pehla part hota hai. Iska shabdik arth hai 'Phool ka khilna' (Blossoming of a flower). Ye ek invocatory item hai jisme dancer bhagwan, guru aur sabha ko pranaam karta hai. Isme koi kahani nahi hoti, sirf pure dance moves (Nritta) aur body movements hote hain. Yaad rakho: Margam (sequence) ki shuruaat Alarippu se hoti hai.
why: GALAT ✗ – Kathakali mein shuruaat 'Todayam' ya 'Purappadu' se hoti hai, jo backstage ya stage par ritual ki tarah hota hai. Alarippu iska part nahi hai.
SAHI ✓ – Bharatanatyam ke 'Margam' (format) mein pehla step Alarippu hota hai, uske baad Jatiswaram, Shabdam, Varnam, Padam aur ant mein Tillana hota hai.
GALAT ✗ – Odissi dance ki shuruaat 'Mangalacharan' se hoti hai jisme Bhumi Pranam kiya jata hai. Alarippu South Indian (Tamil Nadu) style ka part hai.
GALAT ✗ – Kathak ki performance 'Amad' ya 'Thaat' se shuru hoti hai. Alarippu South Indian Carnatic rhythm par chalta hai jo Kathak mein nahi hota.

dance.q: Kumbhi folk dance is performed by the women of which state of India?
dance.solution: Kummi (ya Kumbhi) Tamil Nadu aur Kerala ka ek bahut purana folk dance hai. Isme koi musical instrument nahi bajaya jata, balki mahilayein ek ghere (circle) mein khadi hokar taliyan (clapping) bajati hain aur rhythmic gaane gaati hain. Ye aksar Pongal tyohar ya family functions par kiya jata hai. Yaad rakho: Kummi = No Instruments + Clapping + Tamil Nadu.
why: SAHI ✓ – Kummi Tamil Nadu ka lok-nritya hai. Isme mahilayein apne hatho se tali baja kar rhythm banati hain. Ye ek community dance hai jo khushi ke mauke par hota hai.
GALAT ✗ – Madhya Pradesh mein Matki, Jawara aur Grida jaise folk dances hote hain. Kummi ka wahan ke tribal ya folk culture se link nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Jharkhand mein Chhau aur Sarhul jaise dances famous hain. Jharkhand ke lok nrityo mein dhol aur mandal jaise instruments ka kaafi prayog hota hai.
GALAT ✗ – Rajasthan mein Ghoomar, Kalbelia aur Kachhi Ghodi mashhoor hain. Rajasthan ke dances ka style Kummi se bilkul alag hai kyunki wahan costumes aur instruments ka mahatva zyada hai.

dance.q: Satyaram Reang received Padma Shri for promoting Hojagiri dance style. He belongs to which of the following states?
