dance.solution: Hojagiri Tripura ka ek bahut hi lokpriya folk dance hai jo Reang (Bru) community ki ladkiyon dwara kiya jata hai. Isme sir par ghada (pitcher) rakhkar balancing ki jati hai. Satyaram Reang ko 2021 mein Padma Shri mila tha is art form ko revive karne ke liye. Yaad rakho: Hojagiri = Balancing act in Tripura.
why: GALAT ✗ – Assam Bihu aur Sattriya (classical) ke liye jana jata hai. Yahan ki Reang community minor hai par Hojagiri ka mukhya kendra Assam nahi hai. Isliye ye option galat hai.
GALAT ✗ – Manipur apne Manipuri classical dance aur Thang-Ta (martial art) ke liye famous hai. Hojagiri yahan ka paramparagat nritya nahi hai.
SAHI ✓ – Tripura hi wo rajya hai jahan Reang clan Hojagiri dance karta hai. Satyaram Reang isi rajya ke mukhya kalakar hain.
GALAT ✗ – Sikkim mein Singhi Chham aur Chu Faat jaise dances hote hain. Hojagiri se Sikkim ka koi sidha sambandh nahi hai.

dance.q: Bharatanatyam expresses the religious themes and spiritual ideas of ____ in south India.
dance.solution: Bharatanatyam sabse purana classical dance hai jiska mool 'Natya Shastra' mein hai. Ye mukhya roop se Tamil Nadu ke mandiron mein 'Devdasis' dwara shuru kiya gaya tha. Isnritya mein Lord Shiva (Nataraja) ki upasana aur Shaivite philosophy ko dikhaya jata hai. Yaad rakho: Shiva = Nataraja = King of Dance.
why: GALAT ✗ – Jainism ka prabhav Dilwara temples aur literature par zyada hai, lekin Bharatanatyam ki spiritual roots isse judi nahi hain.
SAHI ✓ – Shaivism (Lord Shiva ki bhakti) hi Bharatanatyam ka aadhar hai. Nataraja ko is dance ka devta mana jata hai aur ise 'Fire Dance' bhi kehte hain.
GALAT ✗ – Sufism ek Islamic mystical tradition hai jo Qawwali aur Sama se juda hai, Bharatanatyam ke mudraon se iska lena-dena nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Buddhism ka influence ajanta paintings aur stupas par hai, lekin South India ka Bharatanatyam Brahmanical/Shaivite parampara se nikla hai.

dance.q: In 2018, Gooogle Doodle celebrated the 100th birth day of Mrinalini Sarabhai. She is an exponent of which of the following dance styles?
dance.solution: Yamini Krishnamurthy ko 'Asthana Nartaki' (Resident Dancer) ka title mila tha Tirumala Tirupati Devasthanam se. Wo Bharatnatyam ki mahan kalakar hain lekin unka contribution Kuchipudi ko classical status dilane mein bhi bahut bada raha hai. Yaad rakho: Yamini = Double Padma Awardee (Shri & Bhushan) + Double Dance Expert.
why: SAHI ✓ – Yamini Krishnamurthy Bharatnatyam aur Kuchipudi dono ki legendary exponent hain. Unhone in dono styles mein perfection hasil ki hai.
GALAT ✗ – Kathakali Kerala ka mask dance hai. Yamini ji ne isme training nahi li hai, unka focus Andhra aur Tamil styles par raha.
GALAT ✗ – Kathak Lucknow/Jaipur gharana se juda hai. Yamini ji South Indian classical dances ke liye jani jati hain.
GALAT ✗ – Manipuri dance Northeast ka hai jisme 'Lai Haraoba' jaise forms aate hain. Yamini ji isse sambandhit nahi hain.

dance.q: Padma Shri and Padma Bhushan awardee Yamini Krishnamurthy is famous for Bharatnatyam and which of the following dances?
dance.solution: Yamini Krishnamurthy ko 'Asthana Nartaki' (Resident Dancer) ka title mila tha Tirumala Tirupati Devasthanam se. Wo Bharatnatyam ki mahan kalakar hain lekin unka contribution Kuchipudi ko classical status dilane mein bhi bahut bada raha hai. Yaad rakho: Yamini = Double Padma Awardee (Shri & Bhushan) + Double Dance Expert.
why: SAHI ✓ – Yamini Krishnamurthy Bharatnatyam aur Kuchipudi dono ki legendary exponent hain. Unhone in dono styles mein perfection hasil ki hai.
GALAT ✗ – Kathakali Kerala ka mask dance hai. Yamini ji ne isme training nahi li hai, unka focus Andhra aur Tamil styles par raha.
GALAT ✗ – Kathak Lucknow/Jaipur gharana se juda hai. Yamini ji South Indian classical dances ke liye jani jati hain.
GALAT ✗ – Manipuri dance Northeast ka hai jisme 'Lai Haraoba' jaise forms aate hain. Yamini ji isse sambandhit nahi hain.

dance.q: Which of the following personalities is a famous Bharatnatyam dancer?
dance.solution: Padma Subramaniam ne 'Bharata Nrityam' naam ka ek naya style develop kiya jo Natya Shastra ke 108 Karana (movements) par based hai. Wo ek research scholar aur choreographer bhi hain. Yaad rakho: Padma Subramaniam = Research + Bharatnatyam + 108 Karanas.
why: GALAT ✗ – Birju Maharaj Lucknow 'Kalka-Bindadin' gharana ke sabse bade Kathak dancer thhe. Wo Bharatnatyam se nahi jude thhe.
GALAT ✗ – Shashwati Sen Birju Maharaj ki senior disciple hain aur Kathak ki ek manni-pramanni kalakar hain.
SAHI ✓ – Padma Subramaniam Bharatnatyam ki vishwa-prasiddh dancer hain jinhone is dance form ko academic level par study kiya hai.
GALAT ✗ – Naik Siddiqui (Nayak Siddiqui) Kathak se jude huye hain, Bharatnatyam se unka koi talluq nahi hai.

dance.q: Tevitichiyattam, Nangai Natakam and Dasiyattam are classical dance styles of which of the following?
dance.solution: Mohiniyattam Kerala ka classical dance hai jo 'Mohini' (Lord Vishnu ka avatar) ke naam par hai. Iske roots 'Dasiyattam' (devadasi dance) aur 'Tevitichiyattam' mein hain. Ye 'Lasyam' style (graceful movement) par focus karta hai aur isme safed-sunehri (Kasavu) saree pehni jati hai. **Yaad rakho:** Jaha 'Attam' dikhe, waha Kerala hone ke chances 90% hote hain.
why: GALAT ✗ – Odissi Odisha ka classical dance hai jo 'Odra Magadha' se evolve hua hai aur isme 'Tribhanga' posture sabse mahatvapurn hai. Is prashn ke styles Odisha se nahi, Kerala se jude hain.
SAHI ✓ – Tevitichiyattam, Nangai Natakam aur Dasiyattam Mohiniyattam ke hi purane roop ya styles hain jo Kerala ke mandiro mein mahilao dwara kiye jaate the.
GALAT ✗ – Sattriya Assam ka dance hai jise Mahapurush Sankaradeva ne 15th century mein shuru kiya tha, ye Vaishnav monasteries (Sattras) mein hota hai.
GALAT ✗ – Kathakali Kerala ka hi hai lekin ye ek 'Male-dominated' dance drama hai jo apne bhari makeup aur costumes ke liye jana jata hai, na ki in feminine styles ke liye.

dance.q: The folk dance of Chavittukali is related to which of the following Indian states?
dance.solution: Chavittukali (ya Chavittu Nadakam) Kerala ki ek purani art form hai jisme 'stamping of feet' (pairo ka zor se marna) mahatvapurn hota hai. Ye Onam aur Vishu jaise festivals par perform kiya jata hai. Isme Christian influence bhi dikhta hai aur ye Kerala ki diversity ko dikhata hai. **Yaad rakho:** Kerala = Kalaripayattu, Kathakali, aur Chavittukali.
why: GALAT ✗ – Andhra Pradesh ke mukhya folk dances Kolattam, Dhimsa aur Lambadi hain. Chavittukali ka yaha koi aitihasik sambandh nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Uttar Pradesh mein Nautanki, Raslila aur Charkula jaise lok nritya mashhoor hain. Chavittukali South Indian style hai.
GALAT ✗ – Gujarat apne Garba, Dandiya Raas aur Tippani dance ke liye jana jata hai. Chavittukali ka culture Gujarat se bilkul alag hai.
SAHI ✓ – Chavittukali Kerala ka lok nritya hai jo vaha ke tyoharo aur mandiro ke melo ki shobha badhata hai.

dance.q: Laho is the dance style of which state?
dance.solution: Laho dance Meghalaya ki 'Pnar' ya 'Jaintia' tribe dwara kiya jata hai. Isme ladke aur ladkiyan ek saath line banakar dance karte hain aur beech mein ek mukhya gayak (leader) hota hai. Ye 'Behdienkhlam' festival ka hissa hai. **Yaad rakho:** Meghalaya = Wangala (Garo tribe) aur Laho (Jaintia tribe).
why: GALAT ✗ – Kerala ke mukhya dances Kathakali aur Mohiniyattam hain. Laho ek North-East Indian tribal dance hai.
GALAT ✗ – Sikkim mein Chu-Faat aur Singhi Chham (Snow Lion dance) jaise mukhya nritya hote hain.
GALAT ✗ – Manipur mein Manipuri (Jagoi), Pung Cholom aur Thang-Ta (martial art) mashhoor hain, Laho yaha ka nahi hai.
SAHI ✓ – Laho Meghalaya ka ek community dance hai jo entertainment ke liye Jaintia logo dwara kiya jata hai.

dance.q: Sattriya, the dance of Assam is inspiream is inspired by ___.
dance.solution: Sattriya ko 15th century mein Saint Sankaradeva ne 'Bhakti Movement' ke prachar ke liye banaya tha. Ye pehle monasteries (Sattras) mein sirf purusho (Bhokots) dwara kiya jata tha, lekin ab sab karte hain. Ye 'Ankiya Naat' (one-act plays) par based hota hai. **Yaad rakho:** Sattriya = Sankaradeva + Bhakti + Assam.
why: GALAT ✗ – Shakti movement Devi puja se juda hai, jabki Sattriya Bhagwan Vishnu/Krishna ki bhakti par focus karta hai.
GALAT ✗ – Tantrawad occult aur esoteric practices se juda hai, Sattriya ek shuddh Vaishnav bhakti nritya hai.
SAHI ✓ – Sattriya puri tarah Bhakti movement ki den hai, jisme geeto (Borgeet) ke madhyam se Krishna ki leelao ka varnan hota hai.
GALAT ✗ – Sufi movement Islam ki mystical side hai jisme Qawwali aur Sama hota hai, iska Sattriya se koi lena-dena nahi hai.

dance.q: Rukmini Devi Arundale has won various awards in which dance style?
dance.solution: Rukmini Devi Arundale ne Bharatnatyam ko ek naya jeevan diya. Unhone 'Kalakshetra Foundation' ki sthapna Chennai mein ki. Wo Rajya Sabha mein nominate hone wali pehli dancer thi. Unhe 'Animal Rights' ke liye bhi jana jata hai. **Yaad rakho:** Rukmini Devi = Kalakshetra = Bharatnatyam Revival.
why: SAHI ✓ – Rukmini Devi ne Bharatnatyam ko 'Sadir' (devadasi dance) se badalkar ek sammanit classical stage art banaya.
GALAT ✗ – Kathakali ke mukhya kalakar Guru Kunchu Kurup hain, Rukmini Devi ka isme mukhya yogdan nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Kathak se Birju Maharaj aur Sitara Devi jaise naam jude hain. Rukmini Devi South Indian classical dance se judi hain.
GALAT ✗ – Lavani Maharashtra ka ek folk dance hai, jabki Rukmini Devi ne pure jeevan classical art form (Bharatnatyam) ko promote kiya.

dance.q: Which of the following folk dances is famous as 'stick dance'?
dance.solution: Kolannalu Andhra Pradesh ka ek behad lokpriya 'stick dance' hai, jise 'Kolattam' bhi kaha jata hai. Isme dancers do sticks (kolalu) ka use karke rhythm banate hain aur ek circle mein move karte hain. Ye dance South India ke 'Dandiya' jaisa dikhta hai. Rural Andhra mein ye tyoharon ke waqt male aur female dono dwara perform kiya jata hai. Yaad rakho: Kolannalu = Kol (Stick) + Annalu (Dance in AP).
why: GALAT ✗ – Theyyam Kerala ka ek ritual dance-drama hai jisme log Devi-Devtaon ka roop dharon karte hain (Theyyam matlab 'Daivom' ya God). Isme sticks ka nahi, balki elaborate headgears aur face masks ka use hota hai.
GALAT ✗ – Ghodemodini Goa ka ek folk dance hai jo Maratha rulers ki victory celebrate karne ke liye kiya jata hai. Isme dancers ghode (horse) jaisa dummy frame pehen kar dance karte hain.
SAHI ✓ – Kolannalu Andhra Pradesh ka 'stick dance' hai. Isme wooden sticks ko aapas mein strike karke music aur steps ka coordination banaya jata hai.
GALAT ✗ – Koli (Coli) Maharashtra ka ek famous folk dance hai jo vahan ke fishing community (Koli) dwara kiya jata hai. Ye samundar ki lehron aur machli pakadne ke movements par based hota hai.

dance.q: Kalakshetra style is relate is related to which Indian classical dance style?
dance.solution: Kalakshetra style Bharatanatyam ka ek modern aur refined school hai, jise Rukmini Devi Arundale ne establish kiya tha. Is style mein 'Angika Abhinaya' (body movements) aur 'Vaachika' (music) par bohot focus kiya jata hai, aur isme vulgarity ko hata kar shuddhata (purity) layi gayi. Bharatanatyam Tamil Nadu ka classical dance hai jo 'Sadir Attam' se evolve hua hai. Yaad rakho: Kalakshetra = Rukmini Devi = Bharatanatyam.
why: GALAT ✗ – Odissi Odisha ka classical dance hai jo 'Tribhanga' mudra aur Mahari tradition ke liye jana jata hai. Iska Kalakshetra se koi direct lena-dena nahi hai.
SAHI ✓ – Kalakshetra style Bharatanatyam ka hi ek prakar hai. Ise Rukmini Devi Arundale ne Chennai mein 'Kalakshetra Foundation' ke zariye world-famous banaya.
GALAT ✗ – Kathak North India (UP) ka dance hai jo 'Katha' (storytelling) par based hai. Iske main gharane Lucknow, Jaipur aur Banaras hain, Kalakshetra nahi.
GALAT ✗ – Kuchipudi Andhra Pradesh ka classical dance hai. Isme 'Tarangam' (brass plate par dance) mashhoor hai, jabki Kalakshetra style Tamil Nadu ke dance se juda hai.

dance.q: Who among the following was a Padma Bhushan awardee, famous Bharatanatyam originator's Brahmavihmavidyaist and founder of Kalakshetra dance school?
dance.solution: Rukmini Devi Arundale ne Bharatanatyam ko ek naya jeevan diya. Unhone 1936 mein Chennai mein 'Kalakshetra' school ki sthapna ki. Wo pehli mahila thi jinhe Rajya Sabha ke liye nominate kiya gaya tha. Unka contribution Bharatanatyam ko 'Sadir' (devadasi dance) se nikaalkar ek sammanit art form banane mein sabse zyada raha. Yaad rakho: 1956 Padma Bhushan + Kalakshetra Founder = Rukmini Devi.
why: GALAT ✗ – Saroja Vaidyanathan ek veteran Bharatanatyam exponent aur guru hain, unhone 'Ganesa Natyalaya' ki sthapna Delhi mein ki thi, Kalakshetra ki nahi.
GALAT ✗ – Sonal Mansingh Bharatanatyam aur Odissi dono ki dancer hain. Wo sabse kum umar mein Padma Vibhushan paane wali dancer hain, par Kalakshetra ki founder nahi.
GALAT ✗ – Mallika Sarabhai Mrinalini Sarabhai ki beti hain aur Bharatanatyam/Kuchipudi karti hain. Wo Darpana Academy (Ahmedabad) se judi hain.
SAHI ✓ – Rukmini Devi Arundale hi wo shaksiyat hain jinhone Kalakshetra banaya aur Bharatanatyam ko global level par revive kiya.

dance.q: Who among the following Kathak dancers of India founded the KADAMB dance center in 1964?
dance.solution: Kumudini Lakhia ne 1964 mein Ahmedabad mein 'Kadamb School of Dance' shuru kiya tha. Unhone Kathak mein 'group choreography' ka concept introduce kiya, jo pehle sirf solo perform kiya jata tha. Wo Shambhu Maharaj (Lucknow Gharana) ki shishya rahi hain. Unhe 1987 mein Padma Shri aur 2010 mein Padma Bhushan mila. Yaad rakho: Kadamb = Kumudini (K-K connection).
why: SAHI ✓ – Kumudini Lakhia ne hi Kadamb dance center ki sthapna ki thi aur Kathak ko ek modern outlook diya.
GALAT ✗ – Rohini Bhate Pune se ek legendary Kathak exponent aur guru thi, jinhone 'Nrityabharati' sanstha banayi thi.
GALAT ✗ – Sitara Devi ko Rabindranath Tagore ne 'Kathak Samragyi' (Empress of Kathak) kaha tha. Wo Banaras gharane se taluk rakhti thi.
GALAT ✗ – Shobhana Narayan ek famous Kathak dancer aur IAS officer hain. Unke guru Birju Maharaj hain, par unhone Kadamb ki sthapna nahi ki.

dance.q: Jam Jamda folk dance is related to which state of India?
dance.solution: Jamda Jharkhand ka ek energetic folk dance hai jo aksar mela aur tyoharon ke mauke par kiya jata hai. Jharkhand apne tribal dances ke liye jana jata hai jaise Chhau (Seraikela), Paika (martial dance) aur Jhumar. Jamda jaise folk dances wahan ki mitti aur sanskriti ko darshate hain. Yaad rakho: Jharkhand ke 'J' se Jamda aur Jhumar.
why: GALAT ✗ – Assam apne Bihu, Bagurumba aur Sattriya (classical) dances ke liye jana jata hai. Jamda yahan ka dance nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Manipur mein Manipuri (Jagoi), Thang-Ta aur Pung Cholom jaise famous dances hote hain.
SAHI ✓ – Jamda Jharkhand ka lok nritya (folk dance) hai, jo tribal communities mein kaafi prachalit hai.
GALAT ✗ – Maharashtra Lavani, Nakata, aur Lezim jaise lok nrityon ke liye famous hai, Jamda ke liye nahi.

dance.q: Who among the following personalities gave the name 'Odissi' to the classical dance of Odisha?
dance.solution: Odissi dance ko pehle 'Odra Magadha' ya 'Mahari' ke naam se jaana jata tha, lekin Kavichandra Kalicharan Patnaik ne hi isse 'Odissi' naam diya. Unhone Odissi music aur drama ko revive karne mein bada yogdaan diya hai. Yaad rakho, Kelucharan Mohapatra ne ise global pehchaan dilayi, par naam Patnaik ji ne diya. Ye dance Odisha ke mandiro se originate hua hai.
why: GALAT ✗ – Rabindra Nath Tagore ne Shantiniketan mein Manipuri aur Kathakali ko promote kiya aur 'Rabindra Nritya' ki shuruat ki thi. Is prashn ke liye ye nahi kyunki unka yogdaan Bengal ke art aur literature mein zyada tha.
SAHI ✓ – Kavichandra Kalicharan Patnaik ek mahan lekhak aur kalakar the, jinhone 1950s mein is classical dance form ko 'Odissi' naam dekar ise ek alag pehchaan di.
GALAT ✗ – Raja Ram Mohan Roy 'Brahmo Samaj' ke founder the aur social reforms (Sati Pratha khatam karna) ke liye jaane jaate hain. Unka dance nomenclature se koi sambandh nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Kelucharan Mohapatra Odissi ke sabse mahan guru aur dancer mane jaate hain, par unhone isse revive kiya tha, naam nahi diya tha.

dance.q: Padayani is the folk dance of which state?
dance.solution: Padayani Kerala ka ek ritualistic folk dance hai jo Bhagwati temples mein Bhadrakali ke samman mein kiya jata hai. Isme bade aur rang-birange masks (Kolams) pehne jaate hain jo areca nut leaves se bante hain. Ye dance Kerala ke Pathanamthitta district mein bahut famous hai. Trick: Padayani = P (Pathanamthitta) + Kerala.
why: GALAT ✗ – Karnataka ke prasiddh dance forms Yakshagana aur Dollu Kunitha hain. Padayani wahan ka dance nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Tamil Nadu mein Bharatnatyam, Karagattam aur Kavadi Aattam jaise dance popular hain. Is prashn ke liye ye sahi nahi hai.
SAHI ✓ – Padayani Kerala ka ek prachin martial aur ritualistic dance hai, jisme Thappu (instrument) ka prayog hota hai aur ye Devi ke mandiro mein hota hai.
GALAT ✗ – Andhra Pradesh (Andaman nahi, context se AP lag raha) mein Kuchipudi aur Vilasini Natyam prachalit hain, Padayani nahi.

dance.q: Which of the following personalities is credited with synthesizing classical and modern Indian dance through a theater group calle theater group called Ranga Sri Little Ballet Troupe?
dance.solution: Shanti Bardhan ne Bhopal mein 'Ranga Sri Little Ballet Troupe' ki sthapna ki thi. Unhone classical Indian techniques ko modern storytelling aur puppet-like movements ke saath mix kiya. Unka 'Ramayana' ballet (jisme dancers puppets ki tarah act karte hain) world-famous hai. Ye synthesis modern Indian dance ki neev hai.
why: GALAT ✗ – Guru Bipin Singh Manipuri dance ke mahan guru aur exponent the, unhone modern ballet group Ranga Sri ki sthapna nahi ki thi.
SAHI ✓ – Shanti Bardhan ek visionary choreographer the jinhone Ranga Sri Little Ballet Troupe banaya aur Indian classical dance ko ek naya modern perspective diya.
GALAT ✗ – Remo Fernandes ek mashhoor Pop/Rock singer aur musician hain Goa se. Inka classical dance synthesis se koi lena dena nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Pandit Birju Maharaj (agar Pan se matlab Pandit hai) Kathak ke diggaj the, par wo Lucknow Gharana se jude the, Ranga Sri Troupe se nahi.

dance.q: Kamsale is the folk dance of which of the following Indian states?
dance.solution: Kamsale Karnataka ke Mysuru aur Chamarajanagar region ka ek rhythmic folk dance hai. Ye Lord Mahadeswara (Shiva) ke bhakto dwara kiya jata hai. Isme 'Kamsale' naam ka brass musical instrument (cymbals) use hota hai jo ek haath mein brass plate aur dusre mein ek cup ki tarah hota hai. Yaad rakho: Kamsale = Karnataka + Lord Mahadeswara.
why: SAHI ✓ – Kamsale Karnataka ka hi ek anokha folk dance hai jo music, devotion aur martial moves ka ek mix hai.
GALAT ✗ – Bihar mein Jat-Jatin aur Bideshiya jaise folk dances famous hain. Kamsale wahan ka nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Jharkhand mein Chhau aur Santhali dance hota hai. Kamsale ka wahan koi prachalan nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Kerala Kathakali aur Mohiniyattam ke liye jaana jata hai. Is prashn ke liye ye option galat hai.

dance.q: Chari folk dance is mainly performed by the women of which Indian state?
dance.solution: Chari dance Rajasthan ke Kishangarh area ki Gurjar aur Saini community ki mahilayein karti hain. Isme mahilayein apne sir par ek pital ki Chari (pot) rakhti hain jisme jalti hui kapas ke beej (lit cotton seeds) hote hain. Ye dance khushi aur pani lene jane ke celebration ko darshata hai. Famous Artist: Falgu Bai.
why: GALAT ✗ – Karnataka mein Yakshagana aur Suggi Kunitha jaise dance hote hain, Chari wahan ka tradition nahi hai.
SAHI ✓ – Chari Rajasthan ka famous folk dance hai jo sir par jalti hui matki rakh kar kiya jata hai, jo balance ka ek behtareen udaharan hai.
GALAT ✗ – Jharkhand ke folk dances mein Karma aur Sarhul aate hain. Chari ka wahan se koi sambandh nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Odisha Odissi aur Sambalpuri dance ke liye jaana jata hai. Rajasthan ka Chari yahan nahi hota.

dance.q: Which of the following Kuchipudi dancers has been honored with the Padma Shri Award 2022?
dance.solution: Kuchipudi Andhra Pradesh ka classical dance hai jo 'Kuchelapuram' village se aaya hai. Dr. Padmaja Reddy ne 'Kakatiyam' (Kakatiya dynasty ke history par based dance) ko revive karne ke liye bahut kaam kiya hai. Yaad rakho, 2022 Padma Shri list me Padmaja Reddy ka naam Andhra ke Kuchipudi artist ke roop me shamil tha. Inhe 2015 me Sangeet Natak Akademi Award bhi mil chuka hai.
why: GALAT ✗ – Sunanda Nair ek famous Mohiniyattam (Kerala) dancer hain. Inhe Mohiniyattam me doctorate hasil hai. Is prashn ke liye ye nahi kyunki ye Kuchipudi se sambandhit nahi hain.
SAHI ✓ – Padmaja Reddy ek veteran Kuchipudi dancer hain jinhe 2022 me unke art me contribution ke liye Padma Shri se sammanit kiya gaya.
GALAT ✗ – Pallavi Krishnan Mohiniyattam ki ek leading exponent hain aur Kerala Sangeet Natak Akademi Award winner hain. Ye Kuchipudi ki list me nahi aati.
GALAT ✗ – Sitara Devi 'Kathak Queen' ke naam se jaani jaati hain. Unka nidhan 2014 me hi ho gaya tha, isliye 2022 award unhe nahi mil sakta.

dance.q: Chhau is a popular folk dance of which of the following states?
dance.solution: Chhau ek martial art style ka dance hai jo UNESCO ki intangible cultural heritage list me bhi shamil hai. Iske 3 main styles hain: Seraikella (Jharkhand), Purulia (West Bengal), aur Mayurbhanj (Odisha). Mayurbhanj Chhau me mask (mukhota) nahi pehna jata, jabki baaki do me pehna jata hai. Exam trick: Chhau = Tribal Martial Dance of Eastern India.
why: SAHI ✓ – Odisha aur West Bengal dono hi Chhau ke pramukh kendra hain (Mayurbhanj aur Purulia styles ke liye).
GALAT ✗ – Assam 'Sattriya' aur 'Bihu' ke liye jana jata hai, wahan Chhau ka prevalence nahi hai. Bihar me iska asar hai par Assam match nahi karta.
GALAT ✗ – Bihar me 'Seraikella Chhau' (purane Bihar, ab Jharkhand) ka prabhav raha hai, lekin West Bengal ke sath primary pair Odisha ka banta hai.
GALAT ✗ – Halaki Odisha aur Bihar (Jharkhand area) dono jagah ye hota hai, par option (a) geographical aur stylistic variety ke hisaab se zyada accurate hai.

dance.q: Famous Kathak dancer Shovana Narayan received ____ in 1992.
dance.solution: Shovana Narayan Lucknow Gharana ki ek bahut badi Kathak dancer hain aur Pandit Birju Maharaj ki shishya hain. Inhe 'Kathak Queen' bhi kaha jata hai. Inhe 1992 me Padma Shri aur 1999-2000 me Sangeet Natak Akademi Award mila. Ek interesting fact ye hai ki ye ek Career Civil Servant (IAAS officer) bhi rahi hain.
why: SAHI ✓ – Shovana Narayan ko 1992 me Bharat ke chauthe sabse bade nagrik samman 'Padma Shri' se nawaza gaya tha.
GALAT ✗ – Kalidas Samman Madhya Pradesh sarkar dwara diya jata hai classical arts ke liye. Shovana Narayan ko ye 1992 me nahi mila tha.
GALAT ✗ – Kabir Award communal harmony aur literature ke field me diya jata hai, classical dance ke liye ye primary award nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Padma Bhushan teesra bada samman hai. Shovana Narayan ko abhi tak Padma Shri mila hai, Padma Bhushan nahi.

dance.q: Sarhul is a popular tribal dance of which state?
dance.solution: Sarhul Jharkhand ka sabse bada tribal festival aur dance hai, jo 'Oraon', 'Munda' aur 'Santal' tribes dwara manaya jata hai. Ye festival Sal tree (Shorea robusta) ki puja se shuru hota hai. Isse New Year ke roop me bhi manaya jata hai jab prakriti me naye phool khilte hain. Yaad rakho: Sarhul = Sal Tree Worship in Jharkhand.
why: GALAT ✗ – Sikkim me 'Chu Faat' aur 'Saga Dawa' jaise festivals famous hain, Sarhul wahan ka mukhya tribal dance nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Chhattisgarh me 'Raut Nacha' aur 'Karma' dance mukhya hain. Sarhul ka center Jharkhand hai.
GALAT ✗ – Assam apne 'Bihu' aur 'Bagurumba' dances ke liye jana jata hai. Sarhul yahan ka tribal dance nahi hai.
SAHI ✓ – Sarhul Jharkhand ka hi mukhya tribal festival aur dance hai, jo nature ki worship par focused hai.

dance.q: Ranjumoni Saikia was awarded the Sangeet Natak Akedemi Award 2019 for her contribution to which classical dance?
dance.solution: Sattriya Assam ka classical dance hai jise 15th century me Saint Srimanta Sankardev ne shuru kiya tha. Ranjumoni Saikia ne is dance ko promote karne me mahatvapurna yogdan diya hai, isiliye unhe 2019 ka Sangeet Natak Akademi award mila. Sattriya dance 'Ankiya Nat' (ek tarah ka natak) ka hissa hota hai aur 'Bhaona' me dikhaya jata hai.
why: SAHI ✓ – Ranjumoni Saikia ek prasiddh Sattriya nartaki hain aur unhe is classical dance form ke liye hi 2019 ka Sangeet Natak Akademi award mila.
GALAT ✗ – Chhau ke liye 2019 me alag artists ko sammanit kiya gaya tha, Ranjumoni Saikia ka sambandh Sattriya se hai.
GALAT ✗ – Kuchipudi Andhra Pradesh ka dance hai aur Ranjumoni Saikia Assam ke art form se judi hain.
GALAT ✗ – Mohiniyattam Kerala ka female solo dance hai. Is field me Ranjumoni Saikia ka koi contribution nahi hai.

dance.q: Which of the following erstwhile princely states was mainly concerned with kathak?
dance.solution: Kathak ka vikas Mughal kal ke dauran Awadh ke Nawab Wajid Ali Shah ke sanrakshan (patronage) mein sabse zyada hua. Wajid Ali Shah ne Lucknow Gharana ko sthapit kiya jo Kathak ke liye famous hai. Kathak 'Katha' shabd se aaya hai jiska arth hai 'kahani sunane wala'. Yaad rakho: Nawab Wajid Ali Shah khud ek acche dancer aur composer (Akhtar Piya) the.
why: GALAT ✗ – Tripura apne 'Hojagiri' aur 'Garia' dance ke liye jana jata hai, na ki Kathak ke liye. Is prashn ke liye ye sahi nahi hai kyunki Tripura North-East ka rajya hai jabki Kathak North India ka hai.
SAHI ✓ – Awadh (Lucknow) Kathak ka sabse bada kendra bana. Nawab Wajid Ali Shah ne is dance form ko darbar mein jagah di aur iski bhava-batana (expressions) technique ko naya roop diya.
GALAT ✗ – Vijayanagar samrajya South India (Karnataka) mein tha aur ye 'Yakshagana' aur Bharatnatyam ke shuruati roopon ke liye jana jata hai. Kathak se iska seedha sambandh nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Vadodara (Gujarat) 'Garba' aur 'Dandiya' ke liye famous hai. Halaki yahan ke Gaekwad rajaon ne kala ko badhava diya, par Kathak ka mukhya garh Awadh hi raha.

dance.q: Who among the following personalities is a professional Kuchipudi dancer?
dance.solution: Kuchipudi Andhra Pradesh ka classical dance hai jo 'Kuchelapuram' gaanv se shuru hua. Kausalya Reddy aur unke pati Raja-Radha Reddy is dance ke mukhya kalakar hain. Isme 'Tarangam' (peetal ki thali par dance) ek khaas visheshtha hai. Yaad rakho: Reddy surname wale adhikatar kalakar Kuchipudi se jude hote hain.
why: GALAT ✗ – Radha Sridhar Bharatnatyam ki ek prasiddh nartaki hain. Unhe 2018 mein Sangeet Natak Akademi Award mila tha. Wo Kuchipudi se nahi judi hain.
GALAT ✗ – Anupama Hoskere ek mashhoor Puppeteer (Kathputli kalakar) hain jo Karnataka se hain. Wo 'Dhaatu' puppet theater chalati hain, dance nahi.
GALAT ✗ – Surupa Sen Odissi dance ki ek bahut badi dancer aur choreographer hain. Wo Bengaluru ke 'Nrityagram' se judi hain. Isliye ye option galat hai.
SAHI ✓ – Kausalya Reddy ek veteran Kuchipudi dancer hain. Unhone is dance form ko duniya bhar mein promote kiya hai aur wo Raja Radha Reddy ki shishya aur patni hain.

dance.q: Pakhavaj syllables are mainly used to complete which of the following Indian classical dances?
dance.solution: Odissi dance mein 'Mardala' (jo Pakhavaj ka hi ek roop hai) ka prayog hota hai. Iske syllables (bol) jaise 'Dha Dhin Ta' dance ke footwork aur chakkaron ko pura karte hain. Odissi 'Odra Magadhi' shaili se nikla hai. Yaad rakho: Odissi mein Tribhanga mudra (body ka 3 jagah se mudna) sabse important hai.
why: GALAT ✗ – Manipuri dance mein 'Pung' (ek dholak jaisa yantra) ka use hota hai. Pakhavaj syllables ka mukhya upyog yahan nahi hota.
GALAT ✗ – Kathakali Kerala ka hai aur isme 'Chenda' aur 'Maddalam' jaise vadya yantra bajaye jate hain. Pakhavaj North Indian traditions se zyada juda hai.

GALAT ✗ – Kathak mein 'Tabla' ka prayog sabse zyada hota hai. Halaki purane samay mein Pakhavaj bajta tha, par Odissi ke context mein Pakhavaj ke syllables (bol) ko 'Mardala' ke roop mein zyada mahatva diya jata hai.
SAHI ✓ – Odissi dance ki mukhya sangat 'Mardala' (Pakhavaj family) se hoti hai. Iske bina Odissi ki prastuti adhuri mani jati hai.

dance.q: Yakshagana is a famous folk dance of which of the following states?
dance.solution: Yakshagana Karnataka ka ek paramparik theater/folk dance hai jo Vaishnava bhakti andolan se prabhavit hai. Isme bhari makeup, vishal mukut (headgear) aur loud music ka use hota hai. Ye raat bhar chalta hai aur isme Ramayana/Mahabharata ki kahaniyan dikhayi jati hain. Yaad rakho: Isme 'Bhagavatha' (singer/narrator) sabse important hota hai.
why: GALAT ✗ – Kerala apne classical dance Kathakali aur Mohiniyattam ke liye jana jata hai. Yakshagana padosi rajya Karnataka ka hai.
SAHI ✓ – Yakshagana Karnataka ka sabse lokpriya kala roop hai. Isme dance, music, dialogue aur costume ka mishran hota hai.
GALAT ✗ – Tamil Nadu Bharatnatyam aur 'Karagattam' jaise folk dances ke liye jana jata hai. Yakshagana wahan ka mool dance nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Orissa (Odisha) Odissi aur Chhau dance ke liye prasiddh hai. Yakshagana ka Orissa se koi sambandh nahi hai.

dance.q: Lacchu Maharaj is famous Indian classical dancer and choreographer of ____.
dance.solution: Pandit Lacchu Maharaj Lucknow Gharana ke ek mahan Kathak dancer the. Inka asli naam Baijnath Prasad tha. Inhone 'Pakeezah' aur 'Mughal-e-Azam' jaisi filmon mein dance choreograph kiya tha. Yaad rakho: Lucknow Gharana ke lagbhag sabhi 'Maharaj' (Birju, Lacchu, Shambhu, Acchan) Kathak se jude hain.
why: GALAT ✗ – Chhau dance (East India) ke mukhya kalakar Makar Dhwaja Darogha jaise log hain. Lacchu Maharaj ka isse sambandh nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Odissi ke sabse bade naam Kelucharan Mohapatra hain. Lacchu Maharaj North Indian style (Kathak) ke master the.
GALAT ✗ – Kuchipudi (Andhra) ke liye Vempati Chinna Satyam mashhoor hain. Lacchu Maharaj ka taluk UP ke Lucknow se tha.
SAHI ✓ – Lacchu Maharaj Kathak ke Lucknow gharane ke stambh mane jate hain. Wo apne bhav (expressions) ke liye pure vishwa mein mashhoor the.

dance.q: 'Pung Cholom' is usually performed on religious auspicious occasions on the tune of songs and drums. It is popularly performed in which of the following states?
dance.solution: Pung Cholom Manipur ka ek bahut hi energetic dance form hai, ise 'Roar of the Drums' bhi kaha jata hai. Isme 'Pung' (ek tarah ka mridanga/drum) bajate hue kalakar acrobatic stunts aur jumps karte hain. Ye Sankirtana tradition ka ek hissa hai jise UNESCO ne Cultural Heritage mana hai. Yaad rakho: Pung = Manipur ka Drum.
why: SAHI ✓ – Pung Cholom Manipur ka soul hai, jo Vaishnavism se juda hai aur drums ke saath perform kiya jata hai. Isliye ye bilkul sahi uttar hai.
GALAT ✗ – Maharashtra apne 'Lavani' aur 'Dhangari Gaja' ke liye jana jata hai, jisme dhol ka prayog hota hai par 'Pung' instrument yahan ka nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Uttar Pradesh me Kathak classical dance aur Nautanki/Raslila folk dances hote hain, Pung Cholom ka is state se koi sambandh nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Kerala 'Kathakali' aur 'Mohiniyattam' ke liye prasiddh hai. Yahan 'Chenda' drum ka prayog hota hai na ki Manipuri Pung ka.

dance.q: Identify this famous Indian classical dancer. She is a guru of both Bharatanatyam and odissi dance styles. He received the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award in the year 1987.
dance.solution: Sonal Mansingh ek legendary dancer hain jo Bharatanatyam aur Odissi dono me maharat rakhti hain. Inhe 1992 me Padma Bhushan aur 2003 me Padma Vibhushan (sabse kam umra me) mila tha. Ye Rajya Sabha ki manoniit (nominated) sadasya bhi rahi hain. Yaad rakho: Sonal = Dual (Bharatanatyam + Odissi).
why: GALAT ✗ – Shovana Narayan ek mashhoor Kathak dancer hain aur IAS officer bhi rahi hain. Unka talluk Lucknow/Jaipur gharana style se hai.
GALAT ✗ – Padma Subramaniam Bharatanatyam ki diggaj hain aur unhone 'Bharatanrytyam' style develop kiya hai, par wo Odissi ke liye nahi jani jatiin.
GALAT ✗ – Mrinalini Sarabhai Darpana Academy ki founder thin aur Bharatanatyam ke saath Kathakali ki expert thin, Odissi ki nahi.
SAHI ✓ – Sonal Mansingh hi wo vyaktitva hain jo Bharatanatyam aur Odissi dono ki guru hain aur 1987 me Sangeet Natak Akademi awardee rahi hain.

dance.q: Which of the following dances is also known as Ekaharya, in which a dance plays multiple roles in a single dance performance?
dance.solution: Bharatanatyam ko 'Ekaharya' isliye kehte hain kyunki ek hi dancer alag-alag kirdaar (characters) nibhata hai. Ye Tamil Nadu ke mandiro me 'Devadasis' dwara shuru kiya gaya tha, jise pehle 'Sadir Attam' kehte the. Iske pramukh tatva Alarippu, Jatiswaram aur Tillana hain. Yaad rakho: Ek dancer = Ekaharya = Bharatanatyam.
why: SAHI ✓ – Bharatanatyam me ek hi artist puri katha sunata hai aur multiple roles play karta hai, isliye ise Ekaharya Lasyanga kaha jata hai.
GALAT ✗ – Kathakali Kerala ka dance-drama hai jisme har character ke liye alag dancer hota hai aur bhaari makeup (vesham) ka prayog hota hai.
GALAT ✗ – Kathak UP ka classical dance hai jo 'Kathakars' (storytellers) dwara shuru hua, isme chakkar aur footwork par zor hota hai, par ise Ekaharya nahi kehte.
GALAT ✗ – Kuchipudi Andhra Pradesh ka dance hai jo pehle group drama (Bhagavatha Melu) tha, baad me solo hua, par 'Ekaharya' term Bharatanatyam ke liye specific hai.

dance.q: Odissi dance style is originally related to which state?
dance.solution: Odissi Odisha ka prachin classical dance hai jo 'Mahari' (temple dancers) aur 'Gotipua' (ladke jo ladkiyon ka roop dharte hain) se nikla hai. Isme 'Tribhanga' posture (sharir ka teen jagah se mudna) sabse khaas hai. Guru Kelucharan Mohapatra ne is dance ko modern pehchan dilayi. Yaad rakho: Odissi = Odisha + Tribhanga mudra.
why: SAHI ✓ – Odissi ka naam hi Odisha rajya se aaya hai aur ye wahan ke Jagannath mandir ki paramparaon se juda hai.
GALAT ✗ – Tamil Nadu 'Bharatanatyam' ka ghar hai, jo Bharat ka sabse purana classical dance mana jata hai.
GALAT ✗ – Kerala me Kathakali aur Mohiniyattam jaise classical dances ka janm hua hai, Odissi ka nahi.
GALAT ✗ – Andhra Pradesh 'Kuchipudi' dance style ke liye famous hai, jo apni speed aur brass plate par dance karne ke liye jana jata hai.

dance.q: Which of the following dance styles reflects the plight of women whose spouses go away from home?
dance.solution: Birha Bhojpuri kshetra (UP aur Bihar) ka ek bahut bhavuk folk song aur dance hai. 'Birha' shabd 'Viraha' se aaya hai, jiska matlab hota hai 'separation' (vichhod). Jab pati kamane ke liye bahar chala jata hai, to patni apne dukh aur intezar ko is geet ke madhyam se vyakt karti hai. Yaad rakho: Birha = Viraha (Separation).
why: GALAT ✗ – Pyka (Paika) Odisha aur Jharkhand ka ek martial folk dance hai jo Munda community ke warriors dwara perform kiya jata hai.
SAHI ✓ – Birha ka mukhya vishay hi 'separation' hai, jisme birahini (woman) apne pardesi pati ke liye apna dard gaati hai.
GALAT ✗ – Mataki Madhya Pradesh (Malwa region) ka folk dance hai jo shaadiyo me ghade (pot) ko sar par rakh kar kiya jata hai.
GALAT ✗ – Alkaap Bengal aur Jharkhand ka ek rural dance-drama hai jo shiv gajan festival ke waqt perform kiya jata hai.

dance.q: Madhavi Mudgal is related to which classical dance of India?
dance.solution: Madhavi Mudgal Odissi ki ek bahut badi dancer hain jo apne refined style ke liye jani jati hain. Odissi dance Odisha state ka hai aur isme 'Tribhanga' posture (body ka teen jagah se mudna) sabse important hota hai. Madhavi ji ko 1990 mein Padma Shri aur 1996 mein Sangeet Natak Akademi award mil chuka hai. Inke pita, Pandit Vinay Chandra Maudgalya, Gandharva Mahavidyalaya ke founder the. **Yaad rakho:** Kelucharan Mohapatra aur Madhavi Mudgal dono Odissi ke 'Pillar' maane jate hain.
why: GALAT ✗ – Kathak Uttar Pradesh ka classical dance hai jisme footwork aur 'Chakkar' par focus hota hai. Madhavi ji is gharane se nahi judi hain.
SAHI ✓ – Madhavi Mudgal Odissi ki prashidh nartaki hain aur unhone is dance form ko global level par pehchan dilayi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Sattriya Assam ka classical dance hai jisko Srimanta Sankardev ne shuru kiya tha. Ye Vaishnavite monasteries (Sattras) mein hota hai.
GALAT ✗ – Manipuri Manipur ka dance hai jo Radha-Krishna ki Raasleela par based hota hai. Isme 'Pung' (drum) ka use hota hai.

dance.q: Who among the following was the first person to bring the concept of modern dance to India with his innovative approach and works?
dance.solution: Uday Shankar ko 'Father of Modern Dance in India' kaha jata hai. Unhone bina kisi formal training ke, Indian classical dance ko Western ballet techniques ke sath mix karke ek naya style banaya tha. Unhone 1938 mein Almora (Uttarakhand) mein 'India Cultural Centre' khola tha. Unhe 1971 mein Padma Vibhushan mila. **Yaad rakho:** Inka dance style 'Creative Dance' ke naam se bhi jana jata hai.
why: SAHI ✓ – Uday Shankar hi wo pehle vyakti the jinhone traditional dance ko modern elements ke sath joda.
GALAT ✗ – Padma Subrahmanyam ek mashoor Bharatanatyam dancer hain jinhone 'Bharata Nrityam' naam ka ek naya fusion style develop kiya hai.
GALAT ✗ – Guru Bipin Singh Manipuri dance ke bahut bade exponent aur teacher rahe hain, jinhe 'Father of Manipuri Dance' bhi kaha jata hai.
GALAT ✗ – Kelucharan Mohapatra Odissi dance ko revive karne wale mukhya guru hain, unka modern dance se direct talluk nahi hai.

dance.q: 'Kalbelia' dance style is related to which of the following states?
dance.solution: Kalbelia Rajasthan ki ek nomadic tribe (sapera community) ka dance hai. Isme female dancers kale rang ki 'Angrakha' aur 'Odhni' pehantin hain aur saamp (snake) ki tarah movements karti hain. Isme 'Been' aur 'Dholak' ka prayog hota hai. UNESCO ne 2010 mein ise 'Intangible Cultural Heritage' list mein shamil kiya tha. **Yaad rakho:** Gulabo Sapera is dance ki sabse famous dancer hain.
why: SAHI ✓ – Kalbelia Rajasthan ka folk dance hai jo waha ki 'Snake Charmer' community karti hai.
GALAT ✗ – Uttarakhand ke mukhya dance 'Choliya' aur 'Jhora' hain. Kalbelia yaha ka culture nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Odisha 'Chhau' aur 'Ghumura' ke liye jana jata hai, Kalbelia ke liye nahi.
GALAT ✗ – Punjab mein 'Bhangra' aur 'Giddha' prachalit hain, jo baisakhi aur harvest time par hote hain.

dance.q: Consider the following statements with reference to Dollu kunitha dance. Choose the correct statements. (i) This is a popular dance of Karnataka. (ii) The drums are decorated with colorful clothes. (iii) Song of religious and war enthusiasmare sung.
dance.solution: Dollu Kunitha Karnataka ka ek powerhouse folk dance hai jo 'Kuruba' samuday (shepherd community) dwara kiya jata hai. Ye Bhagwan Beereshwara (Lord Shiva ka roop) ki pooja se juda hai. Isme bade 'Dollu' (drums) ko rang-birange kapdo se sajaya jata hai. Isme dance ke sath-sath yudh (war) ki bhavna aur dharmik kahaniyan sunayi jati hain. **Yaad rakho:** 'Kunitha' shabd ka matlab hi Karnataka mein 'Dance' hota hai.
why: GALAT ✗ – Ye incomplete hai kyunki statement (i) Karnataka ka hona bhi utna hi sahi aur zaruri hai.
GALAT ✗ – Sirf statement (i) sahi nahi hai, baaki dono drums aur songs wale points bhi is dance ki asli pehchan hain.
GALAT ✗ – Ye option war songs (iii) ko miss kar raha hai, jo is energetic dance ka important part hain.
SAHI ✓ – Teeno hi statements Dollu Kunitha ke baare mein bilkul sahi hain.

dance.q: R. Muthukannammal was awarded the Padma Shri 2022 for which of the following dance styles?
dance.solution: R. Muthukannammal Tamil Nadu ki ek veteran dancer hain jo 'Sadir' nritya se judi hain. Sadir asal mein Bharatanatyam ka purana aur traditional roop hai jo Devdasiyo dwara mandiro mein kiya jata tha. Unhe 2022 mein Padma Shri se nawaza gaya kyunki wo is vilupt hoti (dying art) kala ki aakhri kuch nartakiyo mein se ek hain. **Yaad rakho:** Sadir ko hi modern time mein E. Krishna Iyer ne Bharatanatyam ka naam diya tha.
why: SAHI ✓ – R. Muthukannammal ko Sadir dance form ko zinda rakhne ke liye hi 2022 ka Padma Shri mila.
GALAT ✗ – Sattriya Assam ka dance hai. Muthukannammal ka sambandh Tamil Nadu ke traditional dance se hai.
GALAT ✗ – Mohiniyattam Kerala ka feminine dance hai, jo 'Vishnu ke Mohini roop' par based hota hai.
GALAT ✗ – Kathakali Kerala ka dance-drama hai jisme bhari makeup aur costumes ka use hota hai.

dance.q: Which of the following classical dance styles is related to Hindustani classical music?
dance.solution: Kathak North India ka pramukh classical dance hai jo Mughal darbaron mein phala-phoola. Ye akela classical dance hai jo Hindustani Music (Table aur Pakhawaj) se juda hai, jabki South Indian dances Carnatic music use karte hain. Isme 'Tatkar' (footwork) aur 'Chakkar' par zyada dhyan diya jata hai. Yaad rakho: Kathak = North India = Hindustani Music.
why: GALAT ✗ – Sattriya Assam ka Vaishnavite classical dance hai jise Mahapurush Sankaradev ne shuru kiya tha. Ye Borgeet music par chalta hai, Hindustani par nahi.
GALAT ✗ – Mohiniyattam Kerala ka ek 'Lascya' pradhan dance hai jo Lord Vishnu ke Mohini roop ko dikhata hai. Ye Carnatic music style ko follow karta hai.
GALAT ✗ – Kathakali Kerala ka ek dance-drama hai jisme chehre ke bhaav aur elaborate makeup hota hai. Isme Sopanam sangeet ka istemal hota hai, Hindustani ka nahi.
SAHI ✓ – Kathak Lucknow, Jaipur aur Banaras gharanon ke zariye Hindustani Shastriya Sangeet ke saath juda hua hai. Iske bol aur taal Hindustani sangeet se mel khate hain.

dance.q: Kanaka Raju, awarded the 2021 Padma shri Award, is associated with which of the following tribal folk dance styles?
dance.solution: Kanaka Raju Telangana ke Raj Gond tribe se talluk rakhte hain. Unhone Gussadi dance ko zinda rakhne ke liye 40 saal se zyada waqt tak kaam kiya, jiske liye 2021 mein Padma Shri mila. Gussadi dance Deepavali ke mauke par Gondi logon dwara kiya jata hai. Yaad rakho: Kanaka Raju = Gussadi = Telangana.
why: GALAT ✗ – Popir Arunachal Pradesh ki Galo tribe ka ek lok nritya hai, jo Mopin festival ke dauran devi ko prasan karne ke liye kiya jata hai.
SAHI ✓ – Kanaka Raju 'Gussadi Dance' ke master hain. Is dance mein nartak sher ki khaal aur mor pankh ka mukut (Mal Boora) pehente hain.
GALAT ✗ – Chalo dance Arunachal Pradesh ki Nocte tribe ka harvest festival dance hai jo 'Loku' tyohar par manaya jata hai.
GALAT ✗ – Wancho dance Arunachal Pradesh ki Wancho tribe dwara kiya jane wala ek tribal dance hai, jo khaas taur par social gatherings mein dikhta hai.

dance.q: Changai dance is related to which state of India?
dance.solution: Changai dance Nagaland ki 'Chang' tribe dwara kiya jata hai. Ye dance 'Naknyulum' festival ke dauran hota hai. Isme nartak colorful traditional costumes pehente hain aur Nagaland ki warrior culture ko dikhate hain. Yaad rakho: Chang tribe = Nagaland = Changai Dance.
why: GALAT ✗ – Maharashtra ke pramukh nritya Lavani aur Nakata hain. Yahan Changai dance ka koi historical relation nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Madhya Pradesh mein Matki, Grida aur Phulpati jaise folk dances hote hain jo wahan ki tribal lifestyle ko dikhate hain.
SAHI ✓ – Changai Nagaland ka ek mukhya tribal dance hai jo Naknyulum festival ke mauke par Chang nagaon dwara kiya jata hai.
GALAT ✗ – Jharkhand mein Chhau, Karma aur Sarhul jaise lok nritya mashhoor hain jo Nagaland ke Changai se bilkul alag hain.

dance.q: Who was honored as the resident dancer of Tirumale Tirupati Devasthanams for his unique contribution in promoting classical dance forms?
dance.solution: Yamini Krishnamurthy ko 'Asthana Nartaki' (Resident Dancer) ke roop mein TTD dwara sammanit kiya gaya tha. Wo Bharatanatyam aur Kuchipudi dono ki mahir hain. Unhe Padma Vibhushan se bhi nawaza gaya hai. Unki autobiography ka naam 'A Passion for Dance' hai. Yaad rakho: Resident Dancer of TTD = Yamini Krishnamurthy.
why: SAHI ✓ – Yamini Krishnamurthy ko Tirumala Tirupati Devasthanam ki resident dancer hone ka garv prapt hai, jo unke nritya yogdan ka samman hai.
GALAT ✗ – Uma Sharma ek prasiddh Kathak nartaki hain jinhone Braj ki 'Raslila' ko Kathak mein dobara zinda kiya. Wo TTD ki resident dancer nahi rahi hain.
GALAT ✗ – Ragini Devi Indian classical dance ki ek revivalist thi aur American-born dancer thi jinhone Kathakali aur Mohiniyattam ko popular banaya.
GALAT ✗ – Rukmini Devi Arundale ne Bharatanatyam ko 'Sadir' se modern form mein badla aur Kalakshetra Foundation ki sthapna ki, par TTD resident dancer ye nahi thi.

dance.q: Padmaja Reddy, who was awarded the Padma Shri in 2022, is famous for which of the following dance styles?
dance.solution: Padmaja Reddy Telangana ki ek mashhoor Kuchipudi nartaki hain. Unhone 'Kakatiyam' naam ki ek nritya shaili ko dobara revive kiya jo Kakatiya dynasty ke samay ki thi. Unhe 2022 mein Padma Shri aur 2015 mein Sangeet Natak Akademi Award mila. Yaad rakho: Padmaja Reddy = Kuchipudi = Telangana.
why: GALAT ✗ – Odissi Odisha ka shastriya nritya hai jisme 'Tribhanga' mudra important hai. Padmaja Reddy is shaili se nahi judi hain.
SAHI ✓ – Padmaja Reddy Kuchipudi ki ek diggaj kalakar hain aur unhe Telangana ki pehli mahila hone ka gaurav hai jise is kshetra mein Sangeet Natak Akademi Award mila.
GALAT ✗ – Bharatanatyam Tamil Nadu ka prachin dance hai. Padmaja Reddy Telangana/Andhra ki Kuchipudi parampara ko aage badhati hain.
GALAT ✗ – Kathak North India ka dance hai jisme chakkar aur footwork hota hai. Padmaja Reddy ka sambandh isse nahi, balki Kuchipudi se hai.

dance.q: Thabal Chongba is a folk dance of which state of India?
dance.solution: Thabal Chongba Manipur ka ek bahut hi popular folk dance hai, jo 'Yaoshang Festival' (Holi ke samay) ke dauran kiya jata hai. Iska matlab hota hai 'Moonlight Dance' kyunki ye raat ko khule maidan mein hota hai. Ismein ladke aur ladkiyan ek dusre ka haath pakad kar ek circle mein dance karte hain. Yaad rakho: Manipur = Yaoshang = Thabal Chongba.
why: GALAT ✗ – Mizoram apne 'Cheraw' (Bamboo dance) aur Khuallam ke liye jana jata hai. Is prashn ke liye ye sahi nahi hai kyunki Thabal Chongba yahan ka nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – West Bengal mein Gambhira, Brita aur Jhumair jaise lok nritya hote hain. Yahan Thabal Chongba ka chalan nahi hai.
SAHI ✓ – Manipur ka ye nritya Meitei samuday dwara Yaoshang ke paanch dino tak kiya jata hai, jo iska bilkul sahi uttar hai.
GALAT ✗ – Goa apne Fugdi, Dhalo aur Dekhni dances ke liye famous hai. Thabal Chongba North-East India ka dance hai, Goa ka nahi.

dance.q: Uday Shankar was an Indian dancer known for making ____.
dance.solution: Uday Shankar ko 'Father of Modern Dance' in India kaha jata hai. Unhone Indian classical techniques ko Western theatrical styles ke saath milakar ek nayi 'Fusion' ya 'Modern' vidha banayi thi. Unhone Almora mein 'Uday Shankar India Culture Centre' bhi khola tha. Yaad rakho: Uday Shankar = Modern/Fusion Dance.
why: GALAT ✗ – Indian Dance style ek bahut broad term hai jisme classical aur folk dono aate hain. Uday Shankar ne sirf purani shaili nahi, balki unka mishran pesh kiya tha.
SAHI ✓ – Unhone Indian Classical (Katha-kali/Bharatnatyam) aur Western ballet ko mix karke 'Fusion' style banaya, jo unki asli pehchan hai.
GALAT ✗ – Folk dance kshetriya hota hai jo aam logon dwara kiya jata hai, jabki Uday Shankar ne choreographed stage performances par kaam kiya tha.
GALAT ✗ – Unhone Western techniques zaroor use ki, par unka base hamesha Indian hi raha, isliye ise pure American style nahi keh sakte.

dance.q: Gulabo sapera is related to which of the following dance styles?
dance.solution: Gulabo Sapera Rajasthan ki ek mashhoor nartaki hain jinhone Kalbelia dance ko international pehchan dilayi. Kalbelia ko 'Snake Charmer Dance' bhi kehte hain aur ise 2010 mein UNESCO ki Intangible Heritage list mein shamil kiya gaya tha. Ismein 'Pungi' aur 'Duf' vadya yantra ka prayog hota hai. Yaad rakho: Gulabo = Kalbelia = Rajasthan.
why: GALAT ✗ – Kuchipudi Andhra Pradesh ka classical dance hai. Gulabo Sapera ka sambandh kisi classical dance se nahi balki folk dance se hai.
SAHI ✓ – Gulabo Sapera ne Kalbelia tribe ke is dance ko duniya bhar mein popular kiya, isliye ye sahi vikalp hai.
GALAT ✗ – Pandwani Chhattisgarh ka ek folk singing/storytelling style hai (Teejan Bai iski pramukh kalakar hain), iska Gulabo Sapera se lena-dena nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Sattriya Assam ka classical dance hai jo Vaishnavism se juda hai. Ye Rajasthan ke Kalbelia se bilkul alag hai.

dance.q: Indiand classical dancer Kumkum Dhar awareded the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award 2020 for her contribution in _____
dance.solution: Kumkum Dhar Lucknow Gharana ki ek bahut badi Kathak nartaki hain. Unhone Bhatkhande Sanskriti Vishwavidyalaya ki Vice-Chancellor ke roop mein bhi seva di hai. Kathak Uttar Pradesh ka classical dance hai jisme 'Tatkar' (footwork) aur 'Chakkar' ki bahut ahmiyat hoti hai. Yaad rakho: Kumkum Dhar = Kathak = Lucknow Gharana.
why: GALAT ✗ – Odissi Odisha ka dance hai jisme 'Tribhanga' posture hota hai. Kumkum Dhar is vidha ki kalakar nahi hain.
GALAT ✗ – Manipuri dance Manipur ke Vaishnav culture se juda hai. Kumkum Dhar ka contribution North Indian classical dance mein raha hai.
SAHI ✓ – Kumkum Dhar ko 2020 ka Sangeet Natak Akademi award Kathak mein unke vishesh yogdaan ke liye diya gaya hai.
GALAT ✗ – Bharatnatyam Tamil Nadu ka hai. Kumkum Dhar ka career aur training Kathak ke ird-gird rahi hai.

dance.q: Kuchipudi dance V. Satyanarayana Sharma was honored with which of the following awards?
dance.solution: Vempati Satyanarayana Sharma Kuchipudi ke ek mahan guru aur dancer the. Unhe 'Bhama Kalapam' jaise nritya-natakon mein stree paatra (female roles) nibhane ke liye jana jata hai. Unhe 1970 mein Padma Shri aur Sangeet Natak Akademi Award bhi mila hai. Yaad rakho: V. Satyanarayana = Kuchipudi = Padma Shri.
why: GALAT ✗ – Kalidas Samman Madhya Pradesh sarkar dwara diya jane wala pratishthit award hai, par Satyanarayana ji ki sabse badi pehchan 1970 ka Padma Shri hai.
GALAT ✗ – Murtidevi Award Bhartiya Jnanpith dwara sahitya (literature) ke kshetra mein diya jata hai, dance ke liye nahi.
GALAT ✗ – Kabir Award saamaajik sadbhaav (social communal harmony) ke liye diya jata hai, nritya kala ke liye nahi.
SAHI ✓ – V. Satyanarayana Sharma ko 1970 mein Bharat sarkar dwara Padma Shri se nawaza gaya tha, jo unki kala ka bada samman tha.

dance.q: Dhimsa folk dance is performed by which of the following tribes?
dance.solution: Dhimsa Andhra Pradesh ke Visakhapatnam district ka ek bohot famous tribal dance hai. Isse Porja tribe ki women perform karti hain, khaas karke shaadiyon aur tyoharon ke mauke par. Isme 'Mori' (pipe instrument) aur 'Dappu' ka istemal hota hai jo Araku Valley ki khoobsurti ko darshata hai. Yaad rakho: Dhimsa = Araku (Andhra).
why: GALAT ✗ – Katie Valley Himachal Pradesh ke Shimla district mein hai, jo apni natural beauty ke liye jaani jati hai lekin yahan Dhimsa dance nahi hota. Is prashn ke liye ye sahi nahi hai kyunki Dhimsa ka sambandh South India se hai.
GALAT ✗ – Parvati Valley Himachal Pradesh (Kullu) mein hai jo trekkers ke liye famous hai, yahan Nati dance zyada popular hai. Is prashn ke liye ye galat hai kyunki ye North Indian location hai.
SAHI ✓ – Araku Valley Andhra Pradesh mein hai aur Dhimsa dance isi valley ki Porja tribe dwara kiya jata hai. Ye dance dosti aur bhaichare ka prateek hai.
GALAT ✗ – Solan Valley Himachal Pradesh mein hai jise 'Mushroom City of India' bhi kaha jata hai. Yahan ka culture Pahadi hai, Dhimsa se iska koi lena-dena nahi hai.

dance.q: Which of the following is a dance form performed by the Adi tribe of Arunachal Pradesh?
dance.solution: Tapu dance Arunachal Pradesh ki Adi tribe ka ek 'War Dance' hai, jo dushmanon ko darane ya vijay ke jashn mein kiya jata hai. Isme sirf purush (men) hissa lete hain. Arunachal ke aur bhi mahatvapurn dance hain jaise Popir, Ponung aur Bardo Chham. Yaad rakho: Adi log Tapu (Topu) bajate hain.
why: GALAT ✗ – Karma dance mukhya roop se Jharkhand, Chhattisgarh aur Madhya Pradesh ki tribes (jaise Gond, Baiga, Oraon) dwara Karma puja par kiya jata hai. Isliye ye Arunachal ki Adi tribe se mel nahi khata.
SAHI ✓ – Tapu dance Adi tribe ka ek utsah-bhara paridhan wala dance hai jo buri shaktion ko bhagane ke liye kiya jata hai.
GALAT ✗ – Sangphao jaisa koi major tribal dance Adi tribe se related nahi hai. Halanki Singpho ek tribe hai Arunachal mein, par Tapu hi Adi tribe ka signature dance hai.
GALAT ✗ – Kaksar dance Chhattisgarh ki Abujmaria tribe dwara barsat ke mausam mein kheti ki acchi paidawar ke liye kiya jata hai. Iska Adi tribe se koi sambandh nahi hai.

dance.q: In 1956 reminent Bharatanatyam dancer Rukimini Devi Arunadale received which of the following awards?
dance.solution: Rukmini Devi Arundale Bharatanatyam ki sabse badi hastiyon mein se ek hain jinhone 'Kalakshetra Foundation' ki sthapna ki. Wo Rajya Sabha mein nominate hone wali pehli woman dancer bhi thin. Unhe 1956 mein Padma Bhushan mila tha. Yaad rakho: 1956 - Padma Bhushan, 1957 - Sangeet Natak Akademi.
why: GALAT ✗ – Jnanpith Award Bharat ka sabse uncha 'Literature' (Sahitya) award hai jo lekhakon ko milta hai, nartakon (dancers) ko nahi. Isliye ye option galat hai.
GALAT ✗ – Saraswati Samman bhi ek literary award hai jo K.K. Birla Foundation dwara diya jata hai. Rukmini Devi ek dancer thin, isliye ye unhe nahi mila.
GALAT ✗ – Kabir Puraskar Bharat sarkar dwara 'Communal Harmony' (samajik sadbhavna) ko badhava dene ke liye diya jata hai. Ye art/dance ki field ka specific award nahi hai.
SAHI ✓ – 1956 mein unhe arts mein unke yogdan ke liye Padma Bhushan se sammanit kiya gaya tha. Wo animal rights activist bhi thin.

dance.q: Mundari dance is related to the tribal community of which Indian state?
dance.solution: Mundari dance Jharkhand ki Munda tribe ka traditional dance hai. Ye dance kheti ke seasons (harvesting) aur festivals jaise Mage, Phagu aur Karam ke waqt kiya jata hai. Isme Madal aur Nagada jaise instruments ka upyog hota hai. Yaad rakho: Munda Tribe = Mundari Dance (Jharkhand).
why: SAHI ✓ – Jharkhand ki Munda tribe apne sanskritik virasat ke liye jani jati hai, aur Mundari dance unka sabse pramukh nritya hai.
GALAT ✗ – Karnataka mein Yakshagana aur Dollu Kunitha jaise dance forms famous hain. Munda tribe yahan ki mool niwasi nahi hai, isliye ye galat hai.
GALAT ✗ – Arunachal Pradesh mein Ponung aur Popir jaise dance hote hain. Yahan ki tribes alag hain (Nyishi, Adi, Galo), Mundari yahan ka dance nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Mizoram mein Cheraw (Bamboo dance) aur Khuallam famous hai. Mundari dance ka Mizoram ke culture se koi talluk nahi hai.

dance.q: Who among the following is known as a descendant of the first kathak teacher Ishwari Prasad.
dance.solution: Kathak ke Lucknow Gharana ki neev Ishwari Prasad ji ne rakhi thi. Birju Maharaj (Brijmohan Mishra) unke hi vanshaj (descendant) hain aur unhone Kathak ko global level par pehchan dilayi. Wo Bindadin Maharaj ke parivar se taluq rakhte hain. Yaad rakho: Birju Maharaj = Lucknow Gharana + Ishwari Prasad lineage.
why: GALAT ✗ – Shambhu Maharaj bhi Lucknow gharana ke mahan kalakar hain aur Birju Maharaj ke chacha (uncle) the, lekin 'descendant' ke taur par Birju Maharaj ka naam sabse upar aata hai.
GALAT ✗ – Lacchu Maharaj bhi Birju Maharaj ke chacha the aur unhone Bollywood movies (Mughal-e-Azam) mein choreography ki thi, par vanshaj ki pramukh kadi mein Birju Maharaj ka naam pucha jata hai.
GALAT ✗ – Gopi Krishna Benaras Gharana se talluk rakhte the aur wo ek mahan Kathak dancer hone ke saath actor bhi the. Wo Ishwari Prasad ki direct lineage (Lucknow) se nahi hain.
SAHI ✓ – Birju Maharaj, Ishwari Prasad ki parampara ke sabse lokpriya vanshaj hain. Unhe 1986 mein Padma Vibhushan mila tha.

dance.q: Who among the following is the exponent of Kathak dance is the 19th century?
dance.solution: Kathak ke Lucknow gharana ke buniyaad rakhne waalo mein Kalika Prasad ji ka naam pramukh hai. Ye Maharaj Bindadin ke bhai thhe aur inhone thumri aur dance ko milane par kaam kiya. Unke bete Achchan, Lacchu aur Shambhu Maharaj ne Kathak ko duniya bhar mein pehchan dilayi. Yaad rakho: Lucknow Gharana = Maharaj family.
why: SAHI ✓ – Kalika Prasad 19th century ke mahan Kathak kalakar thhe aur Lucknow Gharana ke pillar maane jaate hain. Inhone Kathak mein 'Abhinaya' aur 'Thumri' ka mishran kiya thha.
GALAT ✗ – Jatin Goswami Assam ke 'Sattriya' dance ke bahut bade exponent hain aur unhe Sangeet Natak Akademi Award bhi mila hai. Isliye ye Kathak se jude nahi hain.
GALAT ✗ – Bhavanand Barbayan bhi 'Sattriya' dance (Assam) ke ek pratishthit guru aur nartak hain. Inka sambandh Majuli island ke sattras se hai.
GALAT ✗ – Krishna Panicker (ya Pannikar) Mohiniyattam aur Kathakali ke mahan guru maane jaate hain, khaas-kar Kerala Kalamandalam ke shuruati saalo mein unka bada yogdaan thha.

dance.q: Which of the following names is associated with Bharatnatyam?
dance.solution: Bharatnatyam Tamil Nadu ka shastriya nritya hai jo 'Sadir' se nikla hai. Dr. Narthaki Nataraj pehli Trans-woman bani jinhe Padma Shri mila Bharatnatyam ke liye. Inka naam Nataraja Ramakrishna ya Dr. Narthaki Nataraj ke roop mein exam mein pucha jata hai. Yaad rakho: Bharatnatyam = Fire dance.
why: GALAT ✗ – Pandit Birju Maharaj Kathak (Lucknow Kalka-Bindadin Gharana) ke sabse bade naam hain. Unhe 'Laya' ka jadugar kaha jata thha.
SAHI ✓ – Dr. Narthaki Nataraj (ya Nataraja of Dr. Narath) ek prasiddh Bharatnatyam dancer hain. Ye Tanjore-style Bharatnatyam mein mahir hain aur transgender community se aati hain.
GALAT ✗ – Guru Bipin Singh ko 'Father of Manipuri Dance' ke roop mein jana jata hai. Inhone Manipur ke nritya ko stage performance ke liye viksit kiya.
GALAT ✗ – Kelucharan Mohapatra Odissi dance ke sabse bade punaruddharak (revivalist) hain. Inhone Odissi ko vilupt hone se bachaya aur vishwa star par pahunchaya.

dance.q: Guru Debprasad Das Awardee Durga Charan Ranbir is a classical dance teacher and artist of ____?
dance.solution: Durga Charan Ranbir Odissi dance ke 'Debaprasad Das' style (dhara) ke sabse bade nartak aur guru hain. Ye shaili apne tribal (aadivasi) aur folk elements ke liye jani jati hai jo Odissi ko baaki shailiyon se alag banati hai. Yaad rakho: Ranbir = Odissi (Odisha).
why: GALAT ✗ – Manipuri dance ke pramukh kalakar Guru Bipin Singh aur Jhaveri sisters hain. Durga Charan Ranbir ka is state se koi sambandh nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Kathak North India (UP) ka dance hai jisme Sitara Devi aur Birju Maharaj jaise naam aate hain. Ranbir ji Odisha ki parampara se hain.
SAHI ✓ – Durga Charan Ranbir Odissi ke mahan guru hain. Inhe Guru Debaprasad Das samman mila hai kyunki ye unki hi parampara ko aage badha rahe hain.
GALAT ✗ – Kathakali Kerala ka mask dance hai jisme chehre ke bhaav aur mudraon ka khel hota hai. Isme 'Kalamandalam Gopi' jaise naam famous hain.

dance.q: The Ellora, Ajanta Dance festival held in _____ is an interface between the culture and history of India.
dance.solution: Ajanta-Ellora International Festival Maharashtra Tourism (MTDC) dwara har saal Aurangabad (Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar) ke Soneri Mahal mein ayojit kiya jata hai. Pehle ye January mein hota thha, lekin ab ise March ke samay ke liye fix kiya gaya hai. Yaad rakho: Ajanta-Ellora = Aurangabad = March.
why: SAHI ✓ – Ajanta-Ellora Dance festival aamtour par March mahine mein hota hai. Ye festival Indian classical dance aur music ka ek behtareen sangam hai.
GALAT ✗ – February mein 'Khajuraho Dance Festival' (MP) aur 'Taj Mahotsav' (UP) hote hain, isliye ye option confuse kar sakta hai par sahi nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – January mein Mamallapuram Dance Festival (Tamil Nadu) hota hai. Ellora festival ke liye March hi sahi samay hai.
GALAT ✗ – April mein aamtour par Baisakhi ya Bihu jaise harvest festivals hote hain, bade dance festivals is samay kam hote hain.

dance.q: ______ is a mask dance prevalent in south malabar?
dance.solution: Kummatikali Kerala ke Thrissur aur Palakkad ilako mein Onam ke dauran kiya jata hai. Isme nartak ghaas (grass) se bani veshbhusha pehente hain aur wooden masks (lakdi ke mukhoute) lagate hain. Ye 'South Malabar' ki ek lok-parampara hai. Yaad rakho: Kummatti = Mask + Grass dress.
why: SAHI ✓ – Kummatikali ek colorful mask dance hai jo Kerala ke South Malabar region mein Onam ke mauke par kiya jata hai. Isme mythological characters dikhaye jate hain.
GALAT ✗ – Zemmadon (ya isse milta julta naam) kisi pramukh South Malabar mask dance ka nahi hai. Ye option yahan fit nahi baithta.
GALAT ✗ – Parichakali (Parichamuttukali) Kerala aur Lakshadweep ka ek martial art dance hai jisme 'Dhaal' (shield) aur 'Talwar' ka upyog hota hai, mask ka nahi.
GALAT ✗ – Dhangar dance Goa aur Maharashtra ke charvaho (shepherds) dwara kiya jata hai jab wo chaturmas ke baad ghar lautte hain.

dance.q: In which of the following dances the dancers balance pots with lit lamps on their heads?
dance.solution: Chari dance Rajasthan ke Ajmer aur Kishangarh ilake ka ek behad sundar folk dance hai, jo khaas karke Gurjar aur Saini community ki mahilaon dwara kiya jata hai. Isme sir par brass pots (chari) rakhkar usme kapas ke beej (binola) aur tel dalkar aag lagayi jati hai. Ye dance shadi ya bete ke janam jaise khushi ke mauko par hota hai. Yaad rakho: 'Chari' matlab pot, aur pot me 'Aag' (fire) iski pehchan hai.
why: GALAT ✗ – Tamasha Maharashtra ka ek traditional folk theatre form hai, jisme Lavani dance ka upyog hota hai aur 'Kolhati' community ise karti hai. Isme sir par jalte hue diye balance nahi kiye jaate.
SAHI ✓ – Chari dance me mahilayein apne sir par kai bartan (pots) balance karti hain jinke upar jalte hue diye ya aag hoti hai, jo Rajasthan ki sanskriti ko dikhata hai.
GALAT ✗ – Koli dance Maharashtra aur Goa ke fisherman community (koli) dwara kiya jata hai, jo samundar ki lehron aur machli pakadne ke tarikon ko darshata hai.
GALAT ✗ – Dhangari Gaja Maharashtra ke Sholapur district ke Dhangar (charwahe) community ka dance hai, jo apne bhagwan Biruba ko prasann karne ke liye kiya jata hai.

dance.q: Which of the following padma Vibhushan awardee famous Indian classical dance has made an important contribution in reviving odissi classical dance in the 20th century?
dance.solution: Surendra Nath Jena Odissi dance ke ek mahan guru aur reformer rahe hain. Unhone Odissi me 'Jena Style' ko vikasit kiya, jo Odisha ke mandiron ki moortiyon (sculptures) aur tribal culture se prabhavit tha. Odissi ko 20th century me dobara zinda (revival) karne me inka yogdan atulniya hai. Yaad rakho: Odissi revival ke 'Trinity' me Kelucharan Mohapatra, Pankaj Charan Das aur Deba Prasad Das aate hain, lekin Jena ji ka apna alag style tha.
why: GALAT ✗ – Guru Kelucharan Mohapatra Odissi ke sabse bade naam hain aur pehle vyakti the jinhe Odisha se Padma Vibhushan mila, lekin yahan specific context Jena ji ke contribution ka pucha hai.
SAHI ✓ – Surendra Nath Jena ne Odissi ko ek nayi disha di aur ise 20th century me revive karne me mahatvapurn bhumika nibhayi.
GALAT ✗ – Gangadhar Pradhan bhi ek veteran Odissi exponent aur teacher hain jinhone Konark Natya Mandap ki sthapna ki, par wo is specific revivalist context me answer nahi hain.
GALAT ✗ – Hare Krishna Behera Odissi ke ek pratishthit guru hain jinhone Delhi me Odissi ko lokpriya banaya, par question ke context me option (b) sahi hai.

dance.q: Mallika sarabhai is the most famous Indian dancer known for ____?
dance.solution: Mallika Sarabhai, mahan scientist Vikram Sarabhai aur mritnangana Mrinalini Sarabhai ki beti hain. Wo do classical dances—Bharatnatyam (Tamil Nadu) aur Kuchipudi (Andhra Pradesh) me maharat rakhti hain. Unhone 'Darpana Academy' ke zariye kala ko samajik badlav ka madhyam banaya. Yaad rakho: Mallika Sarabhai ne Peter Brook ke play 'Mahabharata' me Draupadi ka amar kirdar nibhaya tha.
why: GALAT ✗ – Mallika Sarabhai Bharatnatyam to karti hain, lekin Odissi unka mukhya dance form nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Kuchipudi unka expertise area hai, lekin Kathak North India ka dance hai jisse wo judi nahi hain.
GALAT ✗ – Bharatnatyam sahi hai, lekin Kathak ke liye Birju Maharaj ya Lachhu Maharaj jaise naam famous hain, Mallika ji nahi.
SAHI ✓ – Mallika Sarabhai in dono (Kuchipudi aur Bharatnatyam) dance forms ki ek international star aur activist hain.

dance.q: Yoga sunder Desai, a pioneer in the world of Indian dance in the pre independence era, was born 16 July 1921 in ____?
dance.solution: Yoga Sunder Desai Indian dance world ke ek anokhe vyakti the. Inka janam Gujarat ke Limbdi riyasat me hua tha. Inhone 'Indian Revivalist Group' ki sthapna 1948 me ki thi. Ye na sirf dancer the balki azadi ke samay princely states ko India me merge karne me bhi inki bhumika rahi. Yaad rakho: Desai ji ne folk aur classical dance ko blend karke naye prayog kiye the.
why: SAHI ✓ – Yoga Sunder Desai ka janam Gujarat me hua tha aur wo wahan ki ek royal family se belong karte the.
GALAT ✗ – Madhya Pradesh apne Khajuraho festival ke liye jana jata hai, lekin Desai ji ka janam sthan ye nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Rajasthan folk dances ke liye rich hai, par Desai ji ki roots Gujarat ki princely states me thi.
GALAT ✗ – Maharashtra Tamasha aur Lavani ke liye jana jata hai, par ye Desai ji ki birthplace nahi hai.

dance.q: Famous Jhaveri sisters are related to ____ classical dance style.
dance.solution: Jhaveri Sisters (Nayana, Ranjana, Suvarna aur Darshana) Manipuri dance ki sabse badi pehchan hain. Inhone Guru Bipin Singh se talim li aur Manipuri dance ko pure vishwa me pahunchaya. Manipuri dance me Radha-Krishna ki 'Raaslila' mukhya hoti hai aur isme 'Pung' (drum) ka use hota hai. Yaad rakho: Jhaveri = Manipuri, ye SSC ka favorite repeat question hai.
why: GALAT ✗ – Kathak Lucknow, Jaipur aur Banaras gharane se juda hai (e.g., Birju Maharaj), Jhaveri sisters isse nahi judi hain.
SAHI ✓ – Jhaveri behnein Manipur ke classical dance style ki vishwasthiya prastutkarta hain.
GALAT ✗ – Odissi Odisha ka dance hai jisme Kelucharan Mohapatra aur Sonal Mansingh jaise naam aate hain, Jhaveri sisters nahi.
GALAT ✗ – Bharatanatyam Tamil Nadu ka hai jisme Rukmini Devi Arundale mukhya hain, Manipuri se iska koi lena dena nahi.

dance.q: Shambhu Maharaj was awarded the Padma Shri for his contribution to which of the following dances in India?
dance.solution: Shambhu Maharaj Kathak ke sabse bade naam hain, jo Lucknow 'Kalka-Bindadin' Gharana se talluk rakhte the. Inhone Kathak me 'Thumri' aur 'Bhava' ko ek nayi oonchai di. 1956 me inhen Padma Shri mila. Inke bhai Achchan Maharaj aur Lachhu Maharaj bhi isi kshetra ke diggaj the. Yaad rakho: 'Maharaj' surname aksar Lucknow Kathak gharane se juda hota hai.
why: SAHI ✓ – Shambhu Maharaj Lucknow Gharana ke pratham kalakar the jo 'Bhava' (expressions) me maharat rakhte the. Inhone Kathak ko duniya bhar me pehchan dilayi.
GALAT ✗ – Manipuri Manipur ka shastriya nritya hai jo Radha-Krishna ki 'Raasleela' par adharit hai. Isse Jhaveri behne judi hain, Shambhu Maharaj nahi.
GALAT ✗ – Bharatanatyam Tamil Nadu ka dance hai jisme Rukmini Devi Arundale aur Padma Subrahmanyam jaise naam aate hain. Shambhu Maharaj ka isse sambandh nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Kuchipudi Andhra Pradesh ka dance hai jisme Vempati Chinna Satyam mashhoor hain. Ye Shambhu Maharaj ki shaili nahi hai.

dance.q: Who among the following founded the Odissi dance shool 'Srijan' in 1993?
dance.solution: Guru Kelucharan Mahapatra ko 'Odissi ka Punaruddharak' (Reviver) mana jata hai. Inhone 1993 me Bhubaneswar me 'Srjan' school khola. Inhen Bharat ke teeno bade Padma awards (Vibhushan, Bhushan, Shri) mil chuke hain. Yaad rakho: 'Srjan' ka matlab 'Creation' hota hai aur ye Kelucharan ji ka hi brainchild hai.
why: SAHI ✓ – Guru Kelucharan Mahapatra ne hi 'Srjan' (Odissi Nrityabasa) ki sthapna 1993 me ki thi taaki wo is kala ko agli peedhi tak pahuncha saken.
GALAT ✗ – Ratikant Mohapatra, Guru Kelucharan ji ke bete hain aur Srjan ko chala rahe hain, par founder unke pita the.
GALAT ✗ – Madhavi Mudgal ek prasiddh Odissi nartaki hain par wo 'Gandharva Mahavidyalaya' se judi hain, unhone Srjan nahi banaya.
GALAT ✗ – Kumkum Mohanty Odissi ki ek mahan kalakar hain jinhe Sangeet Natak Akademi award mila hai, par Srjan ka shrey unhe nahi jata.

dance.q: ____ created ''SRIJAN'' in 1993 along with his wife (who is also a dancer) and son.
dance.solution: Odissi dance ko ghar-ghar pahunchane wale Guru Kelucharan Mahapatra ne apni patni Laxmipriya Mohapatra (jo khud pehli mahila thin jinhone manch par Odissi kiya) aur bete Ratikant ke saath milkar 'SRIJAN' school banaya. Wo pehle Odia kalakar the jinhe Padma Vibhushan mila. Yaad rakho: Kelucharan ji pehle 'Gotipua' aur 'Pakhawaj' vadak bhi the.
why: GALAT ✗ – Deba Prasad Das Odissi ke 'Tridhara' style ke janak maane jate hain, par Srjan school unka nahi tha.
GALAT ✗ – Pankaj Charan Das ko 'Odissi ka Adi Guru' kaha jata hai kyunki wo Mahari parampara se aaye the, par unhone Srjan nahi banaya.
SAHI ✓ – Kelucharan Mahapatra ne hi parivaar ke saath milkar 1993 me Bhubaneswar me ye sanstha kholi thi.
GALAT ✗ – Raghunath Dutta Odissi ke ek purane guru hain jinhone dheron shishya taiyar kiye, par wo Srjan ke sansthapak nahi hain.

dance.q: Which of the following dances is dedicated to temples and was earlier known as Sader?
dance.solution: Bharatanatyam Bharat ka sabse purana classical dance hai (Tamil Nadu). Ise pehle 'Sadir Attam' ya 'Dasi Attam' kaha jata tha kyunki ye mandiro me 'Devadasis' dwara kiya jata hai. Iska varnan 'Natyashastra' aur 'Abhinaya Darpana' me milta hai. Yaad rakho: Sadir = Solo dance performance in temples.
why: SAHI ✓ – Bharatanatyam ko hi pehle 'Sadir' kaha jata tha. E. Krishna Iyer aur Rukmini Devi ne ise naya naam aur samman dilaya.
GALAT ✗ – Kathak Uttar Pradesh ka hai aur ye 'Kathakars' (storytellers) se nikla hai. Ise kabhi Sadir nahi kaha gaya.
GALAT ✗ – Manipuri ko 'Jagoi' ke naam se jana jata hai aur ye Vaishnav parampara par adharit hai, Sadir par nahi.
GALAT ✗ – Kathakali Kerala ka 'Dance-Drama' hai jo apne bhari makeup ke liye jana jata hai. Iska purana naam Sadir nahi tha.

dance.q: Dr. Sunanda Nair is an artist, recognized as an artist, teacher and proponent of ____.
dance.solution: Dr. Sunanda Nair Mohiniyattam ki ek world-renowned expert hain. Unhone 'Nalanda Nritya Kala Mahavidyalaya' se isme PhD ki hai. Mohiniyattam Kerala ka ek female solo dance hai jo 'Vishnu' ke Mohini avatar ki katha batata hai. Isme 'Lasya' (grace) ki pradhanta hoti hai. Yaad rakho: Sunanda Nair pehli aisi dancer hain jinhone Mohiniyattam me PhD ki.
why: GALAT ✗ – Kuchipudi Andhra ka hai. Sunanda Nair isse nahi balki Kerala ki parampara se judi hain.
GALAT ✗ – Kathakali Kerala ka hai par ye mukhya roop se purushon dwara kiya jane wala 'tandava' pradhan dance hai, jabki Sunanda ji Mohiniyattam (lasya) karti hain.
GALAT ✗ – Kathak North India ka dance hai. Sunanda Nair ka kaam South Indian classical forms me hai.
SAHI ✓ – Sunanda Nair Mohiniyattam ki mahan pracharak (proponent) hain aur unhone is shaili ko kai naye dimension diye hain.

dance.q: Due to the service rendered by the ____ poet kathakali Dance form got a new impetus and today many innovations are being made to suit the needs of the changing society.
dance.solution: Kathakali Kerala ka ek classical dance-drama hai jo apne heavy makeup aur facial expressions ke liye jana jata hai. 20th century ke shuruat mein ye kala khatam ho rahi thi, tab Malayalam kavi Vallathal Narayana Menon ne 'Kerala Kalamandalam' banakar ise naya jeevan diya. Unhone hi purane gurukul system ko modern stage performance se joda. Yaad rakho: Vallathal = Kathakali ka Revivalist.
why: GALAT ✗ – Purandar Das ko 'Carnatic Music ka Pitamaha' kaha jata hai. Unhone bhakti sangeet mein yogdan diya tha, Kathakali mein nahi. Isliye ye option galat hai.
SAHI ✓ – Vallathal Narayana Menon ek mahan Malayalam kavi the jinhone 1930 mein Kerala Kalamandalam ki sthapna ki aur Kathakali ko international level par pehchan dilayi.
GALAT ✗ – Gopal Bhatt ka sambandh Braj kshetra ki 'Raas Leela' aur nautanki paramparaon se mana jata hai, unka Kathakali se koi direct relation nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – K. Satchidanandan ek modern Indian poet hain jo apni contemporary poetry ke liye jane jate hain, unka Kathakali ke revival mein koi historical role nahi raha hai.

dance.q: Which of the following famous persons is associated with Mohiniyattam dance?
dance.solution: Mohiniyattam Kerala ka ek 'Dance of the Enchantress' (Mohini ka nritya) hai jo laya (grace) aur lasya (feminine aspect) par adharit hai. Jayaprabha Menon iski ek bahut prasiddh kalakar hain jinhone is dance form mein modern elements add kiye hain. Yaad rakho: Mohiniyattam sirf mahilayein karti hain aur isme white-gold saree (Kasavu) pehni jati hai.
why: GALAT ✗ – Prerna Shrimali Jaipur gharane ki ek mahan Kathak nrityangana (dancer) hain. Isliye ye Mohiniyattam se nahi judi hain.
GALAT ✗ – Vyjayanthi Kashi Andhra Pradesh ke Kuchipudi dance ki ek bahut badi exponent hain, unka Mohiniyattam se sambandh nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Yamini Krishnamurthy Bharatnatyam aur Kuchipudi dono ke liye famous hain, lekin unhe Mohiniyattam ke liye nahi jana jata.
SAHI ✓ – Jayaprabha Menon Mohiniyattam ki ek extraordinary artist hain jinhone Kerala ke is dance form ko global level par promote kiya hai.

dance.q: Which Manipuri classical dancer established 'Govindji Nartanalaya' dance school for women in Imphal?
dance.solution: Guru Bipin Singh ko 'Father of Manipuri Dance' kaha jata hai. Unhone Imphal mein 'Govindji Nartanalaya' khola aur Mumbai mein 'Manipuri Nartanalaya'. Unhone hi Jhaveri behno (Darshana, Nayana, Suvarna, Ranjana) ko talim di thi. Manipuri dance mein Pung (drum) aur Kartal ka bahut mahatva hota hai. Yaad rakho: Govindji = Manipuri = Bipin Singh.
why: GALAT ✗ – Nileshwar Mukherjee Manipuri dance se jude zaroor hain lekin Govindji Nartanalaya ki sthapna unhone nahi ki thi.
GALAT ✗ – Chandra Kanta Singh Manipur ke rajaon/protectors mein se ek the, par dance school ki sthapna Guru Bipin Singh ka main credit hai.
SAHI ✓ – Guru Bipin Singh ne hi mahilaon ke liye Imphal mein Govindji Nartanalaya banaya aur Manipuri dance ko shastriya roop (classical form) mein dhalne mein badi bhumika nibhayi.
GALAT ✗ – Senari Prince ek Manipuri artist ho sakte hain, par historical facts ke hisab se school sthapna mein unka naam nahi aata.

dance.q: Which is the first traditional dance of India, which has been reworked as a theater art and has been widely performed both in the country and abroad?
dance.solution: Bharatnatyam Tamil Nadu ka sabse purana classical dance hai (Sadir Attam se nikla). E. Krishna Iyer aur Rukmini Devi Arundale ne ise 'theater art' ke roop mein revive kiya takki ise samaj mein samman mil sake. Ye Natya Shastra par adharit hai aur isme 'Fire Dance' (Agni Nritya) ka element dikhta hai. Yaad rakho: First traditional dance to be globalized = Bharatnatyam.
why: GALAT ✗ – Kathakali ek dance-drama zaroor hai, par Bharatnatyam pehla aisa dance tha jise modern stage/theater ke liye sabse pehle rework kiya gaya.
SAHI ✓ – Bharatnatyam hi wo pehla dance hai jise purane mandiron (Devadasi system) se nikaalkar theater art ke roop mein desh-videsh mein lokpriya banaya gaya.
GALAT ✗ – Manipuri apne Radha-Krishna Raasleela ke liye jana jata hai, par theater revival ki race mein Bharatnatyam pehle aata hai.
GALAT ✗ – Kuchipudi Andhra Pradesh ka dance hai jo pehle sirf male actors (Brahmin) karte the, iska theater transformation Bharatnatyam ke baad ka hai.

dance.q: Nirmala Mehta is the representative of which Indian classical dance style?
dance.solution: Nirmala Mehta Manipuri dance ki ek prasiddh exponent hain. Manipuri dance apne 'Jagoi' aur 'Cholom' styles ke liye jana jata hai aur isme dancers 'Potloi' (barrel-shaped skirt) pehente hain. Nirmala Mehta ne is dance form ki baarikiyaan duniya ko dikhayi hain. Yaad rakho: Mehta surname aksar Manipuri dance exponents mein dekha jata hai (jaise Savita Mehta).
why: SAHI ✓ – Nirmala Mehta Manipuri dance style ki ek prominent representative hain, unka yogdan is classical form mein kaafi bada hai.
GALAT ✗ – Odissi Odisha ka dance hai jiske pramukh kalakar Kelucharan Mohapatra hain. Nirmala Mehta ka isse sambandh nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Kathak North India ka dance hai jisme Birju Maharaj jaise naam aate hain, Nirmala Mehta Kathak se nahi judi hain.
GALAT ✗ – Sattriya Assam ka dance hai jo Shankardev ne shuru kiya tha, Nirmala Mehta is style ki representative nahi hain.

dance.q: The pioneering spirit of Padma Shri Guru Mayadhar Raut revived which of the following dances in the 1950s and redefined the grammar and acting vocabulary of the dance?
dance.solution: Guru Mayadhar Raut ne Jayantika Association ke madhyam se Odissi ko punarjeevit kiya. Unhone Odissi ke 'Mudras' aur 'Sanchari Bhava' ko shastriya dhang se define kiya. Unhe Odissi ka 'Shastra-Kar' bhi kaha jata hai kyunki unhone iske grammar par kaam kiya. Yaad rakho: Mayadhar Raut ne hi Odissi me 'Abhinaya' ki nayi pehchan banayi thi.
why: GALAT ✗ – Manipuri dance Manipur ka hai jo apni 'Raslila' aur 'Pung Cholom' ke liye jana jata hai. Guru Bipin Singh iske pramukh punaruddharak (reviver) the, Mayadhar Raut nahi. Is prashn ke liye ye galat hai.
GALAT ✗ – Kuchipudi Andhra Pradesh ka dance hai jisme 'Thali' par dance aur 'Matka' ka prayog hota hai. Iske revival ka shrey Vempati Chinna Satyam ko jata hai. Isliye ye option galat hai.
GALAT ✗ – Bharatnatyam Tamil Nadu ka sabse purana shastriya nritya hai jise Rukmini Devi Arundale ne revive kiya tha. Mayadhar Raut ka sambandh isse nahi hai.
SAHI ✓ – Odissi Odisha ka nritya hai. Guru Mayadhar Raut ne hi 1950s me iske grammar aur acting vocabulary ko naye sire se vikasit kiya tha. Unhe 2010 me Padma Shri mila tha.

dance.q: Surya classical dance festival dance festival is organized every year for 10 days in ___.
dance.solution: Surya Festival India ka sabse bada cultural event hai jo Kerala ki rajdhani me hota hai. Ise 'Surya Krishnamurthy' ne shuru kiya tha. Isme dance, music aur film festival sabhi shamil hote hain. Yaad rakho: Surya = Kerala ka sabse lamba (111 days total) festival jisme 10 din dance ko diye jate hain.
why: GALAT ✗ – Madurai (Tamil Nadu) 'Meenakshi Amman Temple' aur 'Chithirai Festival' ke liye mashhoor hai. Surya Festival yahan nahi hota.
GALAT ✗ – Rameshwaram ek pavitra tirth sthal (Jyotirlinga) hai, par yahan 10-diwasiya Surya classical dance festival ka ayojan nahi kiya jata.
SAHI ✓ – Thiruvananthapuram (Kerala) me har saal 'Surya Stage and Film Society' dwara ye festival manaya jata hai. Ye Indian classical arts ko promote karne ka bada manch hai.
GALAT ✗ – Mysore (Karnataka) apne 'Dasara' festival ke liye vishva-prasidh hai. Halaki yahan culture rich hai, par Surya Festival yahan ka event nahi hai.

dance.q: Famous classical dancer Tanjore Balasarawti was honored with ____ award in 1977.
dance.solution: Tanjore Balasaraswati ko Bharatnatyam ki 'Queen' mana jata hai. Unhone is dance ko international level par pehchan dilayi. Unhe 1957 me Padma Bhushan aur 1977 me Padma Vibhushan mila. Yaad rakho: Balasaraswati ko 'Abhinaya' me maharat hasil thi, jo Bharatnatyam ka ek mukhya hissa hai.
why: GALAT ✗ – Padma Bhushan unhe 1957 me mila tha, jo Bharat ka teesra sabse bada nagrik samman hai. Prashn me 1977 ke bare me pucha gaya hai.
SAHI ✓ – 1977 me Balasaraswati ko Padma Vibhushan (India's 2nd highest civilian award) se sammanit kiya gaya tha. Wo ye samman pane wali pehli nrityanganaon me se ek thi.
GALAT ✗ – Bharat Ratna ab tak sirf ek hi classical dancer (M.S. Subbulakshmi - Carnatic singer, par dancer nahi) ko mila hai. Balasaraswati ko ye samman nahi mila.
GALAT ✗ – Padma Shri India ka chautha bada samman hai. Balasaraswati ko seedhe bade sammanon se nawaza gaya tha.

dance.q: Name the classical dancer who was honored with the 'Sangeet Natak Akademi Award' in 1966 for his life time contribution to Odissi.
dance.solution: Kelucharan Mohapatra Odissi ke sabse mahan guru mane jate hain. Unhone 'Srjan' school ki sthapna ki. Wo Odisha se pehle vyakti the jinhe Padma Vibhushan mila. Unke pramukh shishya Sonal Mansingh aur Sanjukta Panigrahi hain. Yaad rakho: Kelucharan ji 'Pakhawaj' vadak bhi the aur Odissi ke punaruddharak bhi.
why: GALAT ✗ – Guru Bipin Singh Manipuri dance ke bahut bade guru the. Unhe Manipuri ko modern stage par lane ka shrey jata hai, Odissi ka nahi.
SAHI ✓ – Kelucharan Mohapatra ko 1966 me Sangeet Natak Akademi Award mila. Unhone Gotipua aur Mahari tradition ko jodkar modern Odissi banayi.
