GALAT ✗ – Haricharan Singh ka sambandh Odissi ke is level ke pramukh awards ya revival se nahi hai jaisa Kelucharan ji ka hai.
GALAT ✗ – Nileshwar Mukherjee ek classical dancer ke roop me Odissi ke 1966 Sangeet Natak Akademi vijeta nahi hain.

dance.q: Guru of Kuchipudi dance ''Guru Vempati Chinnastyam'', who played an important role in giving classical status to kuchipudi, was honored with which of the following awards in 1998?
dance.solution: Vempati Chinna Satyam ne Kuchipudi ko 'Solo' dance form me badla aur isme 'Chari' (footwork) ko refine kiya. Unhone Chennai me 'Kuchipudi Art Academy' kholi thi. Unke yogdan se hi Kuchipudi ko shastriya darja milne me madad mili. Yaad rakho: 1998 = Vempati = Kuchipudi = Padma Bhushan.
why: GALAT ✗ – Padma Shri unhe bahut pehle mil sakta tha, par 1998 me unhe isse bada samman 'Padma Bhushan' diya gaya tha.
GALAT ✗ – Padma Vibhushan Bharat ka doosra sabse bada award hai. Vempati Chinna Satyam ko ye samman nahi mila tha.
SAHI ✓ – 1998 me Guru Vempati Chinna Satyam ko Padma Bhushan se nawaza gaya. Unhone Kuchipudi ko poori duniya me lokpriya banaya.
GALAT ✗ – Sangeet Natak Akademi Award unhe 1967 me mila tha, na ki 1998 me. 1998 unke Padma samman ka varsh hai.

dance.q: A colossal architecture with finely carved rock sculptures is the venue for the Mamallapuram Dance festival against the backdrap of Arjune Penance ____.
dance.solution: Mamallapuram (Mahabalipuram) Dance Festival Tamil Nadu mein har saal Jan-Feb mein hota hai. Ye Shore Temple aur Arjuna's Penance ke samne ayojit hota hai. Ye pura shehar Coromandel Coast par sthit hai, jo Bay of Bengal ka hissa hai. UNESCO World Heritage sites yahan ka mukhya akarshan hain. Yaad rakho: Mamallapuram = Tamil Nadu Coast = Bay of Bengal.
why: GALAT ✗ – Brahmaputra nadi Tibet se nikal kar Arunachal aur Assam se behti hui Bangladesh jati hai. Iska South India ya Mamallapuram se koi lena-dena nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Indian Ocean ek bada mahasagar hai jisme Bay of Bengal aur Arabian Sea shamil hain, lekin specific coast ke liye ye naam use nahi hota.
GALAT ✗ – Godavari 'Dakshin Ganga' kehlati hai jo Maharashtra se nikal kar Andhra Pradesh mein khatam hoti hai, lekin Mamallapuram iske kinare nahi hai.
SAHI ✓ – Bay of Bengal (Bengal ki Khadi) hi wo samundar hai jo Mamallapuram ke mandiron aur Arjuna's Penance ki chattan ko gheray hue hai.

dance.q: Pandit Sunder Prasad, who was awarded Sangeet Natak in 1959 was a ____ dancer.
dance.solution: Pandit Sunder Prasad Kathak ke Jaipur Gharana ke ek mahan guru the. Unhone apne bhai Pandit Hanuman Prasad se training li aur baad mein Bindadin Maharaj (Lucknow Gharana) se bhi seekha, isliye unke dance mein dono gharano ka mishran dikhta hai. Unhe 1959 mein Sangeet Natak Akademi Award mila. Yaad rakho: Sunder Prasad = Jaipur Gharana + Kathak.
why: SAHI ✓ – Pandit Sunder Prasad Kathak ke mahir the aur unhone Jaipur gharane ko vishv star par pehchan dilane mein badi bhumika nibhayi.
GALAT ✗ – Odissi Odisha ka classical dance hai jiske pramukh kalakar Kelucharan Mohapatra hain. Sunder Prasad ka isse sambandh nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Kathakali Kerala ka mask dance-drama hai jisme chehre ke bhavo (Navrasa) par zor diya jata hai. Ye Sunder Prasad ki vidha nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Mohiniyattam Kerala ka 'Dance of the Enchantress' hai, jo sirf mahilaon dwara kiya jata hai. Pandit ji ek Kathak exponent the.

dance.q: In 1992, Mrinali Sarabhai was honored with ____.
dance.solution: Mrinalini Sarabhai ek mahan classical dancer thi jo Bharatnatyam aur Kathakali dono mein nipun thi. Unhone Ahmedabad mein 'Darpana Academy of Performing Arts' ki sthapna ki. Unhe 1965 mein Padma Shri aur 1992 mein Padma Bhushan mila. Wo scientist Vikram Sarabhai ki patni thi. Yaad rakho: Mrinalini = Darpana Academy + 1992 Padma Bhushan.
why: GALAT ✗ – Bharat Ratna Bharat ka sarvochch nagrik samman hai jo MS Subbulakshmi aur Pandit Ravi Shankar jaise kalakaron ko mila hai, Mrinalini ji ko nahi.
SAHI ✓ – 1992 mein unhe unke nritya mein yogdan ke liye Padma Bhushan se sammanit kiya gaya tha.
GALAT ✗ – Padma Shri unhe mila tha lekin wo saal 1965 tha, prashn mein 1992 pucha gaya hai.
GALAT ✗ – Padma Vibhushan dusra sabse bada samman hai, lekin Mrinalini Sarabhai ko Padma Bhushan tak hi sammanit kiya gaya tha.

dance.q: Among the dance and music festivals of India, Elephant festival is the cultural pride of ____.
dance.solution: Elephant Festival (Gajotsav) Madhya Pradesh ke Gwalior ya kai baar mukhya paryatan sthalon par manaya jata hai, jahan hathi nritya aur sangeet ka hissa bante hain. Note: Ek mashhoor 'Elephant Festival' Jaipur (Rajasthan) mein bhi hota hai, lekin MP ke context mein ye wahan ke utsavon ka garv hai. Yaad rakho: Madhya Pradesh mein sangeet aur prakriti ka mel Elephant festival mein dikhta hai.
why: SAHI ✓ – Madhya Pradesh ke sanskritik karyakramon mein Elephant Festival ek mukhya aakarshan hai jo vahan ki virasat ko darshata hai.
GALAT ✗ – Maharashtra mein 'Elephanta Festival' (Elephanta caves par) hota hai, lekin wo 'Elephant Festival' se alag hai.
GALAT ✗ – Kerala hathi ke liye jana jata hai (Thrissur Pooram), lekin specific 'Elephant Festival' namak event MP aur Rajasthan ke liye zyada famous hai.
GALAT ✗ – Gujarat mein Rann Utsav aur Navratri mukhya hain, Elephant festival wahan ka pradhan utsav nahi hai.

dance.q: Shobha Naidu honored with Padma Shri award is a ____ dancer.
dance.solution: Shobha Naidu Kuchipudi ki ek diggaj nartaki thi aur Vempati Chinna Satyam ki shishya thi. Unhone 'Kuchipudi Art Academy' Hyderabad mein kafi kaam kiya. Unhe 2001 mein Padma Shri mila. Unki 'Satyabhama' ki bhumika bahut prasiddh thi. Yaad rakho: Shobha Naidu = Kuchipudi + Andhra Pradesh.
why: SAHI ✓ – Shobha Naidu Kuchipudi (Andhra Pradesh ka classical dance) ki sabse pratishthit kalakaron mein se ek thi.
GALAT ✗ – Kathak North India ka dance hai jiske liye Birju Maharaj ya Sitara Devi jani jati hain, Shobha Naidu nahi.
GALAT ✗ – Odissi Odisha ka hai. Iske liye Sonal Mansingh ya Kelucharan Mohapatra mashhoor hain, Shobha ji ka isse nata nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Mohiniyattam Kerala ka nritya hai. Shobha Naidu ki puri life Kuchipudi ko samarpit thi.

dance.q: Which of the folliwng dance styles is related to north India?
dance.solution: Kathak North India (visheshkar Uttar Pradesh) ka shastriya nritya hai, jo 'Katha' kehne ki parampara se nikla hai. Isme 'Chakkar' aur 'Tatkar' (footwork) ka bahut mahatva hota hai. Yeh Mughal darbaro mein bhi prachalit tha. Iske pramukh gharane Lucknow, Jaipur aur Banaras hain. Yaad rakho: 'Katha kahe so Kathak kehlaaye'.
why: GALAT ✗ – Mohiniyattam Kerala ka ek sundar shastriya nritya hai jo 'Mohini' (Lord Vishnu ka avatar) ke roop mein mahilaon dwara kiya jata hai. Is prashn ke liye ye nahi kyunki ye South India se hai.
GALAT ✗ – Kuchipudi Andhra Pradesh ke 'Kuchelapuram' gaon se aaya hai, jisme pital ki thali par nritya (Tarangam) kiya jata hai. Is prashn ke liye ye nahi kyunki ye South India ka dance hai.
GALAT ✗ – Odissi Odisha ka prachin dance hai jo mandiro mein 'Mahari' parampara se shuru hua tha, isme 'Tribhanga' mudra mashhoor hai. Is prashn ke liye ye nahi kyunki ye East India ka hai.
SAHI ✓ – Kathak Uttar Pradesh aur North India ka ekmatra shastriya nritya hai, jo Lucknow, Jaipur aur Banaras gharano mein viksit hua.

dance.q: V. Satyanarayam Sharma is known as a ____ classical dancer.
dance.solution: Vedantam Satyanarayana Sharma Kuchipudi ke mahan kalakar the. Unhe stri-vesham (aurat ka roop dharna) ke liye vishwa star par jana jata hai, khas karke 'Satyabhama' ke kirdar ke liye. Kuchipudi Andhra Pradesh ka dance hai. Inhe 1970 mein Padma Shri aur 1961 mein Sangeet Natak Akademi puraskar mila tha. Yaad rakho: 'Vedantam' surname aksar Kuchipudi se juda hota hai.
why: GALAT ✗ – Manipuri Manipur ka bhakti-pradhan dance hai jo Radha-Krishna ki 'Raasleela' par aadharit hai. Satyanarayam Sharma ji isse jude nahi hain.
GALAT ✗ – Odissi Odisha ka dance hai jisme Kelucharan Mohapatra jaise diggaj naam aate hain. Satyanarayam Sharma ka sambandh isse nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Sattriya Assam ka dance hai jise Mahapurush Sankaradev ne shuru kiya tha. Is prashn ke liye ye nahi kyunki Sharma ji Kuchipudi ke liye mashhoor hain.
SAHI ✓ – V. Satyanarayam Sharma Kuchipudi ke sabse bade naam hain, unhone 'Bhamakalapam' mein Satyabhama ka kirdar nibha kar ise antarrashtriya pehchan dilayi.

dance.q: Which of the following is the correct pari?
dance.solution: Kalamandalam Kalyanikutty Amma ko 'Mother of Mohiniyattam' kaha jata hai kyunki unhone is dance ko vilupt hone se bachaya aur ise ek naya jeevan diya. Mohiniyattam Kerala ka female solo dance hai. Sonal Mansingh Odissi/Bharatnatyam se hain, Shobhana Narayan Kathak se aur T. Balasaraswati Bharatnatyam ki mahan kalakar hain. Yaad rakho: 'Amma' se yaad rakho Kerala ki Mohiniyattam ki maa.
why: GALAT ✗ – Sonal Mansingh Bharatnatyam aur Odissi ki nartaki hain, unka sambandh Manipuri se nahi hai. Wo sabse kam umra mein Padma Bhushan pane wali dancer hain.
GALAT ✗ – Shobhana Narayan Kathak ki ek bahut badi nartaki hain (Birju Maharaj ji ki shishya), wo Odissi se judi nahi hain.
SAHI ✓ – Kalamandalam Kalyanikutty Amma ne Mohiniyattam ko shastriya swaroop dene mein sabse bada yogdan diya hai, isliye ye pair sahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – T. Balasaraswati Bharatnatyam ki 'Queen' kahi jati hain, unka Kathak se koi lena dena nahi hai.

dance.q: Natya Tarangini was established in the ___ National capital region in 1976 by the world famous kuchipudi dance duo.
options: Sita Nagajothi anothi and P. Nagajothi
dance.solution: Raja aur Radha Reddy ek vishwa-prasiddh Kuchipudi duo hain. Unhone 1976 mein New Delhi mein 'Natya Tarangini' school ki sthapna ki thi. In dono ko hi Padma Shri aur Padma Bhushan se sammanit kiya ja chuka hai. Kuchipudi Andhra Pradesh ka shastriya nritya hai. Yaad rakho: Reddy surname aksar Andhra/Kuchipudi se connect hota hai.
why: GALAT ✗ – Jairam Rao aur Vanashree Rao bhi Kuchipudi ke bade kalakar hain, par Natya Tarangini ki sthapna Raja Radha Reddy ne ki thi.
GALAT ✗ – Sita Nagajothi aur P. Nagajothi Kuchipudi dancers hain par wo Natya Tarangini ke founders nahi hain.
SAHI ✓ – Raja aur Radha Reddy ne hi 1976 mein Delhi mein Natya Tarangini institute banaya tha jo Kuchipudi ko promote karta hai.
GALAT ✗ – Pasumarthi Vitthal Kuchipudi ke guru hain, par unhone is sansthan ki sthapna nahi ki thi.

dance.q: Sonal Mansingh is a prominent Indian classical dance who is specialize is specialized in ____.
dance.solution: Sonal Mansingh ek aisi kalakar hain jo do shastriya nrityon mein maharat rakhti hain: Bharatnatyam (Tamil Nadu) aur Odissi (Odisha). Unhe 1992 mein Padma Bhushan aur 2003 mein Padma Vibhushan mila, aur wo Rajya Sabha ki sadasya bhi rahi hain. Yaad rakho: Sonal = South (Bharatnatyam) + Odisha (Odissi).
why: GALAT ✗ – Wo Bharatnatyam to karti hain par Kuchipudi unka mukhya dance nahi hai. Isliye ye option galat hai.
SAHI ✓ – Sonal Mansingh Bharatnatyam aur Odissi dono ki hi mahan nartaki hain aur dono styles mein perform karti hain.
GALAT ✗ – Odissi wo karti hain par Manipuri unka specialization nahi hai. Is prashn ke liye ye galat pair hai.
GALAT ✗ – Bharatnatyam unka core hai par Kathak se unka sambandh nahi hai, unka dusra mukhya dance Odissi hai.

dance.q: 'Pong an 'Pong and Tapu' are popular dances of ___ state.
dance.solution: Arunachal Pradesh ke Adis tribe dwara ye dono dances kiye jate hain. 'Ponung' (Pong) dance acchi fasal (harvest) ke liye kiya jata hai, wahi 'Tapu' ek war dance hai jo mardo dwara kiya jata hai. Arunachal me 'Bardo Chham' aur 'Buiya' bhi kafi famous hain. Yaad rakho: 'AP' (Arunachal) ke log 'Tapu' (Tapo) khate hain aur 'Pong' khelte hain.
why: GALAT ✗ – Goa apne 'Fugdi', 'Dhalo' aur 'Dekhni' dances ke liye jana jata hai jo Konkan culture ka hissa hain. Is prashn ke context me ye galat hai kyunki Ponung/Tapu North-East ke dances hain.
SAHI ✓ – Arunachal Pradesh ki 'Adi Tribe' Ponung (Pong) aur Tapu dance karti hai; ye wahan ke utsavon ka mukhya hissa hain.
GALAT ✗ – Bihar me 'Jat-Jatin', 'Bideshiya' aur 'Panwariya' jaise lok nritya prachalit hain jo yahan ke samajik paridrashya ko darshate hain. Ponung se iska koi lena-dena nahi hai.
Chhattisgarh

dance.q: 'Nattuvanar' operates ____ dance and recital.
dance.solution: Nattuvanar wo vyakti hota hai jo Bharatnatyam prastuti ke samay 'Cymbals' (Manjira) bajata hai aur shlokas ya rhythmic syllables ka ucharan karta hai. Ye dance ka conductor hota hai. Bharatnatyam Tamil Nadu ka shastriya nritya hai jo 'Sadir' se nikla hai. Yaad rakho: Nattuvanar = Director of Bharatnatyam stage.
why: SAHI ✓ – Nattuvanar Bharatnatyam me mukhya bhumika nibhata hai, jo talam (rhythm) ko control karta hai aur recital ko lead karta hai.
GALAT ✗ – Kathak me mukhya zor 'Padhant' par hota hai jo dancer khud ya tabla vadak karta hai, aur isme 'Gharana' system hota hai. Isme Nattuvanar term use nahi hoti.
GALAT ✗ – Kuchipudi (Andhra Pradesh) me Bhagavatulu hote hain, aur isme vachika abhinaya (bolna) dancer khud bhi kar sakta hai. Nattuvanar vishesh kar Bharatnatyam se juda hai.
GALAT ✗ – Odissi me sangeet sanyojan mardala (pakhawaj) aur singers dwara hota hai. Iski parampara Mahari aur Gotipua se judi hai, Nattuvanar se nahi.

dance.q: _____ is a popular dance of Minicoy islanicoy island.
dance.solution: Lava dance Lakshadweep ke Minicoy Island ka sabse popular folk dance hai, jo mardo dwara colourful dresses me kiya jata hai. Isme dhol (drums) ka istemal hota hai. Lakshadweep ke anya dance 'Parichakali' aur 'Kolkali' hain. Yaad rakho: Lakshadweep me 'Lava' (Volcano wala nahi, dance wala) fata.
why: SAHI ✓ – Lava Lakshadweep (Minicoy) ka paramparik nritya hai jo mardo dwara rhythmic movements ke saath kiya jata hai.
GALAT ✗ – Leshalaptu Nagaland ka ek folk dance hai. Ye North-East India ki tribes se juda hai, island culture se nahi.
GALAT ✗ – Aluyuttu bhi Nagaland ki 'Konyak' tribe ka ek dance form hai jo mukhya rup se festival ke samay kiya jata hai.
GALAT ✗ – Moyashai Nagaland ke mukhya nrityon me se ek hai. Ye sabhi options (b, c, d) Nagaland se hain, isliye Minicoy ke liye galat hain.

dance.q: Which Indian dancer was awarded the 'French Palme de or' by the French Government in 1977?
dance.solution: Mallika Sarabhai ek mahan Bharatnatyam aur Kuchipudi nartaki hain. Wo Mrinalini Sarabhai aur Vikram Sarabhai ki beti hain. Unhe 1977 me France ka 'Palme d'Or' mila aur 2010 me Padma Bhushan. Unhone Peter Brook ke 'The Mahabharata' me Draupadi ka role bhi nibhaya tha. Yaad rakho: Sarabhai family = Science + Dance ka combo.
why: GALAT ✗ – Chitra Visweswaran ek prasiddh Bharatnatyam dancer hain jinhe Padma Shri mila hai, par unhe 1977 me ye French award nahi mila tha.
SAHI ✓ – Mallika Sarabhai ko hi unke kala me yogdan ke liye French Government ne 'Palme d'Or' se sammanit kiya tha.
GALAT ✗ – Oopali Operajita ek Odissi aur Bharatanatyam dancer hain aur global ambassador rahi hain, par wo is specific French award ki recipient nahi hain.
GALAT ✗ – Kavya Madhavan ek Malayalam actress aur dancer hain, par unka level aur category is international award ke context me match nahi karta.

dance.q: Kelucharan Mohapatra was an exponent of which of the following categories of dance?
dance.solution: Guru Kelucharan Mohapatra ne Odissi dance ko 20th century me punarjeevit (revive) kiya tha. Wo Odisha se 'Padma Vibhushan' pane wale pehle vyakti thhe. Unhone 'Srijan' school ki sthapna ki. Unke shishyon me Sonal Mansingh jaisey bade naam shamil hain. Yaad rakho: Kelucharan = King of Odissi.
why: GALAT ✗ – Manipuri dance ke mukhya exponent Guru Bipin Singh aur Jhaveri sisters hain. Kelucharan ji ka sambandh Odisha se hai, Manipur se nahi.
GALAT ✗ – Bharatanatyam ke liye Rukmini Devi Arundale aur Tanjore Quartette mashhoor hain. Halanki kayi dancers multiple forms seekhte hain, par Kelucharan ji Odissi ke liye hi jane jate hain.
GALAT ✗ – Kuchipudi ke liye Vempati Chinna Satyam mukhya guru hain. Kelucharan ji ne is form me kaam nahi kiya.
SAHI ✓ – Odissi (option me Oudi likha hai jo Odissi ka shorthand/typo ho sakta hai) Kelucharan Mohapatra ka mukhya dance form hai jisme unhone vishv-stariya pehchan banayi.

dance.q: ‘Ponung’ and ‘Tapu’ are popular dance forms from the state of ______ .
dance.solution: Arunachal Pradesh ki 'Adi Tribe' dwara ye dono dance kiye jate hain. Ponung ek harvest dance hai jise mahilaon dwara acchi fasal ke liye kiya jata hai, wahi Tapu ek 'War Dance' hai jo mard karte hain dhol (drums) ki thaap par. Yaad rakho: 'Adi' tribe Arunachal ki sabse badi tribes me se ek hai.
why: GALAT ✗ – Chhattisgarh apne 'Panthi', 'Raut Nacha' aur 'Pandavani' ke liye jana jata hai. Ponung aur Tapu ka sambandh Central India se nahi balki North-East se hai.
SAHI ✓ – Arunachal Pradesh ki Adi tribe Ponung (harvest) aur Tapu (war dance) perform karti hai. Ye wahan ki sanskriti ka mukhya hissa hain.
GALAT ✗ – Goa ke mukhya nritya 'Fugdi', 'Dhalo' aur 'Dekhni' hain jo Konkani culture ko darshate hain. Arunachal ke tribal dances yahan nahi hote.
GALAT ✗ – Bihar me 'Jat-Jatin', 'Bideshiya' aur 'Fagua' jaise lok nritya prachilit hain. Ponung aur Tapu Himalayan regions ke tribal forms hain.

dance.q: ____is a mask dance popular in South Malabar
dance.solution: Kummattikali Kerala ke Thrissur aur South Malabar me Onam ke tyohar par kiya jata hai. Isme nartak (dancers) colourful wooden masks pehente hain jo Hanuman, Krishna ya anya devi-devtaon ke hote hain. 'Yaad rakho': Mask = Kummattikali (Kerala).
why: GALAT ✗ – Dhangar Goa ka ek lok nritya hai jo wahan ke shepherd (charvaha) community dwara kiya jata hai, ye mask dance nahi hai.
SAHI ✓ – Kummattikali Kerala ka ek prasiddh mask dance hai. Isme nartak 'Pali' (grass) se bani veshbhusha pehente hain aur chehre par lakdi ke mukhoute lagate hain.
GALAT ✗ – Parichakali Lakshadweep aur Kerala ka ek martial art dance hai jisme dhaal aur talwar (ya lathi) ka prayog hota hai, mukhouton ka nahi.
GALAT ✗ – Zemmado (ya Zemmando) Goa ka ek traditional dance form hai jo mukhya roop se Catholic community me prachilit hai, ye South Malabar ka mask dance nahi hai.

dance.q: ___is a popular folk dance of Minicoy Islanoy Island.
dance.solution: Lava nritya Lakshadweep ke Minicoy Island ka sabse popular dance hai. Ise sirf purush (men) karte hain aur isme rhythmic movements aur dhol ki dhun par ek sync me naacha jata hai. 'Yaad rakho': Lakshadweep = Lava (Dono 'L' se shuru hote hain).
why: GALAT ✗ – Leshalaptu Nagaland ki 'Rengma' tribe dwara kiya jane wala ek lok nritya hai, iska sambandh Lakshadweep se nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Aaluyattu bhi Nagaland ki 'Konyak' tribe ka ek mahatvapurna nritya hai jo festivals ke dauran kiya jata hai.
SAHI ✓ – Lava Lakshadweep ke Minicoy dweep ka sabse prasiddh nritya hai. Isme dancers colourful kapde aur headgears pehente hain.
GALAT ✗ – Moyashai Nagaland ke mukhya folk dances me se ek hai. Minicoy Island me iska chalan nahi hai.

dance.q: ‘Povadas’ is a popular folk dance from the state of ______.
dance.solution: Povadas (ya Powada) Maharashtra ka ek ballad singing style hai jo veer ras (bravery) par adharit hota hai. Ye mukhya roop se Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj ki veerta ki kahaniyan sunane ke liye shuru hua tha. Isme 'Shahirs' (singers) mukhya bhumika nibhate hain.
why: SAHI ✓ – Povadas Maharashtra ka ek shaurya-purna (heroic) lok nritya aur sangeet hai. Ise 17th century me Shivaji Maharaj ke vijay abhiyanon ko celebrate karne ke liye banaya gaya tha.
GALAT ✗ – Gujarat ke mukhya nritya 'Garba' aur 'Dandiya Raas' hain jo Navratri me kiye jate hain. Povadas ka style Maratha history se juda hai.
GALAT ✗ – Rajasthan me 'Ghoomar', 'Kalbelia' aur 'Kachhi Ghodi' jaise dances hote hain. Povadas yahan ka mool nritya nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Kerala 'Kathakali' aur 'Mohiniyattam' jaise classical forms ke liye jana jata hai, na ki Maratha-style Povadas ke liye.

dance.q: The efforts of Siddhendra Yogi have brought glory to the dance form called ______.
dance.solution: Siddhendra Yogi ko 'Father of Kuchipudi' mana jata hai. Unhone hi 17th century me is dance ko ek nayi disha di aur 'Bhamakalapam' jaisi mukhya rachna ki thi. 'Yaad rakho': Siddhendra Yogi = Kuchipudi (Andhra Pradesh).
why: GALAT ✗ – Bharatanatyam Tamil Nadu ka hai jiske mukhya gurus me Meenakshi Sundaram Pillai aur Rukmini Devi Arundale ka naam aata hai, Siddhendra Yogi ka nahi.
GALAT ✗ – Mohiniyattam Kerala ka female solo dance hai. Iske punar-udhar (revival) me Vallathol Narayana Menon ka bada yogdan raha hai.
SAHI ✓ – Siddhendra Yogi ne hi Kuchipudi ko ek shastriya (classical) pehchan dilayi. Unhone hi purushon ko isme bhag lene aur 'Bhamakalapam' perform karne ke liye prerit kiya tha.
GALAT ✗ – Kathakali Kerala ka ek drama-dance hai. Iske vikaas me Kerala ke rajaon aur Vallathol Menon ka haath tha, Yogi ji ka sambandh Andhra se hai.

dance.q: Which of the following is a UNESCO recognised dance form?
dance.solution: Kalbelia Rajasthan ki 'Sapera' community ka dance hai, jise 2010 mein UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage list mein shamil kiya gaya tha. Ismein 'Pungi' aur 'Dafli' ka use hota hai aur dancers saamp (snake) jaisi movements karte hain. Gulabo Sapna iski sabse famous dancer hain. Yaad rakho: 'UNESCO + Rajasthan + Snake = Kalbelia'.
why: GALAT ✗ – Bhangra Punjab ka ek bohot hi energetic folk dance hai jo mard baisakhi ke mauke par dhol ki thaap par karte hain. Iska UNESCO se koi lena-dena nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Dalkhai Odisha ka ek popular folk dance hai jo Dussehra ke samay kiya jata hai. Ye UNESCO list mein nahi hai.
SAHI ✓ – Kalbelia Rajasthan ka 'Snake Charmer' dance hai jo apni adbhut movements aur UNESCO recognition ke liye jana jata hai.
GALAT ✗ – Giddha Punjab ki mahilayon dwara kiya jane wala folk dance hai jo khushi ke mauko par hota hai. Ye bhi UNESCO list mein nahi hai.

dance.q: ‘Bagurumba’ is a _____________ of the Bodo Community in Assam.
dance.solution: Bagurumba Assam ki Bodo tribe ka sabse mahatvapurn folk dance hai, ise 'Butterfly Dance' bhi kehte hain kyunki dancers titliyo ki tarah haath hilate hain. Ye aksar Bwisagu (Bodo New Year) festival ke waqt kiya jata hai. Ismein Sifung (flute) aur Kham (drum) ka prayog hota hai. Yaad rakho: 'Bodo = Bagurumba'.
why: GALAT ✗ – Bodo community ke apne paramparik khel (sports) hote hain jaise 'Khunee', lekin Bagurumba koi khel nahi balki ek kala hai.
SAHI ✓ – Bagurumba ek folk dance hai jo Assam ki Bodo mahilayein apni sanskriti ko dikhane ke liye karti hain.
GALAT ✗ – Assam mein 'Aipan' ya 'Manuscript painting' mashhoor hai, lekin Bagurumba koi painting style nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Ye koi procession (juloos) nahi balki ek vyavasthit dance performance hai jo ek jagah khade hokar ya ghere mein hota hai.

dance.q: 'Ponu Yoksi', a sword like instrument use instrument used during ceremonial dances performed by priests
dance.solution: Ponu Yoksi ek talwar jaisa shastra (sword-like instrument) hai jo Arunachal Pradesh ki 'Adi Tribe' ke 'Nyibu' (pujari) istemal karte hain. Jab wo 'Miri' dance karte hain, to ise hila kar ek metallic sound nikalte hain. Ye buri taakato ko bhagane ke liye kiya jata hai. Yaad rakho: 'Ponu Yoksi = Arunachal ki Adi Tribe'.
why: GALAT ✗ – Himachal Pradesh mein Nati dance hota hai aur wahan 'Thoda' jaise martial arts hain, lekin Ponu Yoksi wahan ka nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Madhya Pradesh mein Matki aur Jawara dance hote hain, Ponu Yoksi instrument yahan ke tribal culture ka hissa nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Uttar Pradesh Kathak aur Nautanki ke liye jana jata hai, yahan ceremonial dances mein Ponu Yoksi ka prayog nahi milta.
SAHI ✓ – Ponu Yoksi Arunachal Pradesh ke ritualistic dances ka ek mukhya hissa hai jo priests dwara ritual perform karte waqt pakda jata hai.

dance.q: ______ is a dance which combines speech, mime and pure dance.
dance.solution: Kuchipudi (Andhra Pradesh) mein 'Vachika Abhinaya' (speech) ka bohot mahatva hai, jisme artist dance ke saath-saath kabhi-kabhi shabd bhi bolta hai. Ismein Nritta (pure dance), Nritya (mime/expression) aur Natya (drama) ka perfect sangam hota hai. Iska khas feature 'Tarangam' (pittal ki thali par dance) hai. Yaad rakho: 'Bolne wala dance = Kuchipudi'.
why: GALAT ✗ – Kathakali (Kerala) mein sirf mime aur gestures hote hain, ismein dancer kabhi bolta nahi hai, sirf ishare karta hai.
GALAT ✗ – Bharatanatyam (Tamil Nadu) mein facial expressions aur mudras par zor hota hai, par ismein speech (bolne) ka prayog nahi hota.
GALAT ✗ – Mohiniattam (Kerala) ek graceful 'female-only' dance hai jo Lord Vishnu ke Mohini roop ko dikhata hai, ismein bhi speech nahi hoti.
SAHI ✓ – Kuchipudi hi wo dance hai jisme dialogues/speech ka use hota hai, jo ise baaki classical dances se alag banata hai.

dance.q: A ‘Nattuvanar’ conducts a_____dance recital.
dance.solution: Nattuvanar wo vyakti hota hai jo Bharatanatyam recital ko direct karta hai aur 'Cymbals' (Manjira) bajata hai. Wo rhythm maintain karta hai aur 'Shlokas' ya 'Chants' bolta hai. Ye aksar Guru hote hain jo dancer ki taal ko control karte hain. Yaad rakho: 'Nattuvanar = Bharatanatyam ka conductor/Guru'.
why: GALAT ✗ – Kuchipudi mein jo rhythm maintain karta hai use 'Sutradhara' kehte hain, Nattuvanar term specifically Tamil tradition se judi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Odissi mein mukhya vadya yantra 'Pakhawaj' hota hai aur guru ko Nattuvanar nahi kaha jata.
GALAT ✗ – Kathak mein Table aur Pakhawaj par zor hota hai aur Guru 'Padhant' (bol) bolte hain, unhe Nattuvanar nahi kehte.
SAHI ✓ – Bharatanatyam mein Nattuvanar ka role sabse mukhya hai, unke bina 'Arangetram' (pehli performance) adhura hai.

dance.q: Which of the following is a dance form of West Bengal where there is a confluence of dancing, singing, drama and recital?
dance.solution: Alkap West Bengal ka ek bahut hi unique folk performance hai jo Murshidabad, Malda aur Birbhum districts me famous hai. Isme 'Al' matlab kavita aur 'Kap' matlab drama ka mishran hota hai. Isme ek 'Sarkar' (leader) hota hai aur 'Chhokras' (ladke jo ladkiyon ka roop dharte hain) naachte hain. Yaad rakho: Alkap = Bengal ka 'All-in-one' (Dance + Drama + Song).
why: GALAT ✗ – Bhavai Rajasthan aur Gujarat ka ek professional folk dance hai jisme mahilayein sir par 7-9 mitti ke ghade (pots) rakh kar balance karti hain aur kaanch ya talwar par naachti hain. Ye West Bengal ka nahi hai.
SAHI ✓ – Alkap West Bengal aur Jharkhand ka ek rural performance hai jisme dance, music aur comic plays ka mel hota hai, jo aksar Gajan festival ke waqt kiya jata hai.
GALAT ✗ – Tippani Gujarat ke Chorwad region ka dance hai jo koli mahilayen karti hain. Isme 'Tippani' (ek lambi dandi) ka use karke zameen ko peeta jata hai. Iska Bengal se lena dena nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Hudo Gujarat ke Tarnetar mela ka ek mukhya folk dance hai jo Bharwad shepherd community dwara kiya jata hai. Isme sheep (bhedon) ki ladaai ki nakal ki jati hai.

dance.q: 'Ranapa', a folk dance form of Odisha, consists of enacting chapters from the life of Lord
dance.solution: Ranapa Odisha ke Ganjam district ka ek energetic dance hai. 'Ranapa' ka matlab hota hai 'stilt' (baans ki ladiyan). Kalakar baans ke pairon par khade hokar dhol aur mahuri ki dhun par naachte hain. Isme Lord Krishna ki 'Baal Leela' aur unke bachpan ke kisse dikhaye jate hain. Extra Fact: Odisha ke anya dance hain Danda Nata aur Ghumura.
why: GALAT ✗ – Lord Indra 'Vajra' ke devta hain aur unpar adharit 'Indra Jatra' Nepal aur Sikkim me hoti hai, par Ranapa dance unke liye nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Lord Ram par adharit 'Ramman' (Uttarakhand) ya 'Ramleela' pure North India me hoti hai, lekin Ranapa specific Krishna bhakti se juda hai.
SAHI ✓ – Ranapa me Lord Krishna ki mahima ka varnan hota hai aur ye Odisha ka ek tough acrobatic dance hai jo stilts par kiya jata hai.
GALAT ✗ – Hanuman ji ki bhakti 'Mask dances' ya 'Ramleela' me dikhti hai, lekin Ranapa me Krishna ji ki bachpan ki shararaton aur leelayon par focus hota hai.

dance.q: Which of the following is a dance form in Mizoram participated exclusively by 'village guests'?
dance.solution: Khuallam Mizoram ka ek shandaar dance hai. 'Khual' ka matlab hai guest aur 'Lam' ka matlab dance. Purane zamane me jab dusre gaon ke log (guests) 'Khuangchawi' (ek bada bhoj/feast) me aate the, tab ye dance kiya jata tha. Isme 'Puandum' naam ki ek khas checkered shawl pehni jati hai. Yaad rakho: Khual = Guest.
why: GALAT ✗ – Cheraw Mizoram ka sabse purana 'Bamboo Dance' hai jisme zameen par bamboo sticks ko thapthapaya jata hai. Ye sirf guests ke liye nahi, har bade jashn par hota hai.
SAHI ✓ – Khuallam 'Dance of the Guests' hai jo Vangchhia jaise bade tyoharon par bahar se aaye mehmanon dwara ya unke liye kiya jata hai.
GALAT ✗ – Chailam Mizoram ka ek dance hai jo 'Chapchar Kut' festival ke dauran kiya jata hai, isme ladke aur ladkiyan ek circle banakar naachte hain.
GALAT ✗ – Solakia Mizoram ki Pawi aur Lakher communities ka dance hai, jo pehle jeet (victory) ka jashn manane ke liye kiya jata tha.

dance.q: 'Maimata' is a popular dance of the Kaloi community from the state of ______.
dance.solution: Maimata (ya Mamita) Tripura ka ek harvest (fasal) dance hai jo Kaloi community dwara kiya jata hai. Jab nayi fasal (grain) ghar aati hai, tab Mamita festival manaya jata hai. Tripura ke anya famous dances hain Hojagiri (Reang tribe) aur Garia. Yaad rakho: Maimata = Mamita = Tripura ka Harvest.
why: GALAT ✗ – Assam ke mukhya dances Bihu, Bagurumba aur Sattriya hain. Kaloi community aur Maimata dance Assam se sambandhit nahi hain.
GALAT ✗ – Odisha ke folk dances me Sambalpuri, Ranapa aur Chhau aate hain. Tripura ki Kaloi community ka yahan koi sthan nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Chhattisgarh me Panthi, Raut Nacha aur Pandavani famous hain. Maimata wahan ka dance form nahi hai.
SAHI ✓ – Maimata Tripura ki Kaloi aur anya Tripuri tribes ka traditional dance hai jo Mamita festival par khushi manane ke liye kiya jata hai.

dance.q: ‘Ghoomar’ is a folk-dance form from the state of ______.
dance.solution: Ghoomar Rajasthan ki shaan hai, jise Bhil tribe ne shuru kiya tha aur baad me Rajput gharanon ne apnaya. Isme mahilayein 'Ghaghara' pehenkar gol-gol ghoomti hain (twirling), jisse ek sundar circle banta hai. Isme sirf mahilayein bhag leti hain. SSC Tip: Ghoomar ko 'Dances ka Sirmaur' (Crown of dances) kaha jata hai.
why: GALAT ✗ – Bihar ke mukhya folk dances Jat-Jatin, Bideshiya aur Panwariya hain. Ghoomar Bihar ka culture nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Jharkhand me Sarhul festival aur Chhau, Karma aur Paika jaise virta aur prakriti se jude dance hote hain.
SAHI ✓ – Ghoomar Rajasthan ka state dance hai jo Teej, Gangaur aur shadiyon ke mauke par mahilayon dwara kiya jata hai.
GALAT ✗ – Tripura ke dances me Hojagiri aur Lebang Boomani aate hain, Rajasthan ka Ghoomar wahan nahi hota.

dance.q: 'Thullal' is a solo satiric dance form belonging to the state of ______.
dance.solution: Thullal (Ottamthullal) Kerala ka ek bahut famous solo dance-drama hai. Isse 18th century me Kunchan Nambiar ne shuru kiya tha. Ye apni 'Satire' (vyang) aur humor ke liye jana jata hai, jisme dancer samajik kuritiyon par mazak udata hai. Isme dancer ka makeup aur costume Kathakali se milta-julta hota hai lekin ye perform karne me thoda simple hota hai. Yaad rakho: Thullal = Kerala ka Comedy Dance.
why: GALAT ✗ – Haryana me Phag, Daph, aur Loor jaise lok nritya hote hain jo zyadatar agriculture aur seasons se jude hote hain. Thullal se iska koi lena-dena nahi hai.
SAHI ✓ – Kerala ka hi ye solo satiric dance hai jise Kunchan Nambiar ne popular banaya tha. Isme social issues par vyang kiya jata hai.
GALAT ✗ – Arunachal Pradesh apne tribal dances jaise Aji Lamu aur Chalo ke liye jana jata hai. Yahan Satiric (vyang) dance ki aisi koi purani parampara nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Goa me Fugdi aur Dekhni jaise dances hote hain. Thullal South India ke Kerala state ki specific art form hai.

dance.q: ‘Margam Kali’, a ritual folk art form, is from the state of ______.
dance.solution: Margam Kali Kerala ki Christian community (khaas karke Saint Thomas Christians) ka ek ritual folk dance hai. Isme 12 dancers ek 'Nilavilakku' (lamp) ke chaaro taraf gol ghere me dance karte hain, jo 12 apostles ko darshata hai. Ye zyadatar shaadiyon aur church festivals par perform kiya jata hai. Isme koi vadya yantra (instrument) nahi bajaya jata, sirf gaane gaye jate hain.
why: GALAT ✗ – Assam Bihu aur Sattriya ke liye famous hai. Margam Kali ek Christian ritual dance hai jo North-East India ka hissa nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Punjab me Bhangra aur Giddha popular hain. Punjab ki folk culture Kerala ke Margam Kali ritual se bilkul alag hai.
GALAT ✗ – Nagaland apne Hornbill festival aur tribal war dances ke liye jana jata hai. Margam Kali ek specialized Christian folk art hai jo Kerala me milti hai.
SAHI ✓ – Margam Kali Kerala ka ek prachin Christian lok nritya hai jo shaadi-byah ke mauke par kiya jata hai.

dance.q: Siddhendra Yogi, a doyen of the ______ dance form, was lauded as Adi Guru.
dance.solution: Siddhendra Yogi ko Kuchipudi ka 'Adi Guru' maana jata hai kyunki unhone hi is dance form ko ek structured format diya tha. Unhone 'Bhama Kalapam' naam ka ek prasiddh dance-drama likha tha. Unhone brahmin ladkon ko is nritya ke liye taiyaar kiya tha. SSC Exam Point: Kuchipudi Andhra Pradesh ka classical dance hai aur isme 'Tarangam' (thali par dance) kaafi famous hai.
why: SAHI ✓ – Siddhendra Yogi ne hi Kuchipudi ko 14th-15th century me revive kiya aur ise Bhakti movement se joda, isliye unhe Adi Guru kehte hain.
GALAT ✗ – Kathakali (Kerala) ke mukhya gurus me Guru Kunchu Kurup ka naam aata hai. Siddhendra Yogi ka talluq Andhra ke Kuchipudi se hai.
GALAT ✗ – Bharatanatyam (Tamil Nadu) ke revival me Rukmini Devi Arundale aur E. Krishna Iyer ka yogdan hai, Siddhendra Yogi ka nahi.
GALAT ✗ – Kathak (North India) gharana system (Lucknow, Jaipur) par chalta hai aur iske mukhya kalakar Maharaj family rahi hai.

dance.q: Which of the following dances has been included in the list of the UNESCO Heritage Dances?
dance.solution: Chhau dance ko UNESCO ki 'Intangible Cultural Heritage' list me 2010 me shamil kiya gaya tha. Ye Eastern India ka semi-classical dance hai jiske teen main types hain: 1. Purulia (WB), 2. Seraikella (Jharkhand), aur 3. Mayurbhanj (Odisha). Mayurbhanj Chhau me masks (mukhoute) ka use nahi hota, baaki dono me hota hai. Yaad rakho: Chhau, Kalbelia aur Mudiyettu ko ek saath 2010 me UNESCO tag mila tha.
why: GALAT ✗ – Joomar (ya Jhumair) Jharkhand, Odisha aur Chhattisgarh ka tribal dance hai, par ise abhi tak UNESCO Heritage list me shamil nahi kiya gaya hai.
GALAT ✗ – Dalkhai Odisha ka ek popular folk dance hai jo zyadatar Dussehra ke mauke par hota hai, par ye UNESCO list me nahi hai.
SAHI ✓ – Chhau ko uski sanskritik mahatta ke liye 2010 me UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity list me jagah di gayi thi.
GALAT ✗ – Phugadi Goa aur Maharashtra ka ek folk dance hai jo zyadatar Ganesha Chaturthi par hota hai, ye UNESCO list me nahi hai.

dance.q: Which of the following dance forms is derived from martial arts practices?
dance.solution: Chhau dance ki utpatti martial arts (yuddha kala) se hui hai. Iske steps ko 'Pharikhanda' (talwar aur dhaal ki practice) kaha jata hai. Isme dancers dhaal aur talwar lekar yuddh jaisi mudrayen dikhate hain. Ye ek energy se bharpur dance hai jisme uchhal-kood aur mock-fights dikhayi jati hain. Bharat ke kai martial dances me se Chhau sabse zyada popular hai.
why: SAHI ✓ – Chhau ki origin 'Chhauni' (military camp) se hui hai aur iske basic steps martial arts exercises par based hain.
GALAT ✗ – Jhora Uttarakhand ka ek community folk dance hai jisme log gol ghera banakar gaate hain, ye martial art se nahi juda hai.
GALAT ✗ – Bharatanatyam ek bhaktipurn aur spiritual dance hai jo mandiron me Devadasis dwara shuru hua tha, iska base martial arts nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Ghoomar Rajasthan ki Rajput mahilayon dwara kiya jane wala ek shalin dance hai, jisme ghunghat aur ghere ka mahatva hai, na ki yuddha kala ka.

dance.q: Which of the following is the traditional theatre of Jammu and Kashmir?
dance.solution: Bhand Pather Kashmir ka sadiyon purana folk theatre hai, jisme 'Bhand' ka matlab 'actor' aur 'Pather' ka matlab 'drama' hota hai. Isme aksar Sufiyana mauseeqi (music) ka istemal hota hai aur ye khule maidanon me perform kiya jata hai. Isme koi fixed script nahi hoti, balki vyang (satire) aur hansi-mazak ke zariye samajik muddon ko dikhaya jata hai. Yaad rakho: Kashmir ke 'Bhand' (artistes) hi 'Pather' dikhate hain.
why: GALAT ✗ – Jatra West Bengal, Odisha aur Bihar ka ek lokpriya folk theatre hai jo Krishna Bhakti movement se juda hai. Is prashn ke liye ye nahi, kyunki iska sambandh Eastern India se hai na ki J&K se.

GALAT ✗ – Swaang Haryana, Rajasthan aur Western UP ka ek sangeetmay (musical) folk drama hai jo apni nautanki jaisi shaili ke liye jana jata hai. Is prashn ke liye ye nahi, kyunki ye North-Western plains ka art hai.

GALAT ✗ – Maach Madhya Pradesh (khaas kar Malwa region) ka traditional theatre hai jisme dholak aur sarangi ka prayog hota hai. Is prashn ke liye ye nahi, kyunki ye Central India ka mukhya lok natya hai.
SAHI ✓ – Bhand Pather Jammu & Kashmir ka paramparagat theatre hai jo 'Wathal' (Kashmiri music) aur vyang ke liye jana jata hai.

dance.q: Leshalaptu is folk dance of which Indian state?
dance.solution: Leshalaptu Nagaland ki ek mukhya folk dance form hai, jo aksar mahilayon dwara perform ki jati hai. Nagaland ke dances me sharir ki chust-purtila (agility) aur sundar movement dikhayi jati hai. Nagaland ke anya pramukh dance me War Dance, Khamba Lim aur Bamboo Dance (Cheraw jaisa) shamil hain. Yaad rakho: Nagaland me 'L' se Leshalaptu aur 'L' se hi Log-drum music ka mahatva hai.
why: SAHI ✓ – Leshalaptu Nagaland ka hi dance hai. Ye wahan ki sanskriti aur utsavon ka ek abhinn hissa hai.

GALAT ✗ – Kerala apne classical dances jaise Kathakali aur Mohiniyattam ke liye jana jata hai, aur folk me Thullal aur Mudiyettu mashhoor hain. Is prashn ke liye ye nahi, kyunki Leshalaptu South India ka dance nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Karnataka me Yakshagana aur Dollu Kunitha jaise shaktishali folk dances hote hain. Is prashn ke liye ye nahi, kyunki Karnataka ki paramparaayein bilkul alag hain.
GALAT ✗ – Goa me Fugdi, Dhalo aur Kunbi jaise lok nritya hote hain jo Konkan sanskriti ko darshate hain. Is prashn ke liye ye nahi, kyunki Leshalaptu North-East se talluk rakhta hai.

dance.q: Which of the following classical dance do not match with its corresponding native place?
dance.solution: India me 8 mukhya Classical Dances hain jo Sangeet Natak Akademi dwara manyata prapt hain. Kuchipudi ka janm Andhra Pradesh ke Krishna district ke 'Kuchelapuram' gaanv se hua tha, na ki Odisha se. Odisha ka classical dance 'Odissi' hai. Yaad rakho: 'Kuchi' (Andhra) aur 'Pudi' (Puri/Odisha) ko mix mat hone dena, Kuchipudi sirf Andhra ka hai.
why: GALAT ✗ – Mohiniyattam Kerala ka ek sundar classical dance hai jo sirf mahilayon dwara kiya jata hai (Vishnu ke Mohini avatar par adharit). Ye sahi match hai, isliye galat option hai.
GALAT ✗ – Sattriya Assam ka classical dance hai jise Mahapurush Sankaradev ne 15th century me shuru kiya tha. Ye sahi match hai, isliye galat option hai.
SAHI ✓ – Kuchipudi Odisha ka nahi balki Andhra Pradesh ka classical dance hai. Odisha ka apna dance Odissi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Bharatanatyam Tamil Nadu ka sabse purana classical dance hai (Sadir Natyam se vikasit). Ye sahi match hai, isliye galat option hai.

dance.q: Jhijhiya Dance originated in the India state of
dance.solution: Jhijhiya Bihar ka ek behad lokpriya lok nritya (folk dance) hai jo khaas taur par Navratri ke samay kiya jata hai. Isme mahilayein apne sir par mitti ke ghade (pots) rakhkar dance karti hain jinme diye jal rahe hote hain aur ched (holes) hote hain. Ye dance Raja Chitra Sen ke samman me aur buri nazar se bachne ke liye kiya jata hai. Yaad rakho: Bihar = Bidesia aur Jhijhiya.
why: GALAT ✗ – Gujarat apne Garba aur Dandiya Raas ke liye duniya bhar me mashhoor hai jahan 'Garbi' (lamp) ka mahatva hota hai. Is prashn ke liye ye nahi, kyunki Jhijhiya specifically Bihar ki pehchan hai.
SAHI ✓ – Jhijhiya Bihar ke Mithila kshetra ka mukhya sanskritik dance hai.
GALAT ✗ – Rajasthan me Ghoomar, Kalbelia aur Bhavai jaise rangeen dance hote hain. Is prashn ke liye ye nahi, kyunki Rajasthan ki shaili Jhijhiya se bhinn hai.
GALAT ✗ – West Bengal me Gambhira, Brita aur Dhunuchi dance ka chalan hai. Is prashn ke liye ye nahi, kyunki Jhijhiya ka mul sthan Bihar hai.

dance.q: Which of the following is a form of folk theatre of Gujarat?
dance.solution: Bhavai Gujarat ka ek paramparagat folk theatre (lok natya) hai jo 14th century me Asaita Thakar dwara shuru kiya gaya tha. Isme 'Bhava' ka matlab bhavna aur 'Ai' ka matlab Amba mata hai. Isme 'Bhungal' namak ek lamba instrument bajaya jata hai aur ye samajik buraiyon par vyang karta hai. Yaad rakho: Gujarat ki 'Bhav' (emotions) Bhavai me dikhti hain.
why: GALAT ✗ – Jatra West Bengal ka folk theatre hai jisme loud music aur melodramatic acting hoti hai. Is prashn ke liye ye nahi, kyunki ye Gujarat ka nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Raas (Dandiya Raas) Gujarat ka ek 'folk dance' hai, na ki ek theatre form ya natak. Is prashn ke liye ye nahi, kyunki prashn me theatre (natak) pucha gaya hai.
GALAT ✗ – Tamasha Maharashtra ka ek lokpriya theatre form hai jisme Lavani dance ka upyog hota hai. Is prashn ke liye ye nahi, kyunki ye Maratha sanskriti ka hissa hai.
SAHI ✓ – Bhavai Gujarat ka traditional theatre hai jo apni tezz raftaar aur Bhungal music ke liye jana jata hai.

dance.q: Dandiya is a popular dance form of……….
dance.solution: Dandiya Raas Gujarat ka sabse popular folk dance hai jo Navratri ke 9 dino mein Maa Durga ki puja ke liye kiya jata hai. Isme wooden sticks (Dandiya) ka use hota hai jo Maa Durga aur Mahishasur ke beech ki fight ko represent karti hain. Isme circular motion mein 'Raas Mandal' banakar dance kiya jata hai. Yaad rakho: Garba aur Dandiya dono Gujarat ke Navratri special hain.
why: GALAT ✗ – Punjab apne Bhangra aur Gidda ke liye jana jata hai jo Baisakhi ke mauke par kiya jata hai. Is prashn ke liye ye sahi nahi hai kyunki Dandiya Gujarat ka hai.
SAHI ✓ – Gujarat ka Dandiya Raas puri duniya mein mashhoor hai. Ye Navratri ke dauran lathiyon (sticks) ke saath kiya jane wala ek samuhik nritya (group dance) hai.
GALAT ✗ – Maharashtra mein Lavani aur Dhangari Gaja jaise dance forms famous hain. Yahan Dandiya utna prachalit nahi hai jitna Gujarat mein.
GALAT ✗ – Madhya Pradesh mein Matki aur Jawara dance kiya jata hai jo harvest season se juda hai. Dandiya yahan ka native dance nahi hai.

dance.q: Bhavai and Kalbelia as traditional dance forms, owe their genesis to which Indian state?
dance.solution: Rajasthan ke folk dances mein Bhavai aur Kalbelia bahut mahatvapurn hain. Bhavai ek stunt-based dance hai jisme dancers sir par 7-9 matke (pots) rakhkar talwar ya kanch par dance karte hain. Kalbelia ko 'Snake Charmer Dance' bhi kehte hain aur ise 2010 mein UNESCO Representative List of Intangible Cultural Heritage mein shamil kiya gaya tha. Yaad rakho: Kalbelia = Gulabo Sapera (Famous Dancer).
why: GALAT ✗ – Assam Bihu aur Sattriya ke liye jana jata hai, jo wahan ki identity hai. Bhavai aur Kalbelia ka Assam se koi sambandh nahi hai.
SAHI ✓ – Rajasthan in dono dance forms ka birth-place hai. Bhavai tribal communities (Bhil/Meena) dwara aur Kalbelia sapera community dwara kiya jata hai.
GALAT ✗ – Odisha apne Classical dance 'Odissi' aur folk 'Chhau' ke liye prasiddh hai. Bhavai aur Kalbelia Rajasthan ki shaan hain.
GALAT ✗ – Punjab mein Gidda aur Bhangra prachalit hain. Bhavai jaisa stunt dance ya Kalbelia jaisa nomadic dance yahan ka native nahi hai.

dance.q: Kalbelia folk songs and dance forms are an expression of the Kalbelia community's traditional way of life. It is associated with which of the following states?
dance.solution: Kalbelia Rajasthan ki ek nomadic 'Snake Charmer' tribe hai. Inka dance 'Been' aur 'Dholak' ki dhun par hota hai. Dancers kaali poshak (black dress) pehanti hain jinpar silver embroidery hoti hai, jo saanp ke movement ko copy karti hain. Ye Rajasthan ki cultural identity ka ek mukhya hissa hai. Yaad rakho: Ye UNESCO heritage mein shamil hai, jo exam mein baar-baar pucha jata hai.
why: GALAT ✗ – Haryana apne Phag aur Loor dance ke liye jana jata hai. Kalbelia community Rajasthan ke desert regions (Thar) mein milti hai, Haryana mein nahi.
GALAT ✗ – Maharashtra mein Koli aur Lavani jaise samudayik nritya hote hain. Kalbelia ka Rajasthan ki culture se gehra rishta hai.
GALAT ✗ – Punjab ka culture Bhangra-centric hai. Kalbelia dance ki jo 'serpentine' movements hain, wo Punjab ke folk styles se alag hain.
SAHI ✓ – Rajasthan hi wo rajya hai jahan Kalbelia community basti hai aur ye world-famous 'Sapera Dance' perform karti hai.

dance.q: Bhavai is a folk dance of which state?
dance.solution: Bhavai Rajasthan ka ek professional folk dance hai jo mukhya roop se Bhil, Meena, aur Kalbelia communities karti hain. Isme male aur female dono participate karte hain, lekin mahilaon ka sir par 7 se 9 pital ke matke balance karna sabse bada attraction hai. Ye dance Rajasthan ke Udaipur, Chittorgarh aur Jodhpur regions mein kaafi popular hai. Yaad rakho: Bhavai = High balancing skills.
why: GALAT ✗ – Haryana mein Sang aur Ghoomar (Haryanvi style) hote hain. Bhavai Rajasthan ka mukhya akarshan hai.
GALAT ✗ – Maharashtra ka Loknatya 'Tamasha' hai, wahan Bhavai native form ke roop mein nahi jana jata.
GALAT ✗ – Gujarat mein 'Bhavai' naam ka ek 'Folk Theatre' (Natak) hota hai, lekin as a 'Folk Dance' (balancing pots), ye Rajasthan ka mukhya roop mana jata hai.
SAHI ✓ – Rajasthan ka Bhavai apni balancing techniques aur difficulty level ke liye jana jata hai. Yahi iska sahi rajya hai.

dance.q: With reference to dances and their native states, which of the following pairs is correct?
dance.solution: Sahi match 'Yakshagana-Karnataka' hai. Yakshagana ek traditional theatre form hai jisme music, dance, aur dialogue ka mishran hota hai (Lord Vishnu ke Dashavatara par based). Gomira West Bengal ka mask dance hai. Sattriya Assam ka classical dance hai. Kalaripayattu Kerala ki ek ancient martial art hai. Yaad rakho: Kalaripayattu ko 'Mother of all Martial Arts' kaha jata hai.
why: GALAT ✗ – Gomira Uttar Pradesh ka nahi balki West Bengal (mukhya roop se Dinajpur) ka ek mask dance hai jo 'Gomira' lakdi ke masks ke saath kiya jata hai.
SAHI ✓ – Yakshagana Karnataka ka ek bahut hi shandar traditional dance-drama hai jisme bhari costumes aur makeup ka use hota hai.
GALAT ✗ – Sattriya Manipur ka nahi balki Assam ka 8 classical dances mein se ek hai, jise Mahapurush Sankaradev ne shuru kiya tha.
GALAT ✗ – Kalaripayattu Karnataka ka nahi balki Kerala ki vishwa-prasiddh martial art (yuddh kala) hai.

dance.q: The famous 11-day long 'Dhanu Jatra', considered as the largest open-air theatre of the world is celebrated in which state?
dance.solution: Dhanu Jatra Odisha ke Bargarh district mein manaya jata hai. Ye duniya ka sabse bada 'open-air theatre' hai jisme pura shehar ek rangmanch (stage) ban jata hai. Isme Bhagwan Krishna aur unke mama Kans ki katha dikhayi jati hai. 1947-48 mein Bharat ki azadi ki khushi mein ise shuru kiya gaya tha, jo 'Burai par Achai ki jeet' ka prateek hai. Yaad rakho: Odisha = Jagannath Puri + Dhanu Jatra.
why: GALAT ✗ – Manipur apne classical dance 'Manipuri' aur 'Lai Haraoba' festival ke liye jana jata hai. Dhanu Jatra se iska koi lena-dena nahi hai kyunki ye Radha-Krishna ki Raasleela par zyada focus karta hai.
SAHI ✓ – Odisha ke Bargarh mein har saal 11 din tak ye vishal natak hota hai jise Guinness World Records mein bhi jagah mili hai.
GALAT ✗ – Assam mein 'Bihu' aur 'Majuli' festival bade star par hote hain. Dhanu Jatra wahan ka culture nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Meghalaya 'Wangala' (100 Drums festival) aur 'Nongkrem' dance ke liye famous hai. Ye ek tribal state hai jahan scriptural Hindu natak (Jatra) nahi hote.

dance.q: The famous 'Dhanu Jatra' considered as the largest oper-air theatre of the world is celebrated in which state?
dance.solution: Dhanu Jatra ka sambandh Odisha se hai. Is tyohar mein 'Kans' ka kirdar nibhane wala kalakar pure shehar par shasan karta hai aur log use raja maante hain. Ye mythological story Lord Krishna aur Balaram ke Mathura bhraman par adharit hai. SSC ke liye yaad rakho: Bargarh (Odisha) = World's Largest Open Air Theatre.
why: SAHI ✓ – Odisha hi wo rajya hai jahan ye 11-day long theatre festival hota hai.
GALAT ✗ – Gujarat 'Garba' aur 'International Kite Festival' (Uttarayan) ke liye mashhoor hai. Dhanu Jatra East India ka culture hai.
GALAT ✗ – Uttarakhand mein 'Kumbh Mela' aur 'Nanda Devi Raj Jat' hoti hai. Dhanu Jatra yahan ka paramparik utsav nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Assam (Asham) mein 'Sattriya' dance aur 'Ambubachi Mela' hota hai. Is prashn ke liye ye sahi vikalp nahi hai.

dance.q: The traditional rod puppet of Bihar is known as_____.
dance.solution: Bihar ki 'Yampuri' rod puppetry (kathputli) ek anokhi kala hai. Isme lakdi ki putliyon ko neeche se 'rods' ke sahare control kiya jata hai. Is natak mein maut ke devta 'Yamraj' aur unke darbar ki kahaniyan dikhayi jati hain taaki log bure kamo se daren. Yaad rakho: Yamraj = Yampuri (Bihar).
why: GALAT ✗ – Bommalattam Tamil Nadu ki puppetry hai jo Rod aur String (dhaga) dono ko mila kar ki jati hai. Ye Bihar ki nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Sakhi Kundhei Odisha ki famous string puppetry (dhaga kathputli) hai. Isme Radha-Krishna ki lila dikhayi jati hai.
SAHI ✓ – Yampuri Bihar ki traditional rod puppet art hai jo ab vilupt (extinct) hone ki kagar par hai.
GALAT ✗ – Malasutri Bhaulya (Malasutri Pavidia) Maharashtra ki string puppet parampara hai. Iska Bihar se koi rishta nahi hai.

dance.q: Which of these is the famous art form of Karnataka that combines dance, music, dialogue, costume, make-up and stage techniques to create a unique experience?
dance.solution: Yakshagana Karnataka ka sabse pramukh folk-theatre hai. Isme bhari makeup, bade mukut (headgears), aur loud music ka use hota hai. Iske do main style hain: 'Tenkutittu' aur 'Badagutittu'. Ye zyada-tar raat mein khule maidan mein hota hai. Yaad rakho: Yakshagana = Karnataka ki Shaan.
why: SAHI ✓ – Yakshagana hi wo kala hai jo Karnataka mein dance, dialogue aur music ko ek saath pesh karti hai.
GALAT ✗ – Kalaripayettu Kerala ki 'Martial Art' (yuddh kala) hai, ye koi theatre form nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Kathakali Kerala ka classical dance hai. Halaki isme bhi makeup aur costume bhari hota hai, par ye Karnataka ka nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Ottam Thullal Kerala ka ek vyangya (satirical) dance form hai jise Kunchan Nambiar ne shuru kiya tha.

dance.q: Dhimsa is an official folk dance of which state?
dance.solution: Dhimsa Andhra Pradesh ke Araku Valley (Visakhapatnam) mein 'Porja' tribe ki mahilayon dwara kiya jane wala folk dance hai. Isme 15-20 mahilayein ek dusre ka hath pakad kar chain banati hain. Ye aksar shadiyon aur tyoharon par khushi manane ke liye kiya jata hai. Yaad rakho: Araku Valley = Dhimsa Dance.
why: GALAT ✗ – Karnataka mein 'Dollu Kunitha' aur 'Yakshagana' jaise dance hote hain. Dhimsa wahan ka official dance nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Rajasthan apne 'Ghoomar', 'Kalbelia' aur 'Chari' dance ke liye jana jata hai. Dhimsa south Indian tribal dance hai.
GALAT ✗ – Maharashtra mein 'Lavani', 'Koli' aur 'Lezim' dance famous hain. Is prashn ke liye ye galat hai.
SAHI ✓ – Andhra Pradesh ke tribal areas mein Dhimsa ek official aur behad lokpriya folk dance hai.

dance.q: What is the traditional bamboo dance of Mizoram called?
dance.solution: Cheraw Mizoram ka sabse purana aur famous dance hai jise 'Bamboo Dance' bhi kehte hain. Isme mard zameen par bamboo (baans) ko rhythmically takrate hain aur mahilaon ko un bamboos ke beech me bade hi savdhani se step lena hota hai. Ye dance aksar 'Chapchar Kut' festival ke dauran kiya jata hai. Yaad rakho: Mizoram = Bamboo (Cheraw).
why: SAHI ✓ – Cheraw Mizoram ka sabse prachin bamboo dance hai. Isme bamboos ka istemal musical instrument aur dance prop dono ki tarah hota hai.
GALAT ✗ – Yak Chaam Sikkim ka ek mask dance hai jisme dancers 'Yak' (pahadi bail) ka roop dharte hain aur Buddhist festivals par perform karte hain. Iska Mizoram se sambandh nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Maanch Madhya Pradesh ka ek traditional folk theatre form hai. Ye Malwa region me kiya jata hai aur isme bamboo ka aisa technical use nahi hota.
GALAT ✗ – Thang Ta Manipur ki ek martial art form hai. Iska matlab hota hai 'Talwar aur Bhala' (Sword and Spear). Ye ek yuddha kala hai na ki bamboo dance.

dance.q: Cheraw is a very old traditional dance of which of the following states?
dance.solution: Cheraw dance ko Mizoram ki pehchan mana jata hai. Ye dance form 'Pawi' aur 'Lushei' tribes dwara kiya jata hai. Isme bamboo ko grid pattern me rakha jata hai. SSC exams me aksar ye pucha jata hai ki 'Bamboo dance' kis state ka hai, uska uttar Mizoram hi hoga. Yaad rakho: Mizoram ka 'Ram' aur Cheraw ka 'Raw' rhymes karte hain.
why: SAHI ✓ – Cheraw Mizoram ka ek behad purana sanskritik dance hai jo bamboo sticks ke saath kiya jata hai.
GALAT ✗ – Goa apne Fugdi aur Dekhni dances ke liye jana jata hai. Goa me Konkani culture hai aur wahan Cheraw jaisa koi bamboo dance nahi hota.
GALAT ✗ – Chhattisgarh me Panthi, Raut Nacha aur Pandavani jaise lok nritya mashhoor hain. Ye state tribal culture se bharpur hai par Cheraw yahan ka nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Himachal Pradesh me Nati nritya kiya jata hai. Yahan ka culture Pahadi hai aur Cheraw ka origin North-East India (Mizoram) me hai.

dance.q: Cheraw is a folk dance of………
dance.solution: Mizoram ka Cheraw dance vishwa bhar me apni complexity ke liye jana jata hai. Jab dhol bajta hai, tab dancers bamboos ke beech me koodte hain. Ye ek community dance hai jo khushi ke maukon par kiya jata hai. Extra Fact: Mizoram me 'Khuallam' aur 'Chailam' bhi mukhya dances hain.
why: SAHI ✓ – Cheraw Mizoram ka folk dance hai jisme bamboo grids ka use hota hai. Ye state ke sabse purane dances me se ek hai.
GALAT ✗ – Puducherry (UT) me Garadi dance kaafi famous hai, jo Ramayana ki theme par hota hai. Cheraw se iska koi lena-dena nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Gujarat apne Garba aur Dandiya Raas ke liye world-famous hai. Halaki Dandiya me sticks use hoti hain, par wo Mizoram ke Cheraw (bamboo grid) se bilkul alag hai.
GALAT ✗ – Rajasthan Ghoomar, Kalbelia aur Kachhi Ghodi ke liye jana jata hai. Rajasthan ka culture desert-based hai, jabki Cheraw hilly tribal culture ka hissa hai.

dance.q: 'Behdienkhlam' is a traditional dance festival of which state?
dance.solution: Behdienkhlam Meghalaya ki Jaintia tribe ka sabse bada festival hai. Iska matlab hota hai 'Chasing away the Demon of Cholera' yaani bimariyon ko bhagana. Ye July me kheti (sowing) ke baad manaya jata hai. Isme 'Rath' jaisi badi structures banayi jati hain jinhe 'Rot' kehte hain. Yaad rakho: Meghalaya = Behdienkhlam (Cloud state me bimari bhagana).
why: GALAT ✗ – Gujarat me Navratri aur Uttarayan (patang bazi) bade festivals hain. Behdienkhlam ka North-East connection Gujarat me nahi milta.
GALAT ✗ – Chhattisgarh me Bastar Dussehra aur Madai festival dhoom-dhaam se manaye jate hain. Behdienkhlam yahan ka festival nahi hai.
SAHI ✓ – Behdienkhlam Meghalaya ke Jowai (Jaintia Hills) me manaya jane wala harvest aur purification festival hai.
GALAT ✗ – Tamil Nadu me Pongal aur Puthandu (New Year) mukhya hain. Behdienkhlam ek tribal North-Eastern festival hai jo South India me nahi hota.

dance.q: Which of the following puppet dance is performed in Orissa?
dance.solution: Odisha me puppet dance ko 'Kandhei' ya 'Sakhi Kandhei' kaha jata hai. Ye ek 'String Puppetry' (dhage wali katputli) ka roop hai. Kandhei ka matlab Odia bhasha me 'Doll' hota hai. Isme aksar Radha-Krishna ki lila dikhayi jati hai. Yaad rakho: Odisha = Kandhei (Kendrapara district).
why: GALAT ✗ – Pavakoothu Kerala ki traditional 'Glove Puppetry' hai. Isme Kathakali ke costumes wale puppets ka use hota hai.
SAHI ✓ – Kandhei Odisha ki string puppetry hai, jise 'Sakhi Kandhei' bhi kehte hain. Ye Kendrapara region me popular hai.
GALAT ✗ – Kathputli Rajasthan ki world-famous string puppetry hai. Isme puppets lakdi (kath) ke bane hote hain aur colorful Rajasthani poshak pehente hain.
GALAT ✗ – Putul Nautch West Bengal ki traditional puppetry hai. Ye size me badi 'Rod Puppets' hoti hain jo aksar social themes par hoti hain.

dance.q: Which of the following Indian classical dancers has been INCORRECTLY matched with her dance form?
dance.solution: Saswati Sen Kathak ki ek mahir kalakar hain aur Pandit Birju Maharaj ji ki pramukh shishya rahi hain. Unhe 2004-05 ka Sangeet Natak Akademi Award mila hai. Bharatanatyam se Rukmini Devi Arundale aur Yamini Krishnamurthy judi hain. Yaad rakho: 'Sen' surname aksar Kathak ke Lucknow gharane se juda milta hai.
why: SAHI ✓ – Saswati Sen ek prasiddh Kathak nrityaangana hain, na ki Bharatanatyam ki. Ye Lucknow gharana ki parampara ko aage badhati hain. Isliye ye option galat matched hai.
GALAT ✗ – Madhavi Mudgal Odissi nritya ki ek bahut badi dancer hain aur unhe Padma Shri se bhi nawaza gaya hai. Is prashn ke context me ye jodi sahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Nandini Singh Kathak ke Jaipur gharane se talluq rakhti hain aur apni tez footwork ke liye jaani jaati hain. Is prashn ke liye ye jodi bilkul sahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Radha Reddy aur unke pati Raja Reddy Kuchipudi ke liye duniya bhar me mashhoor hain. Is prashn ke hisab se ye match bilkul sahi hai.

dance.q: Pasi Kongki is folk dance of which state?
dance.solution: Pasi Kongki Arunachal Pradesh ki 'Adi tribe' dwara kiya jaane wala ek sunder lok nritya hai. Isme Pasi samuday dwara kiye gaye samajik karyon (social work) ki kahani sunayi jaati hai. Is dance me jo gaana gaya jata hai use 'Aabang' kehte hain. Yaad rakho: Arunachal ke zyadatar tribes ke dance 'prakriti' ya 'social history' par based hote hain.
why: GALAT ✗ – Haryana apne Phag, Loor aur Daph dance ke liye jana jata hai, jisme energy bahut zyada hoti hai. Pasi Kongki yahan ka dance nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Goa me Fugdi aur Dhalo jaise lok nritya mashhoor hain jo aksar mandap ya utsavon par hote hain. Pasi Kongki ka Goa se koi rishta nahi hai.
SAHI ✓ – Pasi Kongki Arunachal ki Adi tribe ka dance hai, jo wahan ki virasat aur unke purvajon ke kaam ko darshata hai. Isliye ye sahi uttar hai.
GALAT ✗ – Kerala me Kathakali (classical) aur Mohiniyattam jaise nritya hote hain, wahan Pasi Kongki nahi kiya jata.

dance.q: Which of the following dance forms is also known as the 'Royal Dance of Ladakh'?
dance.solution: Shondol dance ko 'Royal Dance of Ladakh' kaha jata hai kyunki ye pehle Ladakh ke Rajaon (Kings) ke liye khaas maukon par pesh kiya jata tha. 2019 me isne sabse bade Ladakhi dance ke roop me Guinness World Record banaya tha. Yaad rakho: Shondol = Shaan (Royal) of Ladakh.
why: GALAT ✗ – Jabro Ladakh ke 'Nomadic' (Changpa) logon ka dance hai jo Tibetan New Year (Losar) par kiya jata hai. Ye Royal dance nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Yak Dance Himalayan kshetra (Arunachal/Ladakh) me hota hai jisme dancer Yak ka mukhauta pehante hain. Ye ek mask dance hai, royal nahi.
SAHI ✓ – Shondol ko hi 'Royal Dance' kaha jata hai kyunki ye purane samay me Namgyal vansh ke rajaon ke liye hota tha. Ye sahi uttar hai.
GALAT ✗ – Koshan dance Ladakh ke Leh area ka ek traditional dance hai, lekin ise 'Royal Dance' ka title nahi mila hai.

dance.q: The 'Loor dance' is a traditional folk dance, performed only by women, in the state of :
dance.solution: Loor dance Haryana ke Bangar kshetra (region) me Holi ke tyohar par kiya jata hai. Haryanvi bhasha me 'Loor' ka arth 'Ladki' hota hai, isliye ise sirf mahilayen karti hain. Isme sawal-jawab wali form me geet gaye jate hain. Yaad rakho: Loor = Larki (Girl) in Haryana.
why: GALAT ✗ – Madhya Pradesh me Matki aur Jawara jaise lok nritya hote hain, jo wahan ki sanskriti ka hissa hain. Loor yahan ka prachalit dance nahi hai.
SAHI ✓ – Loor Haryana ka wo dance hai jisme ladkiyan ghere me sawal-jawab karti hain aur Holi ka swagat karti hain. Ye sahi vikalp hai.
GALAT ✗ – Rajasthan me Ghoomar aur Kalbelia jaise nritya hote hain. Loor Haryana ka hai, Rajasthan ka nahi.
GALAT ✗ – Punjab me mahilaon ke liye Giddha aur Sammi mashhoor hain. Loor Punjab ki parampara nahi hai.

dance.q: Kadsa is a dance style performed by women in Jharkhand, carrying a ________.
dance.solution: Kadsa Jharkhand ka ek kalash nritya (Pot Dance) hai jo mahilayon dwara kiya jata hai. Isme mahilayen sar ya kandhe par 'Kalasha' (metal pot) rakh kar dance karti hain, jo shubh mana jata hai. Jharkhand ke anya dances me Paika, Chhau aur Santhal pramukh hain. Yaad rakho: Kadsa = Kalash.
why: GALAT ✗ – Kapala ka arth skull hota hai jo tantrik ya aghori sadhnao se juda hai, is dance me iska prayog nahi hota.
GALAT ✗ – Kamandalu rishi-muniyo dwara rakha jaane wala pani ka patra hai, ye dance me use hone wala shabda nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Kumbha ka arth bhi matka hota hai, lekin Jharkhand ke is vishisht dance form (Kadsa) ke liye 'Kalasha' shabd ka hi istemal hota hai.
SAHI ✓ – Kalasha (Kalash) hi wo cheez hai jise lekar mahilayen Kadsa nritya karti hain, isliye ye option sahi hai.

dance.q: _____ is a distinct dance form that represents a unique synthesis of Hindu and Muslim genious in art.
dance.solution: Kathak North India (UP) ka classical dance hai jo 'Katha' (storytelling) se nikla hai. Ye akela aisa classical dance hai jisme 'Ghungroo' aur 'Footwork' (Tatkar) par zyada zor diya jata hai. Mughal period ke dauran ye mandiron se nikal kar darbaron (Courts) tak pahuncha, jiske karan isme Persian aur Hindu cultures ka mix dekhne ko milta hai. Yaad Rakho: Lachu Maharaj aur Birju Maharaj isi dance ke Lucknow gharane se hain.
why: SAHI ✓ – Kathak North India ka wo dance hai jisme Bhakti movement ke Radha-Krishna themes aur Mughal darbar ki 'Nazaqat' dono shamil hain. Isiliye ise Hindu-Muslim genius ka synthesis kaha jata hai.
GALAT ✗ – Manipuri Manipur ka classical dance hai jo 'Raas Leela' aur Vaishnavism par focused hai. Isme Hindu sanskriti ka prabhav hai par Muslim influences nahi milte.
GALAT ✗ – Odissi Odisha ka prachin classical dance hai jo 'Natya Shastra' par based hai aur Mahari tradition se juda hai. Isme Hindu temple architecture (Tribhanga posture) ki jhalak milti hai.
GALAT ✗ – Kathakali Kerala ka ek 'Dance-Drama' hai jo apne heavy makeup aur facial expressions ke liye jana jata hai. Ye puri tarah se South Indian Hindu mythology par adharit hai.

dance.q: Name the type of folk songs of Sikkim which describe the natural beauty of the state
dance.solution: Sikkim ki sundarta ko darshane ke liye 'Gha To Kito' folk song kaafi mashhoor hai, jo Bhutia tribe dwara gaya aur nacha jata hai. Isme Mount Kanchenjunga aur Sikkim ki pavitra nadiyon ka zikr hota hai. Sikkim ke aur bhi folk dances hain jaise Chu Faat aur Singhi Chham. Yaad Rakho: Sikkim ki 'Bhutia' aur 'Lepcha' tribes ke folk forms exam me bahut puchte hain.
why: GALAT ✗ – Mando Goa ka ek folk song hai jo Goan Catholics dwara gaya jata hai. Ye pyar aur virah (longing) ke baare me hota hai aur isme Western instruments ka use hota hai.
GALAT ✗ – Dekhni bhi Goa ka ek semi-classical dance-song hai jo 'Devdasi' tradition aur Christian music ka mishran hai. Ye Sikkim se nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Khubakeshei Manipur ka ek folk dance hai jisme haathon se tali (clapping) bajakar rhythm banayi jati hai. Ye Sikkim ki natural beauty se juda nahi hai.
SAHI ✓ – Gha To Kito Sikkim ka wo geet-nritya hai jo wahan ke pahaadon, minerals aur Mount Kanchenjunga ki tarif me gaya jata hai.

dance.q: 'Kunbi Dance' is a popular dance associate dance associated with which Indian state ?
dance.solution: Kunbi dance Goa ki 'Kunbi' community (jo ki basically ek krishak ya agrarian community hai) dwara kiya jata hai. Ye ek social folk dance hai jo zyada tar festive occasions par mahilaon dwara kiya jata hai. Isme traditional sarees pehni jati hain aur dance simple par energetic hota hai. Yaad Rakho: Goa ke anya dance forms 'Fugdi', 'Dhalo' aur 'Sigmo' festival hain.
why: GALAT ✗ – Mizoram apne 'Cheraw' (Bamboo dance) aur 'Khuallam' ke liye famous hai. Kunbi yahan ka culture nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Sikkim me 'Maruni' aur 'Tamang Selo' jaise dances popular hain, jo wahan ki Nepali aur tribal population karti hai.
GALAT ✗ – Jammu and Kashmir me 'Rouf' aur 'Hikat' jaise dances famous hain jo Spring season me perform kiye jate hain.
SAHI ✓ – Kunbi Goa ki ek mool (indigenous) community hai aur ye dance unki sanskriti ka ahm hissa hai jo state ki diversity dikhata hai.

dance.q: In which state is the Ponung folk dance practised?
dance.solution: Ponung dance Arunachal Pradesh ki 'Adi' tribe ka sabse mahatvapurna dance hai. Ye dance aksar 'Solung' festival ke mauke par kiya jata hai taki acchi fasal (harvest) ki prarthna ki ja sake. Isme sirf mahilayein participate karti hain aur unka leader 'Miri' kehlata hai jo lok-geet gata hai. Yaad Rakho: Adi tribe ke aur bhi dance hain jaise 'Tapu' (war dance).
why: GALAT ✗ – Sikkim me 'Chu Faat' dance hota hai jo Mount Kanchenjunga ki puja ke liye kiya jata hai. Ponung yahan ka nahi hai.
SAHI ✓ – Ponung Arunachal Pradesh ki Adi tribe ka folk dance hai, jo harvest season aur social harmony ko celebrate karta hai.
GALAT ✗ – Manipur me 'Thang-Ta' (martial art) aur 'Pung Cholom' mashhoor hain. Ponung ka Manipur se sambandh nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Assam apne 'Bihu', 'Bagurumba' aur 'Sattriya' dance ke liye jana jata hai. Ponung yahan ka paramparik dance nahi hai.

dance.q: Bhavai is a a traditional dance form of ____.
dance.solution: Bhavai Gujarat aur Rajasthan ke border areas ka ek bahut hi difficult folk dance hai. Isme dancer apne sir par 7 se 9 mitti ke ghade (pots) balance karta hai aur kabhi-kabhi kanch ke tukdon ya talwar ki dhaar par natchta hai. Gujarat me ye 'Asaita Thakar' dwara shuru kiya gaya tha aur ise 'Vesha' bhi kehte hain. Yaad Rakho: Bhavai ka matlab 'Bhav' (emotion) aur 'Ai' (mother) yaani Mother Goddess ka nritya.
why: GALAT ✗ – Bihar me 'Jat-Jatin' aur 'Bideshiya' folk theatre/dance popular hain. Bhavai ka Bihar se koi lena-dena nahi hai.
SAHI ✓ – Bhavai Gujarat ka ek traditional folk dance aur theatre form hai jo apni balancing acts aur social themes ke liye jana jata hai.
GALAT ✗ – Maharashtra 'Lavani' aur 'Tamasha' ke liye famous hai. Wahan balancing wale Bhavai ka chalan nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Punjab me 'Bhangra' aur 'Giddha' hote hain jo energy aur dhol par adharit hain, na ki sir par matke balance karne par.

dance.q: Kan. Kandyan Dance is a common dance style of the country ......... ?
dance.solution: Kandyan dance Sri Lanka ka sabse pratishthit 'National Dance' form hai. Iska naam Sri Lanka ki purani rajdhani 'Kandy' ke naam par rakha gaya hai. Ye dance asal me 'Kohomba Kankariya' ritual se nikla hai aur ise sirf purush (men) karte the, lekin ab mahilaen bhi karti hain. Isme 'Geta Beraya' (drum) ka istemal hota hai. Yaad rakho: Kandy = Sri Lanka ka hill capital.
why: GALAT ✗ – Nepal ke prasiddh dance forms 'Maruni' aur 'Lakhey' hain. Kandyan dance yahan ka nahi hai.
SAHI ✓ – Kandyan dance Sri Lanka ka paramparik nritya hai jo Kandy ke rajaon ke samay viksit hua aur wahan ki sanskriti ka pratik hai.
GALAT ✗ – Bhutan me 'Cham' (mask dance) famous hai. Kandyan wahan ka mukhya nritya nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – India me 8 classical dances hain (like Kathak, Bharatnatyam), par Kandyan hamare padosi desh Sri Lanka ka hai.

dance.q: Poush Mela displays local artisians displaying folk dances, music, foo, music, food and culture of _____
dance.solution: Poush Mela West Bengal ke Birbhum district (Santiniketan) me har saal December (Poush month) me manaya jata hai. Iski shuruat Maharshi Debendranath Tagore ne 1894 me ki thi. Is mele me 'Baul' sangeet, handicraft aur Shantiniketan ki art ki pradarshani hoti hai. Ye 'Brahmo Utsav' ke roop me shuru hua tha.
why: GALAT ✗ – Gujarat me 'Rann Utsav' aur 'Kite Festival' bade star par manaye jate hain, Poush Mela nahi.
SAHI ✓ – Poush Mela West Bengal ke Shantiniketan se juda hai, jo Tagore pariwar aur Baul sangeet ke liye jana jata hai.
GALAT ✗ – Rajasthan apne 'Pushkar Mela' aur 'Desert Festival' ke liye famous hai. Poush Mela ka sambandh Bengal se hai.
GALAT ✗ – Uttarakhand me 'Kumbh' aur 'Phool Dei' jaise festival hote hain. Poush Mela Eastern India ka tyohar hai.

dance.q: 'Tho 'Thoda' a sport dance belongs to which of the following states?
dance.solution: Thoda Himachal Pradesh ka ek martial art dance hai jo Kullu aur Shimla ghatiyo me prachalit hai. Ye 'Archery' (teer-andazi) par adharit hai. Ye dance 'Pandavas' aur 'Kauravas' ke beech ke yuddh ka pratik mana jata hai. Isme do groups hote hain - Saathi aur Pashi. Yaad rakho: Thoda = Teer (Archery) + Himachal.
why: GALAT ✗ – Andhra Pradesh me 'Kuchipudi' aur 'Kolannalu' (stick dance) hota hai. Thoda wahan ka sport dance nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Haryana me 'Phag' aur 'Dhamal' famous hain. Thoda hilly area Himachal ka hai.
GALAT ✗ – Sikkim me 'Singhi Chham' aur 'Chu Faat' hota hai. Thoda martial art Himachal se juda hai.
SAHI ✓ – Thoda Himachal Pradesh ka ek martial art form hai jisme archery ki skills ko dance ke roop me dikhaya jata hai.

dance.q: Performe. Performed by Buddhists to drive out evil spirits...........dance is a form of dance of Himachal Pradesh.
dance.solution: Chham dance (jise Mask Dance bhi kehte hain) Tibetan Buddhism se juda hai. Ye Himachal Pradesh ke Lahaul-Spiti aur Kinnaur regions me Buddhist monks dwara kiya jata hai. Iska uddeshya 'Buraai par acchai ki jeet' aur evil spirits ko bhagana hota hai. Isme bade colorful masks aur bhari costumes pehne jate hain.
why: GALAT ✗ – Gogra jaisa koi mukhya Buddhist ritual dance nahi hai jo evil spirits ke liye famous ho.
GALAT ✗ – Theotrical (Natkiya) ek general term hai, ye kisi specific ritual dance ka naam nahi hai.
SAHI ✓ – Chham nritya Himachal aur Ladakh ke mathon (monasteries) me buri aatmon ko bhagane ke liye monks karte hain.
GALAT ✗ – Dhamal ya Dham Haryana aur Himachal me hota hai, par evil spirits bhagane wala Buddhist dance Chham hai.

dance.q: The famous dancer T Balasaraswati was an exponent of which of the following dance forms?
dance.solution: Tanjore Balasaraswati (T. Balasaraswati) Bharatanatyam ki sabse mahatvapurn dancer thi jinhone is dance ko global level par pehchan dilayi. Unhe 1977 me 'Padma Vibhushan' mila tha. Wo 'Abhinaya' (expressions) me mahir thi. Unhe 'Queen of Bharatanatyam' bhi kaha jata hai. Yaad rakho: T. Balasaraswati = Tamil Nadu = Bharatanatyam.
why: GALAT ✗ – Kathak North India ka hai aur iske bade naam Birju Maharaj aur Lachhu Maharaj hain.
GALAT ✗ – Kathakali Kerala ka mask dance hai, Balasaraswati ji isse judi nahi thi.
SAHI ✓ – T. Balasaraswati Bharatanatyam ki legend hain, unhone hi is classical dance ko duniya bhar me lokpriya banaya.
GALAT ✗ – Kuchipudi Andhra Pradesh ka dance hai. Balasaraswati ji Tamil Nadu ke Bharatanatyam se talluk rakhti thi.

dance.q: Which of the following terms is associate following terms is associated with the 'Bharatnatyam' dance form?
dance.solution: Bharatnatyam ke performance ka kram 'Alarippu' se shuru hokar 'Tillana' par khatam hota hai. Tillana ek fast-paced rhythmic piece hai jisme rhythmic syllables aur murshanas ka prayog hota hai. Bharatnatyam Tamil Nadu ka shastriya nritya hai aur iske pramukh kalakar Padma Subrahmanyam aur Rukmini Devi Arundale hain. Yaad rakho: 'ATM' (Alarippu, Tillana, Mangalam) Bharatnatyam ke main steps hain.
why: SAHI ✓ – Tillana Bharatnatyam ka aakhri charan (concluding part) hota hai, jisme nrityangana apni gati aur laya ka pradarshan karti hai.
GALAT ✗ – Mangalacharan 'Odissi' dance ka pehla bhag hota hai jisme bhagwan aur guru ki vandana ki jati hai. Isliye ye Bharatnatyam se sambandhit nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Tharijham ya 'Tarana' jaisa term Kathak mein adhik prachalit hai aur Bharatnatyam ki standard terminology ka pramukh hissa nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Batu Nritya Odissi dance ka ek shuddh nritya (pure dance) bhag hai jo Lord Batukeshwar (Shiva) ko samarpit hai, Bharatnatyam ko nahi.

dance.q: In which state of India did the Kuchipudi dance originate?
dance.solution: Kuchipudi Andhra Pradesh ke 'Kuchelapuram' gaon se nikla hai. Ye nritya-natika (dance-drama) par aadharit hai jisme 'Bhama Kalapam' sabse prasiddh hai. Isme 'Tarangam' ek khaas kriya hai jisme nartak peetal ki thali ke kinaron par pair rakhkar dance karta hai. Yaad rakho: 'Andhera (Andhra) mein kachchi pudi (Kuchipudi) khayi'.
why: GALAT ✗ – Maharashtra apne lok nritya 'Lavani' aur 'Tamasha' ke liye jana jata hai, yahan se koi shastriya nritya originate nahi hua.
GALAT ✗ – Gujarat 'Garba' aur 'Dandiya Raas' jaise folk dances ke liye vishva prasiddh hai, Kuchipudi ka yahan se sambandh nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Karnataka 'Yakshagana' (semi-classical) aur 'Dollu Kunitha' ke liye jana jata hai, halanki yahan Bharatnatyam bhi prachalit hai par Kuchipudi ka udgam yahan nahi hua.
SAHI ✓ – Andhra Pradesh hi Kuchipudi ka janmasthan hai, jise Siddharendra Yogi ne ek vishisht shaili ke roop mein sthapit kiya tha.

dance.q: Kuchipudi is a classical dance of……….
dance.solution: Kuchipudi ekmatra aisa classical dance hai jisme 'Vachika Abhinaya' (bolna/gana) ka bahut mahatva hai. Isme nartak hi aksar chitra bhi banata hai (Simhanandini). Iske mukhya kalakar Raja-Radha Reddy aur Yamini Krishnamurthy hain. Yaad rakho: Kuchipudi = Andhra Pradesh + Brass Plate (Tarangam).
why: GALAT ✗ – Mizoram apne bamboo dance 'Cheraw' ke liye jana jata hai, wahan koi shastriya nritya (classical dance) nahi hai.
SAHI ✓ – Andhra Pradesh ka shastriya nritya Kuchipudi hai, jo Vaishnavism se prabhavit hai aur Bhagwat Purana ki kahaniyan dikhata hai.
GALAT ✗ – Jammu & Kashmir 'Rouf' aur 'Hikat' jaise lok nrityon ke liye jana jata hai, yahan ka koi dance 8 classical dances ki list mein nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Maharashtra 'Povadas' aur 'Dhangari Gaja' ke liye famous hai, Kuchipudi se iska koi lena dena nahi hai.

dance.q: Which of the following is a famous Classical Indian dancer?
dance.solution: Uday Shankar ko 'Father of Modern Dance in India' kaha jata hai. Unhone bina kisi formal training ke 'Creative Dance' ya fusion style banaya tha. Unka film 'Kalpana' dance par hi aadharit hai. Unhone Indian classical forms ko global platform par European techniques ke saath mix kiya. Yaad rakho: Uday Shankar = Modern Fusion Pioneer.
why: GALAT ✗ – Anjolie Ela Menon ek bahut badi 'Painter' (Chitrakar) hain, unka naam fine arts se juda hai, dance se nahi.
SAHI ✓ – Uday Shankar ek vishva-prasiddh nartak aur choreographer the jinhone bharatiya nritya ko naye ayam diye.
GALAT ✗ – Satish Gujral ek prasiddh 'Architect', Sculptor aur 'Painter' the, wo Bharat ke purva PM I.K. Gujral ke bhai the.
GALAT ✗ – Pandit Bhimsen Joshi ek mahan 'Classical Vocalist' (Gayak) the jo Kirana Gharana se talluk rakhte the, wo nartak nahi the.

dance.q: Which of the following is a famous Classical Indian dancer?
dance.solution: Sonal Mansingh Odissi aur Bharatnatyam dono ki mahan nartaki hain. Unhe 1992 mein Padma Bhushan aur 2003 mein Padma Vibhushan mila (sabse kam umra mein ye samman pane wali nartaki). Wo Rajya Sabha ki member bhi rahi hain. Yaad rakho: Sonal = Odissi + Bharatnatyam expert.
why: GALAT ✗ – Amrita Sher-Gil ek mahan 'Painter' thin, unhe Bharat ki 'Frida Kahlo' kaha jata hai. Unka dance se sambandh nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Satish Gujral ek 'Visual Artist' (Painter/Sculptor) the, unhe unke mural works ke liye jana jata hai.
SAHI ✓ – Sonal Mansingh ek prasiddh shastriya nartaki hain jo Odissi aur Bharatnatyam mein maharat rakhti hain.
GALAT ✗ – Bhimsen Joshi Hindustani Classical Music ke 'Gayak' (Singer) the, jinhe 'Bharat Ratna' se nawaza gaya tha.

dance.q: Which of the following is a classical dance from North India?
dance.solution: Kathak North India (UP) ka ekmatra classical dance hai. Ye 'Katha' shabd se bana hai, jiska matlab hai 'kahani sunane wala'. Isme chakkar (spins) aur footwork (tatkar) par bahut dhyaan diya jata hai. Ye Bhakti movement ke waqt mandiron se shuru hua aur baad me Mughal darbaron tak pahuncha. Lucknow, Jaipur aur Banaras iske pramukh gharane hain. Yaad rakho: 'Katha kahe so Kathak kahave'.
why: GALAT ✗ – Bharatanatyam Tamil Nadu ka sabse purana classical dance hai, jo 'Sadir Attam' ke naam se jana jata tha. Is prashn ke liye ye nahi kyunki ye South India se hai.
GALAT ✗ – Kuchipudi Andhra Pradesh ka classical dance hai, jo 'Kuchelapuram' gaon se shuru hua tha. Is prashn ke liye ye nahi kyunki ye South India se hai.
SAHI ✓ – Kathak Uttar Pradesh (North India) ka shastriya nritya hai. Isme Lucknow aur Jaipur gharane famous hain aur ye North India ka represent karta hai.
GALAT ✗ – Kathakali Kerala ka classical dance drama hai, jisme bhaari costume aur chehre par 'pacha' (green) ya 'kathi' makeup hota hai. Is prashn ke liye ye nahi kyunki ye South India se hai.

dance.q: Rukmini Devi Arundale is associated with
dance.solution: Rukmini Devi Arundale ne Bharatanatyam ko ek naya jeevan diya. Unhone 'Kalakshetra Foundation' ki sthapna Chennai me ki thi. Wo pehli mahila thi jinhe Rajya Sabha ke liye nominate kiya gaya tha. Unhe Animal Rights ke liye bhi jana jata hai. Unke prayason se hi is dance ko 'Sadir' se badalkar 'Bharatanatyam' naam diya gaya. Yaad rakho: Rukmini = Kalakshetra = Bharatanatyam.
why: GALAT ✗ – Kathak ke liye Birju Maharaj aur Sitara Devi jaise naam famous hain. Rukmini Devi isse sambandhit nahi hain.
SAHI ✓ – Rukmini Devi Arundale Bharatanatyam ki sabse badi exponent rahi hain, unhone is dance form ko global level par samman dilaya.
GALAT ✗ – Kuchipudi ke liye Yamini Krishnamurthy ya Raja-Radha Reddy jane jate hain. Rukmini Devi is style ki dancer nahi thi.
GALAT ✗ – Bhangra Punjab ka ek folk dance hai jo mard karte hain (Baisakhi par). Iska classical dance ya Rukmini Devi se koi lena-dena nahi hai.

dance.q: Lavani is a folk dance of……….
dance.solution: Lavani Maharashtra ka sabse lokpriya folk dance hai. Ye 'Dholki' ki thaap par kiya jata hai. Isme mahilayein 9-yard (Nauvari) saree pehenti hain. Iske do mukhya prakar hain: 'Nirguni Lavani' (spiritual) aur 'Shringari Lavani' (romantic/erotic). Isme 'Tamasha' theatre ka bhi bada role hota hai. Yaad rakho: Lavani = Maharashtra + Dholki + Nauvari Saree.
why: GALAT ✗ – Manipur apne classical dance 'Manipuri' (Raasleela) aur Pung Cholom ke liye jana jata hai. Lavani yahan ka nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Andhra Pradesh me Kuchipudi (Classical) aur Lambadi, Dhimsa (Folk) hote hain. Lavani yahan ka dance nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Jammu & Kashmir me Rouf aur Hikat jaise folk dances hote hain jo thand ke mausam ya eid par hote hain. Lavani se iska koi nata nahi.
SAHI ✓ – Lavani Maharashtra ka traditional folk dance hai jo apni tej raftar aur 'Dholki' instrument ke liye mashhoor hai.

dance.q: Lavani is a folk dance of which of the following statest of India?
dance.solution: Lavani Maharashtra ki sanskriti ka hissa hai. Ye dance 'Peshwa' period ke waqt bahut popular hua kyunki ye thake hue sainikon (soldiers) ke manoranjan ke liye kiya jata tha. Isme mahilayein 'Ghungroo' baandhkar bahut energetic performance deti hain. Yaad rakho: Maharashtrian Lavani = High energy + Beats of Dholak.
why: GALAT ✗ – Rajasthan me Ghoomar, Kalbelia aur Bhavai jaise lok nritya hote hain. Lavani Rajasthan ka dance nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Jharkhand me Chhau, Paika aur Santhali dance hote hain jo aksar tribal culture ko darshate hain. Lavani yahan nahi hota.
GALAT ✗ – Gujarat me Garba aur Dandiya Raas sabse zyada famous hain jo Navratri par hote hain. Lavani yahan ka nahi hai.
SAHI ✓ – Lavani Maharashtra ka sabse iconic folk dance hai, isliye ye option sahi hai.

dance.q: Which among the following is not dance form of Kerala?
dance.solution: Chhapeli Uttarakhand aur UP ke Kumaon region ka folk dance hai. Isme ek hath me aaina (mirror) aur dusre me rumal lekar dance kiya jata hai, jo premi-premika (lovers) ke beech ki baaton ko dikhata hai. Baaki teeno (Kathakali, Thullal, Kaikottikali) Kerala ke hain. Yaad rakho: Chhapeli = Uttarakhand ka 'Mirror' dance.
why: GALAT ✗ – Kathakali Kerala ka ek classical dance-drama hai jisme kahaniyan 'Mahabharata' aur 'Ramayana' se li jati hain. Ye Kerala ka hi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Ottamthullal ya Thullal Kerala ka ek 'Solo' dance form hai jise Kunchan Nambiar ne shuru kiya tha. Ye Kerala ka hai.
