GALAT ✗ – Kaikottikali (jisey Thiruvathirakali bhi kehte hain) Kerala me Onam ke mauke par mahilayon dwara kiya jata hai. Ye Kerala ka hi hai.
SAHI ✓ – Chhapeli Kerala ka nahi balki Uttarakhand (aur UP) ka dance hai. Isliye ye 'Not' wali category me sahi answer hai.

dance.q: Giddha is a folk dance of which state?
dance.solution: Giddha Punjab ka ek energetic folk dance hai jo sirf mahilaon (women) dwara kiya jata hai. Isme mahilaen ghere (circle) mein khadi hokar boliyan gaati hain aur taaliyan bajati hain. Ye khushi ke maukon jaise ki Vaisakhi, Teej aur shaadi-byah par kiya jata hai. Isme kisi khas vadyayantra ki zarurat nahi hoti, sirf taali aur 'Boli' hi kafi hai. Yaad rakho: Bhangra mardon ke liye aur Giddha mahilaon ke liye.
why: GALAT ✗ – Rajasthan mein Ghoomar, Kalbelia aur Kachhi Ghodi jaise pramukh lok nritya hote hain. Isliye Giddha yahan ka nritya nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Uttar Pradesh apne Kathak (classical) aur Nautanki, Raslila (folk) ke liye jana jata hai. Giddha yahan ki sanskriti ka hissa nahi hai.
SAHI ✓ – Punjab ka ye nritya mahilaon ki masti aur rangini ko darshata hai. Isme mahilaen 'Punjabi Salwar Kameez' pehan kar nanchti hain.
GALAT ✗ – Bihar mein Jat-Jatin aur Bideshiya jaise folk dances mashhoor hain. Giddha ka sambandh is rajya se nahi hai.

dance.q: Bhangra is a folk dance of
dance.solution: Bhangra Punjab ka sabse lokpriya mardana (male) lok nritya hai, jo 'Dhol' ki thaap par kiya jata hai. Ye mukhya roop se Vaisakhi ke tyohar par fasal ki katai (harvest) ki khushi mein hota hai. Isme nartak 'Lungi' aur 'Pagri' pehante hain aur 'Hoye Hoye' ka shor machate hain. Yaad rakho: Bhangra = Dhol + Vaisakhi + Punjab.
why: GALAT ✗ – Arunachal Pradesh mein Bardu Chham aur Lion and Peacock dance hota hai. Bhangra yahan ki parampara nahi hai.
SAHI ✓ – Punjab ka ye energetic dance pure vishwa mein mashhoor hai. Isme sharir ki takat aur khushi ka pradarshan hota hai.
GALAT ✗ – Assam apne Bihu nritya ke liye jana jata hai. Bhangra aur Assam ki shaili bilkul alag hai.
GALAT ✗ – Nagaland mein 'War Dance' aur 'Zeliang' jaise tribes ke nritya hote hain. Bhangra yahan ka nahi hai.

dance.q: Kud is a folk dance of
dance.solution: Kud dance Jammu & Kashmir ke pahadi ilakon mein kiya jata hai. Ye ek dharmik ritual hai jo 'Lok Devatas' (Gram Devta) ko dhanyavad dene ke liye hota hai. Kisan log fasal katne ke baad raat ke samay aag ke charon taraf ye nritya karte hain. Isme 'Flute' (bansuri) aur 'Drum' ka istemal hota hai. Yaad rakho: Kud = Jammu ke Pahad + Devta.
why: GALAT ✗ – Kerala apne Kathakali aur Mohiniyattam ke liye famous hai. Kud nritya ka Kerala ki parampara se mel nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Andhra Pradesh mein Kuchipudi aur Lambadi nritya hote hain. Kud yahan ka regional dance nahi hai.
SAHI ✓ – Jammu & Kashmir ke Chenab valley mein ye nritya kafi prachalit hai, jahan kisan kud ko bhagwan ke prati samarpit karte hain.
GALAT ✗ – Maharashtra mein Lavani aur Koli nritya hote hain. Kud Jammu ka ek vishisht lok nritya hai.

dance.q: Bihu is a folk dance of which state?
dance.solution: Bihu Assam ka sabse mahatvapurn lok nritya aur tyohar hai. Ye saal mein teen baar manaya jata hai—Rongali (Spring), Kongali (Autumn) aur Bhogali (Winter). Bihu nritya mein tez kadmon (brisk steps) aur haathon ki tezi se harqat hoti hai. Isme 'Dhol', 'Pepa' (horn instrument) aur 'Tala' bajaya jata hai. Yaad rakho: Bihu = Assam ki lifeline.
why: SAHI ✓ – Assam ka ye dance vahan ki sanskritik pehchan hai. Mahilaen 'Muga Silk' ki Mekhela Sador pehan kar ye nritya karti hain.
GALAT ✗ – Maharashtra ka mukhya lok nritya Lavani hai. Bihu ka sambandh purvottar Bharat (North East) se hai.
GALAT ✗ – Odisha apne Odissi (classical) aur Sambalpuri (folk) ke liye jana jata hai. Bihu yahan nahi hota.
GALAT ✗ – Uttarakhand mein Choliya aur Jhora nritya hote hain. Bihu wahan ki parampara ka bhag nahi hai.

dance.q: Tertali is a classical dance of
dance.solution: Tertali (ya Teratali) Madhya Pradesh ki 'Kamar' jati (tribe) dwara kiya jata hai. Halaki book mein ise classical likha hai, par ye asal mein ek 'Folk' dance hai. Isme 2-3 mahilaen zameen par baithkar sharir ke alag-alag hisson par 'Manjiras' (cymbals) baandhti hain aur unhe lay mein bajati hain. Yaad rakho: Tertali = Manjira + Kamar Tribe + MP.
why: GALAT ✗ – Chhattisgarh mein Panthi aur Raut Nacha mashhoor hain. Tertali mukhya roop se MP ki pehchan hai.
SAHI ✓ – Madhya Pradesh ka ye anokha nritya hai jisme mahilaen apne mooh mein talwar (sword) dabakar bhi santulan banati hain.
GALAT ✗ – Manipur apne Manipuri (classical) aur Thang-Ta (martial art) ke liye jana jata hai. Tertali yahan ka nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Karnataka mein Yakshagana aur Dollu Kunitha jaise nritya hote hain. Tertali ka sambandh Madhya Bharat se hai.

dance.q: Bharatanatyam is classical dance of which state?
dance.solution: Bharatanatyam Bharat ka sabse purana classical dance hai jo Tamil Nadu ke mandiron me 'Sadhir Attam' ke naam se shuru hua tha. Ye dance 'Natya Shastra' aur 'Abhinaya Darpana' par adharit hai. Isme 'Araimandi' (half-sitting posture) bahut mahatvapurna hai. Rukmini Devi Arundale ne ise modern pehchan dilayi. Yaad rakho: Bharat-Tamil (B-T connection).
why: GALAT ✗ – Kerala me Kathakali (mask dance) aur Mohiniyattam (graceful) hote hain. Is prashn ke liye ye sahi nahi hai kyunki Bharatanatyam ka udgam Tamil Nadu hai.
SAHI ✓ – Tamil Nadu Bharatanatyam ki janamsthali hai. Ye 'Dasi Attam' ke roop me Devdasiyon dwara mandiron me kiya jata tha.
GALAT ✗ – Andhra Pradesh ka classical dance Kuchipudi hai, jo 'Kuchelapuram' gaon se aaya hai. Bharatanatyam yahan ka mukhya nritya nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Uttarakhand ek pahadi rajya hai jahan Choliya aur Jhora jaise folk dances famous hain, koi classical dance yahan se originate nahi hua.

dance.q: Mohiniyattam is a dance form of which state?
dance.solution: Mohiniyattam 'Mohini' (Lord Vishnu ka sundar roop) ke naam par hai. Ye ek 'Lasya' pradhan dance hai jo sirf mahilayon dwara kiya jata hai. Isme dancer safed aur sunehri (white & gold) Kasavu saree pehenti hai. Edakka aur Mridangam iske mukhya vadya yantra hain. Yaad rakho: Mohini = Vishnu avatar = Kerala.
why: GALAT ✗ – Andhra Pradesh Kuchipudi aur Lambadi dance ke liye jana jata hai. Mohiniyattam yahan ka native classical dance nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Assam ka classical dance 'Sattriya' hai jo Mahapurush Sankaradev ne shuru kiya tha. Mohiniyattam South India ka hai.
SAHI ✓ – Kerala me Mohiniyattam ka vikas hua. Ise 'Dance of the Enchantress' bhi kehte hain aur isme bahut hi graceful movements hote hain.
GALAT ✗ – Tripura me Hojagiri folk dance hota hai. Classical dances ki list me Tripura ka koi dance shamil nahi hai.

dance.q: Garadi is a folk dance of……..
dance.solution: Garadi Puducherry ka sabse lokpriya folk dance hai jo Ramayana ki katha se juda hai. Jab Bhagwan Ram Ravan ko harakar laute, tab Sugreev ki Vanar Sena ne ye nritya kiya tha. Isme dancers 'Vanar' (monkeys) ki tarah act karte hain aur pairo me bhari ghungroo pehente hain. Yaad rakho: Garadi = Vanar Sena = Puducherry.
why: GALAT ✗ – Mizoram apne 'Cheraw' (Bamboo dance) ke liye famous hai. Garadi vahan ka culture nahi hai.
SAHI ✓ – Puducherry (UT) ka Garadi dance bahut energetic hota hai aur ye khas taur par festivals ke dauran kiya jata hai.
GALAT ✗ – Gujarat me Garba aur Dandiya Raas hote hain jo Navratri me mashhoor hain. Garadi West India ka dance nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Rajasthan me Ghoomar, Kalbelia aur Kachhi Ghodi mashhoor hain. Garadi ka Rajasthan se koi sambandh nahi hai.

dance.q: Munda is a folk dance of…………
dance.solution: Munda dance Jharkhand ki Munda tribe dwara kiya jane wala ek samudayik nritya (community dance) hai. Ye harvest season aur Maghe festival par hota hai. Isme Madar, Nagara aur Bansi (flute) ka prayog hota hai. Munda logo ke anya dance Jadur aur Karam hain. Yaad rakho: Munda Tribe = Birsa Munda = Jharkhand.
why: GALAT ✗ – Arunachal Pradesh me Bardo Chham aur Bhuiya jaise dances hote hain. Munda tribe yahan ki mukhya tribe nahi hai.
SAHI ✓ – Jharkhand me Munda, Santhal aur Oraon tribes rehti hain aur Munda dance Jharkhand ki sanskriti ka ek atoot hissa hai.
GALAT ✗ – Chhattisgarh me Panthi aur Raut Nacha famous hain. Halaki Munda tribe wahan bhi hai, par ye dance Jharkhand ka mukhya pehchan hai.
GALAT ✗ – Haryana me Phag aur Loor dances hote hain jo North Indian culture ka part hain. Munda tribal dance vahan nahi hota.

dance.q: Gaur dance is a popular folk dance of…………
dance.solution: Gaur dance Chhattisgarh ke Bastar district ki 'Gaur Maria' tribe ka hai. Isme purush 'Bison' (jungli bhains) ke seeng (horns) wala crown pehente hain, isliye ise 'Bison Horn Maria' dance bhi kehte hain. Ye shadi aur shubh avsaron par kiya jata hai. Yaad rakho: Bastar = Gaur Maria = Chhattisgarh.
why: SAHI ✓ – Chhattisgarh ke Bastar plateau me ye dance tribe ki virat aur shakti ka prateek hai. Ye tribal exams ka favorite question hai.
GALAT ✗ – Tripura me Hojagiri aur Garia puja ke samay dances hote hain, par Gaur Maria tribe wahan nahi payi jati.
GALAT ✗ – Jharkhand me Chhau aur Santhali dances dominant hain. Gaur dance specific roop se Chhattisgarh ki pehchan hai.
GALAT ✗ – Uttarakhand me pahadi folk jaise Barada Nati hota hai. Gaur dance ek central Indian tribal dance hai.

dance.q: The Karma dance belongs to which state?
dance.solution: Karma dance Madhya Pradesh aur Chhattisgarh ki Gond, Baiga aur Oraon tribes ka ek bahut hi pavitra dance hai. Ye 'Karam' devta (God of Fate) ko prasann karne ke liye August-September ke mahine mein kiya jata hai. Isme mard aur auratein dono participate karte hain aur 'Mandara' (drum) ka istemal hota hai. **Yaad rakho:** Karma = Karam Devta ki pooja, jo MP/Chhattisgarh/Jharkhand ke tribals karte hain.
why: GALAT ✗ – West Bengal mein Chhau, Brita aur Gambhira jaise lok nritya mashhoor hain, wahan Karma main dance nahi hai. Is prashn ke liye ye sahi nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Sikkim ke pramukh dance Singhi Chham (Snow Lion dance) aur Chu-Faat hain, jo wahan ki Lepcha aur Bhutia tribes karti hain. Isliye ye galat vikalp hai.
SAHI ✓ – Karma dance Madhya Pradesh (aur Chhattisgarh) ka ek mahatvapurna tribal dance hai jo fasal ki katai aur bhagya ke devta ke liye kiya jata hai.
GALAT ✗ – Uttar Pradesh ke folk dances mein Nautanki, Raslila aur Charkula (Braj kshetra) aate hain. Karma UP ka primary folk dance nahi hai.

dance.q: Garba is a folk dance of
dance.solution: Garba Gujarat ka sabse lokpriya dance hai jo Navratri ke 9 dinon mein Maa Durga ki upasna ke liye kiya jata hai. 'Garba' shabd Sanskrit ke 'Garbha' (womb) se aaya hai, jisme ek mitti ke diye (Garbha Deep) ke charo taraf circular movement mein dance hota hai. Isse 2023 mein UNESCO ki Intangible Cultural Heritage list mein shamil kiya gaya hai. **Yaad rakho:** Garba = Gujarat + Circular motion + Navratri.
why: GALAT ✗ – Mizoram mein 'Cheraw' (Bamboo dance) aur 'Khuallam' mashhoor hain. Garba wahan ka paramparik dance nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Puducherry ek Union Territory hai jahan 'Garadi' dance kaafi famous hai. Garba ka sambandh yahan se nahi hai.
SAHI ✓ – Garba Gujarat ka iconic dance hai jo Navratri ke dauran mahilaon dwara mitti ke matke (deepak) ke sath kiya jata hai.
GALAT ✗ – Rajasthan mein Ghoomar aur Kalbelia jaise dances hote hain. Halanki Gujarat ke border par Garba hota hai, par ye mukhya roop se Gujarat ka hi hai.

dance.q: Ghumura is a folk dance of
dance.solution: Ghumura Odisha ke Kalahandi district ka ek prachin aur virta (heroic) dance hai. Iska naam 'Ghumura' naamak ek mitti ke ghade (pot) jaise dikhne wale instrument se pada hai. Purane samay mein ise 'War Dance' mana jata tha kyunki ye yuddh ke maidan mein bajaya jata tha. **Yaad rakho:** Ghumura (instrument) = Odisha (Kalahandi).
why: SAHI ✓ – Ghumura Odisha ka folk dance hai jo Kalahandi zila mein mard dwara kiya jata hai, jisme ghumura instrument bajaya jata hai.
GALAT ✗ – Andhra Pradesh apne Kuchipudi (classical) aur Dhimsa (folk) ke liye jana jata hai. Ghumura ka yahan se koi aitihasik nata nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Jammu & Kashmir mein Rouf aur Kud jaise dances hote hain jo thande ilakon ki sanskriti darshate hain. Ghumura wahan nahi hota.
GALAT ✗ – Maharashtra Lavani aur Lezim ke liye prasiddh hai. Ghumura Odisha ki vishisht pehchan hai, Maharashtra ki nahi.

dance.q: Chang Lo is a folk dance of _______
dance.solution: Chang Lo dance Nagaland ki 'Chang' tribe dwara kiya jata hai. Ise 'Sua Lua' bhi kehte hain. Ye dance dusmanon par vijay (victory) ka jashn manane ke liye 'Poanglem' festival ke dauran kiya jata hai. Isme performers warrior ki dress pehente hain. **Yaad rakho:** Chang tribe = Chang Lo dance = Nagaland.
why: GALAT ✗ – Arunachal Pradesh mein Bardo Chham aur Lion and Peacock dance famous hain. Chang Lo wahan ki tribes ka dance nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Punjab apne Bhangra aur Gidda ke liye jana jata hai jo dhol ki thaap par hote hain. Is prashn ke liye ye galat hai.
GALAT ✗ – Assam mein Bihu, Bagurumba aur Sattriya (classical) jaise dances hote hain. Chang Lo Nagaland ki sanskriti hai.
SAHI ✓ – Chang Lo Nagaland ki Chang tribe ka victory dance hai jo unki virta aur shakti ko darshata hai.

dance.q: Ghoomar is a folk dance of………
dance.solution: Ghoomar Rajasthan ka rajkiya nritya (State Dance) hai. Iski shuruat 'Bhil' tribe ne ki thi Maa Saraswati ki puja ke liye, lekin baad mein ise Rajput gharano ne apna liya. Isme mahilayein ghunghat odhkar ek bade gheredar 'Ghaghra' mein gol-gol ghoomti hain, jise 'Ghoom' kehte hain. **Yaad rakho:** Ghoomar = Rajasthan ki Shaan + Bhil Tribe origin.
why: GALAT ✗ – Mizoram mein Cheraw (bamboo dance) hota hai, Ghoomar Rajasthan ki registani sanskriti ka hissa hai.
GALAT ✗ – Puducherry mein Garadi dance hota hai. Ghoomar se iska koi lena-dena nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Gujarat mein Garba aur Dandiya hote hain. Ghoomar aur Garba dono circular hain par Ghoomar Rajasthan ka vishisht hai.
SAHI ✓ – Ghoomar Rajasthan ka sabse prasiddh lok nritya hai jo tyoharon aur vivah ke avsar par mahilaon dwara kiya jata hai.

dance.q: Sattriya is a classical dance form of₋₋₋₋₋₋₋₋
dance.solution: Sattriya dance Assam ke 'Sattras' (monasteries) se nikla hai. Ise 15th century me Mahapurush Srimanta Sankardev ne shuru kiya tha, jo Vaishnavism failane ka ek madhyam tha. November 2000 me Sangeet Natak Akademi ne ise 8th Classical Dance ke roop me maanyata di. Yaad rakho: Sankardev aur 'Ankiya Nat' ka sambandh hamesha Sattriya se hota hai.
why: GALAT ✗ – Manipur ka shastriya nritya 'Manipuri' hai, jo Radha-Krishna ki Raasleela par aadharit hai aur isme Pung (drum) ka istemal hota hai. Is prashn ke liye ye sahi nahi hai kyunki Sattriya wahan ka nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Uttar Pradesh ka ekmatra classical dance 'Kathak' hai, jo 'Katha' (kahani) sunane ki parampara se aaya hai. Is prashn ke context me ye galat hai.
SAHI ✓ – Assam ka Sattriya ek dharmik dance form hai jo Srimanta Sankardev dwara develop kiya gaya tha. Ye bilkul sahi uttar hai.
GALAT ✗ – Andhra Pradesh ka classical dance 'Kuchipudi' hai, jo 'Kuchelapuram' gaanv se originate hua tha. Isliye ye yahan fit nahi baithta.

dance.q: 'Sattriya' is a traditional Hindu classical dance form of which state?
dance.solution: Sattriya nritya Assam ke Vaishnavite maths (Sattras) ki den hai. Ye dance 'Borgeet' sangheet par kiya jata hai aur isme Khol (drum) aur Taala (cymbals) ka prayog hota hai. Ye 500 saal purani parampara hai jise modern stage tak Sankardev lekar aaye. Trick: 'Sattra' matlab monastery, jo sirf Assam me payi jati hain.
why: GALAT ✗ – Manipur apne 'Lai Haraoba' festival aur Manipuri dance ke liye famous hai. Sattriya ka yahan se koi direct historical link nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Goa me Fugdi aur Dhalo jaise folk dances hote hain, lekin wahan koi Indian classical dance originate nahi hua hai.
SAHI ✓ – Assam hi wo rajya hai jahan 15th century me Neo-Vaishnavite movement ke dauran Sattriya ki shuruat hui thi.
GALAT ✗ – Odisha ka classical dance 'Odissi' hai jo Mahari aur Gotipua parampara se juda hai. Sattriya se iska lena-dena nahi hai.

dance.q: ___ is a group folk dance of Sikkim performed in honour of Mount Khangchendzonga, the guardian deity of the Sikkimese people.
dance.solution: Chu-Faat Sikkim ki Lepcha tribe ka ek pavitra folk dance hai. Ye dance 'Pang Lhabsol' festival ke dauran kiya jata hai. Isme Mount Khangchendzonga ke 5 shikharo (peaks) ki puja ki jati hai kyunki wo log ise apna rakshak maante hain. Yaad rakho: 'Chu' ka matlab hota hai snowy range aur 'Faat' ka matlab worship.
why: GALAT ✗ – Zo-Mal-Lok Sikkim ki Lepcha community ka hi dance hai jo kheti (agriculture) se juda hai, lekin ye Mount Khangchendzonga ki puja ke liye nahi kiya jata.
GALAT ✗ – Tendong Lo Rum Faat Lepcha logo ka ek festival aur dance hai jo 'Tendong Hill' ki puja ke liye hota hai, na ki Khangchendzonga ke liye.
SAHI ✓ – Chu-Faat hi wo dance hai jo Mount Khangchendzonga ke samman me kiya jata hai, jo Sikkim ka guardian deity hai.
GALAT ✗ – Kinchum-Chu-Bomsa ek traditional practice ya ritual ho sakta hai, par ye Khangchendzonga ke liye mashhoor main folk dance nahi hai.

dance.q: Which tribe of Pakistan performs a traditional dance form called 'Waziri Dance?
dance.solution: Waziri Dance Pakistan ke Waziristan region (Northwest Pakistan) ka ek energetic dance hai. Ye Pashtun (Pathan) tribe dwara kiya jata hai. Isme dancers ek circle me ghumte hain aur taaliyan bajate hue rhythmic movements karte hain. Pashtun log apni virta aur sanskriti ke liye jane jate hain.
why: GALAT ✗ – Sindhi log Sindh province ke hain aur unka famous dance 'Dhamal' ya 'Ho Jamalo' hai. Waziri unka dance nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Baloch tribe Balochistan region ki hai, unka traditional dance 'Dochaap' ya 'Lewa' hota hai. Isliye ye option galat hai.
SAHI ✓ – Pashtun tribe hi Waziristan ilake me rehti hai aur wahi Waziri dance perform karti hai. Ye bilkul sahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Brahuis Balochistan ke Central part me rehte hain, unki bhasha Dravidian family ki hai, par Waziri dance unse sambandhit nahi hai.

dance.q: Viyahula Giddha' is a popular folk dance performed during marriages in the Indian state of ______.
dance.solution: Viyahula Giddha Punjab ki mahilao ka ek vibrant dance hai jo shadiyo (Viyah) ke mauke par hota hai. Giddha me mahilaon dwara 'Boliyaan' (couplets) gayee jati hain aur ek circle me nacha jata hai. Isme Dhol ki thaap par taaliyan bajayi jati hain. Fact: Purusho ke liye Bhangra hota hai, aur mahilao ke liye Giddha.
why: GALAT ✗ – Jharkhand me Chhau, Paika aur Santhali jaise dances hote hain. Viyahula Giddha wahan ki parampara ka hissa nahi hai.
SAHI ✓ – Punjab me hi Giddha aur Viyahula Giddha shadi-byah ke mauke par dhum-dham se kiya jata hai. Ye sahi uttar hai.
GALAT ✗ – Gujarat apne Garba aur Dandiya Raas ke liye jana jata hai, jo Navratri ke waqt hota hai. Giddha wahan ka nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Odisha me Sambalpuri aur Odissi jaise dances hote hain. Giddha Punjabi culture ki pehchan hai, Odisha ki nahi.

dance.q: Which of the following dances is a dance style of Madhya Pardesh?
dance.solution: Maacha Madhya Pradesh ke Malwa region ka ek bohot hi purana folk theatre aur dance form hai. Isme ek 'Manch' (raised stage) banaya jata hai jiske naam par iska naam Maacha pada. Ye dance-drama style me hota hai jisme mythological aur folk stories dikhayi jati hain. Yaad rakho: Maacha = Manch = Madhya Pradesh. Isme 'Dholak' aur 'Harmonium' ka upyog hota hai.
why: SAHI ✓ – Maacha MP ke Malwa region ka aatam-nirbhar lok nritya hai jo ek unche manch par perform kiya jata hai. Isliye ye bilkul sahi uttar hai.
GALAT ✗ – Lezim Maharashtra ka ek energetic folk dance hai jo Gudi Padwa aur Ganesh Chaturthi par kiya jata hai. Ye MP se talluk nahi rakhta.
GALAT ✗ – Cheraw Mizoram ka famous 'Bamboo Dance' hai jisme zameen par bans ki dandi(sticks) ka prayog hota hai. Ye North-East ka dance hai.
GALAT ✗ – Ottam Thullal (Ottam Thedal) Kerala ka ek satirical dance-drama form hai jise Kunchan Nambiar ne shuru kiya tha, na ki MP ka.

dance.q: The ‘Lezim’ dance form is peculiar to which of the following states?
dance.solution: Lezim Maharashtra ka ek aisa dance hai jisme dancers ke hath me ek 'Lezim' naam ka musical instrument hota hai (ek danda jisme cymbals lage hote hain). Ye shakti aur chusti ka prateek mana jata hai aur ise aksar Shivaji Maharaj ki shourya gathaon se joda jata hai. Ye Gudi Padwa aur Ganpati visarjan ke time bohot popular hai. Yaad rakho: Lezim = Maharashtra ki Shaan.
why: GALAT ✗ – Karnataka apne 'Yakshagana' aur 'Dollu Kunitha' ke liye jana jata hai. Lezim wahan ka prachalit nritya nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Gujarat me Garba aur Dandiya Raas ki dhoom rehti hai. Lezim vahan ka mukhya folk dance nahi hai.
SAHI ✓ – Lezim Maharashtra ka hi vishisht (peculiar) lok nritya hai jisme jhunjhuna jaisa vadya yantra bajaya jata hai.
GALAT ✗ – Bihar me Jat-Jatin aur Bideshiya jaise lok nritya hote hain. Lezim ka Bihar ki Sanskriti se sambandh nahi hai.

dance.q: 'Moonwalk', the famous dance move, is associated with whom?
dance.solution: Moonwalk ek aisi technique hai jisme dancer peeche ki taraf slide karta hai par lagta hai ki wo aage chalne ki koshish kar raha hai. Michael Jackson ne ise 1983 me 'Billie Jean' performance ke dauran iconic banaya. Halaki unhone ise invent nahi kiya tha (pehle ise 'backslide' kehte the), par wo iske liye puri duniya me mashhoor hain. Yaad rakho: Pop King = Moonwalk.
why: GALAT ✗ – Adele ek British singer-songwriter hain jo apni powerful voice aur soulful ballads ke liye jani jati hain, moonwalk ke liye nahi.
GALAT ✗ – Misha B (Misha Bryan) ek British rapper aur singer hain. Unka is iconic dance move se koi historical link nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Fred Astaire ek legendry American tap dancer aur actor the. Unhone Michael Jackson ko inspire zaroor kiya, par Moonwalk MJ ka signature move hai.
SAHI ✓ – Michael Jackson hi wo 'King of Pop' hain jinhone Moonwalk ko global phenomenon banaya aur ise perfection tak pahunchaya.

dance.q: Dhap is a folk dance performed by the Kandha tribe of _______.
dance.solution: Dhap dance Odisha ki Kandha tribe dwara kiya jata hai. Is dance ka naam 'Dhap' naam ke ek drum (vadya yantra) se aaya hai jo ek taraf se khula hota hai. Ye nritya mukhya roop se Western Odisha me 'Nuakhai' festival (naye anaaj ka tyohar) ke mauke par hota hai. Yaad rakho: Dhap instrument = Kandha tribe = Odisha.
why: GALAT ✗ – Assam Bihu aur Bagurumba ke liye famous hai. Dhap nritya vahan ki tribes ka mukhya dance nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Goa me Fugdi aur Dhalo jaise dances hote hain. Dhap ka Goa ke tribal culture se lena-dena nahi hai.
SAHI ✓ – Dhap Odisha ke Sambalpuri culture aur Kandha tribe ka ek anmol hissa hai, jo khushi ke mauko par kiya jata hai.
GALAT ✗ – Kerala me Kathakali aur Mohiniyattam jaise shastriya nritya hote hain. Dhap Odisha ka regional folk form hai.

dance.q: 'Ranappa' dance is associated with which state?
dance.solution: Ranappa Odisha ke Ganjam district ka ek bohot hi adventurous folk dance hai. Isme dancers 'stilts' (lambe baans ke dande) par khade hokar dance karte hain. Ye Lord Krishna ki bachpan ki lilaon ko darshane ke liye kiya jata hai. Isme dhol aur mahuri (shehnai jaisa instrument) bajaya jata hai. Yaad rakho: Ranappa = Rann (Battle) style on Stilts in Odisha.
why: SAHI ✓ – Ranappa Odisha ka hi ek lok nritya hai jo apni kathinai (stilt walking) ke liye jana jata hai.
GALAT ✗ – Punjab Bhangra aur Gidda ke liye famous hai. Ranappa ka Punjab ke virasat se koi talluk nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Kerala apne classical dances aur Kalaripayattu (martial art) ke liye jana jata hai, na ki Ranappa ke liye.
GALAT ✗ – Tamil Nadu Bharatnatyam aur Karagattam ka gadh hai. Ranappa wahan perform nahi kiya jata.

dance.q: 'Ottamthullal' dance art is associated with which state?
dance.solution: Ottamthullal Kerala ka ek bahut hi energetic aur satirical dance-drama form hai. Isse 18th century me Kunchan Nambiar ne introduce kiya tha. Isme performer khud hi gaata hai aur act karta hai, jisme social issues par vyang (satire) kiya jata hai. Isse 'Poor Man's Kathakali' bhi kaha jata hai. Yaad rakho: Kunchan Nambiar + Kerala = Ottamthullal.
why: GALAT ✗ – Andhra Pradesh apne Kuchipudi (Classical) aur Lambadi (Folk) dances ke liye jana jata hai. Ottamthullal yahan ka traditional art nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Manipur me Manipuri Raasleela aur Thang-Ta (Martial Art) famous hain. Is prashn ke liye ye sahi nahi hai kyunki Ottamthullal South Indian origin ka hai.
GALAT ✗ – Tamil Nadu Bharatnatyam aur Karakattam ke liye prasiddh hai. Yahan Ottamthullal nahi balki isse milta-julta 'Therukoothu' hota hai.
SAHI ✓ – Kerala ka ye dance form 'Thullal' (jumping) movement par based hai aur Malayalam language me perform kiya jata hai.

dance.q: Dumhal is folk dance of which state
dance.solution: Dumhal Jammu and Kashmir ki 'Wattal' tribe dwara kiya jane wala ek prachin folk dance hai. Ye dance Sufi Saint Baba Naseeb-Ud-Din-Gazi ki yaad me perform kiya jata hai. Isme dancers colorful robes aur conical caps pehente hain. Yaad rakho: Wattal tribe + J&K = Dumhal.
why: SAHI ✓ – Dumhal Jammu and Kashmir ka ek vishesh nritya hai jisme ek lamba dhwaj (banner) zameen me gaad kar uske chaaro taraf dance kiya jata hai.
GALAT ✗ – Kerala Mohiniyattam aur Kathakali ke liye jana jata hai. Yahan ke folk dances me Padayani aur Theyyam aate hain, Dumhal nahi.
GALAT ✗ – Gujarat me Garba aur Dandiya Raas ki dhoom rehti hai. Dumhal North Indian UT ka dance hai, West India ka nahi.
GALAT ✗ – West Bengal me Gambhira, Brita aur Chhau jaise nritya hote hain. Dumhal ka sambandh Bengal ki sanskriti se nahi hai.

dance.q: Birhor dance is a tribal folk dance from_____.
dance.solution: Birhor dance Jharkhand ki 'Birhor' tribe (log jo jungle me rehte hain) dwara kiya jata hai. Ye log Hazaribagh aur Ranchi regions me milte hain. Ye dance aksar shikar (hunting) aur nature ki activities ko darshata hai. Yaad rakho: Bir (Jungle) + Hor (Man) = Jharkhand ki tribe.
why: GALAT ✗ – Himachal Pradesh me Nati aur Dangi jaise dances famous hain jo pahadi culture ko dikhate hain, Birhor wahan ki tribe nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Punjab me Bhangra aur Giddha popular hain jo harvest festivals par kiye jate hain. Birhor ka Punjab se koi lena-dena nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Karnataka me Yakshagana aur Dollu Kunitha jaise art forms hain. Jharkhand ki tribe hone ke karan Birhor yahan ka nahi hai.
SAHI ✓ – Jharkhand ki Birhor tribe apne lifestyle aur festivals ko celebrate karne ke liye ye tribal folk dance karti hai.

dance.q: Hallisaka is basically a group dance of ___.
dance.solution: Hallisaka Gujarat ka ek prachin group dance hai jiska zikr 'Harivamsa Purana' me milta hai. Ye circular pattern me kiya jata hai, jo Lord Krishna ke 'Raas' se milta-julta hai. Isme male aur female dono participate karte hain. Yaad rakho: Harivamsa Purana + Circular Dance = Hallisaka (Gujarat).
why: GALAT ✗ – Rajasthan Ghoomar, Kalbelia aur Kachhi Ghodi ke liye famous hai. Hallisaka ka mool sthan Rajasthan nahi balki Gujarat hai.
GALAT ✗ – Goa me Fugdi aur Dhalo jaise folk dances hote hain jo Konkani culture ka hissa hain. Hallisaka yahan ka traditional dance nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Maharashtra Lavani aur Lezim ke liye jana jata hai. Hallisaka ka sambandh Gujarat ki puranik paramparaon se hai.
SAHI ✓ – Gujarat me Hallisaka ek puranik nritya hai jisme dancers ek ghere (circle) me rhythmic movements karte hain.

dance.q: Which of the following is a dance form of Meghalaya?
dance.solution: Laho dance Meghalaya ki 'Pnar' (Jaintia) tribe ka ek bahut hi sundar dance hai. Isse 'Behdienkhlam' festival ke dauran kiya jata hai. Isme ladke aur ladkiyaan ek saath haath pakad kar rhythm me dance karte hain. Yaad rakho: Laho = Meghalaya ki Jaintia Hills.
why: SAHI ✓ – Laho Meghalaya ka folk dance hai, ise 'Chipiah' dance bhi kaha jata hai aur ye community bonding ko darshata hai.
GALAT ✗ – Cheraw Mizoram ka sabse purana aur famous 'Bamboo Dance' hai. Is prashn ke liye ye galat hai kyunki ye Mizoram ka hai, Meghalaya ka nahi.
GALAT ✗ – Dalkhai Odisha ka ek popular folk dance hai jo zyada tar Dussehra ke mauke par kiya jata hai. Ye Meghalaya se sambandhit nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Rangma Nagaland ki 'Naga' tribes ka ek martial-style folk dance hai. Iska Meghalaya ke Laho nritya se koi sambandh nahi hai.

dance.q: Which of the following dance is a folk dance of Goa?
dance.solution: Fugdi Goa ka ek bohot hi iconic folk dance hai jo mahilayon dwara Konkan region mein kiya jata hai. Ye dance bina kisi musical instrument (vadya yantra) ke hota hai; isme mahilaayein apni saans aur taliyon (claps) se ek 'Foo' jaisi sound nikalti hain, isiliye ise Fugdi kehte hain. Ye aksar Ganesh Chaturthi aur Vrata ke mauke par kiya jata hai. Yaad rakho: Fugdi = 'Foo' sound + Goa.
why: GALAT ✗ – Fagua Bihar aur Jharkhand ka ek popular holi folk dance hai jo aksar 'Phagun' mahine mein mard aur aurat dono milkar karte hain. Is prashn ke liye ye sahi nahi hai kyunki iska sambandh Goa se nahi hai.
SAHI ✓ – Fugdi Goa ka traditional folk dance hai jo mahilayein group mein karti hain. Isme Dhangar community ki Fugdi kaafi famous hai jo shepherd community se aati hai.
GALAT ✗ – Bihu Assam ka sabse mahatvapurn lok nritya aur tyohar hai jo saal mein teen baar (Rongali, Kongali, Bhogali) manaya jata hai. Iska Goa se koi lena-dena nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Maach ya Manch Madhya Pradesh ka ek folk theatre (natya) form hai jo Malwa region mein kaafi popular hai. Ye Goa ka nritya nahi hai.

dance.q: The famous dancer Chemancheri Kunhiraman Nair is associated with which of the following dance forms?
dance.solution: Guru Chemancheri Kunhiraman Nair Kathakali ke ek mahan kalakar the jinhone 100 saal se zyada umar tak is kala ko zinda rakha. Unhe 2017 mein Padma Shri se nawaza gaya tha. Kathakali Kerala ka classical dance hai jo apne bhaari makeup aur 'Mudras' ke liye jana jata hai. Yaad rakho: Nair surname aksar Kerala/Kathakali se juda hota hai.
why: SAHI ✓ – Chemancheri Kunhiraman Nair Kathakali ke ek stalward the. Unhone Kerala mein 'Bharatiya Natya Kalalayam' ki sthapna ki thi.
GALAT ✗ – Manipuri Manipur ka shastriya nritya hai jo Radha-Krishna ki 'Raasleela' par aadharit hai. Isse jude mukhya kalakar Jhaveri behnein hain, Nair ji nahi.
GALAT ✗ – Odissi Odisha ka shastriya nritya hai jo mandiron mein 'Mahari' parampara se shuru hua tha. Iske pramukh guru Kelucharan Mohapatra hain.
GALAT ✗ – Sattriya Assam ka shastriya nritya hai jise Mahapurush Srimanta Sankardev ne shuru kiya tha. Ye Vaishnavism se juda hai, Nair ji se nahi.

dance.q: In which of the following state ''Hampi Dance Festival'' is celebrated?
dance.solution: Guru Chemancheri Kunhiraman Nair Kathakali ke ek mahan kalakar the jinhone 100 saal se zyada umar tak is kala ko zinda rakha. Unhe 2017 mein Padma Shri se nawaza gaya tha. Kathakali Kerala ka classical dance hai jo apne bhaari makeup aur 'Mudras' ke liye jana jata hai. Yaad rakho: Nair surname aksar Kerala/Kathakali se juda hota hai.
why: SAHI ✓ – Chemancheri Kunhiraman Nair Kathakali ke ek stalward the. Unhone Kerala mein 'Bharatiya Natya Kalalayam' ki sthapna ki thi.
GALAT ✗ – Manipuri Manipur ka shastriya nritya hai jo Radha-Krishna ki 'Raasleela' par aadharit hai. Isse jude mukhya kalakar Jhaveri behnein hain, Nair ji nahi.
GALAT ✗ – Odissi Odisha ka shastriya nritya hai jo mandiron mein 'Mahari' parampara se shuru hua tha. Iske pramukh guru Kelucharan Mohapatra hain.
GALAT ✗ – Sattriya Assam ka shastriya nritya hai jise Mahapurush Srimanta Sankardev ne shuru kiya tha. Ye Vaishnavism se juda hai, Nair ji se nahi.

dance.q: In which state has the Jawara Dance, a dance form to celebrate wealth, originated?
dance.solution: Jawara dance Madhya Pradesh ke Bundelkhand kshetra ka ek prasiddh 'Harvest Dance' hai. Jab kisan ki fasal (crop) achhi hoti hai, tab khushi manane ke liye ye dance kiya jata hai. Isme mahilayein apne sir par 'Jawara' (jaw) se bhari tokri rakhkar santulan banate hue naachti hain. Yaad rakho: Jawara = Jaw (Barley) + MP Bundelkhand.
why: SAHI ✓ – Jawara Madhya Pradesh ke kisanon dwara samriddhi (wealth) aur achhi fasal ke jashn ke roop mein kiya jane wala mukhya nritya hai.
GALAT ✗ – Rajasthan mein Ghoomar, Kalbelia aur Bhavai jaise nritya hote hain. Jawara vahan ka mukhya harvest dance nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Kerala ke mukhya nritya Kathakali aur Mohiniyattam hain jo shastriya hain, aur harvest ke liye Onam/Thiruvathira popular hai, Jawara nahi.
GALAT ✗ – Gujarat mein Garba aur Dandiya Raas harvest aur navratri ke time popular hain. Jawara ka sambandh yahan se nahi hai.

dance.q: Which of the following is NOT a folk dance belonging to the union territory of Jammu and Kashmir?
dance.solution: Dangi dance Himachal Pradesh ke Chamba district ka folk dance hai, jo mukhya roop se Gaddi tribe ki mahilayon dwara kiya jata hai. J&K ke mukhya dances mein Rouf (Sabse famous), Hafiza, aur Dhumal (Wattal tribe dwara) aate hain. Yaad rakho: Dangi Himachal se hai, jabki baki teeno J&K ke hain.
why: GALAT ✗ – Hafiza J&K ka ek traditional dance hai jo aksar shadiyon mein Sufiana Kalam par kiya jata hai. Ye J&K ka hi hai, isliye answer nahi ho sakta.
GALAT ✗ – Rouf Jammu aur Kashmir ka sabse lokpriya folk dance hai jo Eid aur Spring season mein mahilayon dwara kiya jata hai. Ye J&K ka hi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Dhumal J&K ki Wattal tribe ke mard karte hain, isme ek lamba jhanda gaad kar uske charo taraf naacha jata hai. Ye bhi J&K ka hai.
SAHI ✓ – Dangi Himachal Pradesh ka dance hai. Prashn mein pucha gaya hai kaunsa J&K ka NAHI hai, isliye ye sahi uttar hai.

dance.q: Which of the following pairs are correctly matches?
dance.solution: Bharat mein Sangeet Natak Akademi dwara 8 classical dances ko maanyata di gayi hai. Bharatanatyam Tamil Nadu ka sabse purana dance form hai jo 'Sadir Attam' se nikla hai. Kathak North India (UP) ka hai, Kuchipudi Andhra Pradesh ka hai, aur Kathakali Kerala ka hai. Yaad rakho: 'Bharat' ko 'Tamil' pasand hai aur 'Katha' hamesha 'Uttar' (North) se shuru hoti hai.
why: GALAT ✗ – Kathak Uttar Pradesh (North India) ka classical dance hai jo 'Kathakars' (storytellers) dwara kiya jata hai. Is prashn mein iske saath Kerala likha hai jo galat match hai.
GALAT ✗ – Kuchipudi Andhra Pradesh ka dance hai jismein 'Kuchelapuram' gaanv ka zikr aata hai, jabki Odisha ka classical dance 'Odissi' hai. Isliye ye pairing galat hai.
SAHI ✓ – Bharatanatyam Tamil Nadu ka hi classical dance hai. Ye mandiron mein Devdasis dwara kiya jata tha aur ise 'Fire Dance' bhi kaha jata hai.
GALAT ✗ – Kathakali Kerala ka mukhya classical dance hai jismein bhaari makeup aur masks ka prayog hota hai, jabki Uttar Pradesh Kathak ke liye prasiddh hai.

dance.q: Which of the following is NOT a classical dance style?
dance.solution: Kalbelia Rajasthan ki ek nomadic tribe dwara kiya jaane wala 'Folk Dance' (lok nritya) hai, ise 'Snake Charmer Dance' bhi kehte hain kyunki iski movements saanp jaisi hoti hain. Ise 2010 mein UNESCO ki Representative List of Intangible Cultural Heritage mein shaamil kiya gaya tha. Classical dances ki sankhya 8 hai aur Kalbelia unmein nahi aata. Yaad rakho: Kalbelia = Rajasthan ka Kaala Naag (Folk).
why: GALAT ✗ – Kathak ek shastriya nritya (classical dance) hai jo Lucknow, Jaipur aur Banaras gharane ke liye jaana jata hai. Isliye ye 'Not a classical dance' ki category mein nahi aayega.
GALAT ✗ – Kathakali Kerala ka classical dance drama hai jo apne 'Navarasa' (9 expressions) ke liye jana jata hai. Ye ek shastriya nritya hai.
SAHI ✓ – Kalbelia ek Folk Dance (Lok nritya) hai, na ki Classical. Ye Rajasthan ki Kalbelia community dwara kiya jata hai jismein 'Been' ka prayog hota hai.
GALAT ✗ – Odissi Odisha ka classical dance hai jiska zikr 'Natya Shastra' aur 'Abhinaya Darpana' mein milta hai. Ye shastriya nritya ki category mein aata hai.

dance.q: To which of the following states does the dance drama 'Khayal' belong?
dance.solution: Khayal Rajasthan ka ek paramparik folk theatre (dance-drama) hai jo 18th century mein lokpriya hua. Ismein mythological aur historical kahaniyon ko naatak ke roop mein dikhaya jata hai. Iske alag-alag roop hain jaise Kuchamani Khayal, Shekhawati Khayal, aur Nautanki Khayal. Yaad rakho: Rajasthan ke log 'Khayal' rakhne mein acche hain.
why: SAHI ✓ – Khayal Rajasthan ka hi dance drama hai. Ismein 'Nagada' aur 'Dholak' jaise vadya yantron ka upyog hota hai aur mukhya kalakaar ko 'Khayali' kehte hain.
GALAT ✗ – Gujarat apne 'Bhavai' folk theatre aur Garba/Dandiya ke liye jaana jata hai. Khayal yahan ka mukhya dance drama nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Madhya Pradesh mein 'Maach' naam ka folk theatre prasiddh hai. Khayal ka mukhya kendra Rajasthan hai.
GALAT ✗ – Punjab apne 'Bhangra' aur 'Giddha' ke liye jana jata hai. Khayal Rajasthan ki sanskriti ka hissa hai, Punjab ka nahi.

dance.q: In which of the following is reference of Indian Dance forms found?
dance.solution: Natya Shastra ko 'Pancham Veda' (5th Veda) kaha jata hai, jise Bharat Muni ne likha tha. Ismein dance, music aur drama ke saare niyam diye gaye hain. Ye 200 BC se 200 AD ke beech likha gaya tha. Ismein 36 chapters hain jo Indian classical art ki buniyaad hain. Yaad rakho: Dance aur Drama ka 'Sanyas' (base) Natya Shastra hai.
why: GALAT ✗ – Abhang Vitthal (Lord Vishnu) ki bhakti mein gaaye jaane waale Marathi devotional songs hain jo Sant Tukaram aur Namdev ne lokpriya kiye. Inka dance forms se direct lena-dena nahi hai.
SAHI ✓ – Natya Shastra hi wo mukhya granth hai jismein Indian classical dance (Tandava aur Lasya) ki poori jaankari aur mudraon ka varnan milta hai.
GALAT ✗ – Kama Sutra Vatsyayana dwara likhi gayi ek ancient Indian text hai jo manviya sambandhon aur lifestyle par aadharit hai, na ki dance forms ke niyam par.
GALAT ✗ – Brahma Sutra Badarayana dwara likhi gayi Vedanta darshan (philosophy) ki kitab hai jo Upanishads ki vyakhya karti hai. Iska nritya kala se sambandh nahi hai.

festivals.q: Ka Shad Mastieh or victory dance of _____ tribe of Meghalaya is an ancient war dance performed during the major festival of the tribe.
festivals.solution: Ka Shad Mastieh Meghalaya ki Khasi tribe ka ek shandaar war dance hai jo jeet (victory) ko darshata hai. Isme mard (men) swords aur shields lekar dance karte hain. Ye dance 'Nongkrem' festival ke dauran bhi dekha jata hai. Khasi tribe matrilineal society follow karti hai, lekin ye dance unke warriors ki bravery ko honor karne ke liye hota hai. Yaad rakho: 'Mastieh' = 'Must' (Zaroori) for Khasi warriors.
why: SAHI ✓ – Khasi tribe Meghalaya ki sabse badi tribes me se ek hai. Ka Shad Mastieh inka ek traditional male-only war dance hai jo unke ancestors aur bravery ko dedicate kiya jata hai.
GALAT ✗ – Jaintia tribe Meghalaya ki hai, lekin unka sabse mashhoor festival 'Behdienkhlam' hai aur dance 'Laho' hai. Isliye ye Ka Shad Mastieh se sambandhit nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Var (War-Jaintia) Meghalaya ki ek sub-tribe hai jo southern slopes par rehti hai. Inka apna alag culture hai par Ka Shad Mastieh mukhya roop se Khasi identity ka hissa hai.
GALAT ✗ – 'Bhai' naam ki koi pramukh tribe Meghalaya ke tribal structure ya ancient dances me nahi aati hai, ye option context se bahar hai.

festivals.q: Buddha Purnima is celebrated on the full moon day in the hindu month of .
festivals.solution: Buddha Purnima, jise Vesak bhi kehte hain, Gautam Buddha ke janm, gyan (enlightenment) aur Mahaparinirvana (death) teeno ko mark karta hai. Ye Baisakh (April-May) ki purnima ko manaya jata hai. Sarnath aur Bodh Gaya me is din bahut badi prarthana hoti hai. Yaad rakho: Buddha = B se Baisakh.
why: SAHI ✓ – Baisakh month ki Purnima ko hi Buddha Purnima manate hain kyunki isi din Buddha ne Bihar ke Bodh Gaya me peepal ke ped ke neeche gyan prapt kiya tha.
GALAT ✗ – Jyeshta month (May-June) me Ganga Dussehra aur Vat Savitri jaise vrat aate hain. Buddha Purnima isse pehle wale mahine Baisakh me hi nipat jati hai.
GALAT ✗ – Bhadra (August-September) me Krishna Janmashtami aur Ganesh Chaturthi jaise bade tyohar aate hain. Ye monsoon ke end ka samay hota hai.
GALAT ✗ – Asadh (June-July) me mukhya roop se Puri ki Rath Yatra nikali jati hai aur Guru Purnima manayi jati hai, na ki Buddha Purnima.

festivals.q: According to the sikh literature, the birth anniversary of Guru Nanak dev is celebrated on the full moon day of Lunar month of _____.
festivals.solution: Guru Nanak Dev Ji (Sikhism ke pehle Guru) ka Prakash Parv Kartik Purnima ko manaya jata hai. Inka janm 1469 me Nankana Sahib (ab Pakistan) me hua tha. Is din ko 'Gurpurab' kehte hain aur Gurudwaron me Akhand Path aur Langar hota hai. Yaad rakho: Kartik ki thand me Nanak ka Prakash faila.
why: SAHI ✓ – Kartik Purnima hi wo din hai jab poori duniya ke Sikhs Guru Nanak Dev Ji ka janamdin manate hain. Ye aksar November ke mahine me padta hai.
GALAT ✗ – Magh mahine (January-February) me Maghi Mela (Muktsar) manaya jata hai jo Chali Mukte (40 martyrs) ki yaad me hota hai, Guru Nanak Dev ji ke janm ke liye nahi.
GALAT ✗ – Ashadh (June-July) me Guru Arjan Dev Ji ki shaheedi ka din yaad kiya jata hai. Ye garmi ka mausam hota hai, Kartik ki thand wala nahi.
GALAT ✗ – Paush (December-January) me Guru Gobind Singh Ji ka Prakash Parv aksar manaya jata hai, isliye ye Guru Nanak Dev ji se mel nahi khata.

festivals.exam: (SSC 10+2 CHSL 25.01.17, 10 am) SSC CHSL 21/10/2020 (Shift-III) SSC GD 14/12/2021 (Shift-II) SSC MTS/Havaldar–08/09/2023 (Shift-II)
festivals.q: 'Chapchar kut' is a festival of _____ state. It is celebrated during march after the completion of the most difficult task of Jhum Operation i.e. forest clearing (clearing the burning residues).
festivals.solution: Chapchar Kut Mizoram ka sabse purana aur sabse bada festival hai. Jab kheti ke liye 'Jhum' (slash and burn) vidhi me jungle kaat diye jate hain aur unhe jalane ka intezar hota hai, tab ye khushi manayi jati hai. Isme 'Cheraw' (Bamboo Dance) sabse bada attraction hota hai. Yaad rakho: 'Chap' means cut fruits/trees, 'Char' means drying.
why: SAHI ✓ – Mizoram me 'Kut' ka matlab festival hota hai. Chapchar Kut march me jungle saaf karne ke baad manaya jane wala sabse colorful Mizoram festival hai.
GALAT ✗ – Chhattisgarh me Hareli aur Bastar Dussehra jaise festivals famous hain. 'Kut' shabd Mizoram ke Mizo logon ki pehchan hai.
GALAT ✗ – Nagaland ka sabse bada festival 'Hornbill' hai jo December me hota hai. Chapchar Kut wahan ka culture nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Jharkhand me Sarhul aur Karam jaise tribal festivals manaye jate hain jo pedon aur prakriti ki puja se jude hain, par ye Chapchar Kut se alag hain.

festivals.exam: SSC CPO-SI 23/11/2020 (Shift-II) | SSC MTS/Havaldar–06/09/2023 (Shift-I) SSC CHSL (Tier-1) – 11/08/2023 (Shift-III)
festivals.q: is one of the most important festivals of kamakhya temple in Guwahati. It is held every year during the monsoon season (mid- june), when the temple is closed for three days for tantric rituals.
festivals.solution: Ambubachi Mela Assam ke Guwahati me Kamakhya Devi mandir me lagta hai. Isse 'East ka Mahakumbh' bhi kehte hain. Ye Maa Kamakhya ke annual menstruation cycle ko mark karta hai. Is dauran Brahmaputra nadi ka pani laal ho jata hai aur mandir 3 din band rehta hai. Yaad rakho: Kamakhya = Ambubachi.
why: SAHI ✓ – Ambubachi Mela hi wo tantric festival hai jo June me Kamakhya mandir me hota hai. Ye devi ki shakti aur fertility ka prateek hai.
GALAT ✗ – Baishagu festival Assam ki 'Bodo' tribe dwara New Year ke roop me manaya jata hai, ye Kamakhya mandir ke tantric mela se sambandhit nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Me-Dam-Me-Phi Assam ki 'Ahoms' community ka festival hai jisme wo apne ancestors (purvajon) ki puja karte hain.
GALAT ✗ – Bihu Assam ka state festival hai jo saal me 3 baar hota hai (Rongali, Kongali, Bhogali), lekin ye kisi mandir vishesh ya tantric ritual ka naam nahi hai.

festivals.q: ''Kharchi Pooja'' of Tripura is a Hindu festival in which _____ hindu gods including the earth are worshipped.
festivals.solution: Kharchi Puja Tripura ka sabse popular festival hai jo July ke mahine mein 7 dino tak chalta hai. Isme 14 deities (devi-devtao) ki puja hoti hai jinhe 'Chaturdasha Devta' kaha jata hai. Ye puja Agartala ke Puran Agartala area mein sthit temple mein hoti hai. Isme 'Chantai' (royal priest) ka role bahut important hota hai. 'Kharchi' shabd ka arth hai paapo ki safai (cleaning of sins). Yaad rakho: Tripura = 14 Gods (Kharchi).
why: SAHI ✓ – Kharchi Puja mein kul 14 devi-devtao ki puja ki jati hai, jo Tripura ke rajvansh ke kul-devta mane jate hain. Isme 'Saidra' nadi mein snaan ka mahatva hai.
GALAT ✗ – 12 ka ank Jyotirlinga ya Rashi ke liye mahatvapurna hai. Kharchi Puja mein 14 murtiyo ki puja hoti hai, isliye ye option galat hai.
GALAT ✗ – 8 ka ank Ashtalakshmi ya Ashtavinayak se juda ho sakta hai. Tripura ke is vishesh tyohar mein 14 bhagwano ka vidhan hai.
GALAT ✗ – 5 ka ank Panch-devta ke liye hota hai. Kharchi festival ke context mein 14 devi-devta hi sahi sankhya hai.

festivals.q: Who is known as a majestic Indian classical dancer to perform 'Maghi' dance in India at Salzburg Festival of year 2015?
festivals.solution: Salzburg Festival, Austria mein hone wala ek world-famous opera aur drama festival hai. 2015 mein Alarmel Valli ne yahan perform karke itihaas racha kyunki wo wahan perform karne wali pehli Indian Classical dancer bani. Unhone Bharatanatyam ki 'Pandanallur' style ko global stage par showcase kiya. Salzburg Festival summer mein 5 hafton tak chalta hai. Yaad rakho: Alarmel Valli = Bharatanatyam Queen at Salzburg.
why: GALAT ✗ – Kumari Kamala ek veteran Bharatanatyam dancer aur actress hain jo 'Vazhuvoor' style ke liye jani jati hain, lekin 2015 Salzburg performance unka nahi tha.
GALAT ✗ – V. Satyanarayana Sarma Kuchipudi ke mahan kalakar hain jo female roles (Stri-vesham) ke liye famous hain. Wo is event se nahi jude the.
GALAT ✗ – T. Balasaraswati ko 'Queen of Bharatanatyam' kaha jata hai, unhone is dance ko global pehchan di par unka nidhan 1984 mein hi ho gaya tha.
SAHI ✓ – Alarmel Valli ne 2015 mein Salzburg Festival mein perform kiya tha. Ye Bharatanatyam ki Pandanallur school ki exponent hain aur Padma Bhushan se sammanit hain.

festivals.q: Which festival marks the victory of Goddess Durga over the demon king Mahishasura?
festivals.solution: Navratri ka tyohar 'Shakti' ki upasna ka parv hai. Ye 9 dino tak chalta hai jisme Maa Durga ke 9 roopo ki puja hoti hai. Ye Mahishasura-Mardini (Durga) ki rakshas Mahishasur par vijay ka prateek hai. West Bengal mein ise Durga Puja ke roop mein bade star par manaya jata hai. Chaitra aur Sharadiya Navratri do mukhya samay hain. Yaad rakho: Nav (9) + Ratri (Nights) = Victory over Mahishasura.
why: GALAT ✗ – Janmashtami Bhagwan Krishna ke janmotsav ke roop mein manaya jata hai, iska sambandh Mahishasur vadh se nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Holi rango ka tyohar hai jo Prahlad ki raksha aur Holika dahan ki katha se juda hai, na ki Durga-Mahishasur yuddh se.
SAHI ✓ – Navratri hi wo festival hai jo Maa Durga dwara Mahishasur ke ant aur burai par achai ki jeet ko celebrate karta hai.
GALAT ✗ – Diwali Bhagwan Ram ke Ayodhya lautne aur Laxmi puja ka tyohar hai, ise Deepawali (deepo ki katar) bhi kehte hain.

festivals.q: The four-day harvest festival Pongal is usually celebrated in ______.
festivals.solution: Pongal ek harvest (fasal) festival hai jo Tamil Nadu mein sankranti ke samay manaya jata hai. Ye 4 dino ka hota hai: 1. Bhogi Pongal (Indra Dev), 2. Surya Pongal (Sun God), 3. Mattu Pongal (Cattle/Cow), 4. Kaanum Pongal (Social meet). Isme chawal aur doodh ko ubal kar 'Pongal' dish banayi jati hai. Yaad rakho: Pongal = Tamil Nadu (South India) Harvest.
why: SAHI ✓ – Pongal mukhya roop se South India (visheshkar Tamil Nadu) ka tyohar hai. Ye surya ke Uttarayan hone ki khushi mein manaya jata hai.
GALAT ✗ – Eastern India (Bihar/Bengal) mein is samay Makar Sankranti ya Poush Sankranti manayi jati hai, Pongal nahi.
GALAT ✗ – North India mein is samay Lohri (Punjab) ya Maghi manayi jati hai. Pongal ka naam yahan prachalit nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – North Eastern India (Assam) mein is samay 'Bhogali Bihu' manaya jata hai, jo ki wahan ka harvest festival hai.

festivals.q: Gangaur is an Indian festival mainly celebrated in _____.
festivals.solution: Gangaur Rajasthan ka sabse rang-biranga aur mahatvapurna tyohar hai. 'Gan' ka matlab Shiv aur 'Gaur' ka matlab Gauri (Parvati) hota hai. Ye festival Chaitra mahine mein manaya jata hai jahan kuwari kanyaein aur suhagan mahilaein mitti ke iswar-gora ki puja karti hain. Isme 'Ghoomar' dance bhi kiya jata hai. Yaad rakho: Gan (Shiv) + Gaur (Parvati) = Rajasthan ka Pride.
why: SAHI ✓ – Gangaur Rajasthan ka hi pradhan tyohar hai, jisme Shiv-Parvati ke vaivahik prem ki puja ki jati hai. Jaipur ki Gangaur sawari world famous hai.
GALAT ✗ – Himachal Pradesh mein Kullu Dussehra aur Minjar Mela jaise tyohar mukhya hain, Gangaur wahan ka primary festival nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Tripura mein Kharchi aur Garia Puja mukhya hain. Gangaur ka Rajasthan se gehra aitihasik nata hai.
GALAT ✗ – Arunachal Pradesh mein Solung, Losar aur Mopin jaise tribal festivals manaye jate hain, Gangaur nahi.

festivals.q: 'Maghi' is another name for which of the following festivals of India?
festivals.solution: Maghi festival Punjab aur Himachal Pradesh mein Makar Sankranti ke agle din manaya jata hai. Ye 40 'Mukte' (Sikh warriors) ki shahadat ki yaad mein 'Muktsar Sahib' mein ek bade mele ke roop mein manaya jata hai. Suraj ke Uttarayan hone ki khushi mein ise alag-alag states mein alag naam se jaante hain. Yaad rakho: Magh mahine ki shuruat hi Maghi se hoti hai.
why: SAHI ✓ – Makar Sankranti ko hi Punjab aur Haryana region mein 'Maghi' kaha jata hai. Ye winter solstice ke khatam hone aur harvest season ki shuruat ka prateek hai.
GALAT ✗ – Bihu Assam ka harvest festival hai jo saal mein teen baar (Rongali, Kongali, Bhogali) aata hai. Is prashn ke liye ye nahi, kyunki Maghi ka relation Punjab-North India se hai.
GALAT ✗ – Baisakhi Punjab ka New Year aur harvest festival hai jo 13 ya 14 April ko manaya jata hai. Is prashn ke liye ye nahi, kyunki ye Vaisakh mahine mein padta hai, Magh mein nahi.

GALAT ✗ – Basant Panchami Maa Saraswati ki puja ka din hai aur spring season ka aagman hai. Is prashn ke liye ye nahi, kyunki ye Magh mahine ke shukla paksha ki panchami ko hota hai, Sankranti ko nahi.

festivals.q: Which of the following is an agricultural festival of Arunachal Pradesh celebrated by the Galo tribe?
festivals.solution: Mopin festival Arunachal Pradesh ki 'Galo Tribe' ka sabse mukhya tyohar hai. Isme log apne chehre par 'Ette' (safed chawal ka powder) lagate hain aur 'Popir' dance karte hain. Ye festival buri shaktiyon ko bhagane aur acchi fasal ki dua ke liye manaya jata hai. SSC ka fav: Mopin = Galo Tribe + White Powder.
why: GALAT ✗ – Losar ek Tibetan New Year festival hai jo Arunachal ki Monpa aur Sherdukpen tribes manati hain. Is prashn ke liye ye nahi, kyunki ye Galo tribe ka agricultural festival nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Ugadi Andhra Pradesh, Telangana aur Karnataka ka New Year festival hai. Is prashn ke liye ye nahi, kyunki ye South India se belong karta hai, Arunachal se nahi.
GALAT ✗ – Karma ya Karam festival Jharkhand, Chhattisgarh aur Odisha ki tribes dwara 'Karam Devta' ki puja ke liye hota hai. Is prashn ke liye ye nahi, kyunki ye Central/East India ka tyohar hai.
SAHI ✓ – Mopin Arunachal ki Galo tribe ka agricultural fest hai. Isme Goddess Mopin Ane ki puja hoti hai taaki dhanya-dhanya bana rahe.

festivals.q: Fazilka Heritage festival, an annual festival of art, culture and food is celebrated in which of the following states?
festivals.solution: Fazilka Heritage Festival Punjab ke Fazilka district mein manaya jata hai, jise 'California of Punjab' bhi kehte hain (kinnow production ke liye). Ye festival Malwa region ki virasat, Punjabi folk dance (Giddha, Bhangra) aur handicraft ko promote karta hai. Yaad rakho: Fazilka border district hai Punjab ka.
why: SAHI ✓ – Fazilka Punjab ka ek zila hai. Ye festival wahan ki local culture, food aur heritage ko showcase karne ke liye har saal manaya jata hai.
GALAT ✗ – Uttar Pradesh apne Kumbh Mela, Taj Mahotsav aur Lathmar Holi ke liye jana jata hai. Is prashn ke liye ye nahi, kyunki Fazilka UP ka hissa nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Haryana mein Surajkund International Crafts Mela aur Pinjore Heritage Festival mashhoor hain. Is prashn ke liye ye nahi, kyunki Fazilka Haryana mein nahi aata.
GALAT ✗ – Maharashtra mein Ganesh Chaturthi aur Gudi Padwa mukhya hain. Is prashn ke liye ye nahi, kyunki ye Western India ka state hai aur Fazilka North India mein hai.

festivals.q: Which of the following religious festivals is known as pirla Panduga in Telangana?
festivals.solution: Telangana mein Muharram ko 'Pirla Panduga' kehte hain, jahan 'Piri' (ek prateek) ko juloos mein nikala jata hai. Ye festival Hindu-Muslim unity ka misaal hai kyunki kai gaon mein ise Hindus bhi utni hi shraddha se manate hain. Isme 'Alam' (standards) ko Sufi shrines (Ashurkhana) mein rakha jata hai.
why: GALAT ✗ – Navroz Parsi community ka New Year festival hai. Is prashn ke liye ye nahi, kyunki iska Telangana ke Pirla Panduga se koi lena-dena nahi hai.
SAHI ✓ – Muharram ko hi Telangana mein local language mein Pirla Panduga kaha jata hai, jahan Pirs ki shahadat ko yaad kiya jata hai.
GALAT ✗ – Christmas 25 December ko Jesus Christ ke janam ki khushi mein manaya jata hai. Is prashn ke liye ye nahi, kyunki ye ek Christian festival hai.
GALAT ✗ – Eid-Ul-Fitr Ramadan ke mahine ke baad manaya jane wala khushi ka tyohar hai. Is prashn ke liye ye nahi, kyunki Telangana mein Pirla Panduga Muharram ko kehte hain, Eid ko nahi.

festivals.q: On which day of the Hindu calendar is the festival of Holi celebrated?
festivals.solution: Holi, jise 'Festival of Colours' kehte hain, Hindu calendar ke aakhri mahine 'Phalgun' ki Purnima (Full Moon) ko manayi jati hai. Iske agle din Chaitra mahine ki shuruat hoti hai. Holi ka tyohar burayi par acchayi ki jeet (Prahlad aur Holika ki kahani) ka prateek hai. Yaad rakho: Purnima = Full Moon aur Holi hamesha chandni raat mein hoti hai.
why: GALAT ✗ – Phalgun Amavasya ko Mahashivratri ke aas-paas ka samay hota hai (jo 13th/14th night ko hoti hai). Is prashn ke liye ye nahi, kyunki Holi hamesha Purnima ko hoti hai.
GALAT ✗ – Chaitra Saptami Chaitra mahine ke 7th day ko kehte hain. Is prashn ke liye ye nahi, kyunki Holi Phalgun mein hi khatam ho jati hai.
GALAT ✗ – Chaitra Purnima ko Hanuman Jayanti manayi jati hai. Is prashn ke liye ye nahi, kyunki ye Holi ke lagbhag ek mahine baad aati hai.
SAHI ✓ – Phalgun Purnima hi wo din hai jab Holika Dahan hota hai aur rangon wali Holi manayi jati hai. Ye Hindu calendar ka aakhri din hota hai.

festivals.q: Special traditional bath named ''Shahi Snan'' is a major event of which of the following festival?
festivals.solution: Kumbh Mela duniya ka sabse bada religious gathering hai jo Prayagraj (Ganga-Yamuna-Saraswati sangam), Haridwar (Ganga), Ujjain (Shipra), aur Nashik (Godavari) mein har 12 saal mein lagta hai. Isme 'Shahi Snan' ya 'Rajyogi Snan' ka bahut mahatva hai, jisme sabse pehle Akhado ke Sadhu-Sant pavitra nadi mein dubki lagate hain. Yaad rakho: UNESCO ne ise 'Intangible Cultural Heritage' ki list mein shamil kiya hai.
why: GALAT ✗ – Teej Rajasthan aur North India ka festival hai jo Maa Parvati aur Shiv ji ke milan ki yaad mein manaya jata hai, isme 'Shahi Snan' nahi, balki 'Jhula' aur 'Mehendi' ka mahatva hai. Is prashn ke liye ye sahi nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Holi 'Colors ka tyohar' hai jo Prahlad ki burai par acchai ki jeet ke liye manaya jata hai, isme rangon aur gulal se khela jata hai na ki shahi snan se. Is prashn ke liye ye galat hai.
GALAT ✗ – Diwali 'Lights ka tyohar' hai jo Bhagwan Ram ke Ayodhya lautne ki khushi mein manaya jata hai, isme deepak jalaye jate hain aur Laxmi puja hoti hai. Is prashn ke liye ye mel nahi khata.
SAHI ✓ – Kumbh Mela mein hi Shahi Snan hota hai jisme sadhu-sant nirdharit shubh muhurat par pavitra nadiyon mein snan karte hain, jise 'Amrit' prapti ka zariya mana jata hai.

festivals.q: Raja Parba also known as Mithun Sankranti, is a ____ day long festival of women celebrated in orissa, India.
festivals.solution: Raja Parba Odisha ka ek unique festival hai jo 3 din tak chalta hai (Pahili Raja, Mithuna Sankranti, aur Bhu Daha). Ye festival 'Mother Earth' (Bhumi Devi) ke menstruation period ko celebrate karta hai, jisme dharti ko aaram diya jata hai aur koi agricultural kaam nahi hota. Yaad rakho: Isme ladkiyan 'Doli' (swings) par jhulti hain aur 'Poda Pitha' khaya jata hai.
why: GALAT ✗ – Five days ka festival jaise Diwali ya Durga Puja ke kuch parts hote hain, lekin Raja Parba ki dharmik manyata sirf 3 dinon ki cycle par based hai. Is prashn ke liye ye option galat hai.
GALAT ✗ – Six days ka koi major Odiya festival Raja Parba ke naam se nahi hai, ye duration chhat puja ya anya tyoharon ke ritual se judi ho sakti hai par Raja se nahi. Is prashn ke liye ye galat hai.
GALAT ✗ – Four days Chhath Puja jaisa festival hota hai, lekin Raja Parba specifically 3 dino tak hi chalta hai jiske baad chauthe din 'Vasumati Snana' hota hai. Is prashn ke liye ye sahi nahi hai.
SAHI ✓ – Raja Parba 3 din ka tyohar hai jo nari shakti aur dharti mata ki fertility ko honour karta hai.

festivals.q: Which Indian city is the host of the international kite festival 2023?
festivals.solution: International Kite Festival (Uttarayan) har saal Makar Sankranti ke mauke par Ahmedabad, Gujarat mein Sabarmati Riverfront par manaya jata hai. 2023 ki theme 'One Earth, One Family, One Future' (G20 theme par based) thi. Yaad rakho: Gujarat mein patang baazi ko ek bade level par promote karne ke liye 1989 se ye international event shuru kiya gaya tha.
why: GALAT ✗ – Thane (Maharashtra) mein local festivals hote hain lekin wo International Kite Festival ka official host nahi hai. Is prashn ke liye ye option relevant nahi hai.

GALAT ✗ – Surat apni manjha industry aur 'Locho' ke liye famous hai, aur wahan patang udayi jati hai, lekin main 'International' level ka event Ahmedabad mein hi hota hai. Is prashn ke liye ye galat hai.
SAHI ✓ – Ahmedabad hi wo shehar hai jahan duniya bhar se patangbaaz aate hain aur Sabarmati ke kinare ye grand event host kiya jata hai.
GALAT ✗ – Pune apne Ganesha Utsav aur cultural heritage ke liye jana jata hai, na ki International Kite Festival ke host ke roop mein. Is prashn ke liye ye galat hai.

festivals.q: Which of the following festivals is celebrated in the month of November-December in karnataka?
festivals.solution: Huthri Karnataka (specifically Kodagu/Coorg region) ka ek harvest festival hai jo Nov-Dec ke purnima (full moon) par manaya jata hai. Isme 'Puthari' (nayi fasal) ko kaat kar ghar laya jata hai aur 'Bolak-aat' jaise folk dances kiye jate hain. Yaad rakho: Karnataka ke Kodava community ka ye sabse bada harvest festival hai.
why: SAHI ✓ – Huthri hi wo festival hai jo Nov-Dec mein dhan (paddy) ki katai ke waqt Karnataka mein manaya jata hai.
GALAT ✗ – Dasara (Mysuru Dasara) Karnataka ka 'Nada Habba' (State festival) hai, lekin ye usually Sept-Oct mein Navratri ke waqt manaya jata hai na ki Nov-Dec mein. Is prashn ke liye ye galat hai.

GALAT ✗ – Kambala Dakshina Kannada ki traditional 'Buffalo Race' hai, jo winter months mein hoti hai lekin ye specifically harvest festival ke roop mein Nov-Dec ki fix timeline nahi rakhta. Is prashn ke liye ye uttar nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Hampi Utsav (Vijaya Utsav) Hampi ki virasat ko celebrate karne ke liye Jan-Feb mein manaya jata hai, isliye ye Nov-Dec ka festival nahi hai. Is prashn ke liye ye galat hai.

festivals.q: In which of the following states, Tamu Losar festival is celebrated as New year by the Gurung community?
festivals.solution: Tamu Losar Sikkim aur Nepal ke 'Gurung' community ka New Year festival hai, jo Vikram Samvat ke hisaab se Poush mahine mein aata hai. Isme log traditional dress pehenkar monasteries mein puja karte hain aur 'Tamu' culture ko celebrate karte hain. Yaad rakho: Sikkim mein 'Losar' (Tibetan New Year) aur 'Losoong' (Bhutia New Year) bhi manaye jate hain.
why: GALAT ✗ – Goa mein Shigmo aur Carnival jaise festivals manaye jate hain jo Konkani culture se jude hain, wahan Gurung community ka influence nahi hai. Is prashn ke liye ye galat hai.
SAHI ✓ – Sikkim mein hi Gurung community basi hui hai jo Tamu Losar ko apne naye saal ke roop mein dhoom-dhaam se manati hai.
GALAT ✗ – Assam mein Bihu (Rongali, Kongali, Bhogali) naye saal aur harvest ke roop mein manaya jata hai, wahan Tamu Losar main festival nahi hai. Is prashn ke liye ye galat hai.
GALAT ✗ – Madhya Pradesh Central India mein hai jahan Lokrang aur Khajuraho Dance festival famous hain, lekin Tamu Losar wahan ka native festival nahi hai. Is prashn ke liye ye galat hai.

festivals.q: Makaravilakku festival is celebrated which of the following Indian states?
festivals.solution: Makaravilakku Kerala ka ek bahut hi important religious festival hai. Ye har saal Makar Sankranti ke din Sabarimala Ayyappa Temple mein manaya jata hai. Is tyohar ki sabse badi visheshtha 'Makarajyothi' hai, jo Ponnambalamedu hill par dikhne wali ek divine light hai. SSC exams ke liye yaad rakhiye ki Sabarimala temple Periyar Tiger Reserve ke andar sthit hai. **Yaad rakho:** 'Makara' se Makar Sankranti aur 'Kerala' ka connection.
why: GALAT ✗ – Andhra Pradesh mein Brahmotsavam aur Ugadi jaise festivals bade star par manaye jate hain. Is prashn ke liye ye sahi nahi hai kyunki Makaravilakku specific Kerala ka ritual hai.
SAHI ✓ – Kerala mein hi Sabarimala mandir hai jahan Makar Sankranti ke mauke par Makaravilakku manaya jata hai.
GALAT ✗ – Tamil Nadu mein Pongal aur Puthandu (New Year) manaya jata hai. Halaki Sabarimala mein Tamil devotees bhi jate hain, par ye festival Kerala state ka hai.
GALAT ✗ – Karnataka mein Kambala (buffalo race) aur Ugadi famous hain. Makaravilakku ka sambandh yahan se nahi hai.

festivals.q: Which festival celebrated by Muslims is also known as Barawafat?
festivals.solution: Milad-un-Nabi, jise Eid-e-Milad bhi kaha jata hai, Prophet Muhammad (SAW) ki birth anniversary ke roop mein manaya jata hai. Ise 'Barawafat' isliye kehte hain kyunki ye Islamic calendar ke teesre mahine 'Rabi-ul-Awwal' ki 12th date (Barah) ko hota hai. Ye din unki paidaish aur wafat (death) dono ki yaad dilata hai. **Yaad rakho:** Barah (12) + Wafat = Barawafat.
why: GALAT ✗ – Eid-ul-Zuha (Bakrid) qurbani ka tyohar hai jo Prophet Ibrahim ki sunnat ki yaad mein manaya jata hai, ise Barawafat nahi kehte.
GALAT ✗ – Shab-e-Baraat gunahon se maafi ki raat (Night of Records/Forgiveness) mani jati hai, jo Shaban mahine mein aati hai.
GALAT ✗ – Muharram Islamic calendar ka pehla mahina hai aur isme Imam Hussain ki shahadat ka gham manaya jata hai.
SAHI ✓ – Milad-un-Nabi ko hi Barawafat kaha jata hai kyunki ye 12 Rabi-ul-Awwal ko hota hai.

festivals.q: Nag Panchami is celebrated in which month or the Hindu calender?
festivals.solution: Nag Panchami Hindu calendar ke 'Shravan' (Sawan) mahine ki Shukla Paksha ki Panchami ko manai jati hai. Is din 'Nag Devta' (snakes) ki puja ki jati hai aur unhe doodh pilaya jata hai. Ye tyohar barsaat ke mausam mein saapon ke bil se bahar nikalne ke dar ko dur karne aur unke prati samman vyakt karne ke liye shuru hua tha. **Yaad rakho:** Sawan ki rimjhim aur Naag devta ka connection.
why: GALAT ✗ – Sharad (Ashwin) maas mein Navratri aur Dussehra jaise bade tyohar aate hain, Nag Panchami nahi.
GALAT ✗ – Kartik maas mein Diwali aur Chhath Puja manayi jati hai, jo ki Sharad ritu ke baad aata hai.
SAHI ✓ – Shravan mahina hi wo samay hai jab poore Bharat mein Nag Panchami shraddha ke sath manayi jati hai.
GALAT ✗ – Ashadh mahina monsoon ki shuruat ka hota hai aur isme aksar Jagannath Rath Yatra nikali jati hai.

festivals.q: In which country is the famous festival known as Paro Tschechu celebrated?
festivals.solution: Paro Tshechu Bhutan ka sabse lokpriya religious festival hai. Ye Guru Rinpoche (Padmasambhava) ke samman mein manaya jata hai, jinhone Bhutan mein Buddhism failaya tha. Is festival ka main attraction 'Cham Dance' (Mask Dance) hai, jisme monk bhayanak aur colorful masks pehenkar dance karte hain. Isme ek giant thangka (scroll painting) dikhayi jati hai jise 'Thongdrel' kehte hain. **Yaad rakho:** Paro Bhutan ka ek shahar hai jahan airport bhi hai.
why: GALAT ✗ – Japan mein 'Hanami' (cherry blossom) aur 'Gion Matsuri' jaise festivals hote hain. Paro Tshechu ka culture Japan se bilkul alag hai.
GALAT ✗ – Thailand mein 'Songkran' (water festival) aur 'Loy Krathong' famous hain. Ye ek Buddhist country zaroor hai par Paro Tshechu yahan ka nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Burma (Myanmar) mein 'Thingyan' (New Year water festival) manaya jata hai. Ye Bhutanese culture ka hissa nahi hai.
SAHI ✓ – Bhutan mein hi Paro Tshechu mask dance aur Buddhist rituals ke sath manaya jata hai.

festivals.q: Guruvayoor Ekadashi is a cultural festival of which state of India?
festivals.solution: Guruvayoor Ekadashi Kerala ke Thrissur district mein sthit famous Guruvayur Sri Krishna Temple mein manayi jati hai. Ye Malayalam mahine 'Vrischikam' mein aati hai. Is tyohar ki sabse badi khasiyat 'Gaja-rajan' (Elephants) ki pooja aur unka procession hai. Is din 'Guruvayur Kesavan' (ek legendary hathi) ko yaad kiya jata hai. **Yaad rakho:** Guruvayur = Kerala ka Dwarka.
why: GALAT ✗ – Andhra Pradesh mein Tirupati Balaji main center hai, Guruvayur mandir aur uski Ekadashi Kerala ki parampara hai.
SAHI ✓ – Kerala ke Guruvayur mandir mein hi ye Ekadashi hathi ke procession ke sath dhoom-dhaam se manayi jati hai.
GALAT ✗ – Tamil Nadu mein Ekadashi manayi jati hai par 'Guruvayoor Ekadashi' specific Kerala ke mandir ka cultural event hai.
GALAT ✗ – Karnataka ke Udupi mein Krishna matha hai, lekin Guruvayoor festival wahan ka ritual nahi hai.

festivals.q: The meaning of 'boiling' or 'boiling' is associated with the name of which of the following festivals?
festivals.solution: Pongal festival Tamil Nadu mein harvest ke baad manaya jata hai. Iska shabdik arth (literal meaning) 'boil over' ya 'ubhalna' hota hai, jo naye chawal ko mitti ke bartan mein doodh ke saath ubalne ki parampara ko darshata hai. Ye 4 din ka tyohar hai jisme Sun God (Surya) ki puja hoti hai. Yaad rakho: Pongal = Pottery + Boiling.
why: GALAT ✗ – Onam Kerala ka sabse bada harvest festival hai jo King Mahabali ke swagat mein manaya jata hai. Ismein Vallam Kali (Boat Race) aur Pookalam (Phoolon ki rangoli) banayi jati hai. Iska arth 'boiling' nahi hota.
GALAT ✗ – Bihu Assam ka mukhya tyohar hai jo saal mein teen baar manaya jata hai (Rongali, Kongali, Bhogali). Ye agriculture cycle se juda hai par iska naam 'boiling' se nahi nikla.
SAHI ✓ – Pongal Tamil shabd 'Pongu' se aaya hai jiska arth hai 'to boil over'. Is din naye chawal aur gud ko ubal kar Surya Dev ko bhog lagaya jata hai, jo samridhi ka prateek hai.
GALAT ✗ – 'King' koi festival nahi hai balki ek title hai. Ho sakta hai ye 'Wangala' (Meghalaya ka festival) ke liye ek typing error ho, par 'boiling' ka sambandh isse nahi hai.

festivals.q: The ten-day festival of Bastar Dussehra is related to which state of India?
festivals.solution: Bastar Dussehra duniya ka sabse lamba chalne wala tyohar mana jata hai (lagbhag 75 din). Ye Chhattisgarh ke Bastar kshetra mein Devi Danteshwari ki upasna ke liye manaya jata hai. Iski shuruat 13th century mein Kakatiya vansh ke raja Purushottam Dev ne ki thi. Yaad rakho: Bastar = Chhattisgarh ki tribal heartland.
why: SAHI ✓ – Bastar Dussehra Chhattisgarh ka sabse vishesh parv hai. Ye Lord Rama ki vijay ke bajaye sthaniye Devi Danteshwari aur tribal customs par focus karta hai.
GALAT ✗ – Jharkhand mein Sarhul aur Sohrai jaise bade tribal festivals manaye jate hain. Bastar Dussehra ka mukhya kendra Chhattisgarh hai, na ki Jharkhand.
GALAT ✗ – Bihar apne Chhath Puja aur Sonepur Mela ke liye prasiddh hai. Bastar Dussehra Bihar ki sanskriti ka hissa nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Odisha mein Nuakhai aur Rath Yatra mukhya hain. Halaki Bastar Odisha border ke paas hai, par ye festival puri tarah Chhattisgarh ki pehchan hai.

festivals.q: How many times in a year is Bihu celebrated in Assam?
festivals.solution: Assam mein Bihu saal mein 3 baar manaya jata hai: 1. Bohag (Rongali) Bihu April mein (New Year), 2. Kati (Kongali) Bihu October mein (crops ki raksha ke liye), aur 3. Magh (Bhogali) Bihu January mein (harvest ke baad dawat). Ismein 'Bihu Dance' aur 'Dhol' ka prayog hota hai. Yaad rakho: 3 Bihu = 3 Seasons.
why: GALAT ✗ – 2 baar nahi, kyunki Assam ki agricultural cycle mein sowing, transplanting aur harvesting teeno phases ke liye alag Bihu hote hain.
SAHI ✓ – Bihu teen prakar ke hote hain (Rongali, Kongali, Bhogali). Ye teeno milkar Assamese calendar ke mahatvapurna padav darshate hain.
GALAT ✗ – 5 baar Bihu nahi manaya jata. Assam mein anya tyohar bhi hain par Bihu ki sankhya fix hai.
GALAT ✗ – 4 baar nahi manaya jata. Bhogali (Jan), Rongali (April) aur Kati (Oct) hi mukhya 'Bihu' maane jate hain.

festivals.q: In which city of Assam is Tea festival celebrated every year.
festivals.solution: Jorhat ko 'Tea Capital of the World' kaha jata hai, isliye yahan har saal Tea Festival manaya jata hai. Assam India ka sabse bada tea producer hai. Is festival mein tea tasting aur baganon ki sair karayi jati hai. Tocklai Tea Research Institute bhi Jorhat mein hi hai. Yaad rakho: Tea = Jorhat (T-J).
why: SAHI ✓ – Jorhat mein hi world-famous tea gardens hain aur yahi Tea Festival ka mukhya sthal hai jo tourism ko badhava deta hai.
GALAT ✗ – Guwahati Assam ka sabse bada shehar hai aur Ambubachi Mela (Kamakhya Temple) ke liye jana jata hai, par Tea Festival yahan ka mukhya event nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Silchar Barak Valley mein hai aur tea gardens wahan bhi hain, par official 'Tea Festival' ka title aur event Jorhat ke naam hai.
GALAT ✗ – Dibrugarh ko 'Tea City of India' zaroor kehte hain, par sarkari taur par Tea Festival ka mukhya ayojan Jorhat mein hota hai.

festivals.q: Which religion has influence on Hemis festival?
festivals.solution: Hemis Festival Ladakh ka sabse bada Buddhist tyohar hai jo Hemis Gompa (monastery) mein hota hai. Ye Guru Padmasambhava (Guru Rinpoche) ki birth anniversary par manaya jata hai. Iska mukhya aakarshan 'Chams Dance' hai jisme lamas colorful masks pehenkar dance karte hain. Yaad rakho: Hemis = Ladakh = Buddhism.
why: SAHI ✓ – Hemis Festival puri tarah Tibetan Buddhism par aadharit hai. Ye Guru Padmasambhava ke samman mein manaya jata hai, jinhone Tibet mein Buddhism failaya tha.
GALAT ✗ – Islam mein Eid-ul-Fitr aur Eid-ul-Adha jaise tyohar hote hain. Hemis ek monastery (Gompa) mein hone wala tantric Buddhist festival hai.
GALAT ✗ – Hinduism ka prabhav Ladakh ke is vishesh festival par nahi hai, ye shuddh roop se Vajrayana Buddhism ki parampara hai.
GALAT ✗ – Jainism mein Mahavir Jayanti aur Paryushana jaise parv hote hain. Hemis ka sambandh Jain dharm se nahi hai.

festivals.q: Which of the following festival is associated with the term of ''Tie of protection''?
festivals.solution: Rakshabandhan ka tyohar Shravan maas ki Purnima ko manaya jata hai. Ye bhai-behen ke prem ka prateek hai jisme behen bhai ki kalai par 'Rakhi' (Tie of protection) baandhti hai. SSC exams ke liye yaad rakhein ki isi din 'Narali Purnima' bhi manayi jati hai jo ki coastal regions ka festival hai. Yaad rakho: Raksha = Protection, Bandhan = Tie.
why: SAHI ✓ – Rakshabandhan ka arth hi hai 'Suraksha ka Bandhan'. Isme behenein bhaiyo ko raksha sutra baandhti hain aur bhai unki raksha ka vachan dete hain.
GALAT ✗ – Karva Chauth suhagan mahilayon dwara pati ki lambi umar ke liye rakha jane wala vrat hai. Isme chandrama ki pooja hoti hai, tie of protection ka concept nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Chhath Puja Bihar aur UP ka pramukh tyohar hai jisme Surya Dev aur Chhathi Maiya ki pooja hoti hai. Ye nadiyaon aur ghaton par manaya jata hai.
GALAT ✗ – Baisakhi Punjab ka harvest festival (fasal utsav) hai jo Sikh Nav Varsh aur Khalsa Panth ki sthapna ki khushi mein manaya jata hai.

festivals.q: In which district of Gujarat is the Modhera Dance festival organized by the Gujarat Government?
festivals.solution: Modhera Dance Festival, jise 'Uttarardh Mahotsav' bhi kehte hain, Gujarat Tourism dwara January ke teesre hafte mein manaya jata hai. Ye Modhera ke famous 'Sun Temple' (Surya Mandir) ke backdrop mein hota hai, jise Chalukya vansh ke raja Bhimdev I ne banwaya tha. Yaad rakho: Modhera = Mehsana = Sun Temple.
why: GALAT ✗ – Bharuch Narmada nadi ke tat par sthit ek prachin bandargah (port) hai, jo apni Sujni embroidery ke liye famous hai, Modhera dance yahan nahi hota.
GALAT ✗ – Amreli Gir forest region ke paas hai aur yahan Gir cow ki breed aur Pipavav port famous hain, par ye dance festival yahan ka event nahi hai.
SAHI ✓ – Mehsana district mein hi Modhera Sun Temple hai jahan har saal ye shastriya nritya (classical dance) ka mahotsav aayojit kiya jata hai.
GALAT ✗ – Dang Gujarat ka ek tribal district hai jo 'Dang Darbar' festival ke liye jana jata hai, Modhera yahan se kafi door hai.

festivals.q: Pushkar fair is a popular cultural festival of which state?
festivals.solution: Pushkar Mela Rajasthan ke Ajmer district mein Kartik Purnima ko lagta hai. Ye duniya ka sabse bada 'Cattle Fair' (Pashu Mela) hai jahan oont (camels) ka vyapar hota hai. Yahan Pushkar Lake aur duniya ka ekmatra pramukh Brahma Mandir hai. Yaad rakho: Pushkar = Brahma + Camel + Rajasthan.
why: SAHI ✓ – Rajasthan ka Pushkar mela apni camel trading aur 'Desert Culture' ke liye pure vishwa mein mashhoor hai, isse Rajasthan tourism ko bada badhava milta hai.
GALAT ✗ – Sikkim mein Losar, Saga Dawa aur Pang Lhabsol jaise Buddhist festivals manaye jate hain, Rajasthan ke desert fair ka yahan koi talluk nahi.
GALAT ✗ – Assam apne Bihu aur Ambubachi mela (Kamakhya temple) ke liye jana jata hai, ye Pashu Mela yahan nahi lagta.
GALAT ✗ – Bihar mein 'Sonepur Mela' lagta hai jo Asia ka sabse bada pashu mela hai, par Pushkar fair Rajasthan ki pehchan hai.

festivals.q: Power/Pawl kut is a festival of gratitude (thanks giving) to god is celebrated in ____ state of India
festivals.solution: Pawl Kut Mizoram ka ek mukhya harvest festival hai. Mizo bhasha mein 'Pawl' ka matlab 'Straw' (bhoosa) hota hai aur 'Kut' ka matlab 'Festival'. Jab kisan apni fasal kaat lete hain, tab wo bhagwan ko dhanyavad (thanksgiving) dene ke liye ise manate hain. Mizoram ke doosre festivals: Chapchar Kut aur Mim Kut. Yaad rakho: Sabhi 'Kut' festivals Mizoram se hain.
why: GALAT ✗ – Gujarat mein Navratri aur International Kite Festival (Uttarayan) dhoom-dhaam se manaye jate hain, Pawl Kut yahan ka culture nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Himachal Pradesh mein Kullu Dussehra aur Halda jaise festivals hote hain, Pawl Kut North-East India ka tyohar hai.
SAHI ✓ – Mizoram mein kheti ki fasal katne ke baad khushi aur shukrana jatane ke liye Pawl Kut manaya jata hai.
GALAT ✗ – Kerala apne Onam (harvest festival) aur Vishu (New Year) ke liye jana jata hai, yahan 'Kut' namak tyohar nahi manaya jata.

festivals.q: Mahamastakabhishek is a _____ festival celebrated after every 12 years.
festivals.solution: Mahamastakabhishek Jain dharm ka ek vishal utsav hai jo Karnataka ke Shravanabelagola mein Gomateshwara (Lord Bahubali) ki 57-foot unchi murti par kiya jata hai. Ye har 12 saal mein ek baar hota hai. Murti ko doodh, haldi, aur chandan se nahlaya jata hai. Yaad rakho: 12 saal + Bahubali + Shravanabelagola = Jainism.
why: GALAT ✗ – Buddhist festivals mein Buddha Purnima aur Hemis (Ladakh) mukhya hain, par Mahamastakabhishek unki parampara ka hissa nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Sikh dharm mein Gurupurab aur Hola Mohalla jaise parv hote hain, unme murti abhishek jaisi koi pratha nahi hoti.
GALAT ✗ – Hindu dharm mein Kumbh Mela har 12 saal mein lagta hai, par 'Mahamastakabhishek' naam ka vishisht anusthan Jain Tirthankaro se juda hai.
SAHI ✓ – Ye Jainism ka ek pavitra samaroh hai jo Bhagwan Bahubali ki murti par har 12 saal mein Shraddhaluon dwara kiya jata hai.

festivals.q: Mahavir Jayanti is celebrated in the month of ____.
festivals.solution: Mahavir Jayanti Jain dharam ke 24th aur last Tirthankara, Lord Mahavir ke janamdin ke roop me manayi jati hai. Ye festival Chaitra maas ke Shukla Paksha ki Trayodashi (13th day) ko aata hai, jo Gregorian calendar ke hisab se aksar March ya April me padta hai. Mahavir Swami ne 'Panchsheel' siddhant (Ahimsa, Satya, Asteya, Brahmacharya, Aparigraha) diye the. Yaad rakho: Jainism ke zyada tar bade events March-April ke aaspas hi milenge.
why: GALAT ✗ – August-September ke mahine me 'Paryushan Parv' (Jains ka purification period) aur Ganesh Chaturthi aate hain. Mahavir Jayanti is samay nahi hoti.
GALAT ✗ – May-June me aksar 'Buddha Purnima' manayi jati hai. Mahavir Jayanti isse pehle hi khatam ho jati hai.
SAHI ✓ – Mahavir Jayanti Chaitra mahine me aati hai jo English calendar ke March-April period se match karta hai.
GALAT ✗ – November-December me Deepawali ke baad 'Dev Deepawali' aur Christmas jaise festivals aate hain, Mahavir Jayanti nahi.

festivals.q: Sikhs celebrate Bandi Chhod Diwas which is compatible with ____ hindu festival.
festivals.solution: Bandi Chhod Diwas Sikh itihas ki ek bahut badi ghatna hai. Jab 6th Guru, Guru Hargobind Sahib ji, Gwalior Fort se 52 rajao ke sath azad hoke Amritsar laute the, tab poore sheher ko diye se jagmagaya gaya tha. Ye din Diwali ke sath coincide karta hai. Dono festivals me 'victory of light over darkness' ka message hai. Yaad rakho: Golden Temple ki Diwali (Bandi Chhod Diwas) puri duniya me mashhoor hai.
why: GALAT ✗ – Dussehra 'Vijayadashami' hai jo burayi par acchayi ki jeet hai, lekin Sikh history me Bandi Chhod Diwas ka direct link isse nahi, Diwali se hai.
SAHI ✓ – Bandi Chhod Diwas aur Diwali ek hi din manaye jate hain kyunki isi din Guru Hargobind ji riha hokar wapas aaye the.
GALAT ✗ – Holi rangon ka tyohar hai jo Phalguna me aata hai. Bandi Chhod Diwas ka sambandh roshni aur azadi se hai, jo Diwali par manaya jata hai.
GALAT ✗ – Ganesh Chaturthi Maharashtra ka pramukh tyohar hai, iska Sikh itihaas ke is event se koi lena-dena nahi hai.

festivals.q: Which of the following festival has its origin from the Tibetan New new year and in Ladakh, it is celebrated every year at the end of the harvest season?
festivals.solution: Losar festival Tibetan Buddhism ka 'New Year' hai. Ladakh me ye harvest season ke ant me manaya jata hai. Isme 'Metho' procession nikalta hai aur log apne gharon ko sajate hain. Ye Arunachal Pradesh (Monpa tribe) aur Himachal me bhi popular hai. Extra fact: Is festival me 'Cham Dance' (mask dance) kiya jata hai. Yaad rakho: Losar = Ladakh/Tibetan New Year.
why: GALAT ✗ – Yuru Kabgayat Ladakh ka ek mask dance festival hai jo Lamayuru monastery me hota hai, par ye New Year (Losar) nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Matho Narang festival Matho Monastery me hota hai jo apne 'oracles' (bhavishyavani karne wale monks) ke liye jana jata hai.
SAHI ✓ – Losar hi wo festival hai jo Tibetan New Year hai aur Ladakh me harvesting ke baad dhuma-dham se manaya jata hai.
GALAT ✗ – Dosmochey ko 'Festival of Scapegoats' kehte hain, ye burayi ko bhagane ke liye Leh palace me manaya jata hai, ye New Year nahi hai.

festivals.q: In which of the following states, the five day festival ''Lokrang'' is organized every year starting from 26 January?
festivals.solution: Lokrang Festival Madhya Pradesh ki 'Adivasi Lok Kala Academy' dwara organize kiya jata hai. Ye har saal Republic Day (26 January) se shuru hokar 5 din chalta hai. Iska main aim MP ki folk culture aur tribal arts ko showcase karna hai. MP ke aur bhi exams me aane wale festivals: Mandu, Tansen (Gwalior), aur Khajuraho Dance festival. Yaad rakho: Lokrang = MP ki 'Lok' (folk) kala ka rang.
why: GALAT ✗ – Himachal Pradesh me 'Lavi Fair' ya 'Kullu Dussehra' mashhoor hain, Lokrang yahan ka state festival nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Uttar Pradesh me 'Taj Mahotsav' ya 'Kumbh Mela' bade level par hote hain, Lokrang MP se juda hai.
SAHI ✓ – Lokrang Madhya Pradesh ka annual folk festival hai jo 26 January ko Bhopal me shuru hota hai.
GALAT ✗ – Arunachal Pradesh me 'Solung' ya 'Losar' jaise festivals hote hain. Lokrang central India ka festival hai.
