festivals.q: In which month of Hindu calendar is Diwali celebrated?
festivals.solution: Hindu calendar ke mutabik Diwali 'Kartik' maas ki 'Amavasya' (New Moon) ko manayi jati hai. Ye festival Lord Ram ke 14 saal ke vanvas ke baad Ayodhya lautne ki khushi me manaya jata hai. Kartik mahina usually October-November me padta hai. Yaad rakho: Deepawali 'K' se Kartik aur 'A' se Amavasya ko hoti hai.
why: GALAT ✗ – Ashwin mahine me 'Sharadiya Navratri' aur 'Dussehra' (Vijayadashami) aate hain. Diwali iske 20 din baad aati hai.
SAHI ✓ – Kartik Amavasya hi wo din hai jab poore desh me diye jalakar Diwali manayi jati hai.
GALAT ✗ – Magha mahine me 'Makar Sankranti' aur 'Mauni Amavasya' aate hain, jo thand ke peak ka samay hota hai.
GALAT ✗ – Chaitra Hindu calendar ka pehla mahina hai, jisme 'Ram Navami' aur 'Gudi Padwa' manaye jate hain, Diwali nahi.

festivals.q: The five-day festival Gaan-Ngai is mainly celebrated in which part of India?
festivals.solution: Gaan-Ngai Manipur ki Zeliangrong community (Zeme, Liangmai, aur Rongmei tribes) ka sabse bada festival hai. Ye harvest ke baad manaya jane wala ek post-harvest festival hai jo naye saal ki shuruat ko bhi darshata hai. Isme 'Hegru Mayung' (sacred fire lighting) aur traditional dances bahut famous hain. Yaad rakho: 'Gaan' matlab winter aur 'Ngai' matlab festival, ye January me hota hai.
why: GALAT ✗ – Northern India me Lohri, Baisakhi aur Holi jaise tyohar dhoom-dhaam se manaye jate hain. Gaan-Ngai yahan ka nahi balki Manipur (North-East) ki ek tribe ka specific tyohar hai.
GALAT ✗ – Southern India (Tamil Nadu, Kerala, Karnataka) me Pongal aur Onam jaise festivals harvest ke liye famous hain. Gaan-Ngai ka relation in states se bilkul nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Western India (Gujarat, Maharashtra) me Gudi Padwa aur Ganesh Chaturthi bade tyohar hain. Gaan-Ngai ek tribal festival hai jo sirf North-East region tak limited hai.
SAHI ✓ – Gaan-Ngai North-Eastern India, khaaskar Manipur me Zeliangrong Nagas dwara manaya jata hai. Ye 5 din ka festival communal harmony aur culture ko celebrate karta hai.

festivals.q: Match the columns. State Cultural Festival A) Bihar I) Bihu B) Arunachal Pradesh II) Tamladu C) Assam III) Fatorpa Jatra D) Goa IV) Chhath
festivals.solution: Match the following ke liye har state ki specialty samjho. Chhath Puja Bihar ka mahaparv hai, Bihu Assam ka iconic dance-festival hai, Tamladu Arunachal Pradesh ki Mishmi tribe ka tyohar hai, aur Fatorpa Jatra Goa ka ek prasiddh temple festival hai. Yaad rakho: 'B' se Bihu, 'B' se Bihar nahi hota—Assam hota hai!
why: GALAT ✗ – Is option me Bihar ko Bihu se match kiya hai, jabki Bihu Assam ka hai. Ye combination poori tarah galat hai.
GALAT ✗ – Isme Goa ko Tamladu ke saath joda gaya hai, lekin Tamladu North-East (Arunachal) ka festival hai, Konkan region ka nahi.
GALAT ✗ – Isme Bihar ko Fatorpa Jatra se match kiya hai, jabki Bihar me Chhath Puja sabse bada tyohar mana jata hai.
SAHI ✓ – Ye perfect match hai: Bihar-Chhath (IV), Arunachal-Tamladu (II), Assam-Bihu (I), aur Goa-Fatorpa Jatra (III).

festivals.q: Which of the following festivals is celebrated on the day of Makar Sankranti in Assam?
festivals.solution: Assam me teen tarah ke Bihu hote hain: Bohag (April - New Year), Kati (October - Kangali/Gharelu), aur Magh (January - Harvest). Makar Sankranti January me hoti hai, isliye Magh Bihu hi sahi hai. Is din log 'Meji' (bonfire) jalate hain aur 'Uruka' (feast) karte hain. Yaad rakho: Magh = Makar Sankranti.
why: GALAT ✗ – Raksha Bandhan Shravan maas ki purnima ko manaya jata hai, iska Makar Sankranti se koi lena dena nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Kati Bihu ko 'Kangali Bihu' kehte hain kyunki ye October me hota hai jab anaaj kam hota hai. Is din tulsi ke paudhe ke samne diya jalaya jata hai.
SAHI ✓ – Magh Bihu hi Assam me Makar Sankranti ke din manaya jata hai. Ye harvesting season ke khatam hone ki khushi me manaya jane wala bhog-vilas ka tyohar hai.
GALAT ✗ – Bohag Bihu (Rongali Bihu) April me Assamese New Year ke roop me manaya jata hai. Ye Baisakhi ke samay hota hai, Makar Sankranti par nahi.

festivals.q: Gugga Naumi festival is celebrated in which of the following states?
festivals.solution: Gugga Naumi Haryana ka ek bahut purana tyohar hai jo 'Gugga Peer' (Snake God) ki puja ke liye jana jata hai. Ye Bhadrapada mahine ki navmi ko hota hai. Is din bhakt 'Gugga ki Chhari' (decorated stick) lekar ghumte hain aur dance karte hain. Yaad rakho: Gugga Peer ko saapon se bachav ke liye puja jata hai.
why: SAHI ✓ – Gugga Naumi Haryana ka ek pramukh lok parv hai. Ye snake worship se juda hai aur rural areas me dhoom-dhaam se manaya jata hai.
GALAT ✗ – Himachal Pradesh me Kullu Dussehra aur Minjar Mela famous hain. Gugga Naumi specifically Haryana-Punjab belt ka festival hai.
GALAT ✗ – Gujarat Navratri aur Uttrayan (kite festival) ke liye jana jata hai. Gugga Naumi wahan ka primary regional festival nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Uttarakhand me Phool Dei aur Harela jaise nature-based festivals hote hain. Gugga Naumi yahan ka core cultural festival nahi hai.

festivals.q: In which of the following states, the famous festival of bull taming Jallikattu is celebrated.
festivals.solution: Jallikattu Tamil Nadu ka ek sahasik khel hai jo Pongal (January) ke samay 'Mattu Pongal' ke din hota hai. Isme log bhagte huye saand (bull) ke hump ko pakadne ki koshish karte hain. Ye 'Sangam literature' ke samay se chala aa raha hai. Yaad rakho: Jallikattu = Tamil Nadu ki Shaan (Pride).
why: GALAT ✗ – Karnataka me 'Kambala' hota hai, jo bhainsa-daud (buffalo race) hai. Jallikattu bull taming hai jo Tamil Nadu me hota hai.
GALAT ✗ – Arunachal Pradesh ke tyohar tribal hote hain jaise Losar ya Solung. Bull taming wahan ki tradition ka hissa nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Kerala me 'Vallam Kali' (Snake Boat Race) bahut famous hai. Kerala aur Tamil Nadu padosi hain, par Jallikattu specifically Tamil culture ka symbol hai.
SAHI ✓ – Jallikattu Tamil Nadu ka ek prachin (ancient) khel hai jo unki virasat ka hissa hai. Isme 'Kangayam' breed ke bulls ka use kiya jata hai.

festivals.q: Chaitrual and Phulaich are the festivals of which of the following states?
festivals.solution: Chaitrual aur Phulaich Himachal Pradesh ke pramukh tyohar hain. Phulaich ko 'Festival of Flowers' bhi kaha jata hai jo Kinnaur district mein September ke mahine mein manaya jata hai. Chaitrual Sirmaur area mein manaya jata hai. Ye festivals prakriti (nature) aur purvajon (ancestors) ki puja se jude hain. Yaad rakho: Himachal ke zyadatar festivals pahadi sanskriti aur phoolon se jude hote hain.
why: GALAT ✗ – Uttarakhand mein Harela aur Phool Dei jaise festivals prasiddh hain. Is prashn ke liye ye sahi nahi hai kyunki Phulaich specifically Kinnaur (HP) ka hai.
GALAT ✗ – Gujarat mein Navratri aur Uttarayan (kite festival) dhoom-dham se manaye jate hain. Yahan ka culture Himachal se kaafi alag hai.
GALAT ✗ – Haryana mein Surajkund Mela aur Baisakhi jaise tyohar mukhya hain. Phulaich ka Haryana se koi sambandh nahi hai.
SAHI ✓ – Himachal Pradesh mein hi Chaitrual aur Phulaich manaye jate hain, jo purvajon ko shradhanjali dene aur phoolon ke khilne ka jashn hain.

festivals.q: Shabrinarayan fair is organized in which of the following states?
festivals.solution: Shabrinarayan Mela Chhattisgarh ke Janjgir-Champa district mein Mahanadi ke tat par lagta hai. Ye sthan Mata Shabri aur Bhagwan Ram ki bhent ke liye pavitra mana jata hai. Ye mela Magh Purnima se shuru hokar Mahashivratri tak chalta hai. Exam Fact: Is jagah ko 'Gupt Prayag' bhi kaha jata hai.
why: GALAT ✗ – Jharkhand mein Sarhul aur Sohrai jaise tyohar mukhya hain. Shabrinarayan mela wahan nahi lagta.
SAHI ✓ – Chhattisgarh ke Shabrinarayan dham mein ye mela lagta hai, jise Ramayana kal se joda jata hai.
GALAT ✗ – Madhya Pradesh mein Simhastha Kumbh aur Tansen Samaroh hote hain. Halanki Chhattisgarh pehle MP ka hissa tha, par ab ye fair Chhattisgarh mein hai.
GALAT ✗ – West Bengal mein Gangasagar Mela aur Durga Puja prasiddh hain. Shabrinarayan mela Chhattisgarh ki sanskriti ka hissa hai.

festivals.q: The festival of ''Losar'' is celebrated as New year in sikkim. It is celebrated on the first day of _____ lunar calendar.
festivals.solution: Losar festival Tibetan Buddhism ka New Year hai. 'Lo' matlab saal aur 'Sar' matlab naya. Ye festival Sikkim, Ladakh, Arunachal Pradesh aur Himachal Pradesh mein manaya jata hai. Ye Tibetan Lunar Calendar ke mutabik 1st month ke 1st day par hota hai. Yaad rakho: Losar = Ladakh/Sikkim (North/Northeast) aur ye New Year hai.
why: SAHI ✓ – Losar Tibetan culture ka festival hai aur ye Tibetan Lunar Calendar ke anusar hi manaya jata hai.
GALAT ✗ – Persian calendar ke New Year ko 'Nowruz' kehte hain, jo March mein manaya jata hai.
GALAT ✗ – Gregorian calendar wahi hai jise hum rojmarra mein use karte hain (Jan-Dec), Losar isse alag tithi par hota hai.
GALAT ✗ – Islamic calendar (Hijri) ke hisab se Muharram aur Eid manayi jati hai, iska Losar se koi lena-dena nahi hai.

festivals.q: Tusu is a harvest festival celebrated in Jharkhand during the winter in the last day of _____ month.
festivals.solution: Tusu Parab Jharkhand aur West Bengal ke tribal areas ka ek harvest (fasal) festival hai. Ye Paush mahine ke aakhiri din (Makar Sankranti) ko manaya jata hai. Isme 'Tusu' naam ki ek kumari kanya ki puja ki jati hai. Ladkiyan bamboo frame ko sajati hain jise 'Chaudal' kehte hain. Yaad rakho: Tusu = Paush month ka ant.
why: GALAT ✗ – Phalgun mein Holi aur Shivratri jaise tyohar aate hain. Tusu thand ke mausam ka tyohar hai.
SAHI ✓ – Tusu harvest festival Paush mahine ke aakhiri din manaya jata hai, jo winter season (January) mein padta hai.
GALAT ✗ – Magh mahina Paush ke baad aata hai. Tusu ka visarjan Magh ki shuruat mein hota hai par festival Paush ka hai.
GALAT ✗ – Chaitra mahine mein Sarhul manaya jata hai, jo Jharkhand ka spring festival hai, harvest nahi.

festivals.q: Raja Parba festival of orissa is related to the vibrant cultural tradition and agricultural life. It is held for three days in the month of _____.
festivals.solution: Raja Parba ya 'Mithuna Sankranti' Odisha ka 3 din ka tyohar hai jo June mahine (Monsoon ki shuruat) mein hota hai. Ye tyohar 'Mother Earth' (Bhumi Devi) ke menstruation period ko samman dene ke liye hai. In 3 dino mein kheti ka koi kaam nahi hota aur log jhule (swings) ka anand lete hain. Yaad rakho: Raja Parba = Odisha + June + Earth's fertility.
why: GALAT ✗ – July mein aksar Lord Jagannath ki 'Ratha Yatra' hoti hai. Raja Parba June ke mid mein hota hai.
SAHI ✓ – June mahine mein hi Raja Parba manaya jata hai, jo monsoon ki pehli baarish aur dharti ki urvarata (fertility) ka prateek hai.
GALAT ✗ – August mein Odisha mein 'Nuakhai' (new rice festival) manaya jata hai, Raja Parba nahi.
GALAT ✗ – September mahina harvest festivals ke liye jana jata hai, jabki Raja Parba buai (sowing) se pehle ka break hai.

festivals.q: is a festival of sowing seeds in the fields. This is a major festival celebrated in Jharkhand.
festivals.solution: Rohini Jharkhand ka ek bahut hi pavitra agricultural festival hai jo 'Jeth' (May-June) ke mahine mein manaya jata hai. Is din se kisan apne kheton mein beej bona (sowing seeds) shuru karte hain. Is tyohar ki khasiyat ye hai ki isme koi gaana ya naach nahi hota, bas dharti mata ki puja hoti hai. Yaad rakho: 'Rohini' matlab beej rone (sowing) ka samay.
why: GALAT ✗ – Java festival Jharkhand ki unmarried girls dwara manaya jata hai, jo acchi kheti aur fertility ke liye hota hai. Is prashn ke liye ye nahi, kyunki ye beej bone ka shuruati tyohar nahi hai.

GALAT ✗ – Bandana Jharkhand ke sabse popular tyoharon mein se ek hai jo Kartik Amavasya ko janwaron (animals) ke prati samman dikhane ke liye manaya jata hai. Is prashn ke liye ye nahi, kyunki ye sowing se related nahi hai.
SAHI ✓ – Rohini Jharkhand ka wo pramukh tyohar hai jo kheti ki shuruat ya beej bone ke pratik ke roop mein manaya jata hai. Ye kisanon ke liye nav-varsh jaisa hota hai.

GALAT ✗ – Karma ek tribal festival hai jo prakriti aur bhai-behen ke prem ka pratik hai, jisme Karam devta ki puja hoti hai. Is prashn ke liye ye nahi, kyunki ye beej bone ka specific festival nahi hai.

festivals.q: Hornbill festival is related to which state of India?
festivals.solution: Hornbill Festival ko 'Festivals of Festivals' kaha jata hai. Ye Nagaland mein har saal 1 se 10 December tak manaya jata hai. Iska naam 'Hornbill' bird ke naam par rakha gaya hai jo Naga tribes ke liye bahut pavitra hai. Isme Nagaland ki sabhi tribes apni culture, dance aur music ka pradarshan karti hain. Yaad rakho: Hornbill = Nagaland ka Pride.
why: GALAT ✗ – Bihar apne Chhath Puja aur Sonepur Mela ke liye prasiddh hai. Is prashn ke liye ye nahi, kyunki Hornbill North-East India ka festival hai.
SAHI ✓ – Hornbill festival Nagaland ka sabse bada tyohar hai jo wahan ki tribes aur unki virasat ko duniya ke saamne rakhta hai.
GALAT ✗ – Karnataka mein Ugadi aur Hampi Utsav bade star par manaye jate hain. Is prashn ke liye ye nahi, kyunki Hornbill ka sambandh South India se nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Kerala apne Onam aur Vishu ke liye jana jata hai. Is prashn ke liye ye nahi, kyunki Hornbill Nagaland ka state festival hai.

festivals.q: Konark Dance festival is celebrated in which state of India?
festivals.solution: Konark Dance Festival har saal December mein Odisha ke prasiddh Sun Temple (UNESCO Site) ke background mein manaya jata hai. Iski shuruat 1986 mein hui thi. Ye ek open-air auditorium mein hota hai jahan Bharat ke sabhi classical dances jaise Odissi, Bharatanatyam aur Kathak dikhaye jate hain. Yaad rakho: Konark Sun Temple = Odisha.
why: GALAT ✗ – Karnataka classical music aur Yakshagana ke liye famous hai. Is prashn ke liye ye nahi, kyunki Konark mandir Odisha mein sthit hai.
SAHI ✓ – Konark Dance Festival Odisha mein manaya jata hai jo Bharat ke sabse bade classical dance festivals mein se ek hai.
GALAT ✗ – Jharkhand apne tribal festivals jaise Sarhul ke liye jana jata hai. Is prashn ke liye ye nahi, kyunki yahan koi Konark naam ka sthal nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Rajasthan Pushkar Mela aur Desert Festival ke liye jana jata hai. Is prashn ke liye ye nahi, kyunki Konark Odisha ki pehchaan hai.

festivals.q: In which of the following state Goncha festival is celebrated?
festivals.solution: Goncha Utsav Chhattisgarh ke Bastar kshetra mein manaya jane wala ek anokha tyohar hai jo Jagannath Rath Yatra ke samay hi hota hai. Ise Chalukya vansh ke rajaon ne shuru kiya tha. Isme log 'Goncha' (ek phal) ko bullet ki tarah 'Tupki' (bamboo gun) se chala kar ek dusre ko salaami dete hain. Yaad rakho: Goncha = Bastar ki Rath Yatra.
why: SAHI ✓ – Goncha festival Chhattisgarh ke Bastar district mein manaya jata hai, jise Bastar ki Rath Yatra bhi kehte hain.
GALAT ✗ – Odisha ki Rath Yatra world-famous hai, par 'Goncha' naam ka specific version Chhattisgarh ka hai. Isliye ye option confuse karne ke liye diya gaya hai.
GALAT ✗ – Jharkhand mein Sohrai aur Sarhul jaise tyohar hote hain. Is prashn ke liye ye nahi, kyunki Goncha wahan ka mukhya tyohar nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Rajasthan apne Gangaur aur Teej ke liye famous hai. Is prashn ke liye ye nahi, kyunki Goncha Central India (Chhattisgarh) ka hai.

festivals.exam: (SSC J.E. 01.03.17, 2:45 pm) SSC GD 12/02/2019 (Shift-III) SSC MTS/Havaldar 07/07/2022 (Shift-III) SSC CHSL (Tier-1) – 03/08/2023 (Shift-II)
festivals.q: Onam is an annually celebrated hindu festival which originated in the _____ state of India?
festivals.solution: Onam Kerala ka sabse bada harvest festival hai jo Raja Mahabali ke swagat mein manaya jata hai. Ye Malayalam calendar ke pehle mahine 'Chingam' mein aata hai. Is tyohar par Pookalam (rangoli), Vallam Kali (boat race) aur Sadhya (bhojan) ka khaas mahatva hai. Yaad rakho: Onam = Kerala ka Harvest Utsav.
why: GALAT ✗ – Mizoram ka sabse bada festival Chapchar Kut hai. Is prashn ke liye ye nahi, kyunki Onam South Indian Malayali culture ka hissa hai.
GALAT ✗ – Jharkhand mein tribal culture dominant hai. Is prashn ke liye ye nahi, kyunki Onam ka origin Kerala ke coastal region se hai.
SAHI ✓ – Onam Kerala ka state festival hai jo wahan ki kheti aur paramparaon ko darshata hai.
GALAT ✗ – Manipur apne Yaoshang aur Sangai festival ke liye jana jata hai. Is prashn ke liye ye nahi, kyunki Onam Malayalam-speaking logo ka tyohar hai.

festivals.q: Yaoshang festival is celebrated in which state of India?
festivals.solution: Yaoshang Manipur ka sabse bada festival hai jo Phalguna (Feb-March) ke mahine me 5 dino tak chalta hai. Isse 'Manipur ki Holi' bhi kehte hain. Iska main attraction 'Thabal Chongba' (moonlight dance) hai. Ye Meitei community dwara manaya jata hai aur bamboo se bani 'Yaoshang' (jhopdi) jalane se shuru hota hai. Yaad rakho: Yaoshang = Manipur ki Holi + Thabal Chongba.
why: GALAT ✗ – Rajasthan apne Gangaur aur Pushkar Mela ke liye famous hai, jahan folk songs aur camel fair hote hain. Is prashn ke liye ye galat hai kyunki Yaoshang North-East ka festival hai.
SAHI ✓ – Manipur me hi Yaoshang manaya jata hai. Ye Meitei logo ka pramukh tyohar hai jo Spring season me purnima ke din shuru hota hai.
GALAT ✗ – Uttar Pradesh me Holi aur Diwali bade star par manayi jati hai, visheshkar Mathura ki Lathmar Holi. Yaoshang yahan ka festival nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Tamil Nadu me Pongal aur Puthandu (New Year) manaya jata hai. Yaoshang ka culture South India se mel nahi khata.

festivals.q: Where is the famous Indian festival Dussehra celebrated?
festivals.solution: Mysore Dussehra (Nada Habba) Karnataka ka state festival hai. Iski shuruvat 1610 me Raja Wodeyar I ne ki thi. Isme 'Jumboo Savari' nikali jati hai jahan Elephant par Golden Howdah (Ambari) rakha jata hai. Ye Mahishasura par Devi Chamundeshwari ki vijay ka prateek hai. Yaad rakho: Mysore = Mahishasura ki nagri + Jumboo Savari.
why: GALAT ✗ – Nizam Palace (Chowmahalla) Hyderabad me hai, jo Asaf Jahi dynasty ka seat tha. Yahan Dussehra ki aisi vishal shobha yatra nahi nikalti.
GALAT ✗ – Jaipur Palace (City Palace) Rajasthan me hai, jo Kachwaha Rajputs ka ghar hai. Yahan Teej aur Gangaur ki sawari famous hai, Dussehra ki nahi.
SAHI ✓ – Mysore Palace me Dussehra sabse bhavya roop me manaya jata hai, jise dekhne duniya bhar se log aate hain aur pura palace roshni se jagmaga uthta hai.
GALAT ✗ – Mayurbhanj Palace Odisha me hai, jo Chhau dance ke patronization ke liye jana jata hai. Ye Mysore jitna iconic Dussehra celebration nahi hai.

festivals.q: The Nongkrem festival of Meghalaya is celebrated by which of the following tribes?
festivals.solution: Nongkrem Dance Festival Meghalaya ki Khasi Hills me 'Smit' naam ki jagah par hota hai. Ye ek 'Thanksgiving' festival hai jo 'Ka Blei Synshar' (Goddess) ko acchi fasal ke liye shukriya karne ke liye manaya jata hai. Isme bakri ki bali (sacrifice) di jati hai. Yaad rakho: Nongkrem = Khasi Tribe + Smit Village.
why: GALAT ✗ – Apatani tribe Arunachal Pradesh ki hai, jo apne 'Dree' aur 'Myoko' festivals ke liye jani jati hai. Inka Meghalaya ke Nongkrem se sambandh nahi hai.
SAHI ✓ – Khasi Tribe hi Nongkrem tyohar manati hai. Isme larke aur larkiyan traditional colourful dress pehenkar dance karte hain.
GALAT ✗ – Tutsa tribe Arunachal Pradesh ke Changlang aur Tirap districts me milti hai. Ye log 'Pongtu' festival manate hain, Nongkrem nahi.
GALAT ✗ – Garo tribe Meghalaya ki hi hai, lekin inka sabse bada festival 'Wangala' (100 Drums Festival) hai. Nongkrem Khasi community ka hai.

festivals.q: This event is celebrated to the rebirth of Jesus christ, Name the program.
festivals.solution: Easter Sunday wo din hai jab Jesus Christ marne ke 3 din baad dobara jivit (Resurrection) huye the. Ye 'Lent' ke 40 dino ke upvas ke baad aata hai. Easter Eggs aur Bunny iske modern symbols hain. Yaad rakho: Good Friday = Death, Easter = Rebirth (Life over Death).
why: GALAT ✗ – Christmas 25 December ko manaya jata hai jo Jesus Christ ke 'Janm' (Birth) ka din hai, na ki unke dobara jivit hone ka.
SAHI ✓ – Easter hi wo pavitra din hai jo Jesus ke punarjanm ya Resurrection ki khushi me manaya jata hai.
GALAT ✗ – Good Friday wo dukhbhara din hai jab Jesus ko Cross par chadhaya gaya tha (Crucifixion). Ye rebirth ka din nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Holy Thursday (Maundy Thursday) wo din hai jab Jesus ne apne shishyon ke saath 'Last Supper' kiya tha. Ye rebirth se pehle ki ghatna hai.

festivals.q: Lui Nagai Ni festival is related to which of the following states?
festivals.solution: Lui-Ngai-Ni Manipur ka ek major seed-sowing festival hai. Ye har saal 15 February ko manaya jata hai. Ye Manipur ki sabhi 'Naga Tribes' (jaise Tangkhul, Mao, Maram) ko ek saath lata hai. Isme fasal ki boyi (sowing) ke liye ashirwad manga jata hai. Yaad rakho: Lui-Ngai-Ni = Sowing Season + Naga Tribes of Manipur.
why: GALAT ✗ – Uttarakhand me Phool Dei aur Harela jaise festivals manaye jate hain. Lui-Ngai-Ni North-East ka tribal festival hai.
SAHI ✓ – Manipur me hi Naga tribes dwara Lui-Ngai-Ni manaya jata hai. Ye Manipur ke 'State Holiday' list me bhi shamil hai.
GALAT ✗ – Uttar Pradesh ke festivals me Kumbh Mela aur Diwali pramukh hain. Lui-Ngai-Ni yahan ke culture ka hissa nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Himachal Pradesh me Kullu Dussehra aur Losar (Tibetan New Year) popular hain. Ye Manipur ke tribal festivals se alag hai.

festivals.q: Which of the following statements are true. a. Sarhul festival is celebrated in Jharkhand b. On the occassion of Sarhul festival, the flowers of sal tree are collected and offered to the gods. c. The flowers of the sal tree are a symbol of fertility in the land.
festivals.solution: Sarhul Jharkhand ki tribes (jaise Munda, Oraon, Ho) ka sabse bada festival hai. Ye Hindu calendar ke Chaitra mahine (March-April) me manaya jata hai. Isme 'Sal' ke ped ki puja hoti hai kyunki tribal culture me ise pavitra maana jata hai. Sal ke phool dharti ki urvarta (fertility) ka prateek hain. Yaad rakho: Sarhul = Jharkhand + Sal tree flowers.
why: SAHI ✓ – Sarhul Jharkhand ka tribal festival hai, jisme Sal tree ki puja hoti hai aur phoolon ko devtaon ko chadhaya jata hai, jo fertility ka symbol hain. Teeno statements (a, b, c) bilkul accurate hain.
GALAT ✗ – Ye option sirf a aur c ko sahi maanta hai, lekin statement b (Sal flowers offering) bhi Sarhul ka ek core ritual hai, isliye ye incomplete hai.
GALAT ✗ – Ye option statement c (fertility symbol) ko ignore kar raha hai, jabki Sarhul ka main significance hi dharti ki upaj aur fertility se juda hai.
GALAT ✗ – Isme statement a (Jharkhand) ko choda gaya hai, jabki Sarhul Jharkhand ki identity ka sabse pramukh festival hai.

festivals.q: Match the following statements :-
festivals.solution: Fairs aur states ka ye combination SSC me aksar pucha jata hai. Champakulam Kerala ki sabse purani boat race hai. Surajkund (Haryana) International Crafts Mela ke liye famous hai. Baneshwar (Rajasthan) ko 'Tribals ka Kumbh' kaha jata hai aur Somnath Gujarat ka ek prasiddh Jyotirlinga aur mela sthal hai. Yaad rakho: Baneshwar = Dungarpur (Rajasthan).
why: GALAT ✗ – Is match me Champakulam ko Baneshwar se mix kiya gaya hai. Champakulam Kerala ka event hai, Rajasthan ka nahi.
GALAT ✗ – Yahan Surajkund ko Somnath se exchange kar diya gaya hai. Surajkund hamesha Haryana (Faridabad) me hota hai.
SAHI ✓ – Champakulam boat race Kerala me hoti hai, Somnath fair Gujarat me, Surajkund Haryana me aur Baneshwar fair Rajasthan me dungarpur area me lagta hai.
GALAT ✗ – Isme Baneshwar aur Somnath ke states ko galat match kiya gaya hai. Rajasthan ka mela Baneshwar hai, Somnath nahi.

festivals.q: Makaravilakku festival is celebrated in the sacred grow of Lord Ayyappa located in _____.
festivals.solution: Makaravilakku festival Kerala ke Sabarimala temple me har saal Makar Sankranti (Jan 14/15) par manaya jata hai. Ye Lord Ayyappa ko dedicated hai. Is din 'Makarajyothi' (ek celestial star) dikhayi deta hai, jise devotees bahut pavitra maante hain. Yaad rakho: Sabarimala = Lord Ayyappa + Kerala + Makaravilakku.
why: GALAT ✗ – Andhra Pradesh me Brahmotsavam aur Ugadi bade level par manaye jate hain, lekin Makaravilakku yahan ka festival nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Telangana me Bonalu aur Bathukamma sabse popular festivals hain. Lord Ayyappa ka ye specific Makaravilakku ritual yahan nahi hota.
GALAT ✗ – Karnataka me Ugadi aur Mysore Dasara ka mahatva hai. Makaravilakku specifically Kerala ke Sabarimala shrine se juda hai.
SAHI ✓ – Makaravilakku Kerala ke Sabarimala temple ka sabse bada annual festival hai jo Lord Ayyappa ke samman me Makar Sankranti par hota hai.

festivals.q: Which of the following festivals is organized on the day of Amavasya?
festivals.solution: Hindu calendar ke mutabiq, Amavasya (New Moon) par wo tyohar hote hain jo andhere me roshni ka mahatva dikhate hain. Kali Puja aur Diwali Kartik mahine ki Amavasya ko aati hain. Holi Phalguna Purnima (Full Moon) par hoti hai, aur Dussehra Ashvin Shukla Dashami ko. Yaad rakho: Deepavali/Kali Puja = Amavasya.
why: SAHI ✓ – Kali Puja, jo Bengal aur Odisha me popular hai, Kartik mahine ki Amavasya ko manayi jati hai, usi din jab North India me Diwali hoti hai.
GALAT ✗ – Mahavir Jayanti Chaitra mahine ke Shukla Paksha ki Trayodashi ko hoti hai, Amavasya ko nahi.
GALAT ✗ – Holi hamesha Purnima (Full Moon) ki raat ko manayi jati hai, Amavasya (Dark Moon) ko nahi.
GALAT ✗ – Dussehra (Vijayadashami) Ashvin mahine ke bright fortnight (Shukla Paksha) ki 10th date ko hota hai, na ki Amavasya ko.

festivals.q: 'Sakewa' is a religious festival celebrated in the state of _____.
festivals.solution: Sakewa Sikkim ki Rai community (Kirat) ka ek bada festival hai. Ise 'Bhumi Puja' bhi kehte hain kyunki ye Mother Nature aur dharti ko shukriya ada karne ke liye manaya jata hai. Isme 'Sili' dance kiya jata hai jo animals aur birds ki movements ko copy karta hai. Yaad rakho: Sakewa = Rai Community + Sikkim.
why: SAHI ✓ – Sakewa Sikkim ka ek religious festival hai jo Kirat Khambu Rai community manati hai nature ki puja karne ke liye.
GALAT ✗ – Assam me Bihu, Ambubachi Mela aur Baishagu jaise tyohar mukhya hain. Sakewa yahan ka traditional festival nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Goa me Carnival, Shigmo aur Sao Joao festivals ki dhum hoti hai. Sakewa ek Himalayan region (Sikkim) ka festival hai.
GALAT ✗ – Punjab me Baisakhi, Lohri aur Hola Mohalla manaye jate hain. Sakewa ka Punjab ke culture se koi sambandh nahi hai.

festivals.q: 'Sangken' is a festival of ______.
festivals.solution: Sangken festival Arunachal Pradesh aur Assam ki 'Theravada Buddhist' communities (jaise Khamti, Singpho) dwara manaya jata hai. Ye inka 'Traditional New Year' hota hai jo aksar April (Baisakhi ke samay) me padta hai. Isme log ek dusre par pavitra pani chidakte hain jo shuddhi (purification) ka pratik hai. Yaad rakho: Sangken = Water Festival of Buddhists.
why: GALAT ✗ – Jains ke mukhya tyohar Paryushana aur Mahavir Janma Kalyanak hain. Is prashn ke liye ye galat hai kyunki Sangken ek Buddhist nav-varsh hai.
GALAT ✗ – Christians Easter aur Christmas jaise tyohar manate hain. Sangken ka inke dharmik riti-riwazon se koi sambandh nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Sikhs Baisakhi aur Gurpurab bade dhoom-dhaam se manate hain. Sangken ek Buddhist community ka tyohar hai na ki Sikh dharm ka.
SAHI ✓ – Buddhists (khaaskar Theravada sect) Sangken ko naye saal ke roop me manate hain, jisme Lord Buddha ki pratima ko pavitra snan karaya jata hai.

festivals.q: The festival of Durga Puja is celebrated on the occasion of the victory of goddess durga on ____.
festivals.solution: Durga Puja burai par achchai ki jeet ka pratik hai. Ye Ashvin maas (September-October) ke shukla paksha me manaya jata hai. West Bengal, Odisha aur Tripura me iska sabse zyada mahatva hai. 2021 me UNESCO ne Kolkata ki Durga Puja ke 'Intangible Cultural Heritage' list me shamil kiya tha. Yaad rakho: Durga vs Mahishasura battle 10 din chalti hai.
why: GALAT ✗ – Hiranyakashyap ek asur raja tha jiska vadh Bhagwan Vishnu ke 'Narasimha' avatar ne kiya tha, jo Holi/Holika Dahan se juda hai.
GALAT ✗ – Ravana ka vadh Bhagwan Rama ne kiya tha, jise hum Dussehra (Vijayadashami) ke roop me manate hain, na ki Durga Puja ki mukhya katha ke roop me.
GALAT ✗ – Jarasandha Magadh ka raja tha jise Mahabharata me Bhima ne Krishna ki sahayata se mallyuddha (wrestling) me haraya tha.
SAHI ✓ – Mahishasura ek bhains-roopi asur tha jise Devi Durga ne 10 dinon ke yuddh ke baad maara tha, isliye unhe 'Mahishasura Mardini' kehte hain.

festivals.q: Which of the following festival is celebrated in Uttarakhand?
festivals.solution: Phul Dei Uttarakhand ka ek lok-parv (folk festival) hai jo Chaitra mahine ki sankranti ko manaya jata hai. Isme chhote bachche (jinhe Phulyari kehte hain) ghar-ghar jakar chaukhat par phool rakhte hain aur samriddhi ki kamna karte hain. Isme 'Buransh' ke phoolon ka khas mahatva hai. Yaad rakho: Phul Dei = Harvest/Spring festival of Devbhoomi.
why: GALAT ✗ – Dol Jatra (ya Dol Purnima) West Bengal aur Odisha me Holi ke roop me manayi jati hai, jo Radha-Krishna ko samarpit hai.
SAHI ✓ – Phul Dei Uttarakhand ka 'Harvest Festival' hai jo naye saal aur phoolon ke khilne ki khushi me manaya jata hai.
GALAT ✗ – Vishu Kerala ka 'New Year' festival hai jisme 'Vishukkani' (shubh chizon ka darshan) dekhne ki parampara hai.
GALAT ✗ – Nuakhai Odisha ka ek mukhya krishi tyohar (harvest festival) hai, jisme naye chawal (dhan) ki puja ki jati hai.

festivals.q: In which of the following states, the festival 'Mee-Dum-Me Phi' a festival related to the worship of ancestors, is celebrated?
festivals.solution: Me-Dam-Me-Phi Assam ki 'Ahom' community ka sabse mukhya tyohar hai. 'Me' matlab Puja, 'Dam' matlab Dead (Ancestors), aur 'Phi' matlab God. Yani apne purvajon ko devta maankar unki puja karna. Ye har saal 31 January ko manaya jata hai taaki purvajon ka aashirwad bana rahe. Yaad rakho: Ahom Dynasty = Assam = Me-Dam-Me-Phi.
why: GALAT ✗ – Odisha me Raja Parba, Nuakhai aur Rath Yatra jaise tyohar prachalit hain, lekin Me-Dam-Me-Phi yahan nahi manaya jata.
SAHI ✓ – Assam ki Ahom jati is tyohar ko manati hai takki purvajon (ancestors) ki aatma ko shanti mile aur samaj me shanti rahe.
GALAT ✗ – Madhya Pradesh me Khajuraho Dance Festival aur Bhagoria jaise tribal festivals mashhoor hain, ye Tai-Ahom culture ka hissa nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Chhattisgarh me Bastar Dussehra aur Hareli jaise tyohar manaye jate hain, purvaj-puja ka ye vishisht roop Assam se talluk rakhta hai.

festivals.q: _______ is a three-day festival organized every year at the Bada Saheed Dargah of Nellore.
festivals.solution: Rottela Panduga (Rotiyon ka tyohar) Andhra Pradesh ke Nellore me 'Bara Shaheed Dargah' par manaya jata hai. Ye tyohar communal harmony ka pratik hai jisme log apni mannat puri hone par 'Roti' exchange karte hain. Ye Muharram ke samay hota hai. Yaad rakho: Nellore + Roti = Rottela Panduga.
why: GALAT ✗ – Bheldia (ya Bhelaghar) Assam me Magh Bihu ke dauran banaya jane wala ek temporary bamboo structure hota hai, ye koi Dargah festival nahi hai.
SAHI ✓ – Rottela Panduga Nellore ki Bada Shaheed Dargah par 3 din tak chalta hai, jahan log Swarnala Cheruvu lake me rotiyan baant-te hain.
GALAT ✗ – Ali-Aye-Ligang Assam ki 'Mising' tribe ka ek spring festival hai jo beej bone (sowing) ki shuruat par manaya jata hai.
GALAT ✗ – Baishagu Assam ki 'Bodo' community ka nav-varsh tyohar hai jo Baisakhi ke samay manaya jata hai.

festivals.q: In which of the following states is the Losoong festival celebrated?
festivals.solution: Losoong Sikkim ka ek pramukh festival hai jo Bhutia aur Lepcha tribes dwara manaya jata hai. Ye Tibetan New Year (Losar) ke ant aur harvest season ki khushi me hota hai. Isme 'Chaam Dance' (mask dance) monasteries me perform kiya jata hai. Yaad rakho: 'Lo' matlab saal aur 'Soong' matlab ant, yaani saal ka ant.
why: SAHI ✓ – Sikkim ka ye nav-varsh aur fasal utsav hai jo Bhutia aur Lepcha samuday dwara manaya jata hai, isliye ye sahi uttar hai.
GALAT ✗ – Andhra Pradesh me Ugadi aur Brahmotsavam jaise tyohar mukhya hain. Losoong ka yahan se koi sambandh nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Karnataka me Kambala (bhains daud) aur Ugadi manaya jata hai. Losoong ek Himalayan state ka festival hai.
GALAT ✗ – Himachal Pradesh me Losar aur Halda manaya jata hai, lekin Losoong vishisht roop se Sikkim se juda hai.

festivals.q: 'Kati Bihu' in Assam is celebrated by lighting a lamp in front of a tree/plant.
festivals.solution: Assam me teen tarah ke Bihu hote hain: Bohag (Rongali), Magh (Bhogali), aur Kati (Kongali). Kati Bihu October me manaya jata hai jab khet khali hote hain. Is din 'Akash Banti' (sky candle) jalayi jati hai aur Tulsi ke paudhe ki pooja hoti hai. 'Kati' ka matlab hai kaatna ya kami, kyunki is samay anaaj kam hota hai.
why: GALAT ✗ – Banyan (Bargad) ki pooja Vat Savitri jaise tyoharon me hoti hai, Kati Bihu me iska mahatva nahi hai.
SAHI ✓ – Kati Bihu ke din ghar ke aangan me Tulsi ke paudhe ke samne mitti ka diya (Saaki) jalaya jata hai, jo is tyohar ki mukhya pratha hai.
GALAT ✗ – Banana (Kela) ke patton ka upyog dakshin bharat ke bhojan aur pooja me hota hai, par Kati Bihu ka diya Tulsi ke paas rakha jata hai.
GALAT ✗ – Neem ka upyog Gudi Padwa aur Ugadi me prasad ke roop me hota hai, par Bihu me Tulsi ki pradhanata hai.

festivals.q: Arthunkal Feast and Vettukad Festival are church festivals from the state of ____.
festivals.solution: Kerala apni 'Syncretic culture' (mili-juli sanskriti) ke liye jana jata hai. Arthunkal Feast St. Sebastian ko samarpit hai aur Alappuzha district me hota hai. Vettukad Festival Thiruvananthapuram ke 'Madre de Deus' Church me manaya jata hai. Dono hi Kerala ki Christian pilgrimage ke bade hisse hain.
why: SAHI ✓ – Arthunkal aur Vettukad dono hi Kerala ke aitihasik churches me manaye jane wale bade 'Perunnal' (festivals) hain.
GALAT ✗ – Nagaland Hornbill festival aur Christian festivals ke liye famous hai, par Arthunkal wahan ka nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Sikkim me Buddhist monasteries aur festivals (Saga Dawa) ki bahulyata hai, church festivals ke liye ye prasiddh nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Goa me Feast of St. Francis Xavier aur Carnival bade hote hain, par Arthunkal Kerala ka vishesh tyohar hai.

festivals.q: Which of the following festivals of Tamil Nadu is dedicated to Lord Muruga?
festivals.solution: Thai Poosam Tamil Nadu ka ek shaktishali tyohar hai jo 'Thai' mahine ki purnima ko manaya jata hai. Ye Lord Muruga (Kartikeya) ki burayi par vijay ka pratik hai. Isme bhakt 'Kavadi' uthate hain aur sharir par sui (piercing) chubhate hain. Lord Muruga ko Tamil logo ka rakshak devta mana jata hai.
why: GALAT ✗ – Pongal Tamil Nadu ka harvest festival hai jo Surya Dev (Sun God) ko samarpit hota hai, Muruga ko nahi.
GALAT ✗ – Aadi Perukku monsoon aur nadiyon (Kaveri) ke prati kritagyata prakat karne ka tyohar hai.
GALAT ✗ – Onam mukhya roop se Kerala ka tyohar hai jo Raja Bali ke swagat me manaya jata hai.
SAHI ✓ – Thai Poosam hi wo tyohar hai jo Lord Muruga ko samarpit hai aur jisme unhe 'Vel' (shakti ka pratik) milne ki katha hai.

festivals.q: 'Ali Ai Ligang Festival' is a festival celebrated in the state of _____.
festivals.solution: Ali-Ai-Ligang Assam ki 'Mising' tribe dwara manaya jane wala spring festival hai. 'Ali' ka matlab beej (seed), 'Ai' ka matlab phal (fruit) aur 'Ligang' ka matlab boyi (sowing) hota hai. Is tyohar par 'Gumrag' dance kiya jata hai aur dhonw (local beer) aur pork ka sevan hota hai.
why: GALAT ✗ – Bihar me Chhath aur Sama Chakeva jaise tyohar hote hain, Ali-Ai-Ligang wahan nahi manaya jata.
GALAT ✗ – Chhattisgarh me Bastar Dussehra aur Madai jaise tribal festivals hote hain, ye Mising tribe ka festival nahi hai.
SAHI ✓ – Ali-Ai-Ligang Assam ki Mising janjati ka kheti se juda sabse bada tyohar hai jo February me manaya jata hai.
GALAT ✗ – Kerala me Vishu aur Onam jaise utsav hote hain, North-East ke is festival ka Kerala se talluk nahi hai.

festivals.q: 'Sakewa' is a religious festival celebrated in the state of_____.
festivals.solution: Sakewa Sikkim ki Kirat Khambu Rai community ka ek mukhya festival hai, jise 'Bhoomi Puja' ya 'Chandi Puja' bhi kehte hain. Isme Mother Earth ki pooja hoti hai taki achhi fasal aur raksha mil sake. Isme 'Sili' naam ka traditional dance perform kiya jata hai jo animals aur nature ki movements ko copy karta hai. Yaad rakho: Sakewa = Sikkim (Dono 'S' se start hote hain).
why: SAHI ✓ – Sakewa Sikkim ka ek important religious festival hai jo Kirat Khambu Rai community dwara Mother Earth ko samman dene ke liye manaya jata hai.
GALAT ✗ – Assam ke mukhya tyohar Bihu (Bhogali, Rongali, Kongali) aur Ambubachi Mela hain. Is prashn ke liye ye sahi nahi hai kyunki Sakewa Assam ka nahi Sikkim ka hai.
GALAT ✗ – Goa apne Carnival, Shigmo aur Feast of St. Francis Xavier ke liye famous hai. Sakewa ek Himalayan region ka festival hai, isliye Goa galat option hai.
GALAT ✗ – Punjab me Baisakhi, Lohri aur Teeyan jaise festivals dhoom-dham se manaye jate hain. Sakewa ka Punjab se koi lena-dena nahi hai.

festivals.q: 'Nuakhai' is the greatest harvesting festival of Odisha, celebrated one day after of which of the following festivals?
festivals.solution: Nuakhai Western Odisha ka sabse bada harvest (fasal) festival hai. 'Nua' matlab naya aur 'Khai' matlab khana—yani nayi fasal ka swagat. Ye Bhadrapada mahine ki 'Panchami' ko manaya jata hai. Is din log 'Nabanna' (naya chawal) Devi Samaleswari ko chadhate hain. Yaad rakho: Ganesh Chaturthi (Chaturthi) ke thik agle din Nuakhai (Panchami) hota hai.
why: GALAT ✗ – Dussehra ya Vijayadashami Ashvin mahine me manaya jata hai jo burayi par achhayi ki jeet ka prateek hai. Nuakhai isse kaafi pehle Bhadrapada mahine me aata hai.
GALAT ✗ – Holi ek rangon ka tyohar hai jo Phalguna Purnima ko manaya jata hai. Nuakhai harvesting se juda hai aur monsoon ke time aata hai, isliye Holi galat hai.
SAHI ✓ – Nuakhai Ganesh Chaturthi (Bhadrapada Shukla Chaturthi) ke thik ek din baad, yaani Panchami tithi ko manaya jata hai.
GALAT ✗ – Diwali Kartik mahine ki Amavasya ko aati hai. Ye lights ka festival hai, jabki Nuakhai monsoon ke end me fresh harvest ka tyohar hai.

festivals.q: Which of the following is an animal trading festival of Gujarat?
festivals.solution: Vautha Mela Gujarat ka ek bahut bada 'Animal Trading Fair' hai jo Dholka (Ahmedabad) me hota hai. Yahan 7 nadiyon ka sangam hota hai jise 'Saptasangam' kehte hain. Is mele me hazaron gadhe (donkeys) aur camel beche-khareede jate hain. Yaad rakho: Vautha = Vyapaar (Animal Trade) in Gujarat.
why: GALAT ✗ – Madhavpur Mela Gujarat me hi hota hai par ye Bhagwan Krishna aur Rukmani ki yaad me lagta hai, ye animal trading fair nahi hai.
SAHI ✓ – Vautha Mela Gujarat ka sabse bada pashu mela (animal fair) hai jahan khas taur par gadho ka vyapaar hota hai.
GALAT ✗ – Kumbh Mela Prayagraj, Haridwar, Ujjain aur Nashik me lagta hai jo ek bahut bada religious gathering hai, pashu mela nahi.
GALAT ✗ – Ambubachi Mela Assam ke Kamakhya Devi temple me lagta hai jise 'East ka Kumbh' bhi kehte hain, iska Gujarat ya animal trade se talluk nahi hai.

festivals.q: Teeyan is a festival celebrated in Punab, which celebrates the onset of _____.
festivals.solution: Teeyan Punjab me manaya jane wala Teej festival ka hi naam hai. Ye monsoon (Sawan) ke mahine me manaya jata hai jab baarish shuru hoti hai. Is tyohar me ladkiyan aur mahilayein peeng (jhoola) jhoolti hain aur Giddha dance karti hain. Yaad rakho: Teeyan = Teej = Rain/Monsoon.
why: GALAT ✗ – Spring (Basant) ke liye Punjab me Basant Panchami manayi jati hai jisme peele kapde pehne jate hain, Teeyan spring ka tyohar nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Winter me Punjab ka mukhya tyohar Lohri hai jo Makar Sankranti se ek din pehle aata hai. Teeyan garmiyon ke baad monsoon me aata hai.
GALAT ✗ – Summer me koi major Punjabi festival monsoon ki tarah Teeyan ke roop me nahi manaya jata, ye baarish ke swagat ka tyohar hai.
SAHI ✓ – Teeyan festival Punjab me Monsoon (Sawan) ki shuruat ko celebrate karne ke liye manaya jata hai.

festivals.q: Which of the following Hindu festivals is celebrated in the last month of the Hindu calendar?
festivals.solution: Hindu Calendar (Vikram Samvat) ka pehla mahina 'Chaitra' hota hai aur aakhri mahina 'Phalguna' hota hai. Holi Phalguna mahine ki Purnima (full moon) ko manayi jati hai, isliye ye saal ka aakhri bada tyohar hota hai. SSC point: Chaitra Pratipada se naya saal shuru hota hai. Yaad rakho: Holi = Happy Ending of Hindu Year.
why: SAHI ✓ – Holi Phalguna mahine me aati hai jo Hindu calendar ka aakhri (12th) mahina hai.
GALAT ✗ – Raksha Bandhan Shravana mahine (monsoon) ki Purnima ko hota hai, ye saal ke beech ka samay hai, aakhri nahi.
GALAT ✗ – Diwali Kartik mahine me manayi jati hai, jo calendar ke hisaab se lagbhag 8va mahina hota hai, aakhri nahi.
GALAT ✗ – Makar Sankranti Magha mahine me aati hai (January). Ye surya ke Uttarayan hone ka tyohar hai par calendar ka aakhri tyohar nahi hai.

festivals.q: Shigmotsav is essentially a festival of the masses, celebrated on the full moon day in the month of Phalguna (March). Which state celebrates this festival?
festivals.solution: Shigmotsav ya Shigmo Goa ka sabse bada spring festival hai jo 'Paddy harvest' (dhaan ki katai) ki khushi me manaya jata hai. Ye Hindu calendar ke Phalgun mahine me hota hai, jo Holi ke aas-pass padta hai. Isme 'Ghode Modni' aur 'Gopha' jaise folk dances perform kiye jaate hain. Yaad rakho: Shigmo = Goa ki Holi.
why: GALAT ✗ – Haryana me Surajkund Mela aur Teej jaise tyohar dhoom-dhaam se manaye jaate hain. Shigmotsav se iska koi lena-dena nahi hai kyunki ye Konkan region ka festival hai.
GALAT ✗ – Meghalaya apne Wangala (100 Drums) festival ke liye jana jata hai jo Garo tribe manati hai. Shigmo yahan ka traditional festival nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Sikkim me Buddhist festivals jaise Saga Dawa aur Losar ki maanyata zyada hai. Goa ka tribal harvest festival yahan nahi manaya jata.
SAHI ✓ – Goa me hi Shigmotsav manaya jata hai. Ye do tarah ka hota hai: Dhaklo Shigmo (villages me) aur Vhadlo Shigmo (sabke liye). Isme colourful float parades nikali jati hain.

festivals.q: Makaravilakku is an annual festival held on Makar Sakranti in which of the following states?
festivals.solution: Makaravilakku Kerala ke Sabarimala Temple (Lord Ayyappa) me manaya jane wala ek pavan tyohar hai. Makar Sankranti ke din Ponnambalamedu hill par ek 'Jyoti' (roshni) dikhayi deti hai, jise Makaravilakku kehte hain. Kerala ke dusre famous festivals Onam aur Vishu hain. Yaad rakho: Sabarimala + Makar Sankranti = Makaravilakku.
why: GALAT ✗ – Tamil Nadu me Makar Sankranti ko 'Pongal' ke roop me 4 dino tak manaya jata hai, jisme Surya Dev ki puja hoti hai. Makaravilakku specific Kerala se juda hai.
GALAT ✗ – Odisha me Makar Sankranti par 'Makara Mela' lagta hai aur Konark Sun Temple me vishesh puja hoti hai, par Makaravilakku wahan ka event nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Karnataka me ise 'Suggi' kehte hain jahan bailon (bulls) ko sajaya jata hai. Makaravilakku ritual sirf Kerala ke temple tradition se belong karta hai.
SAHI ✓ – Kerala ke Pathanamthitta district me Sabarimala shrine par ye annual festival hota hai, jahan lakho devotees darshan ke liye aate hain.

festivals.q: Which of the following festivals is celebrated for fertility and better fortune in Jharkhand?
festivals.solution: Jawa festival Jharkhand ki unmarried tribal ladkiyon dwara 'fertility' aur ache fortune ke liye manaya jata hai. Isme ek basket me sprouts (ankurit anaaj) ugae jaate hain. Jharkhand ke tyohar aksar nature aur agriculture se jude hote hain. Yaad rakho: Jawa = Jharkhandi girls' fertility festival.
why: GALAT ✗ – Karam festival Jharkhand aur Chhattisgarh me 'Karam Devta' (Shakti aur Yauvan ke devta) ki puja ke liye hota hai, ye fertility specific Jawa jitna focus nahi karta.
GALAT ✗ – Sarhul Jharkhand ka 'New Year' festival hai jahan Sal vriksh (Sal tree) ki puja ki jati hai. Ye Jharkhand ka sabse bada tribal festival hai.
GALAT ✗ – Sohrai ek harvest festival hai jo pashu-dhan (cattle) ke liye hota hai. Isme ghar ki deewaron par Sohrai art banayi jati hai.
SAHI ✓ – Jawa hi wo festival hai jisme kunwari kanyaayein ache ghar-parivar aur fertility ki kamna karti hain.

festivals.q: Which of the following festivals is called the month of merits and is celebrated between May and June?
festivals.solution: Saga Dawa Sikkim ka sabse pavitra Buddhist festival hai. Ise 'Month of Merits' isliye kehte hain kyunki maana jata hai ki is mahine me kiye gaye punya (good deeds) ka phal 1 lakh guna badh jata hai. Ye Lord Buddha ke birth, enlightenment aur parinirvana ko commemorate karta hai. Yaad rakho: Saga Dawa = Sikkim/Tibetan Buddha Purnima.
why: SAHI ✓ – Saga Dawa Tibetan calendar ke 4th month me hota hai (May-June) aur ise 'Triple Blessed Festival' bhi kaha jata hai.
GALAT ✗ – Bhanu Jayanti Sikkim aur Nepal me 'Adikavi' Bhanubhakta Acharya ki yaad me manayi jati hai, ye merit-based religious month nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Losar 'Tibetan New Year' ko kehte hain jo February ke mahine me padta hai, na ki May-June me.
GALAT ✗ – Losoong Sikkim ka harvest festival hai jo December me Bhutia aur Lepcha tribes dwara manaya jata hai.

festivals.q: Which of the following festivals is celebrated as a kite-flying festival across India?
festivals.solution: Makar Sankranti jab Surya 'Makara' rashi me pravesh karta hai, tab poore Bharat me alag-alag naam se manaya jata hai. Gujarat aur Rajasthan me ise 'International Kite Festival' (Uttarayan) ke roop me bade star par manaya jata hai. Science ke hisaab se, patang udane se thand ke baad body ko dhoop (Vitamin D) milti hai. Yaad rakho: Sankranti = Patang (Kites).
why: SAHI ✓ – Makar Sankranti hi wo tyohar hai jab aakash rang-birangi patango se bhar jata hai, khas karke Gujarat me jahan ise Uttarayan kehte hain.
GALAT ✗ – Holi rangon (colors) ka tyohar hai jo Phalgun purnima ko manaya jata hai, isme patang udane ka prachalan nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Janmashtami Lord Krishna ke janmotsav ka tyohar hai, jisme 'Dahi Handi' ka mahatva zyada hota hai.
GALAT ✗ – Durga Puja West Bengal ka pramukh tyohar hai jo burayi par acchayi ki jeet (Goddess Durga vs Mahishasura) ka prateek hai.

festivals.q: In which festival of Maharashtra and Chhattisgarh, are the bullocks and other cattles used for agriculture worshipped?
festivals.solution: Pola festival Maharashtra aur Chhattisgarh ke farmers ka ek mukhya tyohar hai. Is din bailon (bulls/oxen) ko acche se sajaya jata hai aur unki pooja ki jati hai kyunki wo saal bhar kheti me kisan ka sath dete hain. Ye Shravan Amavasya (Pithori Amavasya) ko manaya jata hai. Yaad rakho: Pola = 'Pura' (Full) samman bailon ko.
why: SAHI ✓ – Pola festival me kheti me kaam aane wale bailon aur pashuon ka dhanyavad kiya jata hai. Ye Nagpur aur Vidarbha region me bahut famous hai.

GALAT ✗ – Jiviti Puja Maharashtra me Shravan mahine ke shukravaar ko hoti hai, jisme maayein apne bacchon ki lambi umar aur raksha ke liye Jiviti devi ki pooja karti hain. Iska bailon se sambandh nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Vata Poornima me suhagan mahilayein apne pati ki lambi aayu ke liye 'Bargad' (Banyan tree) ki pooja karti hain aur uske chaaro taraf dhaaga bandhti hain.
GALAT ✗ – Ganga Dussehra mukhya roop se UP aur Uttarakhand me Ma Ganga ke dharti par aane ki khushi me manaya jata hai, isme pashu poojan mukhya nahi hai.

festivals.q: 'Ugadi' is the famous festival of which of the following states?
festivals.solution: Ugadi (Yugadi) South India ka New Year festival hai jo Chaitra mahine ke pehle din manaya jata hai. Is din 'Ugadi Pachadi' banayi jati hai jisme 6 alag swad (sweet, sour, salt, bitter, etc.) hote hain jo life ke alag emotions ko darshate hain. Karnataka aur Telangana me bhi ise utsah se manate hain. Yaad rakho: U-Ga-Di (U = Uttar, Gadi = Beginning of age).
why: GALAT ✗ – Punjab ka naya saal 'Baisakhi' ke roop me manaya jata hai, jo harvest season aur Khalsa Panth ki sthapna ka din hai.
GALAT ✗ – Goa me New Year aur harvest festivals me 'Shigmo' aur 'Sao Joao' jaise bade tyohar hote hain, Ugadi wahan ka mukhya parv nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Uttar Pradesh me naya saal 'Chaitra Pratipada' ya 'Hindu Nav Varsh' ke naam se jana jata hai, Ugadi term wahan use nahi hota.
SAHI ✓ – Andhra Pradesh me Ugadi ko naye saal ke roop me manaya jata hai. Ye Brahma ji dwara srishti ki rachna ka din mana jata hai.

festivals.q: 'Bhand Pather' is a form of theatre dance performed in _____.
festivals.solution: Bhand Pather Kashmir ka sadiyon purana folk theatre hai. 'Band' ka matlab hota hai 'Actor' aur 'Pather' ka matlab 'Drama'. Isme mukhya roop se 'Surnai' (shehnai jaisa), 'Dhol' aur 'Nagara' bajaya jata hai. Ye aksar khule maidanon me hota hai aur isme social satire (vyangya) hota hai. Yaad rakho: Kashmir ki 'Thandi' me 'Bhand' (Bhand Pather).
why: GALAT ✗ – Goa ka lok rangmanch 'Dashavatar' aur 'Tiatr' hai, jo wahan ki sanskriti aur history ko dikhata hai.
GALAT ✗ – Haryana me 'Saang' (Swang) theatre kaafi popular hai jo kathaon aur geeton par aadharit hota hai.
GALAT ✗ – Sikkim me 'Chu-Faat' jaise dance aur Buddhist mask dances (Cham) mukhya hain, Bhand Pather yahan ka nahi hai.
SAHI ✓ – Bhand Pather Kashmir ki Muslim community ke 'Bhand' (performers) dwara kiya jane wala traditional satirical drama hai.

festivals.q: In which of the following states is the 'Eco Retreat' festival held every year?
festivals.solution: Eco Retreat Odisha Tourism ka ek flagship festival hai jise 'Glamping' (Glamorous Camping) concept par banaya gaya hai. Ye Konark, Bhitarkanika aur Hirakud jaise sundar locations par luxury tents laga kar manaya jata hai taaki tourism ko badhava mile. Yaad rakho: Odisha = Eco (Ocean aur Nature ka mel).
why: SAHI ✓ – Odisha sarkar ise har saal December se February ke beech nature aur luxury tourism ko promote karne ke liye organize karti hai.
GALAT ✗ – Tamil Nadu me Pongal aur Natyanjali jaise bade festivals hote hain, lekin Eco Retreat wahan ka branded festival nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Assam apne 'Bihu' aur 'Ambubachi Mela' ke liye jana jata hai. Yahan ka tourism 'Kaziranga' aur tea gardens par focus karta hai.
GALAT ✗ – Bihar me 'Chhath Puja' aur 'Sonepur Mela' mukhya hain. Eco Retreat jaisa luxury camping festival Odisha ki pehchaan hai.

festivals.q: In which of the following months is the ‘Valvil Ori Vizha’ festival of Tamil Nadu celebrated?
festivals.solution: Valvil Ori Vizha Tamil Nadu ke Namakkal district me Kolli Hills par manaya jata hai. Ye raja 'Valvil Ori' ki yaad me hota hai jo Sangam era ke ek mahaan dhanurdhar (archer) aur 'Seven Patrons' (Pari, Ori, etc.) me se ek the. August me 'Aadi' mahine ke samay archeries competitions bhi hote hain. Yaad rakho: Ori = Archer (August me).
why: GALAT ✗ – May me mukhya roop se summer festivals hote hain, lekin Valvil Ori ka sambandh Aadi Perukku ke aas-pass August se hai.
GALAT ✗ – June me Tamil Nadu me koi bada mukhya state festival nahi hota, ye monsoon ke shuruat ka samay hota hai.
GALAT ✗ – January me Tamil Nadu ka sabse bada tyohar 'Pongal' hota hai, jo harvest festival hai. Valvil Ori is samay nahi hota.
SAHI ✓ – August (Aadi month) me ye do-din ka festival hota hai jisme raja ki murti par maalyarpan kiya jata hai aur archery dikhayi jati hai.

festivals.q: With which of the following states is the ‘Sao Joao’ festival associated?
festivals.solution: Sao Joao festival Goa ka ek bahut hi lively event hai jo St. John the Baptist ko tribute dene ke liye June 24 ko celebrate kiya jata hai. Isme log 'Vocti' (crown of flowers) pehente hain aur wells/ponds mein jump lagate hain. Ye monsoon ke arrival ki khushi mein hota hai. Yaad rakho: Goa ke baaki festivals Sunburn, Mando aur Feast of St. Francis Xavier bhi exams ke liye important hain.
why: GALAT ✗ – Karnataka apne Kambala (buffalo race) aur Ugadi festivals ke liye jana jata hai. Is prashn ke context mein ye galat hai kyunki Sao Joao ek Catholic tradition hai jo Goa se juda hai.
GALAT ✗ – Kerala mein Onam aur Vishu jaise bade tyohar hote hain. Yahan boat races (Vallam Kali) famous hain, lekin Sao Joao yahan ka mukhya festival nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Tamil Nadu mein Pongal aur Puthandu (New Year) manaye jate hain. Sao Joao ka culture Tamil Nadu ke Dravidian heritage se match nahi karta.
SAHI ✓ – Goa mein hi Sao Joao manaya jata hai jahan log 'Viva Sao Joao' chillate hue paani mein koodte hain aur fruits exchange karte hain.

festivals.q: ______ festival in the Bastar region is celebrated along with the worship of the local goddess, Kesharpal Kesharpalin Devi.
festivals.solution: Madai Festival Chhattisgarh ki Gond tribe dwara Bastar region mein dhoom-dhaam se manaya jata hai. Isme Kesharpal Kesharpalin Devi ki pooja hoti hai aur tribal dances jaise 'Saila' perform kiye jate hain. Ye festival December se March ke beech alag-alag jagaho par hota hai. Yaad rakho: Bastar Dussehra (75 days) aur Madai dono Chhattisgarh ke signature tribal events hain.
why: GALAT ✗ – Phool Dei Uttarakhand ka 'Harvest Festival' hai jisme bacche ghar-ghar jakar phool rakhte hain. Ye Chhattisgarh ke Bastar region se sambandhit nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Harela Uttarakhand ke Kumaon region ka tyohar hai jo paryavaran aur kheti (monsoon arrival) se juda hai. Iska Kesharpalin Devi se koi lena-dena nahi hai.
SAHI ✓ – Madai hi wo tyohar hai jisme local deities aur Kesharpalin Devi ki pooja Bastar ke tribals dwara ki jati hai.
GALAT ✗ – Khatarua Uttarakhand ka ek bonfire festival hai jo jeet (victory) ka prateek hai. Ye Bastar region ka tribal festival nahi hai.

festivals.q: ‘Float Festival’ is one of the main festivals celebrated in ______.
festivals.solution: Float Festival, jise local language mein 'Teppotsavam' ya 'Teppam' kaha jata hai, Madurai (Tamil Nadu) ka ek shandaar utsav hai. Ye Mariamman Teppakulam lake mein full moon night (Thai Pousham) par manaya jata hai. Bhagwan Sundareshwar aur Devi Meenakshi ki idols ko ek decorated boat (float) par bithakar taalab mein ghumaya jata hai. Yaad rakho: Madurai ko 'City of Festivals' bhi kehte hain.
why: GALAT ✗ – Puducherry mein Bastille Day aur Fête de la Musique jaise French influence wale festivals hote hain. Float Festival yahan ka mukhya icon nahi hai.
SAHI ✓ – Madurai ke Meenakshi Temple ke paas wale Teppakulam lake mein hi ye prashiddh Float Festival har saal manaya jata hai.
GALAT ✗ – Kanyakumari apne Cape Comorin festival ke liye jana jata hai. Halaki wahan bhi temples hain, par 'Theppam' festival Madurai ki pehchan hai.
GALAT ✗ – Kannur (Kerala) Theyyam dance ke liye famous hai. Float festival (Teppotsavam) Tamil Nadu ke temple culture ka hissa hai, Kannur ka nahi.

festivals.q: 'Vallam Kali Boat Race' is held in which state?
festivals.solution: Vallam Kali jise 'Snake Boat Race' bhi kehte hain, Kerala ke Onam festival ka sabse bada attraction hai. Ye race Punnamada Lake (Alappuzha) mein hoti hai jahan lambi-lambi chundan vallams (boats) ka muqabla hota hai. Is race ke winner ko 'Nehru Trophy' di jati hai. Yaad rakho: Ye boat races Kerala ki maritime history aur team spirit ko darshati hain.
why: SAHI ✓ – Kerala mein hi Vallam Kali boat race hoti hai, jo duniya ki sabse badi team sport mani jati hai.
GALAT ✗ – Tamil Nadu mein Jallikattu (bull-taming) hota hai, boat race yahan ka traditional state-level event nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – West Bengal mein Durga Puja aur Baul sangeet famous hai. Yahan ki naukavihar (boating) spiritual hoti hai, aisi massive race nahi hoti.
GALAT ✗ – Andhra Pradesh mein Sankranti aur Ugadi main hain. Vallam Kali specific Kerala ka hi cultural heritage hai.

festivals.q: Which of the following options is correct?
options: He was called a scribe who could read, write and teach Arabic
Graffiti is a hanging rock painting
Gulfroshan is a festival of flowers
Aurang was a type of horse trading
festivals.answer: Gulfroshan is a festival of flowers
festivals.solution: Gulfroshan, jise 'Phool Walon Ki Sair' bhi kehte hain, Delhi ke Mehrauli mein manaya jane wala ek communal harmony ka festival hai. Isme Hindu aur Muslim dono milkar Pankha aur Phoolon ki chadar chadhate hain (Yogmaya Temple aur Bakhtiyar Kaki Dargah par). Ye Akbar Shah II ke zamane se chala aa raha hai. Yaad rakho: Ye festival Delhi ki 'Ganga-Jamuni Tehzeeb' ka symbol hai.
why: GALAT ✗ – Scribe (Kaatib) wo hota hai jo documents copy karta hai, ye keval Arabic sikhane wale teacher ke liye limited term nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Graffiti deewaron par ki gayi drawing ya writing hoti hai (aksar public places pe), ye 'hanging rock painting' nahi hai.
SAHI ✓ – Gulfroshan ka literal matlab hi 'flowers ki numayish' hai, aur ye Delhi ka famous flower festival hai.
GALAT ✗ – Aurang Mughal kal mein 'Warehouse' ya godown ko kaha jata tha jahan maal rakha jata tha, ye horse trading se juda term nahi hai.

festivals.q: Eid-ul-fitr is celebrated on seeing which of the following?
festivals.solution: Eid-ul-Fitr, Islamic calendar ke Shawwal mahine ke pehle din manayi jati hai. Ye Ramadan ke 30 rozo ke khatam hone ki khushi me hota hai. Iska nirdharan 'Hilal' yani naye chand ki sighting par depend karta hai. Yaad rakho: 'Eid = Crescent Moon (Dooj ka Chand)'.
why: GALAT ✗ – Full moon (Purnima) ko chand pura gol hota hai, jabki Eid ki shuruat barik chand dekh kar hoti hai.
GALAT ✗ – Gibbous moon wo phase hai jab chand 50% se zyada par 100% se kam chamakta hai. Eid is par depend nahi karti.
SAHI ✓ – Crescent moon (Hansiya jaisa chand) ki sighting hote hi Eid-ul-Fitr ki shuruat mani jati hai, ise 'Hilal' bhi kehte hain.
GALAT ✗ – New moon (Amavasya) ke samay chand bilkul dikhayi nahi deta, jabki Eid ke liye chand ka dikhna zaroori hai.

festivals.q: Which festival is celebrated annually in Ladakh region, on the first day of the eleventh month of the Tibetan calendar?
festivals.solution: Losar Ladakh aur Tibetan Buddhism ka sabse mahatvapurn New Year festival hai. Ye Tibetan calendar ke 11th month (aksar Feb/March) me shuru hota hai. Isme 'Metho' procession aur traditional dances hote hain. Yaad rakho: 'Losar = Ladakh/Tibetan New Year'.
why: GALAT ✗ – Lohri Punjab ka harvest festival hai jo har saal 13 January ko manaya jata hai, iska Tibetan calendar se taluq nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Makar Sankranti Surya ke Makar rashi me pravesh ka tyohar hai jo 14/15 January ko pure Bharat me alag naamo se manaya jata hai.
GALAT ✗ – Holi pure Bharat ka rangon ka tyohar hai jo Falgun Purnima ko aata hai, ye Ladakh ka specific 11th month festival nahi hai.
SAHI ✓ – Losar Ladakh me Tibetan New Year ke roop me manaya jata hai aur ye 11th month ke pehle din se shuru hota hai.

festivals.q: Losar festival is celebrated by which tribal community?
festivals.solution: Losar festival Arunachal Pradesh ki Monpa tribe dwara Tawang aur West Kameng regions me dhoom-dhaam se manaya jata hai. Ye 3-15 din tak chalta hai. Monpa community Mahayana Buddhism ko follow karti hai. Yaad rakho: 'Monpa = Losar (Arunachal)'.
why: SAHI ✓ – Monpa tribe Arunachal Pradesh ki ek pramukh community hai jo Losar ko apne New Year ke roop me manati hai.
GALAT ✗ – Khasi tribe Meghalaya ki hai, inka mukhya tyohar 'Nongkrem' aur 'Wangala' (Garo ke saath) hote hain, Losar nahi.
GALAT ✗ – Munda tribe Jharkhand aur Odisha region ki hai, inka sabse bada festival 'Sarhul' hota hai.
GALAT ✗ – Kodava tribe Karnataka (Coorg) ki hai, jo 'Kailpodh' aur 'Puthari' jaise harvest festivals ke liye jaani jati hai.

festivals.q: Which festival is celebrated on the full moon of the Phalgun month?
festivals.solution: Holi Hindu calendar ke aakhri mahine 'Phalguna' ki Purnima ko manayi jati hai. Isse ek raat pehle 'Holika Dahan' hota hai. Iske baad naya saal aur Chaitra mahina shuru hone ki taiyari hoti hai. Yaad rakho: 'Phalguna Purnima = Holi'.
why: GALAT ✗ – Raksha Bandhan 'Shravan' (Saawan) mahine ki Purnima ko manaya jata hai, Phalgun me nahi.
GALAT ✗ – Vat Purnima 'Jyeshtha' mahine ki Purnima ko manayi jati hai, jisme suhagin mahilayein Bargad (Banyan tree) ki puja karti hain.
GALAT ✗ – Navratri saal me do baar (Chaitra aur Ashwin) Shukla Paksha ki Pratipada (1st day) se shuru hoti hai, Purnima ko nahi.
SAHI ✓ – Holi hi wo pramukh tyohar hai jo Phalguna mahine ki Purnima ko pure Bharat me harshollas se manaya jata hai.

festivals.q: Onam is a traditional Hindu festival celebrated in
festivals.solution: Onam Kerala ka sabse bada harvest festival hai jo Malayalam mahine 'Chingam' mein manaya jata hai. Ye King Mahabali ke swagat mein 10 dinon tak chalta hai. Isme Vallam Kali (Boat Race) aur Pookalam (Flower Rangoli) bahut famous hain. Yaad rakho: Onam = Kerala = King Mahabali.
why: GALAT ✗ – Andhra Pradesh mein mukhyatah Ugadi (New Year) aur Brahmotsavam bade star par manaye jate hain. Isliye ye option galat hai.
SAHI ✓ – Onam Kerala ka state festival hai jo harvest season ke baad King Mahabali ki yaad mein manaya jata hai.
GALAT ✗ – Tamil Nadu ka pramukh harvest festival Pongal hai, Onam nahi. Yahan Puthandu (New Year) bhi manaya jata hai.
GALAT ✗ – Karnataka mein Ugadi aur Hampi Utsav bade tyohar hain. Onam yahan ka mukhya tyohar nahi hai.

festivals.q: Which festival is celebrated in Kerala when a crop is harvested ?
festivals.solution: Kerala mein rice harvest (dhan ki katai) ke waqt Onam manaya jata hai. Ye Malayalam Calendar ke hisaab se naye saal ki shuruat bhi hoti hai. Is tyohar par 'Sadya' (ek bada bhojan) parosa jata hai. SSC Fact: Onam 10 din chalta hai aur iska aakhri din 'Thiruonam' sabse mahatvapurn hai.
why: GALAT ✗ – Lohri Punjab ka harvest festival hai jo winters (January) mein aag jalakar manaya jata hai. Iska Kerala se sambandh nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Pongal Tamil Nadu ka harvest festival hai. Halanki ye bhi South India ka hai, par state Kerala nahi Tamil Nadu hai.
SAHI ✓ – Onam hi wo tyohar hai jo Kerala mein fasal ki katai aur Raja Bali ke samman mein manaya jata hai.
GALAT ✗ – Baisakhi Punjab aur Haryana ka harvest festival hai jo Sikh New Year ke roop mein manaya jata hai.

festivals.q: Which festival is celebrated on the first day of Uttarayana?
festivals.solution: Uttarayana wo samay hai jab Surya Uttar (North) ki disha mein sankraman karta hai, ise Makar Sankranti ke naam se jana jata hai. Tamil Nadu mein isi din ko 'Pongal' ke roop mein manate hain. Ye festival Surya Dev ko samarpit hai. Yaad rakho: Jallikattu (Bull taming) Pongal ka hi hissa hai.
why: GALAT ✗ – Vat Purnima Maharashtra aur Gujarat mein suhagan mahilayein apne pati ki lambi umar ke liye manati hain, ye Uttarayana se related nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Guru Purnima Guruon ke samman mein Ashadha mahine mein manayi jati hai, iska Uttarayana se koi lena-dena nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Onam Kerala ka festival hai jo August-September (Chingam month) mein aata hai, na ki January (Uttarayana) mein.
SAHI ✓ – Pongal hi Tamil Nadu mein Uttarayana/Makar Sankranti ke din shuru hone wala 4-din ka harvest festival hai.

festivals.q: Pongal festival is celebrated for four days in Tamil Nadu. What is the fourth day of Pongal called?
festivals.solution: Pongal 4 din ka festival hai: 1. Bhogi Pongal (Indra Dev), 2. Surya Pongal (Sun God), 3. Mattu Pongal (Cows/Bulls), 4. Kaanum Pongal (Family meeting). SSC aksar inka kram (order) puchta hai. Yaad rakho: B-S-M-K (Bhogi, Surya, Mattu, Kaanum).
why: GALAT ✗ – Thai Pongal dusra aur sabse main din hota hai jab chawal aur doodh ka 'Pongal' banakar Surya Dev ko chadhaya jata hai.
SAHI ✓ – Kaanum Pongal hi chautha (4th) aur aakhri din hota hai jisme log doston aur rishtedaroon se milte hain.
GALAT ✗ – Mattu Pongal teesra (3rd) din hota hai jo kheti mein madad karne wale pashuon (Bulls/Cows) ko samarpit hai.
GALAT ✗ – Bhogi Pongal pehla (1st) din hota hai jisme purani cheezon ko jalakar naye ki shuruat ki jati hai.

festivals.q: Jallikattu is associated with which Indian festival?
festivals.solution: Jallikattu ek ancient sport hai jisme saand (bull) ko kabu kiya jata hai. Ye Tamil Nadu mein 'Mattu Pongal' (Pongal ka teesra din) ke mauke par hota hai. Ise 'Eru Thazhuvuthal' bhi kehte hain. Supreme Court ke ban aur phir hatne ki wajah se ye hamesha news mein rehta hai.
why: GALAT ✗ – Onam ke dauran 'Vallam Kali' (Boat Race) hoti hai, Jallikattu nahi. Onam Kerala ka hai.
SAHI ✓ – Jallikattu Tamil Nadu ke Pongal festival ka ek atoot hissa hai, jo pashuon ke prati samman dikhane ke liye hota hai.
GALAT ✗ – Bihu Assam ka festival hai jahan 'Bulbul fight' jaise khel hote thay, par Jallikattu wahan nahi hota.
GALAT ✗ – Hornbill Festival Nagaland ka cultural festival hai jise 'Festivals of Festivals' kaha jata hai, iska bull-taming se koi rishta nahi.

festivals.q: In which state is the festival of Uttarayan uniquely celebrated?
festivals.solution: Uttarayan, jise International Kite Festival bhi kehte hain, Gujarat ka sabse bada tyohar hai. Ye har saal 14 January ko Makar Sankranti ke din manaya jata hai jab Suraj (Sun) North ki taraf move karta hai. Ahmedabad me is din 'Patang-baazi' ka bada level par aayojan hota hai. Yaad rakho: Gujarat = Patang = Uttarayan.
why: GALAT ✗ – Jharkhand me is samay 'Tusu Parab' manaya jata hai jo ki ek harvest festival hai. Isliye ye Uttarayan ke liye sahi nahi hai.
SAHI ✓ – Gujarat me Makar Sankranti ko 'Uttarayan' kaha jata hai, jahan asman patango se bhar jata hai aur Undhiyu-Jalebi khayi jati hai.
GALAT ✗ – Uttar Pradesh me ise mukhya roop se 'Khichdi' ya Makar Sankranti kaha jata hai, halanki kuch hisso me Uttarayan term use hota hai par uniquely ye Gujarat se juda hai.
GALAT ✗ – Kerala me is samay 'Makaravilakku' festival Sabarimala temple me manaya jata hai, wahan ise Uttarayan nahi kehte.

festivals.q: Sankranti, the harvest festival, is celebrated in the month of Magh of the Hindu calendar and is known by different names in different parts of India. What is it called in Gujarat?
festivals.solution: Makar Sankranti ek harvest festival hai jiske alag-alag states me vibhinn naam hain. Gujarat me ise 'Uttarayan' kehte hain. Yahan log dhago (manjha) aur patango ke sath terrace par pura din bitate hain. Exam ke liye yaad rakho: Punjab me Lohri, Tamil Nadu me Pongal, aur Assam me Magh Bihu.
why: GALAT ✗ – Lohri Punjab aur Haryana ka tyohar hai jo Sankranti se ek din pehle aag (bonfire) jala kar manaya jata hai.
GALAT ✗ – Pana Sankranti Odisha ka New Year festival hai jise 'Maha Vishuva Sankranti' bhi kehte hain.
GALAT ✗ – Maghi Punjab me Makar Sankranti ka hi naam hai, jahan Muktsar me mela lagta hai.
SAHI ✓ – Gujarat me Sankranti ko 'Uttarayan' kaha jata hai, jo suraj ke uttar disha me pravesh ka pratik hai.

festivals.q: The Festival _____ has various names, Khichdi, Uttarayan and Lohri.
festivals.solution: Makar Sankranti Bharat ka wo tyohar hai jo lagbhag har state me alag naam se manaya jata hai. UP/Bihar me 'Khichdi', Gujarat me 'Uttarayan', Punjab me 'Lohri/Maghi', aur Assam me 'Bihu'. Ye sun ke movement aur fasal ki katai se juda hai. Yaad rakho: 'Khichdi' khayi jati hai aur 'Lohri' jalayi jati hai.
why: GALAT ✗ – Holi rango ka tyohar hai jo Phalgun maas me manaya jata hai, iska Khichdi ya Uttarayan se sambandh nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Ganesh Chaturthi Maharashtra ka pramukh tyohar hai jo Bhadrapada mahine me aata hai.
GALAT ✗ – Dussehra ya Vijayadashami burayi par achayi ki jeet ka tyohar hai jo Ashwin maas me manaya jata hai.
SAHI ✓ – Makar Sankranti hi wo common festival hai jise Khichdi, Uttarayan aur Lohri jaise anant naamo se jana jata hai.

festivals.q: Hareli is the harvest festival of which state?
festivals.solution: Hareli Chhattisgarh ka sabse pehla tyohar mana jata hai jo Shravan Amavasya ko hota hai. Is din kisan apne kheti ke auzaro (tools) ki puja karte hain aur 'Bhelwa' ped ki patiyan khet me lagate hain taaki keede na lagen. 'Gedi' dance is tyohar ka main attraction hai. Yaad rakho: Hareli = Hariyali (Greenery) = Chhattisgarh.
why: GALAT ✗ – Assam ka main harvest festival 'Bihu' hai, Hareli wahan ka nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Andhra Pradesh me Sankranti aur Ugadi jaise bade harvest festivals manaye jate hain.
GALAT ✗ – Himachal Pradesh me 'Halda' aur 'Sazo' jaise festivals hote hain jo fasal se jude hain.
SAHI ✓ – Hareli Chhattisgarh ka kheti se juda mukhya tyohar hai jisme auzaro ki puja hoti hai.

festivals.q: In which state the Feast of St. Francis Xavier festival is celebrated?
festivals.solution: Feast of St. Francis Xavier Goa ka ek bahut hi pavitra tyohar hai jo har saal 3 December ko manaya jata hai. Ye St. Francis Xavier ki death anniversary par hota hai. Unki body 'Basilica of Bom Jesus' (Old Goa) me rakhi gayi hai, jo ek UNESCO World Heritage site hai. Yaad rakho: Basilica of Bom Jesus = St. Francis Xavier = Goa.
why: GALAT ✗ – Kerala me 'Onam' aur 'Vishu' jaise festivals ki dhoom hoti hai, ye feast wahan ka main event nahi hai.
SAHI ✓ – Goa me St. Francis Xavier ko 'Goencho Saib' (Lord of Goa) kaha jata hai aur ye unka hi feast hai.
GALAT ✗ – Assam me Vaishnavite culture jyada hai jahan Bihu aur Ambubachi Mela lagta hai.
GALAT ✗ – Arunachal Pradesh me tribal festivals jaise Losar aur Solung manaye jate hain.

festivals.q: Hemis, the two–day religious festival is from which part of India?
festivals.solution: Hemis Festival Ladakh ka sabse famous Buddhist festival hai, jo Guru Padmasambhava (Guru Rinpoche) ki birth anniversary par manaya jata hai. Isme monks 'Chams' naam ka masked dance perform karte hain, jo burayi par achayi ki jeet dikhata hai. Ye festival Hemis Monastery mein hota hai jo Drukpa lineage se juda hai. Yaad rakho: Hemis = Ladakh ka Mask Dance.
why: GALAT ✗ – Assam apne Bihu, Ambubachi Mela aur Sattriya dance ke liye jana jata hai. Is prashn ke liye ye nahi, kyunki Hemis ek Himalayan Buddhist festival hai jo Northeast mein nahi manaya jata.
SAHI ✓ – Ladakh mein Hemis Gompa mein ye 2-day festival hota hai jisme colorful masks aur Tibetan culture ki jhalak dikhti hai.
GALAT ✗ – Himachal Pradesh mein Kullu Dussehra aur Losar jaise tyohar hote hain. Is prashn ke liye ye nahi, kyunki Hemis specifically Ladakh ki pehchan hai.
GALAT ✗ – Goa apne Carnival aur Shigmo festival ke liye famous hai jo Christian aur Konkani culture dikhata hai. Iska Buddhist traditions se lena-dena nahi hai.

festivals.q: Kala Ghoda Arts festival is held in which city?
festivals.solution: Kala Ghoda Arts Festival (KGAF) South Mumbai ke iconic Kala Ghoda district mein har saal February ke pehle Saturday se shuru hota hai. Ye 9 din ka multi-cultural festival hai jisme cinema, theatre, dance, aur visual arts ka sangam hota hai. 1999 mein shuru hua ye event ab India ka sabse bada street art festival ban gaya hai. Yaad rakho: Kala Ghoda = Mumbai ka Street Art.
why: GALAT ✗ – New Delhi mein Surajkund (NCR) aur National Street Food Festival hote hain. Is prashn ke liye ye nahi, kyunki Kala Ghoda Mumbai ki heritage se juda hai.
GALAT ✗ – Hyderabad apne Bathukamma aur Bonalu festivals ke liye jana jata hai. Is prashn ke liye ye nahi, kyunki ye Mumbai ka specific area-based festival hai.
GALAT ✗ – Pune mein Sawai Gandharva Bhimsen Mahotsav (classical music) hota hai. Is prashn ke liye ye nahi, kyunki Kala Ghoda arts festival Mumbai mein hi ayojit hota hai.
SAHI ✓ – Mumbai ke South area mein ye festival heritage preservation aur art culture ko celebrate karne ke liye hota hai.

festivals.q: The Desert Festival is held in………
festivals.solution: Desert Festival (Maru Mahotsav) Rajasthan Tourism dwara Jaisalmer ki Sam Sand Dunes mein har saal February (Magh month) mein manaya jata hai. Isme Gair aur Fire dance, Turban tying (pagdi bandhna), aur sabse lambi mooch (Longest Moustache) ki competition hoti hai. Ye Rajasthan ke culture aur camels ko promote karta hai. Yaad rakho: Maru Mahotsav = Golden City Jaisalmer.
why: GALAT ✗ – Barmer mein 'Thar Festival' hota hai. Halanki ye bhi desert area hai, par official 'Desert Festival' Jaisalmer ki pehchan hai.
SAHI ✓ – Jaisalmer ki retile teelo (sand dunes) par ye 3 din ka grand event hota hai jo world famous hai.
GALAT ✗ – Sahara duniya ka sabse bada desert hai jo Africa mein hai. Is prashn ke liye ye nahi, kyunki hum Indian festivals ki baat kar rahe hain.
GALAT ✗ – Thar ek pura desert region hai jo Rajasthan aur Pakistan tak faila hai. Ye ek specific shahar nahi hai jahan festival plan ho sake.

festivals.q: Gugga Naumi is a religious festival in connection with snake-worship. This festival is of which state?
festivals.solution: Gugga Naumi Haryana aur Punjab ka ek mahatvapurn lok tyohar hai jo Bhadrapad mahine ki Navami ko manaya jata hai. Ye 'Goga Ji' (Snake God) ko samarpit hai, jo Chauhan Rajput yoddha the. Maana jata hai ki unki puja se saanp ke kaatne ka dar nahi rehta. Isme 'Deru' naam ka instrument bajaya jata hai. Yaad rakho: Gugga Naumi = Haryana ka Snake Worship.
why: SAHI ✓ – Haryana mein ye tyohar badi shradha se manaya jata hai, jahan Goga ji ke bhakt 'Chhadi' (flag) lekar procession nikalte hain.
GALAT ✗ – West Bengal mein snake worship 'Manasa Puja' ke roop mein hoti hai. Is prashn ke liye ye nahi, kyunki Gugga Naumi North India ka term hai.
GALAT ✗ – Gujarat mein Tarnetar Mela aur Navratri famous hai. Is prashn ke liye ye nahi, kyunki Gugga Naumi wahan ka primary snake festival nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Maharashtra mein 'Nag Panchami' bahut bade star par manayi jati hai. Is prashn ke liye ye nahi, kyunki Gugga Naumi specific regional name Haryana se juda hai.

festivals.q: "Ganga Sagar Mela" fair is held in which state?
festivals.solution: Ganga Sagar Mela Kumbh Mela ke baad India ka doosra sabse bada mela hai. Ye West Bengal ke Sagar Island (Sagar Dweep) par manaya jata hai jahan Ganga nadi Bay of Bengal mein milti hai. Makar Sankranti (Jan 14-15) par shradhalu yahan pavitra dubki lagate hain. Ek kahavat famous hai: 'Sab teerth baar baar, Ganga Sagar ek baar'. Yaad rakho: Ganga Sagar = West Bengal ka Island Mela.
why: GALAT ✗ – Uttarakhand mein Kumbh Mela (Haridwar) hota hai. Is prashn ke liye ye nahi, kyunki Ganga Sagar wahan hota hai jahan nadi samudra mein milti hai (delta region).
GALAT ✗ – Uttar Pradesh mein Prayagraj (Sangam) mein Magh Mela aur Kumbh hota hai. Is prashn ke liye ye nahi, kyunki Ganga Sagar specific island West Bengal mein hai.
SAHI ✓ – West Bengal ke Hooghly river ke muhane (mouth) par ye mela lagta hai jahan Ganga aur Sagar ka milan hota hai.
GALAT ✗ – Maharashtra mein Nashik Kumbh mela Godavari nadi par hota hai. Is prashn ke liye ye nahi, kyunki Ganga nadi wahan se nahi behti.

festivals.q: Where is Pushkar Fair held?
festivals.solution: Pushkar Mela Rajasthan ke Ajmer district mein Pushkar Lake ke kinare lagta hai. Ye duniya ka sabse bada 'Camel Fair' (Oont Mela) maana jata hai jo Kartik Purnima ko manaya jata hai. Yahan Pushkar Lake mein shahi snaan ka mahatva hai aur Brahma ji ka ekmatra pramukh mandir bhi yahin hai. Yaad rakho: Pushkar = Rajasthan ka Rajasthan Culture ka Kumbh.
why: GALAT ✗ – Bihar apne 'Sonepur Mela' ke liye jana jata hai, jo Asia ka sabse bada cattle fair hai. Is prashn ke liye ye nahi kyunki Pushkar Rajasthan mein sthit hai.
GALAT ✗ – Uttar Pradesh Kumbh Mela aur Taj Mahotsav ke liye famous hai. Pushkar ki bhaugolik sthiti UP mein nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Madhya Pradesh mein Ujjain ka Simhastha Kumbh aur Khajuraho Dance Festival hota hai. Pushkar ka Rajasthan se sambandh hai.
SAHI ✓ – Rajasthan ke Ajmer mein Pushkar Mela lagta hai, jise 'Pushkar Camel Fair' bhi kehte hain, isliye ye sahi uttar hai.

festivals.q: Salzburg Festival is held in which country?
festivals.solution: Salzburg Festival Europe ka ek bahut hi pratishthit music aur drama festival hai. Ye har saal Austria ke Salzburg shehar mein hota hai. Khaas baat ye hai ki Salzburg mahan sangeetkaar 'Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart' ka janamsthan hai, isliye unki yaad mein classical music ke program hote hain. Yaad rakho: Salzburg = Music = Mozart's Home (Austria).
why: GALAT ✗ – Italy apne Venice Carnival aur opera ke liye jana jata hai, lekin Salzburg shehar Italy ka hissa nahi hai.
SAHI ✓ – Salzburg Austria ka ek shehar hai aur ye festival 1920 se yahin manaya ja raha hai, isliye ye sahi uttar hai.
GALAT ✗ – Australia ek alag continent hai jo Sydney Festival ke liye jana jata hai, Salzburg se iska koi lena-dena nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Spain La Tomatina aur Flamenco dance ke liye mashhoor hai, Salzburg wahan nahi sthit hai.

festivals.q: Flamingo festival is celebrated in which state?
festivals.solution: Flamingo Festival Andhra Pradesh ke Nellore district mein Pulicat Lake aur Nelapattu Bird Sanctuary ke paas manaya jata hai. Ye festival migratory birds (pravasi pakshi) ko promote karne aur paryatan badhane ke liye hota hai. Flamingo birds har saal yahan Breeding ke liye aate hain. Yaad rakho: Flamingo = Pulicat Lake = Andhra Pradesh.
why: GALAT ✗ – Karnataka Hampi Utsav aur Kambala (buffalo race) ke liye jana jata hai. Flamingo festival yahan ka mukhya utsav nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Kerala Onam aur boat races ke liye famous hai. Yahan ke backwaters mein Flamingo festival nahi manaya jata.
SAHI ✓ – Andhra Pradesh ke Pulicat Lake kshetra mein Flamingo festival manaya jata hai, isliye ye sahi vikalp hai.
GALAT ✗ – Maharashtra Ganesh Chaturthi aur Elephanta Festival ke liye jana jata hai, Flamingo bird festival Andhra ka flagship event hai.

festivals.q: In which of the following states is 'Me-Dam- Me-Phi' the festival of ancestor worship celebrated?
festivals.solution: Me-Dam-Me-Phi Assam ki Tai-Ahom community ka ek mahatvapurna tyohar hai. 'Me' ka matlab hai puja, 'Dam' ka matlab hai purvaj (ancestors) aur 'Phi' ka matlab hai bhagwan. Ye har saal 31 January ko ancestors ko samman dene ke liye manaya jata hai. Yaad rakho: Ahom Dynasty = Assam = Me-Dam-Me-Phi.
why: GALAT ✗ – Odisha Raja Parba aur Nuakhai ke liye jana jata hai. Ancestor worship ka ye specific Tai-Ahom style yahan nahi hota.
SAHI ✓ – Assam mein Ahom samuday dwara purvajon ki puja ke liye ye tyohar manaya jata hai, isliye ye sahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Madhya Pradesh ke tribes (Gond, Bhil) apne alag rituals karte hain, lekin Me-Dam-Me-Phi North-East ka tyohar hai.
GALAT ✗ – Chhattisgarh Bastar Dussehra ke liye jana jata hai, ye Ahom sanskriti ka hissa nahi hai.

festivals.q: The –––– festival is clebrated by the Ahom people of Assam on 31st January every year in memory of the departed people.
festivals.solution: Me-Dam-Me-Phi Assam ke Tai-Ahom logo dwara manaya jane wala sabse bada ancestor worship festival hai. Is din wo apne purvajon ko bali chadhate hain aur unse aashirwad maangte hain taaki samaj mein shanti bani rahe. SSC aksar iski date (31st Jan) aur state (Assam) puchta hai. Yaad rakho: Purvaj (Ancestors) = Dam = Me-Dam-Me-Phi.
why: GALAT ✗ – Lampra Puja Tripura ki Noatia community dwara ki jati hai, ye Assam ke Ahom logo ka festival nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Ashokastami mukhya roop se Tripura mein Unakoti mein manayi jati hai, ye ancestor worship se direct related nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Tirthamukh Tripura ka ek mela hai jahan log Gomati nadi mein dubki lagate hain, ye Ahom ritual nahi hai.
SAHI ✓ – Me-Dam-Me-Phi hi wo tyohar hai jo 31 January ko Ahom log purvajon ki yaad mein manate hain, isliye ye sahi uttar hai.

festivals.q: 'Ali-Aye-Ligang', a spring festival, is associated with which state?
festivals.solution: Ali-Aye-Ligang Assam ki Mishing tribe ka sabse bada festival hai. 'Ali' ka matlab 'Root', 'Aye' ka 'Seed' aur 'Ligang' ka 'Sow' (bona) hota hai. Ye festival paddy cultivation (dhaan ki kheti) ki shuruat ko mark karta hai. Isme 'Ligang Bangun' dance aur 'Oi-Nitom' songs perform kiye jate hain. Yaad rakho: Ali-Aye-Ligang me 'Ali' se Assam link kar lo.
why: GALAT ✗ – Sikkim me 'Losoong' aur 'Saga Dawa' jaise festivals bahut famous hain jo Tibetan Buddhist culture ko dikhate hain. Is prashn ke context me ye galat hai kyunki Ali-Aye-Ligang ka sambandh Mishing tribe se hai jo yahan nahi payi jati.
SAHI ✓ – Ali-Aye-Ligang Assam ka spring festival hai jo Mishing community manati hai. Ye kheti ki shuruat aur dharti mata ke samman me hota hai.
GALAT ✗ – Odisha apne 'Raja Parba' aur 'Nuakhai' (harvest festival) ke liye jana jata hai. Ali-Aye-Ligang ka Odisha ke tribal culture se koi direct relation nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Bihar me 'Chhath Puja' aur 'Sama Chakeva' mukhya parv hain. Ali-Aye-Ligang North-East India ka festival hai, isliye ye option yahan fit nahi hota.

festivals.q: In which state is the Madai festival celebrated?
festivals.solution: Madai festival Chhattisgarh ki Gond tribe dwara badi dhoom-dhaam se manaya jata hai, khas kar Bastar region me. Ye festival December se March tak chalta hai aur 'Kesharpal Kesharpalin Devi' ki puja ki jati hai. Isme tribal dances aur local liquor ka bhi mahatva hota hai. Yaad rakho: 'Madai' matlab 'Mela' jo Gondi sanskriti ka hissa hai.
