why: GALAT ✗ – Jharkhand me 'Sarhul' aur 'Karam' mukhya tribal festivals hain. Halaki ye padosi rajya hai, par Madai mukhya roop se Chhattisgarh ki pehchan hai.
GALAT ✗ – Jammu and Kashmir me 'Hemis' aur 'Tulip Festival' jaise utsav hote hain. Madai ek Central Indian tribal festival hai, isliye ye option galat hai.
SAHI ✓ – Madai Chhattisgarh ka ek pramukh festival hai jise Gond aur anya tribes Bastar aur Kanker districts me manati hain.
GALAT ✗ – Odisha me 'Bali Jatra' aur 'Dhanu Jatra' famous hain. Madai Odisha ke bajaye uske padosi rajya Chhattisgarh me zyada prachalit hai.

festivals.q: During the Sao Joao festivities, Goans present _____ to each other.
festivals.solution: Sao Joao Goa ka ek Roman Catholic festival hai jo 24 June ko St. John the Baptist ke samman me manaya jata hai. Is din log 'Kopel' (phoolon ka crown) pehente hain aur well/pond me koodte hain. Nav-vivaahit jode ek dusre ko aur rishtedaron ko seasonal fruits ki 'Dali' gift karte hain. Yaad rakho: Sao Joao = Jump in well + Seasonal fruits.
why: SAHI ✓ – Sao Joao me seasonal fruits jaise Mango, Jackfruit aur Pineapple ko 'Dali' (basket) me rakh kar exchange kiya jata hai.
GALAT ✗ – Flowers (phool) ka prayog 'Kopel' banane me hota hai, par gift ke roop me fruits aur feni bottle mukhya taur par di jati hai.
GALAT ✗ – Beer ki jagah Goa ki local drink 'Feni' ka tradition is festival se zyada juda hua hai, lekin prashn ke context me fruit basket sabse bada tradition hai.
GALAT ✗ – Fish Goa ke khan-paan ka hissa hai, lekin Sao Joao festivities me fruits exchange karne ka specific riwaaj hai, fish ka nahi.

festivals.q: Dashain is the grandest festival of _____.
festivals.solution: Dashain Nepal ka sabse lamba aur mahatvapurna festival hai, jo lagbhag 15 din chalta hai. Ye Devi Durga ki Mahishasur par vijay ka prateek hai (Bilkul India ke Dussehra jaisa). Isme gharo me 'Jamara' (jau ke paudhe) ugaye jate hain aur bade-budhe chhoton ko 'Tika' lagate hain. Yaad rakho: Dashain = Nepal ka Dussehra.
why: GALAT ✗ – Sri Lanka me 'Vesak Poya' aur 'Esala Perahera' mukhya festivals hain. Dashain wahan ka grandest festival nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Bhutan me 'Tshechu' (mask dance festival) sabse bada utsav hota hai. Dashain ka sambandh Nepali culture se hai jo Bhutan ke kuch hisso me to hai par wahan ka mukhya parv nahi hai.
SAHI ✓ – Dashain Nepal ka national festival hai jo burayi par achai ki jeet ka jashn manata hai.
GALAT ✗ – Bangladesh me 'Pohela Boishakh' (New Year) aur 'Eid' bade star par manaye jate hain. Dashain wahan ka primary festival nahi hai.

festivals.q: In which state is the Sarhul festival celebrated?
festivals.solution: Sarhul Jharkhand ki tribes (Oraon, Munda aur Ho) ka New Year festival hai. Ye 'Sal' ke ped ki puja par adharit hai kyunki Sal ka phool (flower) hi naye saal ka sandesh lata hai. Ye festival Spring season me manaya jata hai aur 'Pahan' (pujari) isme mukhya bhumika nibhata hai. Yaad rakho: Sarhul = Sal tree worship in Jharkhand.
why: GALAT ✗ – Assam me 'Bihu' (Rongali, Kongali, Bhogali) ki dhoom rehti hai. Sarhul Jharkhand ki specific tribal identity hai.
GALAT ✗ – Gujarat apne 'Navratri' aur 'Uttarayan' (Kite festival) ke liye world-famous hai. Sarhul ka Gujarat se koi lena-dena nahi hai.
SAHI ✓ – Sarhul Jharkhand ka sabse popular tribal festival hai jo prakriti ki upasna aur naye saal ka swagat karta hai.
GALAT ✗ – Chhattisgarh me 'Bastur Dussehra' aur 'Madai' famous hain. Halaki dono states me tribes hain, par Sarhul Jharkhand ka signature festival hai.

festivals.q: In which state of India is the harvest festival of 'Kailpodh' celebrated by an indigenous community?
festivals.solution: Kailpodh Karnataka ke Kodagu district mein Kodava community dwara manaya jata hai. Iska matlab hai 'weapons ka festival' (Kail = weapon, Podh = worship). Harvest khatam hone ke baad log apne hathyaro (weapons) aur kheti ke auzaro ki puja karte hain kyunki pahle ye log shikar aur raksha dono ke liye weapons par nirbhar the. Yaad rakho: Kodava community + Weapons + Karnataka = Kailpodh.
why: GALAT ✗ – Odisha ke mukhya harvest festivals 'Nuakhai' aur 'Pua Jiuntia' hain, jahan naye chawal ka swagat kiya jata hai. Is prashn ke liye ye sahi nahi hai kyunki Kailpodh wahan ka nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Madhya Pradesh mein 'Hareli' aur 'Bhagoria' jaise festivals famous hain. Kailpodh ka sambandh is Central Indian state se nahi hai.
SAHI ✓ – Karnataka ke Coorg (Kodagu) region mein Kodava log ise September ke shuruat mein manate hain. Ye kheti ke auzaro aur weapons ki puja ka din hota hai.
GALAT ✗ – Jharkhand mein 'Sarhul' aur 'Sohrai' jaise tribal harvest festivals manaye jate hain. Kailpodh South India ka festival hai.

festivals.exam: SSC CPO-SI 24/11/2020 (Shift-I) | SSC CPO-SI 24/11/2020 (Shift-I) SSC MTS 19/08/2019 (Shift-I) | SSC MTS 19/08/2019 (Shift-I)
festivals.q: Bathukumma and Bonalu are the traditional festivals of which state?
festivals.solution: Bathukamma 'Flowers ka festival' hai jahan mahilayein sundar phoolon se gopuram jaisi akriti banati hain. Bonalu 'Goddess Mahankali' ko dedicated hai jahan mitti ke ghade (Bonam) mein bhog chadhaya jata hai. Dono hi Telangana ki sanskriti ki pehchan hain. Yaad rakho: 'Bathukamma' matlab 'Mother Goddess come alive'.
why: GALAT ✗ – Kerala 'Onam' aur 'Vishu' ke liye jana jata hai. Yahan Boat races aur Kathakali mukhya hain, Bathukamma nahi.
SAHI ✓ – Telangana mein Bathukamma (Sept-Oct) aur Bonalu (Ashada month) bade dhoom-dhaam se manaye jate hain. Ye dono state festivals hain.
GALAT ✗ – Karnataka mein 'Ugadi' aur 'Mysore Dasara' mukhya hain. Halaki ye padosi rajya hai, par Bathukamma Telangana ka specific festival hai.
GALAT ✗ – Tamil Nadu mein 'Pongal' aur 'Puthandu' (New Year) mukhya hain. Bathukamma ka yahan koi prachalan nahi hai.

festivals.q: In which the following states of India 'Ambubachi Mela' is organized every year?
festivals.solution: Ambubachi Mela Guwahati (Assam) ke Kamakhya Temple mein lagta hai. Ye Maa Kamakhya ke 'Annual Menstruation' (masik dharm) ka prateek hai. Is dauran Brahmaputra nadi ka pani lal ho jata hai aur mandir 3 din ke liye band rehta hai. Ise 'Mahakumbh of the East' bhi kehte hain. Yaad rakho: Nilachal Hills + Kamakhya + Assam = Ambubachi.
why: SAHI ✓ – Assam ke Guwahati mein har saal June (Ahaar month) mein ye mela lagta hai, jahan desh-videsh se tantrik aur bhakt aate hain.
GALAT ✗ – Sikkim mein 'Saga Dawa' aur 'Losoong' jaise Buddhist festivals mukhya hain. Ambubachi wahan nahi manaya jata.
GALAT ✗ – Gujarat 'Navratri' aur 'Madhavpur Mela' ke liye famous hai. Ambubachi North-East ka tyohar hai.
GALAT ✗ – Kerala mein 'Attukal Pongala' aur 'Thrissur Pooram' bade mele hain, par Ambubachi ka sambandh Assam se hai.

festivals.q: In which of the following temples is the Ambubachi Fair celebrated every year?
festivals.solution: Kamakhya Devi Mandir 51 Shakti Peethon mein se ek sabse mahatvapurn peeth hai. Ambubachi Mela yahi celebrate hota hai. Ye mandir 'Nilachal Hills' par sthit hai. Yahan Devi ki koi murti nahi balki ek 'Yoni-like' shila (rock) ki puja hoti hai. SSC Fact: Ye Ahom architecture aur Koch dynasty ke itihas se bhi juda hai.
why: GALAT ✗ – Jagannath Temple (Puri, Odisha) 'Rath Yatra' ke liye vishwa-prasiddh hai. Yahan Ambubachi Mela nahi lagta.
SAHI ✓ – Kamakhya Temple (Assam) hi wo jagah hai jahan Ambubachi Mela lagta hai. Ye Devi ke rajaswala (menstruation) hone ka utsav hai.
GALAT ✗ – Kashi Vishwanath (Varanasi, UP) Bhagwan Shiv ka Jyotirlinga hai. Yahan 'Dev Deepawali' aur 'Mahashivratri' mukhya hain.
GALAT ✗ – Kedarnath (Uttarakhand) bhi ek Jyotirlinga hai jo Himalaya mein sthit hai. Ambubachi ka isse koi lena-dena nahi hai.

festivals.q: Which festival is also known as 'Mahakumbh of the East'?
festivals.solution: Ambubachi Mela ko 'Mahakumbh of the East' isliye kehte hain kyunki Kumbh mela ki tarah hi yahan lakhon ki sankhya mein sadhu, tantrik aur shradhalu ikatthe hote hain. Ye Eastern India ka sabse bada dh धार्मिक samagam (religious gathering) hai. Extra Point: Tantrik vidya ke liye ye pure vishwa mein mukhya kendra hai.
why: GALAT ✗ – Hornbill Festival Nagaland ka 'Festival of Festivals' hai jo December mein hota hai. Ise Mahakumbh nahi kaha jata.
GALAT ✗ – Moatsu Mong Nagaland ki 'Ao tribe' ka harvest festival hai. Ye ek samudayik utsav hai, Mahakumbh nahi.
SAHI ✓ – Ambubachi Mela ko hi uski vishal bheed aur mahatva ke karan 'Mahakumbh of the East' ki upadhi di gayi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Bihu Assam ka cultural identity hai (Rongali, Kongali, Bhogali). Ye harvest aur new year festivals hain, mela nahi.

festivals.q: Sekrenyi festival, usually held during the February month, is celebrated by the Angami tribes of _________.
festivals.solution: Sekrenyi Nagaland ki Angami tribe ka sabse bada tyohar hai, jise 'Phousanyi' (Purification Festival) bhi kehte hain. Ye 10 dino tak chalta hai aur iska main maksad buraiyo ko dhokar khud ko pavitra karna hota hai. Yaad rakho: 'Angami' tribe hamesha Nagaland se judi hoti hai aur Sekrenyi unka signature event hai.
why: GALAT ✗ – Rajasthan apne Gangaur aur Pushkar Mela ke liye prasiddh hai, yahan Angami tribe nahi rehti. Isliye ye option galat hai.
GALAT ✗ – Maharashtra me Gudi Padwa aur Ganesh Chaturthi bade star par manaye jate hain. Yahan ka tribal culture alag hai. Isliye ye sahi nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Chhattisgarh me Bastar Dussehra aur Madai festival manaya jata hai, jo Gond tribes se juda hai na ki Angami se.
SAHI ✓ – Sekrenyi Nagaland ki Angami tribe ka tyohar hai jo February me 'purification' ke liye manaya jata hai.

festivals.q: Baliyatra which literally means 'Journey of Bali' which is a festival celebrated with great pomp, especially in ____.
festivals.solution: Baliyatra Odisha ka ek prachin vyaparik mela (trade fair) hai jo Mahanadi ke tat par Cuttack me manaya jata hai. Ye Kalinga ke purane samudri vyapar (maritime trade) ki yaad dilata hai jo Bali, Sumatra aur Java ke saath hota tha. Yaad rakho: Baliyatra = Cuttack (Mahanadi River).
why: GALAT ✗ – Vellore Tamil Nadu me hai aur ye apne Golden Temple aur fort ke liye jana jata hai, Baliyatra yahan ka festival nahi hai.
SAHI ✓ – Cuttack (Kuttak) Odisha me hai jahan Kartik Purnima ke din se Asia ka sabse bada open trade fair 'Baliyatra' shuru hota hai.
GALAT ✗ – Gurgaon (Gurugram) Haryana ka corporate hub hai, yahan Baliyatra jaisa koi prachin samudri tyohar nahi hota.
GALAT ✗ – Kochi Kerala me hai, jo apne port ke liye mashhoor hai, par Baliyatra specific taur par Odisha se juda hai.

festivals.q: Sakewa is a religious festival celebrated by the Kirat Khambu Rai Community of ________.
festivals.solution: Sakewa Sikkim ki Kirat Khambu Rai community ka ek mahatvapurna tyohar hai, jise 'Bhumi Puja' ke roop me manaya jata hai. Isme dharti mata (Mother Earth) ki pooja hoti hai taaki achhi fasal ho. Yaad rakho: Kirat Rai community = Sikkim & Sakewa festival.
why: GALAT ✗ – Arunachal Pradesh me Losar aur Solung jaise festivals manaye jate hain, Sakewa yahan ka mukhya tyohar nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Nagaland Hornbill festival aur tribes jaise Angami/Ao ke liye jana jata hai, Kirat Rai yahan mukhya nahi hain.
GALAT ✗ – Meghalaya me Wangala (Garo tribe) aur Behdienkhlam (Jaintia tribe) manaya jata hai. Isliye ye galat hai.
SAHI ✓ – Sakewa Sikkim ka tyohar hai jise Rai community dharti mata ko samman dene ke liye manati hai.

festivals.q: ______ is a festival of Zoroastrian (Parsi) origins which begins on the spring equinox every year in the month of March and it is celebrated by Parsi community in India.
festivals.solution: Jamshedi Navroz Parsi logon ka Naya Saal (New Year) hai jo 21 March (Spring Equinox) ko manaya jata hai. Bharat me ise Balban ne introduce kiya tha. Yaad rakho: Navroz = New Day/New Year (Zoroastrian).
why: GALAT ✗ – Khordad Sal Prophet Zoroaster ka birthday hota hai. Ye Parsi festival hai par equinox par naya saal nahi hota.
SAHI ✓ – Jamshedi Navroz hi wo festival hai jo Spring Equinox par Parsi community dwara New Year ki tarah manaya jata hai.
GALAT ✗ – Pateti Parsi calendar ke saal ka aakhri din hota hai (Repentance Day), naya saal iske agle din shuru hota hai.
GALAT ✗ – Frowardigan ya Muktad ek 10 din ka period hota hai jo purvajo (ancestors) ko yaad karne ke liye hota hai.

festivals.q: Which of the following state-festival pair is not correct?
festivals.solution: Baisakhi Punjab ka mukhya fasal utsav (harvest festival) hai, jo 1699 me Guru Gobind Singh ji dwara 'Khalsa Panth' ki sthapna ki yaad me manaya jata hai. Yaad rakho: Baisakhi = Punjab (not UP).
why: GALAT ✗ (Identity) – Gudi Padwa Maharashtra ka New Year festival hai. Ye pair bilkul sahi hai, isliye answer nahi hai.
SAHI ✓ – Baisakhi UP ka nahi balki Punjab ka festival hai. UP me mukhya festivals Holi, Diwali aur Magh Mela hain.
GALAT ✗ (Identity) – Chhath Puja Bihar ka sabse pavitra tyohar hai jisme Surya Dev ki pooja hoti hai. Ye pair sahi hai.
GALAT ✗ (Identity) – Durga Puja West Bengal ka sabse bada utsav hai, jise UNESCO Heritage list me bhi jagah mili hai. Ye pair sahi hai.

festivals.q: Which of the following festivals is celebrated in Odisha?
festivals.solution: Bali Trutiya Odisha ka ek mahatvapurn vrat aur tyohar hai jo Bhadrapada month ki Shukla Paksha Trutiya ko manaya jata hai. Ye Lord Shiva aur Mata Parvati ko samarpit hai. Maana jata hai ki Parvati ji ne Shiv ji ko pati ke roop me paane ke liye ye vrat kiya tha. Odisha me isi din 'Bali' (sand) se idols banayi jati hain. Yaad rakho: Odisha = Bali (Bali Jatra aur Bali Trutiya dono Odisha ke hain).
why: GALAT ✗ – Bonalu Telangana ka ek Hindu festival hai jisme Goddess Mahakali ki puja hoti hai. Isme 'Bonam' (pot) me chawal aur gud chadhaya jata hai. Isliye ye Odisha ka nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Chhappar Mela Punjab ke Ludhiana district me lagta hai. Ye Gugga Pir ki yaad me manaya jata hai jo 'snakes' ke devta maane jate hain. Odisha se iska sambandh nahi hai.
SAHI ✓ – Bali Trutiya Odisha me Lord Shiva-Parvati ke liye manaya jata hai, jo Ganesh Chaturthi se thik ek din pehle aata hai. Ye Odisha ki sanskriti ka hissa hai.
GALAT ✗ – Hornbill Festival Nagaland ka sabse famous event hai jise 'Festival of Festivals' kehte hain. Ye Naga tribes ki unity aur culture ko dikhata hai, Odisha ka nahi.

festivals.q: Kumbh Mela is NOT held at :
festivals.solution: Kumbh Mela duniya ka sabse bada dharmik sammelan hai jo 4 pavitra nadiyon ke tat par har 12 saal me lagta hai. Ye jagah hain: Prayagraj (Ganga-Yamuna sangam), Haridwar (Ganga), Ujjain (Shipra), aur Nashik (Godavari). Puri me 'Rath Yatra' hoti hai, Kumbh nahi. Yaad rakho: P-U-N-H (Prayagraj, Ujjain, Nashik, Haridwar) hi Kumbh ki locations hain.
why: GALAT ✗ – Allahabad (ab Prayagraj) me Ganga, Yamuna aur Saraswati ke sangam par Kumbh Mela lagta hai, isliye ye option question ke 'NOT' criteria me fit nahi hota.
GALAT ✗ – Ujjain (Madhya Pradesh) me Shipra nadi ke kinare Kumbh lagta hai jise 'Simhastha Kumbh' bhi kehte hain. Ye bhi ek valid location hai.
SAHI ✓ – Puri (Odisha) me Kumbh Mela nahi lagta. Ye Jagannath Temple aur Rath Yatra ke liye vishwa-prasiddh hai, par Kumbh ke 4 sthalon me shamil nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Haridwar (Uttarakhand) me Ganga nadi ke tat par Kumbh ka aayojan hota hai. Ye un 4 pavitra sthalon me se ek hai jahan Amrit ki boondein giri thin.

festivals.q: Which of the following is a harvest festival of India?
festivals.solution: Lohri Punjab aur Haryana ka ek pramukh Harvest Festival (fasal ki katai ka tyohar) hai, jo January me Makar Sankranti se ek din pehle manaya jata hai. Ye winter solstice ke ant aur naye shubh samay ka pratik hai. Isme 'Bonfire' jalakar 'Sugarcane' (ganna) aur 'Sesame' (til) ki bali di jati hai. Yaad rakho: Harvest = Fasal ki khushi.
why: GALAT ✗ – Darpka Teshi (Drukpa Teshi) ek Buddhist festival hai jo Sikkim/Ladakh me Lord Buddha ke pehle updesh (Sarnath) ki khushi me manaya jata hai, ye harvest festival nahi hai.
SAHI ✓ – Lohri ek harvest festival hai jo Punjab me rabi crops (gehun) ki katai aur sardi ke jane ki khushi me manaya jata hai.
GALAT ✗ – Teej Rajasthan aur North India me Monsoon ke aane aur Lord Shiva-Parvati ke milan ki khushi me manaya jata hai. Ye suhagan mahilaon ka tyohar hai, harvest ka nahi.
GALAT ✗ – Bonalu Telangana ka ek ritualistic festival hai jisme Mahakali ki puja hoti hai. Ye ek thanksgiving festival hai par ise 'harvest festival' ki category me nahi rakha jata.

festivals.q: 'Rangoli Bihu' one of the major festival of Assam is celebrated in the month of ____.
festivals.solution: Assam me teen tarah ke Bihu hote hain: 1. Rongali/Bohag Bihu (April) - New Year, 2. Kongali/Kati Bihu (October) - Garibi/Kanjusi ka bihu, 3. Bhogali/Magh Bihu (January) - Khane-peene ka bihu. Rangali Bihu Assamese calendar ka naya saal hai jo Vaishakh (April) me padta hai. Isme Bihu dance aur Dhol ka prayog hota hai. Yaad rakho: Rongali = Rang (April/Spring).
why: SAHI ✓ – Rangali ya Bohag Bihu April (mid-April) me manaya jata hai. Ye spring season aur Assamese New Year ki shuruat ko mark karta hai.
GALAT ✗ – June me Assam me Ambubachi Mela (Kamakhya Temple) lagta hai, lekin koi Bihu is mahine me nahi hota.
GALAT ✗ – March me Holi (Phagwah) hoti hai, lekin Bihu festivals ki dates March me nahi aati.
GALAT ✗ – October me 'Kati Bihu' (Kongali) manaya jata hai, jo ki ek shaant festival hai jisme tulsi ke paas diye jalaye jate hain, Rangali nahi.

festivals.q: Which of the following festivals means 'Merry Making of the Gods'.
festivals.solution: Lai Haraoba Manipur ki Meitei community ka sabse purana ritualistic festival hai. Iska shabdik arth hai 'Merry Making of the Gods'. Isme 'Maibis' (priestesses) dwara dance kiya jata hai jo srishti ke nirmaan ki kahani sunata hai. Isme 'Pena' namak vadya yantra (musical instrument) ka use hota hai. Yaad rakho: Lai = God, Haraoba = Merry making.
why: GALAT ✗ – Diwali 'Festival of Lights' hai jo Bhagwan Ram ke Ayodhya lautne ki khushi me manaya jata hai. Iska arth 'Devtaon ka manoranjan' nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Pongal Tamil Nadu ka ek harvest festival hai. Iska arth 'to boil over' hota hai kyunki isme chawal ko doodh me ubala jata hai.
GALAT ✗ – Makar Sankranti Surya ke Makar rashi me pravesh ka tyohar hai. Ise alag alag rajyo me alag naamo se jana jata hai, par ye is arth se nahi juda hai.
SAHI ✓ – Lai Haraoba Manipur ka tyohar hai jiska literal meaning 'Merry Making of the Gods' hai, jisme Umang Lai (local deities) ki puja hoti hai.

festivals.q: In which of the following Indian states is the Lai Haraoba festival celebrated?
festivals.solution: Lai Haraoba Manipur ki Meitei community ka sabse purana aur mahatvapurna tyohar hai. Iska matlab hai 'Merry making of the Gods'. Isme 'Umang Lai' (forest deities) ki pooja ki jati hai aur Maibi (priestesses) dwara 'Jagoi' dance kiya jata hai. Isme srishti (creation) ki kahani ko darshaya jata hai. Yaad rakho: Lai = Bhagwan, Haraoba = Utsav.
why: GALAT ✗ – Karnataka apne Kambala (buffalo race) aur Ugadi tyohar ke liye jana jata hai. Is prashn ke liye ye galat hai kyunki Lai Haraoba North-East ka festival hai.
GALAT ✗ – Goa me Carnival aur Shigmo utsav dhoom-dhaam se manaye jate hain jo Konkan sanskriti darshate hain. Is prashn ke liye ye mel nahi khata.
GALAT ✗ – Kerala Onam aur Vishu jaise bade tyoharo ke liye famous hai. Lai Haraoba ka sambandh South India se nahi balki Manipur se hai.
SAHI ✓ – Manipur me hi Lai Haraoba manaya jata hai. Ye festival Meitei logo ki sanskriti, folk oral literature aur dance ka ek anokha mishran hai.

festivals.q: In which of the following states is the Madhavpur Mela celebrated?
festivals.solution: Madhavpur Mela Gujarat ke Porbandar zile me lagta hai. Ye mela Bharat ke West (Gujarat) aur North-East (Arunachal Pradesh) ke beech ek Sanskritik setu (cultural bridge) hai. Ye Bhagwan Krishna aur Rukmini ke vivah ki yaad me manaya jata hai. Yaad rakho: Mishmi Tribe (Arunachal) isse judi hui hai.
why: GALAT ✗ – Uttar Pradesh Kumbh Mela aur Taj Mahotsav ke liye jana jata hai. Madhavpur Mela yahan nahi lagta.
GALAT ✗ – Bihar me Sonepur Mela (Asia ka sabse bada cattle fair) lagta hai, lekin Madhavpur Mela ka sambandh coastal Gujarat se hai.
SAHI ✓ – Gujarat ke Madhavpur Ghed (Porbandar) me ye mela har saal Ram Navami ke avsar par lagta hai jo Krishna-Rukmini milan ko celebrate karta hai.
GALAT ✗ – Madhya Pradesh me Lokrang aur Khajuraho Dance Festival hote hain. Madhavpur Mela yahan ka event nahi hai.

festivals.q: In memory of whom is the Madhavpur Mela of Gujarat celebrated?
festivals.solution: Madhavpur Mela Bhagwan Krishna aur Rukmini ke vivah ka celebration hai. Mythological kathaon ke anusar, Rukmini Arunachal Pradesh ke Raja Bhishmak ki putri thin, jinhe Krishna Gujarat le aaye the. Is mele me Arunachal ki Mishmi tribe khas taur par shamil hoti hai. Yaad rakho: 'Rukmini Haran' ki katha yahan main hai.
why: GALAT ✗ – Draupadi Panchal ki rajkumari aur Pandavo ki patni thin, unke sambandh me Gujarat me ye mela nahi manaya jata.
GALAT ✗ – Radha-Krishna ka prem prasang Mathura-Vrindavan (UP) me jyada manaya jata hai, jabki Madhavpur Mela unke vivah (Rukmini ke saath) par focused hai.
GALAT ✗ – Shiva-Parvati ke liye Mahashivratri aur Teej jaise tyohar hote hain. Ye mela Vaishnav parampara se juda hai.
SAHI ✓ – Lord Krishna aur Rukmini ka vivah hi Madhavpur Mela ka mukhya adhaar hai, jo West aur NE India ko jodta hai.

festivals.q: 'Bhagta Parab', a tribal festival that is celebrated between the period of spring and summer, originated in the state of ____.
festivals.solution: Bhagta Parab Jharkhand ki tribal communities (jaise Tamar region) dwara manaya jane wala ek kathin vrat aur tyohar hai. Isme 'Budha Baba' ki pooja hoti hai. Isme log upvas rakhte hain aur mandir ke bahar ek khambe se latak kar 'Chhau' dance jaise stunts karte hain. Yaad rakho: Ye Spring aur Summer ke beech (April-May) me aata hai.
why: GALAT ✗ – Maharashtra me Gudi Padwa aur Pola festival mukhya hain. Bhagta Parab ek chhota tribal festival hai jo Jharkhand tak limited hai.
GALAT ✗ – Mizoram me Chapchar Kut aur Pawl Kut manaye jate hain. Bhagta Parab yahan ki sanskriti ka hissa nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Madhya Pradesh me Bhagoria mela hota hai, lekin Bhagta Parab mukhya roop se Jharkhand ke tribal belt me popular hai.
SAHI ✓ – Jharkhand ke Tamar ilake me Bhagta Parab bahut utsah se manaya jata hai jahan log Budha Baba (Lord Shiva ka ek roop) ki upasna karte hain.

festivals.q: 'Kalamezhuthu' is a ritual art form found in :
festivals.solution: Kalamezhuthu Kerala ki ek 'Floor Art' hai jisme prakritik rango (natural powders) ka upyog karke zameen par Devi-Devtaon (jaise Bhadrakali, Ayyappa) ki tasveer banayi jati hai. Ye 2D art hai aur isme sirf 5 rang (kala, peela, hara, safed, lal) use hote hain. Iske baad ritual songs gaye jate hain. Yaad rakho: Kalam = Art/Drawing, Ezhuthu = Likhna/Banana.
why: GALAT ✗ – Maharashtra me 'Warli Painting' famous hai, lekin Kalamezhuthu jaisi ritual floor art yahan ki parampara nahi hai.
SAHI ✓ – Kerala ke mandiro aur pavitra groves (Kaavu) me Kalamezhuthu ki parampara sadiyon se chali aa rahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Karnataka me 'Yakshagana' aur 'Kambala' hota hai. Ritual floor drawing ke liye Kerala hi mukhya kendra hai.
GALAT ✗ – Tamil Nadu me 'Kolam' banaya jata hai, lekin 'Kalamezhuthu' ek ritualistic aur complex art form hai jo khas Kerala se hai.

festivals.q: Chapchar Kut is a festival of which state?
festivals.solution: Chapchar Kut Mizoram ka sabse bada aur khush-haal festival hai jo 'Jhum Cultivation' (clearing of forest) ke khatam hone par March mahine me manaya jata hai. Isme log traditional dress pehenkar 'Cheraw Dance' (Bamboo dance) karte hain. Isse 'Festival of Spring' bhi kaha jata hai. Yaad rakho: Mizoram ke zyada-tar festivals ke piche 'Kut' word lagta hai.
why: GALAT ✗ – Manipur me 'Yaoshang' (Holi jaisa) aur 'Sajibu Cheiraoba' jaise festivals famous hain. Is prashn ke liye ye sahi nahi hai kyunki Chapchar Kut wahan ka nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Nagaland apne 'Hornbill Festival' aur 'Moatsu' ke liye jana jata hai. Chapchar Kut ka sambandh is state se nahi hai.
SAHI ✓ – Chapchar Kut Mizoram ka sabse purana festival hai. Ye bamboo cutting ke baad kheti ki nayi cycle shuru hone ki khushi me manaya jata hai.
GALAT ✗ – Meghalaya me 'Wangala' (100 Drums Festival) aur 'Nongkrem' dance festival hote hain. Ye Chapchar Kut se alag hain.

festivals.q: The festival ‘Anthurium’ is celebrated in:
festivals.solution: Anthurium festival Mizoram ki government dwara 'Reiek Tlang' (hills) par har saal manaya jata hai taaki tourism ko badhava diya ja sake. Anthurium asal me ek bahut sundar phool (flower) hai jo Mizoram me kafi hota hai. Ye festival nature aur local culture ka mel hai. Yaad rakho: Anthurium = Mizoram ka Flower Festival.
why: GALAT ✗ – Nagaland me 'Sekrenyi' aur 'Hornbill' jaise bade events hote hain, lekin Anthurium wahan ka state-sponsored flower festival nahi hai.
SAHI ✓ – Anthurium festival Mizoram me manaya jata hai. Ye wahan ke phoolon ki vividhta (diversity) ko dikhane ke liye shuru kiya gaya tha.
GALAT ✗ – Manipur 'Sangai Festival' aur 'Kang Festival' ke liye mashhoor hai. Is prashn ka uttar ye nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Assam me 'Bihu' aur 'Ambubachi Mela' pramukh hain. Anthurium yahan ka primary festival nahi hai.

festivals.q: The festival of Durga Puja is observed to celebrate the triumph of Goddess Durga over______.
festivals.solution: Durga Puja burayi par achayi ki jeet ka prateek hai. Devi Durga ne 10 dinon tak bhayanak yuddh ke baad asur Mahishasura ka vadh kiya tha, jise 'Mahishasura Mardini' ke roop me puja jata hai. Ye tyohar West Bengal, Odisha aur Bihar me bade star par manaya jata hai. Yaad rakho: Navratri ke aakhri din (Dashami) ko ye jeet celebrate hoti hai.
why: GALAT ✗ – Jarasandha Magadh ka raja tha jise Bheem ne Mallayuddha (wrestling) me maara tha, Devi Durga ne nahi.
GALAT ✗ – Ravana ka vadh Bhagwan Ram ne kiya tha, jise hum Dussehra ke roop me manate hain, Durga Puja ke main demon wo nahi hain.
GALAT ✗ – Hiranyakashipu ek asur tha jise Bhagwan Vishnu ne 'Narasimha Avatar' lekar maara tha.
SAHI ✓ – Mahishasura wo buffalo-demon tha jise Devi Durga ne maara tha. Isliye Durga Puja isi vijay ke liye manayi jati hai.

festivals.q: ______ is an annual three-day festival held at Bara Shaheed Dargah in Nellore.
festivals.solution: Rottela Panduga (Roti Festival) Andhra Pradesh ke Nellore me Bara Shaheed Dargah par manaya jata hai. Isme log apni mannat (wishes) puri hone par ek dusre se 'Roti' exchange karte hain. Ye communal harmony ka ek bada udharan hai jisme har dharm ke log aate hain. Yaad rakho: Nellore + Dargah + Roti = Rottela Panduga.
why: GALAT ✗ – Bheldiya Assam ka ek chhota folk festival hai jo boat making se juda hai. Iska Nellore se koi lena-dena nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Baishagu Assam ki 'Bodo' tribe ka New Year festival hai jo April me manaya jata hai.
GALAT ✗ – Ali Ai Ligang Assam ki 'Mising' tribe ka agriculture festival hai. Ye Dargah ka festival nahi hai.
SAHI ✓ – Rottela Panduga hi wo festival hai jo Nellore ki Bara Shaheed Dargah par Roti exchange karke manaya jata hai.

festivals.q: In which Indian state is the ‘Fatorpa Zatra’ celebrated?
festivals.solution: Fatorpa Zatra Goa ke Shantadurga Kunkalienkarin temple me hone wali ek annual rath yatra hai. Ye Goa ke sabse popular Hindu festivals me se ek hai, jahan dur-dur se log rath khichne aate hain. Goa me 'Shigmo' aur 'Carnival' ke alawa ye Zatra bhi exam me puchi jati hai. Yaad rakho: Goa me temple festivals ko aksar 'Zatra' kaha jata hai.
why: GALAT ✗ – Madhya Pradesh me 'Khajuraho Dance Festival' aur 'Lokrang' jaise bade events hote hain, Fatorpa Zatra wahan ka nahi hai.
SAHI ✓ – Fatorpa Zatra Goa ka ek mahatvapurn dharmik tyohar hai jo Fatorpa village me manaya jata hai.
GALAT ✗ – Kerala me 'Onam' aur 'Vishu' jaise festivals hote hain. Wahan temple festivals ko 'Pooram' kaha jata hai, Zatra nahi.
GALAT ✗ – Himachal Pradesh me 'Kullu Dussehra' aur 'Minjar Mela' famous hain. Is prashn ke context me ye galat hai.

festivals.q: ‘Sangken’ is a festival of the
festivals.solution: Sangken Arunachal Pradesh ki Khamti tribe dwara manaya jane wala ek important festival hai. Ye Buddhist New Year ka pratik hai jisme Lord Buddha ki idols ko pavitra jal (holy water) se snan karaya jata hai. Ye festival 'Water Festival' ke naam se bhi popular hai, jo Burmese festival 'Thingyan' se milta-julta hai. Yaad rakho: Sangken = Pavitra Snan (Buddhism).
why: GALAT ✗ – Jains ke mukhya tyohar Paryushana Parv aur Mahavir Jayanti hain. Is prashn ke liye ye sahi nahi hai kyunki Sangken ka sambandh Jainism se nahi hai.
SAHI ✓ – Sangken ek Theravada Buddhist festival hai jo mukhya roop se Arunachal Pradesh aur Assam ke Lohit district mein manaya jata hai.
GALAT ✗ – Sikhs ke pramukh tyohar Baisakhi, Gurpurab aur Hola Mohalla hain. Sangken ka Sikhism ki maryadaon se koi lena-dena nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Christians Easter aur Christmas jaise tyohar manate hain. Sangken ek purvi (Eastern) Buddhist parampara ka hissa hai, isliye ye galat hai.

festivals.q: The ______ festival of Sikkim is also known as Bhoomi Puja or Chandi Puja.
festivals.solution: Sakewa Sikkim ki Kirat Khambu Rai community dwara manaya jane wala ek spiritual festival hai. Ise 'Bhoomi Puja' isliye kehte hain kyunki isme 'Dharti Mata' (Mother Earth) ki puja ki jati hai achhi fasal ke liye. Isme 'Sili' dance perform kiya jata hai jo prakriti ki nakal karta hai. Yaad rakho: Sakewa = Sikkim = Sakal Dharti ki puja.
why: GALAT ✗ – Barahimizong Sikkim ki Mangar community ka festival hai. Halaki ye Sikkim ka hai, par ise Chandi Puja nahi kaha jata.
GALAT ✗ – Losar Tibetan New Year hai jo Sikkim aur Arunachal mein manaya jata hai, par ye New Year festival hai na ki Bhoomi Puja.
GALAT ✗ – Indra Jatra Sikkim ki Newar community dwara Rain God (Indra) ke liye manaya jata hai, iska sambandh Chandi Puja se nahi hai.
SAHI ✓ – Sakewa hi wo festival hai jise Chandi Puja ya Bhoomi Puja kehte hain, jisme dharti ki urvarata (fertility) ki prarthna ki jati hai.

festivals.q: The tenth day after ______ Navratri is celebrated as Dussehra or Vijayadashami.
festivals.solution: Hindu calendar ke anusar ek saal mein char Navratri aati hain, lekin 'Sharad Navratri' (Ashwin mahine mein) sabse mukhya hai. Iske 9 dino ke vrat ke baad 10th day ko Vijayadashami ya Dussehra manaya jata hai, jo burai par achhai ki jeet (Lord Rama's victory) ka pratik hai. Yaad rakho: S se Sharad, S se Sabse badi Navratri.
why: SAHI ✓ – Sharad Navratri jo September-October mein aati hai, usi ke dasve din Dussehra manaya jata hai.
GALAT ✗ – Ashadha Gupt Navratri 'Gupt' (hidden) hoti hai jo tantrik vidyaon ke liye mukhya hai, iske baad Dussehra nahi hota.
GALAT ✗ – Chaitra Navratri (March-April) ke dasve din Dussehra nahi, balki nauve din Ram Navami manayi jati hai.
GALAT ✗ – Magha Gupt Navratri sheet ritu (winter) mein aati hai, ye bhi ek gupt navratri hai jiska Dussehra se sambandh nahi hai.

festivals.q: _____ a festival of the Galo tribe of Arunachal Pradesh, is celebrated in April every year.
festivals.solution: Mopin Arunachal Pradesh ki 'Galo' tribe ka sabse bada agriculture festival hai. Is tyohar mein log apne chehre par 'Iti' (rice powder) lagate hain aur 'Popir' dance karte hain. Ye festival buri aatmaon ko bhagane aur samridhi laane ke liye manaya jata hai. Yaad rakho: Galo = Mopin = Rice powder.
why: GALAT ✗ – Doljatra West Bengal ka festival hai jo Holi ki tarah manaya jata hai, iska Arunachal ki Galo tribe se sambandh nahi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Ali Ai Ligang Assam ki Mising tribe ka agriculture festival hai. Ye Arunachal ka nahi hai.
SAHI ✓ – Mopin hi Galo tribe dwara April mein manaya jane wala harvest festival hai.
GALAT ✗ – Me Dum Me Phi Assam ki Ahom community dwara purvajon (ancestors) ki puja ke liye manaya jata hai, ye Galo tribe ka nahi hai.

festivals.q: Which of the following festivals is held on a new moon day?
festivals.solution: Kali Puja, jo mukhya roop se West Bengal, Odisha aur Assam mein manayi jati hai, Kartik mahine ki 'Amavasya' (New Moon) ko hoti hai. Ye aksar North India ki Diwali ke din hi padti hai. SSC me pucha jata hai: Diwali aur Kali Puja dono Amavasya ko hote hain. Yaad rakho: Kali Maa = Dark night (Amavasya).
why: GALAT ✗ – Mahavir Jayanti Chaitra mahine ke shukla paksh ki Trayodashi (13th day) ko hoti hai, Amavasya ko nahi.
SAHI ✓ – Kali Puja hamesha Kartik Amavasya (new moon day) ki raat ko manayi jati hai.
GALAT ✗ – Dussehra hamesha Shukla Paksh ki Dashami (10th day) ko hota hai, ye Chandrama ki roshni wala din hota hai.
GALAT ✗ – Holi hamesha 'Purnima' (Full Moon) ko manayi jati hai, ye Amavasya ke bilkul viprit hai.

festivals.q: Shambhu Maharaj was the famous guru of which of the following Kathak gharana?
festivals.solution: Pandit Shambhu Maharaj Kathak ke sabse bade exponents me se ek the. Ye Achhan Maharaj aur Lachhu Maharaj ke bhai aur Birju Maharaj ke chacha (uncle) the. Inhe 1967 me Sangeet Natak Akademi Fellowship mili thi. Lucknow gharana 'Abhinaya' (emotions) aur 'Thumri' par zyada focus karta hai. Yaad rakho: Maharaj surname wale adhikatar kalakar Lucknow gharane se hote hain.
why: GALAT ✗ – Banaras gharana (Janaki Prasad gharana) apne natvari nritya aur floor work ke liye jana jata hai, par Shambhu Maharaj isse nahi jude the. Is prashn ke liye ye galat hai.
GALAT ✗ – Jaipur gharana 'Layakari' aur tez 'Chakkar' (footwork) ke liye mashhoor hai, jise Rajasthan ke raaj-darbaron me sanrakshan mila. Shambhu Maharaj ka sambandh isse nahi hai.
SAHI ✓ – Shambhu Maharaj Lucknow gharane ke mukhya stambh hain, jo Nawab Wajid Ali Shah ke darbar me viksit hua aur bhaav-pradhan nritya ke liye jana jata hai.
GALAT ✗ – Raigarh gharana Raja Chakradhar Singh ne viksit kiya tha, jo Lucknow aur Jaipur dono ka mishran hai. Shambhu Maharaj yahan ke guru nahi the.

festivals.q: Natwari dance belongs to which dance style?
festivals.solution: Natwari dance Kathak ka hi dusra naam hai. Bhagwan Krishna ko 'Natwar' kaha jata hai aur maana jata hai ki unhone hi ye nritya shuru kiya tha. Kathak shabd 'Katha' se aaya hai, jiska matlab hai 'Katha kahe so Kathak kahave'. Isme Krishna ki Raslila aur Radha-Krishna ke prem ko dikhaya jata hai. Yaad rakho: Krishna = Natwar = Natwari Dance = Kathak.
why: GALAT ✗ – Kathakali Kerala ka classical dance hai jo apne bhari makeup, costume aur 'Mudras' ke liye jana jata hai. Iska Natwari se lena-dena nahi hai.
SAHI ✓ – Kathak ko hi Natwari nritya ke roop me jana jata hai kyunki ye Lord Krishna (Natwar) ki kahaniyon aur Raslila par aadharit hai.
GALAT ✗ – Kuchipudi Andhra Pradesh ka classical dance hai jo 'Bhagavat Mela' parampara se juda hai. Isme peetal ki thali (Brass plate) par dance kiya jata hai.
GALAT ✗ – Odissi Odisha ka nritya hai jo 'Tribhanga' mudra ke liye famous hai. Iska prachin naam Odra-Magadhi hai, Natwari nahi.

festivals.q: Roshan kumari, Shovana Narayan, Maya Rao and kumudini Lakhia are famous _____ artists.
festivals.solution: Roshan Kumari, Shovana Narayan (IAS officer bhi rahi hain), Maya Rao (choreographer) aur Kumudini Lakhia (Kadamb School ki founder) sabhi Kathak ki diggaj kalakar hain. Kathak me 'Ghungroo' aur 'Tatkar' (footwork) ka bahut mahatva hai. Yaad rakho: 'Kumari', 'Narayan' aur 'Lakhia' exam me baar-baar puche jane wale Kathak names hain.
why: SAHI ✓ – Ye sabhi mahila kalakar Kathak nritya se judi hain aur inhone is art form ko global level par pehchan dilayi hai.
GALAT ✗ – Manipuri nritya me Jhaveri behne (Darshana, Nayana, etc.) aur Guru Bipin Singh famous hain. Inka style soft aur graceful hota hai.
GALAT ✗ – Kuchipudi me Yamini Krishnamurthy aur Raja-Radha Reddy jaise naam aate hain. Diye gaye naam is style se nahi jude hain.
GALAT ✗ – Odissi me Kelucharan Mohapatra aur Madhavi Mudgal jaise kalakar prashiddh hain. Is prashn ke context me ye galat hai.

festivals.q: The sangeet Natak Akademi of India has recognized 8 dance forms of Indian classical dance. Which of the following is not included in these?
festivals.solution: Sangeet Natak Akademi (SNA) ne kul 8 classical dances ko recognition di hai: Bharatnatyam (TN), Kathak (UP), Kuchipudi (AP), Odissi (Odisha), Kathakali (Kerala), Mohiniyattam (Kerala), Manipuri (Manipur), aur Sattriya (Assam). Note: Culture Ministry 'Chhau' ko bhi 9th classical dance maanti hai, lekin SNA sirf 8 ko hi maanti hai. Yaad rakho: SNA = 8, Ministry of Culture = 9.
why: GALAT ✗ – Sattriya Assam ka classical dance hai jise Mahapurush Sankaradev ne 15th century me shuru kiya tha. Ye SNA ki list me shamil hai.
GALAT ✗ – Bharatnatyam Tamil Nadu ka sabse purana classical dance hai (Sadir Attam). Ye bhi SNA list me shamil hai.
GALAT ✗ – Kuchipudi Andhra Pradesh ka shastriya nritya hai jo SNA dwara recognized 8 dances me se ek hai.
SAHI ✓ – Chhau (tribal/folk origin) ko Sangeet Natak Akademi ne classical status nahi diya hai, ise 'Semi-classical' ya folk ki category me rakha jata hai.

festivals.q: Select the correct combination of Indian classical dances and their respective dancers.
festivals.solution: Elam Endira Devi Manipur ki ek prashiddh Manipuri dancer hain, jinhe unke yogdan ke liye Padma Shri se nawaza gaya hai. Aise questions me dancer aur unke state-specific dance ka pair check karna hota hai. Yaad rakho: Guru Bipin Singh = Manipuri, Birju Maharaj = Kathak, aur Surendra Nath Jena = Odissi.
why: GALAT ✗ – Guru Bipin Singh Manipuri nritya ke 'Bhishmapitamah' maane jate hain, Mohiniyattam ke nahi. Mohiniyattam Kerala ka hai.
GALAT ✗ – Pandit Birju Maharaj Kathak (Lucknow Gharana) ke sabse bade kalakar the. Sattriya Assam ka dance hai, jiske liye Sankaradev famous hain.
GALAT ✗ – Surendra Nath Jena Odissi nritya ke ek bahut bade guru aur kalakar the, Kuchipudi ke nahi.
SAHI ✓ – Elam Endira Devi Manipuri dance ki ek pratishthit kalakar hain. Ye combination bilkul sahi hai.
